### [1] [Sparse tensor networks for individual tree diameter estimation in mixed forests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37784)
*Clara Lößl,Fabian Ewald Fassnacht,Viacheslav Barkov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出轻量稀疏张量网络TreeNext，从无人机激光扫描点云直接回归单木胸径，自动分割数据上R²=0.8355，优于RF/XGBoost。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 森林清查需大面积DBH测量，人工调查不现实；ULS虽可规模化，但冠层遮挡导致茎干点密度低，QSMs与圆拟合等重建方法受限。

Method: 在德国四个混交温带林样地采集ULS数据，构建从单木实例分割到DBH回归的全自动流程；改进现有稀疏张量网络，提出轻量架构TreeNext，直接对体素化点云做树木参数估计，并与随机森林、XGBoost等表格基线对比，同时用真值分割衡量分割误差影响。

Result: 自动分割树木上R²=0.8355，真值分割上R²=0.9380，均优于强表格基线；分割质量是自动化流程中的主导误差来源；模型数据效率高，小样本场景仍表现良好。

Conclusion: 稀疏张量网络是ULS自动化单木DBH估计的实用基础，端到端深度学习优于手工特征与点云重建方法。

Abstract: Measurements of tree diameter at breast height (DBH) are fundamental to forest inventories, but manual surveys across entire stands or regions are impractical. UAV-borne laser scanning (ULS) enables scalable automated forest surveys, yet canopy occlusion makes accurate DBH estimation from ULS point clouds non-trivial. Limited stem-level point density of ULS data constrains approaches relying on detailed stem reconstruction, such as Quantitative Structure Models (QSMs) and circle fitting. Empirical machine learning methods based on predefined point cloud metrics are an alternative. New deep learning approaches offer an even more principled solution, allowing models to learn directly from point clouds. Sparse tensor networks have shown particular promise, transforming forestry tasks such as tree species classification. We investigate whether these strengths can be extended to estimate individual tree DBH from ULS data across four mixed-species temperate forest plots in Germany. We further advance existing sparse tensor networks by introducing TreeNext, a lightweight deep learning architecture for direct individual tree parameter estimation from voxelized LiDAR point clouds. We present a fully automated forest inventory pipeline from individual tree instance segmentation to DBH regression, and quantify the impact of segmentation errors by comparing performance on automatically segmented and ground truth instances. TreeNext achieves an $R^2$ of 0.8355 on automatically segmented trees and 0.9380 on ground truth segments, outperforming strong tabular baselines including Random Forest and XGBoost. Segmentation quality emerges as the dominant error source in the automated pipeline. TreeNext proves highly data-efficient, performing well even in small data scenarios. Our findings establish sparse tensor networks as a practical foundation for automated individual tree DBH estimation from ULS.

</details>


### [2] [GOFish: Full Field-of-View Gaussian Splatting and Mesh Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37818)
*Allen Tu,Meher Gitika Karumuri,Shifan Zhu,Hailing Wang,Yen-Liang Lin,David Held,Matthias Zwicker,Tom Goldstein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GOFish是首个直接在鱼眼图像上训练的三维高斯泼溅表面重建方法，可渲染超过180°的视场并从同一场景提取对齐的网格，实现无需LiDAR的仿真就绪数字孪生。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人、自动驾驶和消费级360°相机使用鱼眼镜头获取宽视场，仿真就绪的数字孪生需要全视场照片级渲染和对齐的碰撞网格。但已有鱼眼高斯泼溅方法仅能光栅化至180°且不产生网格，而高斯表面重建方法假设针孔训练图像。

Method: 在鱼眼图像上直接训练3D高斯泼溅表面重建：校准致密化（Calibrated Densification）恢复全视场表面；校准Mip滤波（Calibrated Mip Filtering）与广角外观建模（Wide-Angle Appearance Modeling）将像素模糊与镜头衰减排除出场景和网格。

Result: 在200° FIORD和205° FullCircle基准上，PSNR分别比最佳先前方法提升2.28 dB和1.97 dB；在其自身视场内优于鱼眼渲染基线；在FIORD和ScanNet++主集上取得最高网格F-score。

Conclusion: 高斯场景与网格共同构成无需LiDAR的仿真就绪数字孪生，支持实时渲染、全视场光线追踪并提供碰撞几何。

Abstract: Robots, autonomous vehicles, and consumer 360° cameras use fisheye lenses for wide fields of view (FoVs). Simulation-ready digital twins require photorealistic rendering across the full FoV and an aligned collision mesh. However, prior fisheye Gaussian Splatting methods only rasterize up to 180° and do not produce meshes, while Gaussian surface reconstruction methods assume pinhole training images. We present GOFish, the first 3D Gaussian Splatting surface reconstruction method to train directly on fisheye images, rasterize FoVs beyond 180°, and extract an aligned mesh from the same scene. Calibrated densification recovers the surface across the entire FoV, while Calibrated Mip Filtering and Wide-Angle Appearance Modeling keep pixel blur and lens falloff out of the scene and mesh. Across the 200° FIORD and 205° FullCircle benchmarks, GOFish improves PSNR over the best prior method by 2.28 and 1.97 dB, respectively. It also outperforms fisheye rendering baselines within their own FoVs and achieves the highest mesh F-score on FIORD and the main ScanNet++ set. Together, the Gaussian scene and mesh form a LiDAR-free, simulation-ready digital twin that renders in real time, ray traces the full FoV, and provides collision geometry.

</details>


### [3] [The Power Watershed as a Differentiable Segmentation Layer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38516)
*Galia Akl,Laurent Najman,Hugues Talbot*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文将分水岭变换（Watershed）作为深度网络最后一层，通过可微的幂分水岭（Power Watershed, PW）极限实现端到端训练，从而把软预测转成精确边界并直接完成实例分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分水岭是经典形态学分割工具，但难以直接嵌入深度网络端到端训练。作者想探究：能否把分水岭放在网络末端并"训穿"，从而让网络直接输出实例级分割而非依赖后处理。

Method: 利用 PW 是带种子随机游走（RW）在 p→∞ 时的极限这一性质：对任意有限 p，RW 求解稀疏正定线性系统，可通过一次伴随求解精确地对边权与 unary 求导；多标签情形每标签一个右端项。作者将这一族作为网络末层（WS 层），研究随 p 变化的求解、梯度与收敛到极限的距离等条件性，并用展开法校验隐式梯度。实验中在 PanNuke 上用实例作标签训练该分区。

Result: 合成数据上 WS 层可将软预测变为精确边界；PanNuke 上二值 WS 层与阈值化 U-Net 持平；以实例为标签时网络变为实例分割器，标签数由 marker 每图决定，忽略层布局。实例 F1 从 0.656 升至 0.795，与调好 marker 的分水岭后处理持平。有限温度下求解可"对冲"，折扣弱 marker 并共享争议像素；仅用十分之一数据训练时领先基线 0.015–0.020 F1，代价是推理需部署有限 p 解而非精确极限。

Conclusion: 分水岭变换可置于深度网络末端并端到端训练；有限温度 PW 层兼具可微性与对弱 marker 的鲁棒性，能直接实现实例分割，并在小数据条件下优于基线。

Abstract: Can a Watershed transform, the classical tool of morphological segmentation, be placed at the end of a deep network and trained through? The Power Watershed (PW) is the limit of the seeded Random Walker (RW) as p grows to infinity with edge weights raised to the power p. At every finite p the RW solves a sparse positive-definite linear system and is exactly differentiable with respect to the edge weights and the unaries through one adjoint solve; its multi-label form costs one right-hand side per label, and its limit is the PW. We study this family as the last layer of a segmentation network, the watershed layer (WS layer). A conditioning study measures how the solve, the gradient and the distance to the limit evolve with p, and the implicit gradient is checked against unrolling. On synthetic data with correct edge costs the WS layer transforms a soft prediction into an exact boundary. On nuclei segmentation (PanNuke), a binary WS layer is level with a thresholded U-Net. With the instances as labels, the WS layer turns the U-Net into an instance segmenter whose number of labels is set per image by the markers rather than by the output layout, and the network is trained through that partition: instance F1 score rises from 0.656 to 0.795 over a U-Net with connected components, level with the same network followed by a tuned marker watershed. At the training temperature the partition is a watershed of the learned costs, and the finite temperature lets the solve hedge, discounting weak markers and sharing contested pixels. The hedging puts the WS layer 0.015--0.020 F1 ahead of the baseline when trained on a tenth of the data, at the price of having to deploy the finite-p solve rather than its exact limit at inference. Code and the full experimental record are released.

</details>


### [4] [Convex Potential Learning for Optimal Transport Between Medical Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37844)
*Hongyu Kan,Ivan Medri,Natasha Ironside,Kristofor Pas,Richard Corp,Shinjini Kundu,Gustavo Kunde Rohde*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出通过参数化凸势函数来估计最优传输映射的新方法，构造上保证映射无旋（符合Brenier定理），在2D/3D医学图像上获得更低传输估计误差与更优重建质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学图像形态学分析中计算最优传输映射很重要，但现有方法要么难以扩展到大型3D医学图像，要么依赖正则化形式只能得到近似传输映射，影响下游医学图像分析的精度。

Method: 参数化凸势函数（convex potential function）来估计最优传输映射，使所得映射在构造上即是curl-free（无旋），并与Brenier定理一致；在2D和3D医学影像数据集上进行评估。

Result: 实验结果表明，相比现有方法，该方法取得更低的传输估计误差，并产生更高质量的图像重建结果。

Conclusion: 基于凸势函数参数化的最优传输估计可兼顾准确性与可扩展性，为医学图像形态学分析提供更精确的传输映射。

Abstract: Computing optimal transport maps between medical images plays a fundamental role in morphological analysis. However, existing methods are either difficult to scale to large 3D medical images or rely on regularized formulations that provide only approximate transport maps. To improve the accuracy of downstream medical image analysis, we propose a novel approach for estimating optimal transport maps by parameterizing the convex potential function. By construction, the resulting transport map is guaranteed to be curl-free, consistent with Brenier's theorem. We evaluate the proposed method on both 2D and 3D medical imaging datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves lower transport estimation errors and produces higher-quality image reconstructions than existing methods.

</details>


### [5] [Effects of Deep Learning Architecture and Pretraining on Automated Vocal Fold Segmentation in Ex Vivo High-Speed Phonation Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37860)
*Varun Vinayak Kalaiarasan,Charles Farbos de Luzan,Khalid Malik,Ephraim Gutmark,Liran Oren*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究首次将深度学习用于二维声门内PIV的声带分割，基于16,344张离体犬喉高速图像基准测试6条流程（UNet、UNet++、TransUNet、Swin-UNet含/不含ImageNet预训练），发现各模型DSC差异极小(0.9734–0.9764)，主要差异在边界保真度；预训练显著提升TransUNet与Swin-UNet的BF1和HD95。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2D声门内粒子图像测速(PIV)声带实验依赖人工分割，因残余眩光、组织-流场对比度低及示踪粒子斑点干扰使声带边界模糊；需评估网络架构与预训练对自动分割的影响。

Method: 采用227次离体犬喉发声试验的16,344张专家标注图像，标准化协议下以5个随机种子训练6条流程：CNN类UNet、UNet++，混合CNN-Transformer的TransUNet，纯Transformer的Swin-UNet（后两者分别为从头训练与ImageNet预训练）；在50个留出测试试验上用试验级Wilcoxon符号秩检验（Holm校正）比较。

Result: 平均DSC仅0.9734–0.9764；预训练显著提升TransUNet与Swin-UNet的BF1和HD95，Swin-UNet提升幅度约为其四倍；预训练后二者表现相近，而Swin-UNet可训练参数仅约四分之一。无预训练时TransUNet的BF1显著更高、HD95更低，HD95>50像素的图像占比约为两个CNN流程的一半。

Conclusion: 该工作是首个将深度学习应用于2D声门内PIV声带分割的研究；预训练对Transformer类模型边界精度至关重要，Swin-UNet在参数更少时可达同等性能；为噪声光学条件或大形变对象的实验流场可视化图像分割提供了参考框架。

Abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) intraglottal particle image velocimetry (PIV) of ex vivo phonation experiments quantifies vocal fold medial surface dynamics and the intraglottal flow field. However, it relies on manual segmentation because residual glare, low tissue-to-flow contrast, and tracer-particle speckle obscure the vocal fold boundaries. This study assessed how deep learning architecture and ImageNet pretraining affect automated vocal fold segmentation in these high-speed images. Four established architectures from three categories were benchmarked: the convolutional neural network (CNN)-based UNet and UNet++, the hybrid CNN-transformer-based TransUNet, and the pure transformer-based Swin-UNet, the latter two trained from scratch and from ImageNet-pretrained weights. Using 16,344 expert-annotated images from 227 phonation trials of excised canine larynges, the six pipelines were trained with five seeds under a standardized protocol and compared on 50 held-out test trials using trial-level Wilcoxon signed-rank tests with Holm correction. Mean Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) spanned only 0.9734 to 0.9764, so the pipelines differed mainly in boundary fidelity. Pretraining significantly improved the boundary F1 score (BF1) and 95th percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95) of the TransUNet and Swin-UNet, about four times more for the Swin-UNet. Once pretrained, the two performed similarly, although the Swin-UNet has only about a quarter of the trainable parameters. Without pretraining, the TransUNet had a significantly higher BF1 and a lower HD95 than both CNN-based pipelines and about half their share of images with HD95 > 50 pixels. To our knowledge, this is the first study to apply deep learning to vocal fold segmentation in 2D intraglottal PIV, and it offers a reference framework for segmenting experimental flow-visualization images with noisy optical conditions or highly deformable objects.

</details>


### [6] [FDSML: Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning with Parameter-Aware Triplet Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39423)
*Hina Otake,Shinei Arakawa,Keitaro Tanaka,Yoshihiro Fukuhara,Hirokatsu Kataoka,Shigeo Morishima*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FDSML（公式驱动的监督度量学习），从图像生成参数中导出关系型监督，替代传统离散标签分类，提升预训练的可迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有FDSL（公式驱动监督学习）无需真实图像即可预训练，但将其视为对离散化标签的分类任务，丢弃了生成过程中的连续性信息。

Method: 提出FDSML：结合改进的分形数据集FineFractalDB（更高类内变化、更稳定结构）与参数感知三元组损失（PA-Triplet Loss），依据IFS（迭代函数系统）参数空间中的距离分配正负样本，使嵌入遵循由参数导出的相对相似性排序。

Result: 迁移至图像检索显著提升，下游分类保持竞争力，多种损坏设置下鲁棒性增强。ResNet-50上，Recall@1在Stanford Online Products从65.6%升至74.0%，Stanford Cars从56.2%升至78.4%。

Conclusion: 参数导出的关系型监督比基于标签的分类为合成预训练提供了更强的信号，尤其在识别之外的迁移任务上更具优势。

Abstract: Formula-Driven Supervised Learning (FDSL) enables vision pre-training without real images, but existing methods cast pre-training as classification on discretized labels, discarding continuity in the generative process. We propose Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning (FDSML), which derives relational supervision from image-generation parameters beyond discrete class labels. FDSML combines FineFractalDB, our refined fractal dataset with higher intra-class variation and more stable structures, with a Parameter-Aware Triplet (PA-Triplet) Loss that assigns positives and negatives according to distances in the underlying Iterated Function System parameter space. This objective trains embeddings to respect parameter-derived relative similarity orderings. Experiments show that FDSML improves transferability to image retrieval while remaining competitive on downstream classification and improving robustness under several corruption settings. On ResNet-50, Recall@1 improves from 65.6% to 74.0% on Stanford Online Products and from 56.2% to 78.4% on Stanford Cars over FDSL pre-training. These results suggest that parameter-derived relational supervision provides a stronger synthetic pre-training signal than label-based classification for transfer beyond recognition.

</details>


### [7] [PairCLIP-SWA: Similarity-Guided Balancing and Stochastic Weight Averaging for Generalized Deepfake Image Detection with OpenCLIP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37874)
*Md. Nakib,Sudipto Sarkar,A. J. A. Jubayer Talukder,Mohammad Ariful Haque*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PairCLIP-SWA单骨干深度伪造检测器，用权重空间平均消除checkpoint选择的不稳定，在DF-Wild-Cup上超越三骨干集成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度伪造检测器通常只部署验证集上得分最高的单一checkpoint，但这一选择的可靠性从未被测量；本文要量化该不稳定性并提出更稳健的方案。

Method: 基于OpenCLIP ViT-L/14视觉塔，采用渐进式block解冻微调；用CLIP相似度引导的一对一子采样构建类别均衡语料；对微调轨迹在权重空间做SWA平均（PairCLIP-SWA）。另做22组同分布配置实验，涵盖预处理消融。

Result: DF-Wild-Cup上达97.04%准确率、98.64% AU-ROC、4.07% EER，优于最强三骨干集成的94.46%/97.60%/5.00%。训练日志显示非平均checkpoint验证准确率摆动5.34个百分点、验证损失翻倍以上，而平均值从不更差，最多高出5.99个百分点。OpenForensics派生基准上，验证准确率选出的checkpoint（验证98.43%）在10,905张图像测试集仅88.85%，误拒21.1%真实照片；而验证排名最后的终点平均值达94.76%。消融显示CLIP预训练（而非集成）是精度主因，二次人脸裁剪损失约34个百分点，频域输入迁移性差。

Conclusion: 单一checkpoint选择不可靠且可能造成严重错排；权重平均提供无成本的稳健性。建议在早停划分上采用按类别的选择准则，并以CLIP预训练骨干为核心而非依赖集成。

Abstract: Deepfake detectors are almost always deployed as the single checkpoint that scored best on a validation split, yet the reliability of that choice is rarely measured. We measure it with PairCLIP-SWA, a single-backbone detector that adapts an OpenCLIP ViT-L/14 visual tower by progressive block unfreezing on a class-balanced corpus built by CLIP-similarity-guided one-to-one subsampling, and averages the fine-tuning trajectory in weight space. Trained in-domain on the IEEE SP Cup 2025 (DF-Wild-Cup) benchmark under the same protocol as the strongest published three-backbone ensemble, the weight-averaged detector reaches 97.04% accuracy, 98.64% AU-ROC and a 4.07% equal error rate, against 94.46%, 97.60% and 5.00%. Its training log shows why averaging matters: over the averaged epochs the non-averaged checkpoint swings across 5.34 points of validation accuracy while its validation loss more than doubles, whereas the average is never worse and is up to 5.99 points better. On an OpenForensics-derived benchmark the same instability becomes a misranking: the checkpoint that validation accuracy selects (98.43%) scores 88.85% on a disjoint 10,905-image test partition, rejecting 21.1% of genuine photographs, while the terminal average, ranked last on validation, scores 94.76%. A study of twenty-two in-house configurations on the identical DF-Wild-Cup split, including preprocessing ablations, shows that CLIP pre-training rather than ensembling drives accuracy, that secondary face cropping costs about 34 points, and that frequency-domain inputs transfer poorly. We recommend per-class selection criteria measured off the early-stopping split.

</details>


### [8] [Intersectional Invariant Learning for Fair Deepfake Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37881)
*Uzoamaka Ezeakunne,Taiwo Olabamipe,Deevesh Jain,Xiuwen Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出交集不变学习(IIL)框架，从特征学习层面而非仅调整输出，缓解深度伪造检测中的跨人群（性别×肤色）公平性差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度伪造检测模型整体准确率高，但在不同人群间性能差异大，某些群体假阳性率显著更高。已有的公平性方法只约束模型输出以均衡群体预测，未解决特征层面的偏差，模型仍可能依赖肤色纹理等人口特征作为间接检测线索。

Method: IIL交替执行两步：识别最具挑战性的人口群体划分，以及学习在这些划分间保持一致的特征。框架还引入假阳性率公平目标，并针对6个性别×肤色交集群体进行群体平衡采样。

Result: 在含超百万图像、10个基线检测器、21项公平性与效用指标的大规模基准上评估，IIL实现帕累托最优：AUC超99%、假阳性率低于2.5%、交集公平差异FMEO最低；在21项指标中大多数优于先前公平性方法，假阳性率与交集公平差异较最强竞争方法降低数倍。

Conclusion: 从特征层面进行不变学习并结合假阳性率公平目标，可同时提升深度伪造检测的效用与交集公平性，优于仅调整输出的现有方法。

Abstract: Deepfake detection models achieve high overall accuracy but exhibit large performance disparities across demographic groups, causing some groups to experience substantially higher false-positive rates than others. Existing fairness-aware methods address this by constraining model outputs to equalize group predictions, but do not tackle the underlying feature-level bias. As a result, models may still rely on demographic characteristics, such as skin texture, as indirect cues for detecting manipulated content. IIL alternates between identifying the most challenging demographic partitions and learning features that remain consistent across those partitions. Results show that IIL achieves Pareto-optimal performance, simultaneously attaining an AUC above 99%, a false-positive rate under 2.5%, and the lowest intersectional fairness disparity (FMEO) among all compared methods. IIL outperforms prior fairness-aware methods on the large majority of the 21 evaluation metrics, while reducing both false-positive rates and intersectional fairness disparities by several-fold compared with the strongest competing method.

</details>


### [9] [FYC: FPR-Disparity Weight Perturbation and Youden Calibration for Fair Deepfake Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37882)
*Uzoamaka Ezeakunne,Taiwo Olabamipe,Deevesh Jain,Xiuwen Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出两阶段后处理法 FYC，在无需重训与人口统计标签的前提下，通过基于 FPR 差异准则的权重扰动与分组阈值校准，显著缩小深度伪造检测器的群体误差差异。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度伪造检测器总体准确率虽高，但跨性别与肤色的假阳性率差异达两位数；现有补救手段要么需要公平性目标的全量重训，要么依赖人口统计标注数据，或仅为不改变权重的无标签事后校准，在仅有预训练权重的场景下均不实用。

Conclusion: FPR 差异准则相比 DP 更稳健、可跨架构泛化，FYC 为已有检测器提供低成本的即插即用公平性提升方案；公平准则的选择是决定后处理权重扰动成败的关键因素。

Abstract: Deepfake detectors routinely achieve high aggregate accuracy while exhibiting substantial demographic disparities in their errors: false-positive rates differ by double digits across gender and skin tone. Most existing remedies require either full retraining with a fairness-aware objective or demographic-annotated training data, both impractical when only a pretrained checkpoint is available, while label-free post-hoc calibrators leave the detector's weights unchanged. We introduce FYC (FPR-disparity Weight Perturbation and Youden Calibration), a two-stage post-hoc method that perturbs a detector's weights under an FPR-disparity criterion, then calibrates a separate decision threshold for each demographic group - requiring no architectural changes and no full retraining. Evaluated against every detector benchmarked on AI-Face v2 across six intersectional gender x skin-tone groups, FYC outperforms the field on 18 of 21 reported fairness and utility metrics, including purpose-built fairness architectures, at a fraction of the training cost. We further identify why the choice of fairness criterion is critical: the original Demographic Parity objective used in prior weight-perturbation work is architecture-dependent and unpredictable, improving two of four evaluated architectures, leaving a third largely unchanged, and substantially degrading the fourth (PG-FDD), with no way to anticipate the outcome for a given checkpoint in advance. </details>


### [10] [Read, Allocate, Route: Role-Coupled Tokenization for Pixel-Space Generative Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40647)
*Jiongfan Yang,Weichen Fan,Haiwen Diao,Zhongang Cai,Ziwei Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SpecSlot 是一种像素空间 rectified-flow Transformer，通过让每个空间锚点分裂成多个 slot、各 slot 负责不重叠的 DCT 频带，使全局注意力序列长度与输出细节解耦，从而以更低成本获得更高细节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 像素空间生成 Transformer 通常一个图像 patch 一个 token，要生成更细的细节就需要更多 token，全局注意力代价随之急剧上升。作者观察到：细节更细并不必然需要更多全局通信——低频结构需要全局交互，而高频细节可在局部建模。

Method: 核心做法是解耦"锚点密度"与"频带细分"：每个空间锚点扩展为多个 slot，每个 slot 分配一段不相交的 DCT 系数；仅每个锚点中最低频的 slot 参与全局注意力，所有 slot 只在局部交互。另加一个 spatial head，对频谱预测做局部修正；而生成状态、目标与损失仍保持在像素空间。

Result: ImageNet-256 上，与 FLOPs 匹配的 JiT 基线相比最终 FID 相当且收敛更快；ImageNet-512 上 FID 改善 2.84，FLOPs 少 3.9%，与 JiT-B/16 仅差 0.69 FID 而计算量低 38.2%；文本到图像在 DPG-Bench 上超过 JiT-B/8 达 1.06，前向成本低 40.6%。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，将全局通信限制在低频 slot、把高频细节交由局部与频带 slot 处理，是一种可扩展且高效提升像素空间生成细节的方式，在多种任务和分辨率上均取得更好质量-计算权衡。

Abstract: Pixel-space generative Transformers typically use one token per image patch, so capturing finer detail requires more tokens and makes global attention increasingly expensive. We observe that finer detail does not necessarily require more global communication: low-frequency structure benefits from global exchange, while high-frequency detail can be modeled locally. Based on this insight, we introduce SpecSlot, a pixel-space rectified-flow Transformer that decouples output detail from the length of the global attention sequence. SpecSlot expands each spatial anchor into multiple slots, each assigned a disjoint band of DCT coefficients; this separates anchor density from spectral subdivision. Only the lowest-frequency slot from each anchor participates in global attention, while all slots interact locally. This allows the model to increase spectral detail without enlarging the global sequence. A spatial head further adds a local correction to the spectral prediction, while the generative state, target, and loss remain in pixel space. On ImageNet-256, SpecSlot achieves a comparable final FID to a FLOPs-matched JiT control while converging faster. On ImageNet-512, it improves FID by 2.84 over the control with 3.9% fewer FLOPs, and comes within only 0.69 FID of JiT-B/16 at 38.2% lower cost. On text-to-image generation, SpecSlot surpasses JiT-B/8 on DPG-Bench by 1.06 at 40.6% lower forward cost.

</details>

*Chenfan Qu,Yachao Liang,Mingqi Fang,Jiangwei Xie,Zhenming Wang,Baoyue Zhang,Changjiang Jiang,Zheng Chang,Fanli Jin,Xuekang Zhu,Kaiwen Feng,Junchi Li,Weihong Zhang,Haoyue Wang,Chenfeng Zhang,Yinan Xia,Fangming Cui,Dong Fan,Jingjing Liu,Tianyi Zhang,Luobin Chen,Ji-Zhe Zhou,Sheng Li,Wei Wang,Bin Li,Ran He,Xinpeng Zhang,Linna Zhou,Jian Liu,Weiqiang Wang*

TL;DR: Venus-DefakerOne2 是一个统一的防伪基础模型，同时覆盖数字篡改与物理欺骗、图像与视频，在六类取证基准上取得新的 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实伪造高度异构：既有数字篡改也有物理欺骗，载体既有图像也有视频。现有方法虽有进展，但尚缺乏覆盖如此宽威胁谱的统一防伪基础模型。

Method: 基于数千万开源与自研样本训练；提出 Tide-Style-Tuning，交替使用 LoRA 与全参数微调，兼顾算力效率、泛化性与难样本拟合，并缓解灾难性遗忘；采用基于熵的测试时自适应，通过分析预测熵确定最优预测模态。

Conclusion: Venus-DefakerOne2 在伪造形式与媒体类型两个维度大幅拓展取证能力边界，可作为二分类取证任务中强大且通用的基础模型。

Abstract: Real-world forgery is inherently heterogeneous: it manifests not only as digital manipulation but also as physical spoofing, and is carried not only by images but also by videos. Despite substantial progress, a unified anti-forgery foundation model covering such a broad threat spectrum remains absent. In this paper, we present Venus-DefakerOne2, which substantially extends the forensic capability boundary along both the forgery-form and media-type dimensions. Trained on tens of millions of open-source and in-house samples, it incorporates two key designs. Tide-Style-Tuning alternates LoRA and full-parameter fine-tuning to balance computational efficiency, generalization, and hard-sample fitting while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Entropy-based Test Adaptation determines the optimal prediction modality by analyzing prediction entropy. Venus-DefakerOne2 achieves new state-of-the-art performance across a comprehensive suite of benchmarks, including DeepFake faces (96.7%), AI-generated images (93.3%), tampered documents (87.6%), manipulated natural images (89.6%), physical spoofs (93.1%), and AI-generated videos (96.0%). It significantly outperforms both specialized expert models and its predecessor, DefakerOne, establishing itself as a powerful and versatile foundation model for binary-decision forensic tasks.

</details>

*Hamza Etcibasi,Ramazan Gokberk Cinbis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RPKD提出用共享的随机初始化冻结原型库替代师生特征空间对齐，在外部参考空间中完成知识蒸馏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 打破"教师与学生表征必须处于兼容或对齐的特征空间"这一普遍假设，并解决logit类方法在类别数少时监督信号坍缩的问题。

Method: 构建随机初始化且冻结的原型向量库作为共享参考空间；教师侧用无参数的固定随机映射投影，仅学生端可训练；分两支：logit支对齐全局原型相似度分布，特征支匹配空间解析的原型激活图；原型库与蒸馏目标跨师生对保持不变，仅输入投影按架构实例化。

Abstract: A widely held assumption in knowledge distillation is that teacher and student representations must occupy a compatible or explicitly aligned feature space. We propose RPKD (Random Prototype Knowledge Distillation), which discards this assumption by comparing both networks against a shared bank of randomly initialized, frozen prototype vectors. Alignment is therefore carried out in an external reference space rather than in the teacher's native feature coordinates: the teacher side is projected by fixed random maps that carry no trainable parameters, and only the student adapts. Two branches handle the transfer: a logit branch aligning global prototype similarity distributions and a feature branch matching spatially-resolved prototype activation maps. Both operate within the same fixed prototype space, which can be interpreted as a random feature embedding that approximately preserves inter-sample similarity structure, so the prototype bank and the distillation objective stay unchanged across teacher-student pairs while only the input projections are instantiated per architecture. In low-category settings, decoupling the prototype vocabulary from the task label space yields richer supervision than the label space alone, an advantage absent from logit-based methods, whose supervisory signal collapses as class count shrinks. This advantage is especially relevant in real-world scenarios where the label space is typically constrained. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of RPKD, achieving a maximum gain of +7.98% over OFA on CIFAR-100, +12.44% on ImageNet-100, and +1.28% on ImageNet-1K. Source code is available at https://github.com/HamzaEtcibasi/RPKD

</details>

*Marat O. Zinovev,Dmitry V. Sorokin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该工作研究用元初始化加速KAN-IDIR隐式神经表示可变形医学图像配准的逐对优化过程，在OASIS-1上比较Reptile元初始化与STRAINER共享分量迁移两种方案，发现早期迭代两者均优于随机初始化，Reptile数值上更优但预训练成本高得多。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: INR配准方法需对每个新图像对重新优化网络参数，适应速度是实际应用的瓶颈；作者希望检验能否从既往已求解的配准任务中学习一个初始化，从而加速早期适应。

Method: 以KAN-IDIR作为基础INR位移场模型，研究两种初始化方案：Reptile元初始化，以及STRAINER对坐标网络共享分量的迁移。在OASIS-1上实验，364个连续图像对用于训练，49个用于测试时适应；以平均Dice、HD95以及第1500次迭代时负雅可比行列式体素比例作为评价指标。

Result: 在所研究配置下，两种方案在早期迭代均比随机初始化获得更高Dice和更低HD95。小迭代预算下Reptile数值上优于STRAINER，但二者预训练预算并不匹配；随迭代次数增加，方案间差异缩小。STRAINER预训练耗时39–40分钟，而Reptile需44.98小时。

Conclusion: 学习式初始化可有效加速INR配准的早期适应，Reptile在少量迭代下精度略优，STRAINER则以显著更低的预训练成本获得相近效果；随迭代增加收益递减，且由于预训练预算未对齐，结论仍属初步。

Abstract: Implicit neural representation (INR) methods for deformable medical image registration require the network parameters to be optimized for each new image pair, making adaptation speed a practical limitation. This work investigates whether early adaptation can be accelerated using an initialization learned from a collection of previously solved registration tasks. We examine two schemes: Reptile meta-initialization and STRAINER transfer of the shared component of a coordinate network. KAN-IDIR is used as the base INR displacement-field model. Experiments are conducted on OASIS-1, with 364 consecutive pairs used for training and 49 pairs for test-time adaptation. Registration quality is evaluated using mean Dice and HD95, together with the fraction of voxels with a negative Jacobian determinant at iteration 1500. In the configurations studied, both schemes yield higher Dice and lower HD95 at early iterations than random initialization. Reptile numerically outperforms STRAINER under a small iteration budget, although their pretraining budgets are not matched. As the number of iterations increases, the differences between the schemes shrink. STRAINER pretraining takes 39-40 minutes, compared with 44.98 hours for Reptile.

</details>


### [14] [Hierarchical Diffusion for Camera-controlled Autoregressive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37983)
*Kaihua Chen,Yiming Gong,Deva Ramanan,Tarasha Khurana*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出WanAR+FixAR轻量框架，将视频生成重构为warping-and-inpainting问题，并用分层长上下文去噪策略缓解长视频自回归误差累积，在RealEstate10k和DL3DV上实现相机可控、时序稳定的长视频生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单图长视频相机可控生成中，主流自回归范式存在两大问题：(1)远处帧依赖已生成输出而非真值，导致时间上误差累积与漂移；(2)相机控制的融入方式存在歧义。现有方案（self-forcing、显式6-DOF位姿条件）要么计算开销大，要么场景几何随时间漂移。

Method: 结合自回归生成(WanAR)与分层长上下文去噪(FixAR)。借鉴前馈新视角合成，将视频生成重构为warping-and-inpainting问题以保持场景几何与输入相机一致；采用从粗到细的分层去噪：先用紧邻过去帧条件生成，再由第二个去噪器以时间下采样的长程历史为条件进行精修，实现全局一致性而不显著增加成本。

Result: 在RealEstate10k和DL3DV数据集上，WanAR+FixAR优于先前的相机可控长视频生成方法，结果兼具时序稳定性与对输入相机轨迹的一致性。

Conclusion: 通过warping-and-inpainting重构与分层长上下文去噪，可在低成本下让每帧有效利用完整时序上下文，缓解漂移并实现几何一致的相机可控长视频生成。

Abstract: We address the task of long-video, camera-controlled generation from a single image. The dominant autoregressive paradigm suffers from two key limitations: (1) error accumulation over time, as distant frames are conditioned on previously generated outputs rather than ground truth, leading to drift; and (2) ambiguity in how to incorporate camera control. Standard solutions to both--such as self-forcing and conditioning on explicit 6-DOF poses--either incur significant computational overhead or produce drifting scene geometries over time. We propose a simple and lightweight framework that combines autoregressive generation (WanAR) with hierarchical long-context denoising (FixAR). To enforce scene geometry remains consistent with input cameras, we draw from feed-forward novel-view synthesis and reformulate video generation as a warping-and-inpainting problem. To mitigate drift, we introduce a hierarchical denoising strategy in which different stages condition on different temporal histories. Specifically, we first generate frames conditioned on the immediate past, and then refine them using a second denoiser conditioned on a temporally subsampled long-range history to enforce global consistency. This fine-to-coarse scheme enables each generated frame to effectively condition on the full temporal context without incurring a prohibitive cost. Experiments on RealEstate10k and DL3DV demonstrate that WanAR+FixAR outperforms prior methods for camera-controlled long-video generation, producing results that are both temporally stable and consistent with input camera trajectories.

</details>


### [15] [Frequency-Adaptive Gaussian Grids for Efficient Image Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38007)
*Anatolii Evdokimov,Stavros Diolatzis,Bingxuan Li,Akshay Jindal,Patsorn Sangkloy,Qi Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Gaussian-Grid混合神经表示，按局部频率内容动态分配2D高斯基元与多分辨率特征网格的计算，自动匹配信号复杂度，用以提升高分辨率图像表示与存储效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率图像需求激增，需高效神经表示；但结构化表示（特征网格，具空间一致性）与无结构化表示（2D高斯，适应局部变化）之间存在根本性权衡，单一选择难以兼顾，影响表示质量。

Method: 构建混合表示：将2D高斯分布与其附着的多分辨率特征网格结合，依据局部频率内容在两者间动态分配计算量，从而自动优化架构以匹配目标信号的内在复杂度。

Result: 在高分辨率自然图像上评估，作为GPU原生数据集存储时，相比JPEG+ZIP归档解码速度提升1.24–2.14×，PCIe数据流量减少23–176×；同时保持小内存占用与高重建保真度。

Conclusion: Gaussian-Grid通过自适应融合结构化与无结构化基元，在多种数据集上兼顾小内存与高保真重建，并显著提升解码速度、降低传输开销，适合作为GPU原生数据存储方案。

Abstract: Neural representation has emerged as a powerful tool to mitigate the demand for increasingly higher-resolution images. However, a fundamental trade-off remains between structured (e.g., feature grids, which offer spatial consistency) and unstructured (e.g., 2D Gaussians, which adaptively capture local variances) representations. This choice significantly affects how well an algorithm represents an image. Here, we present Gaussian-Grid, a hybrid neural representation that adaptively integrates structured and unstructured primitives. By dynamically partitioning computation between 2D Gaussian distributions and their attached multi-resolution feature grids based on the local frequency content, Gaussian-Grid automatically optimizes its architecture to match the underlying complexity of the target signal. We evaluate our approach using high-resolution natural images and demonstrate its applications as GPU-native dataset storage, showing $1.24$-$2.14\times$ decoding speed improvement and PCIe data traffic reduction of $23\times$-$176\times$ over JPEG + ZIP data archiving. The results show that Gaussian-Grid maintains small memory footprints while achieving high reconstruction fidelity across a variety of datasets.

</details>


### [16] [Where Can We Fool the Model's Mind? Response-Guided Semantic Probing and Adaptive Routing for Transferable Attacks on Black-Box MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38013)
*Ahmed Abdelnaby,Mohamed Elmahallawy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VISTA 是一种黑盒多模态大模型对抗攻击框架，通过从模型响应中构建"不确定性多模态行为"脆弱性地图，聚焦语义脆弱区域进行扰动，在 GPT-5、Gemini-3.5-Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.6 上实现高达 97% 攻击成功率且 PSNR>30dB，纯迁移设定下也能达 93% ASR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对多模态大模型的可迁移黑盒攻击依赖替代模型的显著性分配扰动，但这种显著性未必反映未知目标模型在语义上如何解释或依赖图像不同区域，因此扰动分配不够精准、迁移效果受限。

Method: 提出 VISTA 黑盒框架，无需梯度、logits、参数或内部表示，仅从 MLLM 响应中识别语义脆弱区域。含两种设定：VISTA-Proxy（纯迁移，探测开源 MLLM 后迁移到未见商业模型）与 VISTA-Victim（查询辅助，探测目标模型）。核心是构建基于响应漂移、冲突、误导和语义偏移的"不确定性多模态行为（UBMB）"地图，再用熵自适应 Sinkhorn 路由与替代模型集成将扰动集中于脆弱区域。

Result: 在 GPT-5、Gemini-3.5-Flash 和 Claude Sonnet 4.6 上，ASR 最高达 97%，同时 PSNR 保持在 30 dB 以上；VISTA-Proxy 在不查询最终受害者的情况下 ASR 最高达 93%，证明响应衍生的语义脆弱性可有效跨异构 MLLM 迁移。

Conclusion: 响应层面的语义脆弱性信息可作为有效的扰动导向信号，实现高成功率、低可感知度且强迁移性的黑盒攻击，揭示了异质 MLLM 间共享的语义弱点，对 MLLM 鲁棒性提出警示。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) ground language in visual evidence, yet their semantic reasoning can be exploited through transferable black-box adversarial attacks. Existing attacks typically allocate perturbations using surrogate-model saliency, which may not reflect how an unseen MLLM semantically interprets or relies on different image regions. We introduce VISTA (Vulnerability-Informed Semantic Transfer Attacks), a black-box framework that identifies semantically vulnerable visual regions from an MLLM's responses without access to gradients, logits, parameters, or internal representations. VISTA supports two attack settings: (i) VISTA-Proxy, a pure-transfer setting that probes an open-source MLLM and transfers the resulting adversarial examples to unseen commercial MLLMs without querying them; and (ii) VISTA-Victim, a query-assisted setting that probes the target MLLM to capture model-specific semantic vulnerabilities. VISTA builds an Uncertainty-Based Multimodal Behavior (UBMB) map from response drift, conflict, misleading, and semantic shifts, then uses entropy-adaptive Sinkhorn routing and a surrogate ensemble to focus perturbations on vulnerable regions. Across GPT-5, Gemini-3.5-Flash, and Claude Sonnet 4.6, VISTA achieves up to 97 % attack success rate (ASR) while maintaining a Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) above 30 dB. Notably, VISTA-Proxy achieves up to 93 % ASR without querying the final victim, demonstrating that response-derived semantic vulnerability can enable effective transfer across heterogeneous MLLMs.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: 跨视角泛化是网球事件检测的核心瓶颈；无标签仲裁方法在困难视角上更稳健但击球时序精度不足，微调可部分弥合域差异；标注、评测器及各方法冻结预测已公开。

Abstract: Ball bounces and racket hits are the events from which tennis statistics are derived, and on monocular video the two are easy to confuse. We release a benchmark of 345 bounce and hit annotations at frame level on eight clips that mix broadcast, fixed elevated, phone and court-level viewpoints, with a frozen development and test split, a confusion-aware matcher, clip-level bootstrap intervals and a blind second annotation of three clips. On it we score supervised precise spotters with published broadcast weights, two zero-shot vision-language models, and RallyArb, an arbitration layer over a ball track and player poses that fits no parameter on event labels. The supervised spotters score near-perfectly on broadcast footage and almost nothing on phone and court-level footage, where the pooled bounce F1 of E2E-Spot is 0.130. RallyArb keeps a bounce F1 above 0.8 on the three phone and court-level clips, two of which were used to tune it, and finds 8 of 11 bounces on the held-out one, but it places hits too far from the contact frame to match human timing. The vision-language models detect events on every viewpoint and miss the contact frame by about 0.1 s. Fine-tuned leave-one-clip-out from its broadcast weights, the spotter reaches about 0.8 bounce F1 on two phone and court-level clips and stays at 0.2 on a grazing phone angle. The annotations, the evaluator and the frozen predictions of every scored row are released.

</details>

Abstract: Objectives: Agencies invest in bicycle facilities but lack tools to assess whether cyclists use them as designed. We examine whether usage patterns follow facility configurations and whether higher bike lane usage is associated with less wrong-way riding.
  Methods: Motion-triggered cameras covered 19 deployments at 17 locations in Tempe, Arizona, in 2023. Manual review identified 1,963 cycling events; excluding 20 crossings left 1,943 labeled events for analysis. An automated pipeline on the same captures counted 92.9 percent of the full manual total (per-deployment r = 0.99), and every automated wrong-way call was visually verified. Deployments were classified using thresholds on facility usage shares.
  Findings: Deployments were bike-lane dominant (9), sidewalk dominant (6), or mixed (4). Cyclists in bike lanes rode against the flow in 4.6 percent of events; on sidewalks, riders opposed the near-side traffic flow in 49.6 percent. Across deployments, bike lane share and wrong-way rate were negatively correlated (Spearman rho = -0.87, p < 0.001, n = 16). An independent volunteer count in the same city showed a similar sidewalk-direction pattern (rho = 0.79).
  Novelty: The study combines multi-site still-camera observations with a fully hand-verified benchmark to characterize facility use and travel direction.
  Practical Applications: The workflow offers planners a low-cost screen for locations with high sidewalk cycling and travel against the near-side traffic flow, supporting more detailed site investigation.

</details>


### [19] [Vision Tomography: Towards Portable 3D Bidirectional Face-Skull Inference from Visual Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38065)
*Zidu Wang,Meng Xu,Miao Xu,Hengyuan Ma,Jiankuo Zhao,Xutao Li,Zhen Lei,Xiangyu Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Vision Tomography (VT)框架，仅凭图像/素描等视觉输入重建成对3D人脸-颅骨几何，并支持联合编辑，核心是构建200+样本数据集、稠密射线匹配配准和双向人脸-颅骨形变模型BFSM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统CT虽能获取成对3D人脸与颅骨，但成本高、地点固定、有辐射，难以满足远程诊疗、法医鉴定、失踪人口调查与考古等场景对便携、安全、可及3D颅骨采集的需求。

Method: 1) 构建200+样本数据集，每例含CT颅骨、CT人脸和高保真纹理人脸扫描；2) 提出稠密射线匹配配准方法，保证人脸、颅骨及组织对应关系的拓扑一致性；3) 构建3D双向人脸-颅骨形变模型BFSM，通过共享系数空间实现人脸与颅骨间形状互推，并建模组织厚度变化以支持同一颅骨的多对一人脸重建（如年龄、体脂变化）。

Result: 在图像或素描驱动的成对人脸-颅骨重建、以及联合人脸-颅骨编辑预测手术效果等法医与医学应用中验证有效，大量实验证明方法具有稳健性与准确性。

Conclusion: VT为便携、无辐射的3D颅骨-人脸获取与联合建模提供了可行方案，并开源（github.com/wang-zidu/BFSM），可服务于远程诊断、数字医疗、法医鉴定等应用。

Abstract: Traditional computed tomography (CT) can capture paired 3D face and skull geometry, but it remains costly, fixed in location, and exposes patients to radiation. For applications such as remote diagnostics, digital healthcare, forensic identification, missing-person investigation, and archaeological analysis, there is an urgent need for a portable, safe, and accessible solution to capture 3D skull geometry. In this work, we introduce Vision Tomography (VT), a concept and framework capable of reconstructing paired 3D face-skull geometry from various visual modalities, and also enabling joint manipulation of 3D facial and skull geometry. To achieve this, we first construct a dataset of over 200 samples, where each case includes a CT-based skull, a CT-based face, and a high-fidelity textured face scan. Secondly, we propose a novel dense ray matching registration method that ensures topological consistency across face, skull, and their tissue correspondences. Building on this registration, we introduce the 3D Bidirectional Face-Skull Morphable Model (BFSM) as the foundation of Vision Tomography, which enables shape inference between the face and skull through a shared coefficient space, while also modeling tissue thickness variation to support one-to-many facial reconstructions from the same skull, reflecting individual facial changes such as age or body fat. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of Vision Tomography across various forensic and medical applications, including paired 3D face-skull reconstruction from images or sketches and predicting surgical outcomes with joint face-skull editing. Extensive experiments confirm the robustness and accuracy of our method. Vision Tomography is available at https://github.com/wang-zidu/BFSM

</details>

*Jose Guillen,Renzo Zanca,Valentin Barriere*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出AFSeq多模态野火数据集与UTAE-AR自回归模型，实现逐日野火蔓延预报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准（如WSTS）规模受限、只覆盖燃烧数周的大火且环境相似，缺乏对短时小型火灾的代表性，且单步模型无法输出逐日预测。

Conclusion: AFSeq为迄今规模最大、最多样的时序野火预测数据集；轻量自回归架构UTAE-AR在精度、参数效率与长时预测能力上均优于现有方法。

Abstract: Benchmarks such as WildfireSpreadTS (WSTS) have enabled data-driven forecasting of wildfire spread from multimodal satellite time series, but they suffer from limitations: size restricts them to large fires that burn for weeks, and they are from similar environments. We introduce AFSeq, a multimodal dataset of 1,194 recent fire events (2023 to 2026) from 8 different countries across three regions, dominated by the short, small fires that existing benchmarks underrepresent. Our dataset is the largest and most diverse to date for time-series-based wildfire spread prediction. We also introduce UTAE-AR, an extension of a classical U-Net with Temporal Auto Encoder, enhanced with recurrent modules before the decoder. This allows the model to not only predict the next day but the whole sequence in an autoregressive way. Moreover, our model can feed its own predicted fire mask back one day at a time, producing the day-by-day forecasts that single-step models cannot. Our results show that UTAE-AR surpasses state-of-the-art on both WSTS, WSTS+ and AFSeq for next-day accuracy while having 21.5% of their parameters, and being able to predict confidently at a longer horizon.

</details>


### [21] [The Prestige: Benchmarking Cognitive Visual Reasoning using Magic Tricks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38103)
*Shuo Wen,Beixi Du,Edwin Meriaux,Junming Shi,Chloe Si,David Meger,Doina Precup,Gregory Dudek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 The Prestige 视频理解基准，用专业魔术表演中的误导来测试视觉语言模型的认知推理，发现最强模型与人类差距显著，且自动评分与人工评分存在系统性偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频理解基准难以探测模型在刻意误导下的事件追踪与因果解释能力，因此需要一个更具挑战性的认知推理测试平台。

Abstract: We introduce The Prestige, a video understanding benchmark that probes cognitive visual reasoning through professional magic performances, where deliberate misdirection challenges models to track events and explain unexpected outcomes. The benchmark comprises open-ended questions ranging from temporal and causal understanding to robustness against adversarial questions. Evaluation of leading open-source and proprietary VLMs reveals a substantial gap between even the strongest model and human performance. We also find systematic discrepancies between human and automated grading and identify recurring model failure modes. Ablations further show that models can select correct multiple-choice answers even when they fail to generate correct explanations independently, motivating further investigations into question formats. Together, these findings highlight limitations in both VLM reasoning and its evaluation, underscoring the need for more reliable video understanding models and more rigorous benchmarks.

</details>


### [22] [What Does LOL Measure? Hidden Label Shifts in Low-Light Enhancement Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38121)
*Adityan Thirumani Srinivasan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文审计了LOL-v1和LOLv2-Real两个低光照增强基准，发现测试标签与训练标签分布不一致，且社区普遍使用的测试时手动调参与这些偏移相符，导致评测结论可能失真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LOL-v1和LOLv2-Real是监督式低光照图像增强的标准基准，但许多领先方法在评测脚本中附带手工设定的测试时调整参数。作者怀疑这些基准存在训练/测试标签不一致，且这些调整可能是在补偿数据偏移而非真实提升，从而影响排名与方法比较的公正性。

Method: 用统一的指标实现审计两个基准、8种方法的18个公开权重（复现每个已发表数字误差≤0.09 dB）；（i）对比LOL-v1测试标签与LOLv2同源图像的渲染差异；（ii）检验LOLv2-Real测试集（图像690-789连续块）标签比训练标签暗14%的偏移（Cliff's delta=-0.45，p<1e-12）及无监督方法在测试/训练上的差距；（iii）分析LOL-v1测试输入与LOLv2-Real的重叠；最后把可训练集校准的收益与仅靠测试集调参的残差分离。

Result: (i) LOL-v1的15张测试标签渲染与训练标签不同：同源图像在LOLv2中亮度相同但饱和度低1.48倍，且LOL-v1训练标签与LOLv2渲染一致。(ii) LOLv2-Real测试集标签比训练标签暗14%，而无标签训练方法在测试集上最高高出5.5 dB。(iii) LOL-v1全部15张测试输入重现于LOLv2-Real，其中12张在其训练集中。发布的手工测试设置与补偿这些偏移相符：仅测试集残差在无偏移的LOLv2-Syn上中位数为0.00 dB，而在LOL-v1为0.37 dB、LOLv2-Real为0.92 dB（最高3.9 dB）；在偏移下测试集选点使从零训练模型虚高0.9-2.0 dB，去掉发布设置会改变第一名方法。

Conclusion: 两个主流基准存在显著的训练/测试标签偏移与数据泄漏（LOL-v1测试输入几乎全部出现在LOLv2-Real），发布的手工测试时设置主要是在补偿这些偏移。因此基于这些基准的排名、尤其是依赖测试集调参的结果不可靠，论文给出具体报告建议（如区分可校准与测试集调参部分、报告无调参结果）。

Abstract: LOL-v1 and LOLv2-Real are the standard benchmarks for supervised low-light image enhancement, and several leading methods ship hand-set test-time adjustments with their evaluation scripts. We audit both benchmarks with 18 public checkpoints of eight methods under one metric implementation that reproduces every published number to within 0.09 dB, and find that their test labels differ from their training labels. (i) The 15 LOL-v1 test labels are rendered differently: the same captures appear in LOLv2 with labels of identical luminance but 1.48x lower saturation, and LOL-v1's own training labels match the LOLv2 rendering; we confirm this on the official release. (ii) The LOLv2-Real test set is the contiguous block of images 690-789, whose labels are 14% darker than the training labels (Cliff's delta = -0.45, p < 1e-12) with no comparable shift in the input statistics we examined; methods trained without any labels score up to 5.5 dB higher on test than on train. (iii) All 15 LOL-v1 test inputs reappear in LOLv2-Real, 12 in its training set. The released test-time settings are consistent with compensating for these shifts. Separating what can be calibrated on training data from what only test-set tuning finds, the test-only residual has median 0.00 dB on LOLv2-Syn, which has no shift, but 0.37 dB on LOL-v1 and 0.92 dB on LOLv2-Real (up to 3.9 dB). Under the shift, test-set checkpoint selection inflates a from-scratch model by 0.9-2.0 dB, and removing the released settings changes which method ranks first. We give concrete reporting recommendations.

</details>


### [23] [StepControl: Long-Horizon Human Motion Generation from Foot-Contact Schedules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38153)
*Hojun Jang,Jinseok Bae,Donggeun Lim,Taesun Kim,Seungbin Jeong,Younghwan Lee,Yong Seok Kim,Young Min Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 StepControl，一种仅以未来左右脚触地时序表为条件、采用自回归扩散的全身运动生成模型，无需目标根/身体姿态或语义提示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可控人体运动生成多关注"做什么动作"或"身体往哪移动"，缺少一个直觉性的时间维度接口——能否仅通过规定每只脚何时着地来控制全身运动。

Method: 将脚部接触表示为显式时间事件，通过专用交叉注意力注入模型，并结合无分类器引导；同时引入随机混合噪声调度与预热策略以稳定长时程自回归生成。

Result: 相比将现有空间引导式运动生成器改造为接触约束的方案，StepControl 更精确地遵循指定接触时序；在长连续生成中保持有效控制，并能响应节奏变化、停走停顿、跛行步态、双腿跳跃等编辑后的时序表。

Conclusion: 最小化的脚部接触时序表是一种有效且直觉的可控运动生成时间接口。

Abstract: Controllable human motion generation has largely focused on specifying what action should occur or where the body should move. Abstract: Video understanding keeps moving toward longer recordings, and the longer a recording is, the more questions can be asked about it. Yet what to remember is decided before anyone knows what will be asked, and whatever is left out cannot be recovered later.

Abstract: Building damage assessment (BDA) from very-high-resolution imagery supports disaster response, and deep models now achieve high overall accuracy on public benchmarks. Because damage is spatially clustered, most buildings share the damage level of their neighbours, so overall scores are dominated by such buildings, whereas damaged buildings among intact ones are rare and easily overlooked. A high overall score therefore cannot tell whether a model judges the building itself or relies on its neighbourhood as a shortcut, and this study tests which of the two current models do. We stratify buildings by their agreement with their neighbours, move buildings into new neighbourhoods with their pixels unchanged, and diagnose nine models covering the main paradigms of BDA. All models miss a third to half of the isolated damaged buildings, and in non-flood events they call 73--87% of intact buildings damaged once these are moved into a damaged neighbourhood. We propose a building-evidence plug-in that adds two experts to an existing model without retraining it. One expert sees only the building, and the other sees its surroundings but is trained with seamlessly swapped neighbourhoods so that it learns not to trust them. With each of the nine models, the plug-in maintains or improves overall accuracy, reduces errors on buildings that disagree with their neighbours by 8--18%, and cuts by 40--69% the intact buildings that a damaged neighbourhood turns into damaged ones. </details>

Abstract: Short video platforms have become a primary channel for black and gray industry operations in internet finance, where inducements such as prompts to like, follow, join private chat groups, or click external links frequently steer users toward fraud. Because such videos are short, dynamic, and often convey intent through fleeting visual cues rather than stable text, a moderation system must guarantee detection recall and localize the offending segment so reviewers inspect only the relevant clip. Many inducements are conveyed through visual cues OCR cannot observe, and keyframe-based localization cannot recover precise temporal boundaries. We explore OCR+MLLM, which augments the text pipeline with a Multimodal Large Language Model, and compare three routes: OCR+LLM, OCR+MLLM, and a large zero-shot MLLM, along detection, latency, token consumption, and deployment complexity. We report two findings: auxiliary reward terms are exploited through reward hacking, and stronger localization rewards degrade class-balanced detection. Abstract: Current datasets for text-to-video generation are largely limited to short clips depicting a single event or coarse-grained captions. Abstract: Data augmentation improves visual recognition by exposing models to synthetic training examples that encourage generalization beyond the observed data. We propose TreemapMix, a distribution-controlled multi-image augmentation that samples source weights from a Dirichlet distribution and assigns them to area-proportional regions using a treemap partition. The resulting known region areas support two complementary objectives. TreemapMix with soft cross-entropy (SCE) treats areas as soft class-probability targets, while TreemapMix with a Plackett-Luce (PL) objective converts areas into ordinal supervision. </details>


### [31] [BudSplat: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting under a Rendering Budget](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38278)

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting has recently emerged as a promising alternative to per-scene optimization, enabling fast novel view synthesis by predicting Gaussian primitives directly from input images. However, it quickly faces a bottleneck of rendering efficiency while scaling from sparse to dense multi-view inputs, which offer more geometric constraints but produce a rapidly growing set of candidate Gaussians. Existing solutions cannot reliably distinguish redundant primitives, leading to many redundant primitives from repeatedly observed regions and increased rendering cost without much gain in visual quality. We propose BudSplat, a compact feed-forward 3DGS framework that learns to keep the most valuable Gaussians under a limited primitive count. BudSplat has two novel designs. The first is a detail-aware importance score that is extracted from multi-level visual tokens, providing an explicit cue for regions where pruning is likely to harm perceptual quality. The score can be injected into voxel fusion to preserve high-value local contributors during multi-view aggregation. The second is quality-aware Gaussian pruning that selects a compact set of primitives by jointly considering rendering contribution and detail importance. The quality-aware pruning enables local quota redistribution that helps avoid over-allocating primitives to large redundant regions. Experiments on RE10K, DL3DV, and ACID show that BudSplat achieves a favorable trade-off among rendering quality and efficiency.

</details>


### [32] [ConvRoute-ViT: Convolutional Token Routing for Efficient Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38284)
*Manish Das,Shiv Ram Dubey,Satish Kumar Singh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ConvRoute-ViT 提出卷积式 token 路由机制，在选定层保留高注意力 patch token，并将其余 token 压缩为卷积摘要 token，从而降低 ViT 计算量而不丢失上下文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ViT 自注意力随 token 数二次增长，且对所有 patch token 同等对待，造成冗余计算，并削弱对最具判别性区域的关注。

Method: 依据 class-token 注意力在选定层保留最相关 patch token；其余 token 经空间重组压缩为紧凑的卷积摘要 token，避免完全丢弃上下文；分层应用该路由过程，为深层构建紧凑且具判别性的表示。

Result: 在 CIFAR-100 与 TinyImageNet 上，相比基础 ViT，在保持分类精度的同时提升了计算效率。

Conclusion: 卷积路由式 token 压缩可在保留上下文信息的前提下有效降低 ViT 计算成本，是兼顾效率与精度的可行方案。

Abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) achieve strong image recognition performance, but their self-attention increases quadratically with the number of input tokens and makes them computationally expensive. The standard implementation of ViT models treats all patch tokens with equal importance across every layer of the model. This uniform treatment introduces redundant computation and may reduce the model's focus on the most discriminative object regions. In this paper, we propose ConvRoute-ViT, a convolutional token routing mechanism for efficient vision transformers that performs token reduction through convolutional routing. Our model preserves the most relevant patch tokens according to class-token attention at selected layers, while the remaining tokens are spatially reorganized and compressed into a compact set of convolutional summary tokens. This design reduces the sequence length without completely removing the contextual information of the less informative tokens. By applying the routing process hierarchically, the proposed framework constructs compact and discriminative representations for deeper layers. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and TinyImageNet show that ConvRoute-ViT improves computational efficiency while maintaining classification accuracy compared with the base ViT.

</details>


### [33] [PulmoWorld: An Asynchronous Multimodal Medical World Model for Longitudinal Pneumonia Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38289)
*Cheng Tang,Xinyu Zhang,Jiawei Chen,Minghui Zhang,Shaocong Wei,Wei Li,Yuxing Chen,Kongcheng Zhang,Chun-Mei Feng,Nanqing Dong,Xinyuan Zhu,Ziyan Huang,Junjun He,Yirong Chen,Lingtong Huang,Min Cen,Ming Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PULMOWORLD，面向纵向肺炎动态的世界模型，将异步状态估计、递归模拟与证据约束规划统一起来。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肺炎涉及呼吸、炎症、器官功能多维度动态变化，观测数据到达时间不同步且常不完整，传统模型难以处理这种异步不完整信息。

Method: 历史感知滤波将状态传播与观测驱动校正分离，仅在观测时更新共享信念；信念支持临床值与模态表示的递归预测及预后摘要；Cap-MBRL在授权动作集内搜索想象轨迹，仅在候选满足风险预算和预测成本余量时替换冻结回退策略。

Result: 在MASS队列上递归预测与任务训练的序列模型相当，模拟未来状态保留预后信息；在MIMIC-IV-CXR胸片和临床轨迹分别训练后，预后判别优于最新值融合；五个已知机制的MASS-Syn环境中Cap-MBRL降低选择遗憾。

Conclusion: 世界模型可有效建模肺炎纵向动态并支持受约束的安全决策。

Abstract: Pneumonia changes across respiration, inflammation, and organ function, while the measurements that describe it arrive at different times and are often incomplete. We introduce PULMOWORLD, a world model for longitudinal pneumonia dynamics that connects asynchronous state estimation, recursive simulation, and evidence-constrained planning. History-aware filtering separates state propagation from observation-driven correction, so a measurement updates the shared belief only when it is observed. That belief supports recursive forecasts of clinical values and modality representations, and summaries of future prognosis. Cap-MBRL searches imagined continuations inside an authorized action set and replaces a frozen fallback only when a candidate meets the risk budget and a predicted-cost margin. On the pneumonia cohort MASS, recursive forecasts are competitive with task-trained sequence models, and simulated future states retain prognostic information. Trained separately on public MIMIC-IV-CXR chest radiographs and clinical trajectories, this model improves prognostic discrimination over latest-value fusion in development and is competitive on long-horizon error on the locked pneumonia panel. In five known-mechanism MASS-Syn environments, Cap-MBRL lowers selection regret relative to direct fallback execution.

</details>


### [34] [Hidden Commitment: When Language Models Silently Pick a Side and How Steering Can Surface It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38296)
*Samuel Dawit Assefa,Jae Won Cho*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文检验"语言模型答案是否忠实反映内部决策"的假设：在冲突语境问答中，模型会处理文档分歧却仍给出单边答案，即使提示要求披露冲突。作者在Qwen 0.8B中发现残差流里的"来源选择方向"可量化隐性来源倾向，并用稀疏中层MLP写入同一坐标，可通过引导改变所选来源；在Gemma 3 1B上复现了读取与稀疏写入结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人们常把模型输出当作其内部决策的可见记录，但这一假设在存在冲突证据时未必成立。检索系统等场景需要识别模型是否已暗中选定某一来源，而现有方法缺乏对"沉默来源承诺"的可靠监测手段。

Method: 构建冲突语境问答设定（两份文档支持不兼容答案）；在Qwen 0.8B中定位残差流中的"来源选择方向"，其符号对应答案所用文档；分析稀疏中层MLP写入该坐标的机制；通过引导该坐标验证能否改变来源选择；在Gemma 3 1B上用LLM审计标签做迁移验证，并单独分析冲突披露行为的层级与可引导性。

Result: Qwen 0.8B中来源选择方向能捕捉隐性来源承诺，引导该坐标可改变所选来源；Gemma 3 1B在LLM审计标签下复现来源选择读取与稀疏写入桥接。冲突披露则表现更弱、出现于更后层且仅部分可引导，与来源承诺呈现不同模式。

Conclusion: 来源承诺与冲突披露是两类不同机制。可据此提出实用的检索系统监测策略：用残差读取检测沉默来源承诺，并在模型已选边时结合冲突提示与披露引导，提升答案可信度与透明度。

Abstract: Language-model answers are often treated as a visible record of the internal decision that produced them. We test this assumption in conflicting-context question answering, where two supplied documents support incompatible answers. A model can process the disagreement and still return a one-sided answer, even under prompts that ask it to disclose conflict. In Qwen 0.8B, hidden source commitment is captured by a residual source-choice direction whose sign tracks which document the answer uses. Sparse middle-layer MLP writers feed the same coordinate, and steering the coordinate changes the chosen source. A transfer run on Gemma 3 1B preserves the source-choice readout and sparse-write bridge under LLM-audited labels. Conflict disclosure follows a different pattern, appearing weaker, later-layer, and only partially steerable. These results support a practical monitoring strategy for retrieval systems that detects silent source commitment with residual readouts and pairs conflict-surfacing prompts with disclosure steering when the model has selected a side under disagreement.

</details>


### [35] [Don't Ask the LLM: Visual Token Pruning with Spectral Structure and Semantic Relevance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38303)
*Intaek Shin,Geuntaek Lim,Sungjune Park,Yukyung Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无需训练的 ST-Pruner 框架，在送入 LLM 之前利用谱显著性与反置 patch-文本相似度进行查询感知的视觉 token 剪枝，在多个 LVLM 上仅用≤11.1% 的视觉 token 保留超过 95% 性能，在 LLaVA-NeXT 上实现 3.2 倍端到端加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVLM 将图像和视频表示为长视觉 token 序列，导致推理成本高。视觉 token 剪枝的有效性取决于使用何种信号以及信号何时可得。作者发现两类信号存在互补局限：视觉侧 [CLS] 注意力在激进压缩下选择分散且偏向背景；更强的查询条件信号需在 LLM 内大量计算后才可用。由此提出疑问：能否在咨询 LLM 之前就完成结构连贯、查询感知的 token 选择。

Method: ST-Pruner（Spectral-Textual Pruner）是一个无需训练的预 LLM 视觉 token 选择框架。它将与注意力无关的谱显著性（spectral saliency）与反置 patch-文本相似度（inverted patch-text similarity）通过无参数乘法融合结合，实现结构连贯且查询感知的 token 选择。

Result: 在多种 LVLM 上，ST-Pruner 仅使用至多 11.1% 的视觉 token 即可保留超过 95% 的全 token 性能；在 LLaVA-NeXT 上实现 3.2 倍端到端加速。代码开源。

Conclusion: 在 LLM 之前进行查询感知、结构连贯的视觉 token 选择是可行且高效的，ST-Pruner 通过谱显著性与反置 patch-文本相似度的无参数融合，在极低 token 预算下保持性能并显著降低推理成本。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) represent images and videos as long visual-token sequences, substantially increasing inference costs. These costs motivate visual-token pruning, whose effectiveness depends on both what signal is used for selection and when that signal becomes available. Our analysis reveals complementary limitations: visual-side [CLS] attention produces scattered, background-biased selections under aggressive compression, while stronger query-conditioned signals become available after substantial computation within the large language model (LLM). This raises a natural question: can structurally coherent, query-aware token selection be performed before consulting the LLM? We therefore propose ST-Pruner (Spectral-Textual Pruner), a training-free framework for pre-LLM visual-token selection. It combines attention-independent spectral saliency with inverted patch-text similarity through parameter-free multiplicative fusion. Across diverse LVLMs, ST-Pruner retains over 95% of full-token performance using at most 11.1% of visual tokens and achieves a 3.2x end-to-end speedup on LLaVA-NeXT. Code is available at https://github.com/sejong-rcv/ST-Pruner.

</details>


### [36] [Does 3D Pose Improve Action Valuation in Football? An Empirical Study of Pose Representations and Learning Objectives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38308)
*Rikuhei Umemoto,Kenjiro Ide,Soham Majumder,Ulf Brefeld,Keisuke Fujii*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在SARSA框架下引入3D姿态（关节、躯干头部朝向、ST-GCN嵌入）仅能提升即时动作预测，很少改善动作价值/回报估计；训练设定的影响远大于姿态输入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有足球多智能体深度强化学习模型仅用2D位置与速度，缺失与即将发生动作相关的姿态信息。作者检验加入3D姿态能否提升观测动作价值对进攻回报（进球、失球、期望控球价值）的估计。

Method: 使用UEFA欧冠2022/23赛事、追踪与3D姿态数据，比较六种表征（无姿态、原始关节、躯干头部朝向、ST-GCN嵌入）在五种学习设定、三个随机种子下的表现；设定变化TD目标与动作预测损失，并以蒙特卡洛回报回归作参照。

Result: 50组有球/无球对比中，姿态仅在3组稳健提升回报预测（均为躯干头部朝向），12组变差（多为ST-GCN）。训练选择影响更大：去掉动作预测损失使纯位置价值的有球技能从0.003升至0.040、与xG相关性从0.23升至0.60，且在等训练长度下仍成立。姿态可改善0.2秒后动作预测（macro AUC 0.914→0.934，原始关节）及传球成功率预测（0.844→0.856）。

Conclusion: 该训练协议下，姿态有助于预判即将发生的动作，但很少改善观测动作价值；价值估计提升主要来自训练设定而非姿态输入。

Abstract: Football action valuation estimates players' contributions to future scoring. Existing multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (MADRL) models use 2D positions and velocities, omitting posture information relevant to imminent actions. We investigate whether adding 3D pose to a SARSA-based model improves observed-action values relative to attack returns: goals, conceded goals or final expected possession value. Using UEFA Champions League 2022/23 event, tracking and 3D pose data, we compare six representations (no pose, raw joints, torso and head orientation, and spatial-temporal graph convolutional network (ST-GCN) embeddings) across five learning settings and three seeds. The settings vary temporal-difference targets and action-prediction loss, with Monte Carlo return regression as a reference. Across 50 on-ball and off-ball comparisons, pose robustly improved return prediction in only three, all using torso and head orientation, while worsening it in twelve, mostly with ST-GCN. Training choices had greater effects: removing the action-prediction loss raised on-ball skill of position-only values from 0.003 to 0.040 and their correlation with expected goals from 0.23 to 0.60; the improvement in return prediction persisted at matched training length. Separately, pose improved prediction of the on-ball action 0.2 s ahead (macro AUC 0.914 to 0.934 with raw joints), while the passer's pose during execution improved pass-success prediction (AUC 0.844 to 0.856). Within this training protocol, pose informed imminent actions but rarely improved observed-action values.

</details>


### [37] [Extremely Sparse-View Computed Tomography from 2D Projections via Pose-Aware Diffusion Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38319)
*Linrui Dai,Jinxiu Liang,Chu Zhou,Mae Yamaguchi,Ryuya Takahashi,Imari Sato*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究"训练稀疏、推理稀疏"（train-sparse/infer-sparse）的极稀疏视角CT重建场景：仅用每个训练样本一张2D投影学习位姿感知扩散先验，再在采样时用测量视图保真、共享体积重投影和投影物理一致性引导，重建质量优于使用稠密体积监督的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 极稀疏视角CT（xSV-CT，每扫描仅几张投影）场景下，扫描时间、运动或辐射限制往往同样限制数据集构建，导致无法获得稠密扫描预重建的3D体积。这暴露了现有方法空白：优化类方法直接用稀疏测量但缺乏数据驱动先验，抑噪能力弱；学习类方法先验强但需要xSV-CT范围之外的稠密扫描体积作训练。因此需要在训练也只有稀疏数据时仍能获取强先验。

Method: 从每个训练样本仅一张2D投影中学习位姿感知（pose-aware）扩散先验；推理时以测得视图保真、共享体积重投影（shared-volume reprojection）以及投影物理一致性三项约束引导扩散采样，实现断层重建。

Result: 在两个公开CT数据集上，针对1、4、8视图设置，该方法取得最佳新视角合成指标，并且重建质量优于或可比于使用稠密体积监督的基线方法。

Conclusion: 结果表明，即使训练阶段也只有稀疏测量、缺少稠密体积，位姿感知扩散先验结合物理一致性引导仍可支撑高质量极稀疏视角CT重建，为数据受限场景提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Extremely sparse-view computed tomography (xSV-CT) is critical when scanning time, motion, or radiation tolerance limits each scan to only a few projections. In many such scenarios, the same acquisition limits also constrain dataset construction, making pre-reconstructed 3D volumes from dense scans unavailable. This exposes a gap in current sparse-view approaches: Optimization-based methods, which use the sparse measurements directly but lack data-driven priors to suppress artifacts, and learning-based methods, which use strong priors but usually require densely scanned training volumes acquired outside the xSV-CT regime. We study this train-sparse / infer-sparse setting by learning a pose-aware diffusion prior from one 2D projection per training sample, then guiding diffusion sampling with measured-view fidelity, shared-volume reprojection, and projection-physics consistency for tomographic reconstruction. On two public CT datasets across 1-, 4-, and 8-view settings, the proposed method achieves the best novel-view synthesis scores and best or competitive reconstruction quality compared with baselines that use dense-volume supervision.

</details>


### [38] [SSQA: Sibling-Selective Quadtree Attention for Hierarchical Modeling in Perception Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38320)
*Yufan Chen,Arnav Bali,Angela Liu,Laura Zheng,Ming C. Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Sibling-Selective Quadtree Attention (SSQA)，利用四叉树结构分层建模图像token，以线性复杂度替代二次复杂度的注意力机制，在多任务上取得更优或相当性能且计算成本大幅降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人与自动驾驶等导航感知任务具有显著的结构先验（如无人机视角下天空在上、地形在下、障碍物居中；驾驶场景含车道线与道路布局），其图像结构性强于通用视觉任务，因此可用四叉树式的轴对齐分层方式高效建模。

Method: 将图像token组织为结构化完整四叉树进行分层特征建模，并设计Sibling-Selective Quadtree Attention（同层级兄弟节点选择性注意力）；给出解析性复杂度分析证明其线性时间特性，并与Mamba 2、Quadtree Attention等主流方法进行推理速度的实证对比。

Result: 多个基准任务上的实验表明，SSQA在性能上至少不逊于现有方法、部分任务上显著更优，同时计算成本仅为后者的一小部分；推理速度对比也验证了线性复杂度的实际效率优势。

Conclusion: 利用导航感知任务的轴对齐结构先验，四叉树分层注意力可作为通用注意力的一种高效线性时间替代方案，兼顾性能与计算效率。

Abstract: Perception tasks for navigation in robotics, including aerial platforms such as drones and autonomous driving systems, are inherently structured. Drone-mounted cameras typically capture sky above, terrain below, and obstacles or man-made structures in between, while driving data often contains organized road layouts, lane markings, and surrounding agents. Motivated by these axis-aligned structural priors, we note that such information is typically more structured than in generic image tasks. We hypothesize that processing information in a quadtree-esque manner can not only model features effectively in a hierarchical manner, but also offers an efficient linear-time alternative to vanilla attention mechanisms, which run in quadratic time. In this paper, we propose Sibling-Selective Quadtree Attention (SSQA), which models image tokens hierarchically as a structured, full quadtree. We show analytical complexity analysis that guarantees linear-time feature modeling, in addition to empirical experiments comparing inference speeds with other popular modeling approaches, such as Mamba 2 and Quadtree Attention. Our results, benchmarked across several tasks, show that we achieve results at least as good, if not notably better, as others at a fraction of the computational costs.

</details>


### [39] [Knowledge-structured and evidence-aware semantic self-distillation for glomerular pathology foundation model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38346)
*Qiming He,Jing Li,Zihan Wang,Tian Guan,Yifei Ma,Zimo Zhao,Yanxia Wang,Hongjing Chen,Yexing Zhang,Yizhi Wang,Xinrui Chen,Xitong Ling,Minxi Ouyang,Yujie Xie,Lianghui Zhu,Yiqing Liu,Qingxia Hou,Shuyan Zhao,Xiaoqin Wang,Lili Ma,Qiang Huang,Zhiyuan Shen,Junru Cheng,Siqi Zeng,Chao He,Yonghong He,Zhe Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GloSAGE是一个语义自蒸馏框架，利用预训练视觉教师模型预测的病变谱构建结构化病理文本描述，在无需昂贵图文配对的情况下为肾小球视觉基础模型提供概念级语义监督，并在零样本病变识别、图文检索、病例级分类等七项任务中表现良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉基础模型能学习丰富的病理形态学，但缺乏显式的概念级监督；视觉-语言预训练可提供此类监督，但需要昂贵的图像-文本配对数据。

Method: 以预训练视觉教师模型预测的病变谱构建结构化病理描述；采用可靠性引导选择确定图文锚点；通过知识结构化病理文本合成（Knowledge-Structured Pathology Text Synthesis）与证据引导负样本构建（Evidence-Guided Negative-pair Construction）应对部分观测病变；训练时冻结视觉编码器、仅训练投影层，并以中间语义迁移层向下游任务提供特征。

Abstract: While single-view novel view synthesis methods have been dramatically enhanced recently, how to quantify their performance has yet to be standardized. In this work, we demonstrate that an important factor lies in how each method's own reference frame is aligned with the so-called ground-truth pose. Existing methods often rely on test-time optimization of target poses for this alignment, which inherently is ill-posed due to the complexity of the optimization landscape of camera poses vs render accuracy, leading to methods being evaluated at an arbitrary local optimum. Some recognize this limitation and thus rely on 3D reconstructions of entire scenes using training and test views to align poses, which may be infeasible. In this work, instead, we propose to use traditional 2D-to-2D and 2D-to-3D image matching techniques to align 3D reconstructions. We also evaluate only within co-visible regions, between different views, which is the only place where a `correct' ground truth can be defined. Our evaluations show that with proper coordinate alignment, novel-view synthesis methods that use explicit 3D Gaussians achieve the state of the art, despite being previously reported in the literature to be outperformed by pure image-based 2D methods. We further provide a simple baseline that directly utilizes an off-the-shelf video generator and a feed-forward geometry estimator. Our simple baseline is already comparable to state-of-the-art methods specifically trained for novel-view synthesis, without any task-specific training.

Abstract: Producing long-form videos from narration requires interdependent decisions that remain coherent across shots. Existing agentic editors often use multi-stage workflows driven by general models, leaving the quality-cost trade-off of compact, task-adapted policies unclear. We address this gap with WeVisCut, a long-form script-to-video system that connects tool execution with policy learning. Its agent harness maintains shared production state so that tool feedback informs subsequent decisions and repairs. Because finished videos do not expose these decisions, our four-stage data pipeline combines editing inversion with verified replay to turn recovered editing intent into executable supervision. Applied to 3,750 finished videos, this pipeline yields over 130K training examples. We use this supervision to train a single 9B policy that coordinates production and recovers from failures within the same harness. Moreover, we introduce a 100-task benchmark and five metrics assessing editing quality and delivery reliability. Under a shared tool environment, WeVisCut substantially outperforms its base model and achieves comparable performance to Claude Opus 5 while using nearly 33x fewer generated tokens per successful output minute. It also outperforms task-matched native editors on our proposed metrics.

Abstract: 3D reconstruction from single-view sports broadcast is a pivotal capability for automated analytics and immersive AR/VR replays, yet notoriously ill-posed due to difficult-to-calibrate moving cameras and depth ambiguity. Unlike widely studied racket sports, team sports such as volleyball feature unpredictable multi-contact sequences and high altitude jumps. These dynamics categorically invalidate the standard planar projection assumptions relied upon by existing methods. To resolve these limitations without 3D training supervision, we propose a complete, physics-grounded pipeline tailored to monocular broadcast volleyball. First, we include a correction module to the perspective drift induced by ground-plane projection by coupling temporal jump spotting with Newtonian interpolation for 3D player placement. Second, for 3D ball trajectory estimation, we design a dedicated sub-trajectory segmentation architecture alongside a collision-matching algorithm. By anchoring physical equations to reconstructed 3D hand vertices, we lift noisy ball 2D detections into a spatiotemporally coherent 3D scene. Evaluations on multi-camera benchmarks demonstrate our approach significantly reduces 3D spatial drift compared to 2D-reprojection baselines.

</details>

*Zihan Deng,Zhenzhen Gong,Yujie Liu,Jiaxin Gong,Dingkun Liu,Kexian Xie,Yixing Huang,Peng Jin,Tianye Niu,Zhisheng Wang,Fenglin Liu,Hongming Shan,Lequan Yu*

TL;DR: SparseTokenGS 用可复用 token 池解决前馈高斯方法在稀疏视角 CBCT 中解码时无法获取全扫描上下文的问题，六投影重建 PSNR 达 29.51 dB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 提出 SparseTokenGS：构建可复用 token 池，通过 Anchor Token Fusion 在 anchor 处、Point-Token Attention 在查询坐标处分别查询该共享池；保留局部高斯先验，单次前向完成重建，无需逐扫描优化，也无需投影域损失。

Conclusion: 可复用 token 池为前馈重建提供了在整个解码过程保持全扫描上下文的机制，有望服务未来快速临床病灶定位与分析。

Abstract: Sparse-view cone-beam computed tomography is widely used for fast, low-dose volumetric imaging and lesion localization in dentistry and image-guided interventions, but it introduces severe artifacts. Feed-forward Gaussian methods transfer the reconstruction cost to training and decode each coordinate from projection-aligned features and neighboring anchors. However, information from the whole scan is written only when the field is constructed and cannot be retrieved during coordinate decoding, leaving the volume inconsistent within the scan. This is a common limitation of such methods: once the field is fixed, decoding uses only local features and reconstruction quality drops substantially. We propose SparseTokenGS, a Gaussian-based method for sparse-view cone-beam computed tomography reconstruction via a reusable token pool. Anchor Token Fusion and Point-Token Attention query this shared pool at the anchors and at the query coordinates, respectively. The local Gaussian prior is retained, and the volume is reconstructed in one forward pass, without per-scan optimization or a projection-domain loss. On three public chest and dental datasets, SparseTokenGS achieves the highest reconstruction performance among the compared methods. On clinical dental scans, reconstruction from only six projections reaches 29.51 decibels in peak signal-to-noise ratio and a structural similarity of 0.842 against the full-view reference, and off-the-shelf tooth-and-pulp segmentation keeps these structures separable for root-canal localization. Experiments on volcanic rock and chicken show performance after same-object adaptation. A reusable token pool gives feed-forward reconstruction a mechanism that keeps scan-wide context available through decoding and can benefit future rapid clinical lesion localization and analysis. The code is available at: https://github.com/FrankDengAI/SparseTokenGS.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 在覆盖RRG与Med-VQA的4个数据集、多种医学及通用VLM上均优于SOTA检测基线；MIMIC-CXR上AUPRC从85.10%提升至90.23%；在GT衍生的受控VIH基准上效果亦获验证。

Conclusion: 将视觉无关幻觉确立为医学VLM重要的细粒度可靠性失效模式，证明模型无关的视觉支撑审计有助于提升多模态临床生成的可信度。

Abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) show strong performance in radiology report generation (RRG) and medical visual question answering (Med-VQA), producing free-form clinical descriptions and answers from medical images. However, they may generate clinically meaningful statements that lack visual evidence or contradict image content. We refer to these errors as visually irrelevant hallucinations and investigate them at the phrase level. We propose CLEAR (Counterfactual Localized Evaluation of Alignment and Response), a model-agnostic post-hoc framework for phrase-level hallucination risk estimation. CLEAR decomposes generated responses into visually assessable clinical phrases. For each phrase, phrase-conditioned grounding identifies a candidate visual region, which is selectively perturbed by a localized counterfactual intervention. CLEAR characterizes the intervention using two complementary auditing cues: response cues, capturing semantic and clinically meaningful changes in the generated response, and alignment cues, measuring changes in image-phrase compatibility. These cues are normalized and jointly modeled to estimate phrase-level hallucination risk. Across four datasets spanning RRG and Med-VQA, CLEAR outperforms state-of-the-art hallucination detection baselines across multiple medical and general-purpose VLMs. On MIMIC-CXR, CLEAR improves AUPRC from 85.10% to 90.23%. Its effectiveness is further validated on a GT-derived controlled VIH benchmark. These results establish visually irrelevant hallucination as an important fine-grained reliability failure mode in medical VLMs and demonstrate the value of model-agnostic visual-support auditing for more trustworthy multimodal clinical generation.

</details>

*Shunxin Wang,Alexandros Stergiou,Luuk Spreeuwers,Estefania Talavera,Nicola Strisciuglio*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于结构保持LoRA的天气合成框架，无需ControlNet外部条件即可实现结构一致的高真实感天气图像生成。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 户外视觉模型部署受恶劣天气等环境干扰限制，而现有数据集在同一场景观测中动态元素（行人、车辆）与相机视角会变化，难以将天气引起的分布偏移与场景本身解耦，因此缺乏高质量、仅含天气变化的数据。
