Result: 计数可见表象明显易于恢复连接它们的实体身份；最强模型仅13.36%的分组全部答对；当单一实体产生多个表象或表象跨越不同观察方式时性能下降；提高图像分辨率改善视觉证据获取但对完整组准确率增益有限；联合回答相关问题可带来显著提升。

Conclusion: 结果揭示了"识别可见内容"与"正确恢复这些观察背后的物理实体"之间存在能力鸿沟，当前MLLM在此类推理上仍严重不足。

Abstract: Images reveal appearances, but counting often asks about physical objects. A single entity may be visible directly, in several reflections, or through glass, so detecting every visible occurrence does not determine how many entities are present. Existing visual counting benchmarks rarely separate these two operations. We introduce PhysCount, a benchmark for evaluating whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can distinguish what appears in an image from what physically exists in the scene. PhysCount contains 546 real-world images and 4,595 human-written questions organized into 651 target-specific groups. For each group, annotators locate the relevant appearances, label how each is observed, and identify appearances of the same entity. Four complementary question families test the enumeration of appearances, the enumeration of physical entities, image-formation-specific counting, and appearance--entity correspondence. We measure both accuracy on each family and the proportion of groups answered entirely correctly. Across 40 MLLMs, counting visible appearances is substantially easier than recovering the identities that connect them. Even the strongest model answers every question correctly in only 13.36\% of groups. Performance declines when one entity produces many appearances or when its appearances cross observation modes. Higher image resolution improves access to visual evidence but brings limited gains in complete-group accuracy, whereas answering related questions jointly produces a marked improvement. These results expose a gap between recognizing what is visible and correctly recovering the physical entities behind those observations.

</details>


### [189] [RADIOlogy: A Single-Pass Approach to Training-Free Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40580)
*Joaquín Figueira,Giacomo D'Amicantonio,Egor Bondarau*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RADIOlogy：利用视觉语言模型中多头注意力池化的涌现特性，实现单次前向的免训练零样本异常检测与分割，无需滑窗和密集标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零样本异常检测依赖复杂提示学习或昂贵滑窗以对齐细粒度视觉特征，根因是CLIP的[CLS]注意力和空间patch池化难以捕捉细微局部异常；而提示学习需大量分割掩码，在专业领域常不可得。

Method: 发现多头注意力池化具备开箱即用的零样本异常定位能力，将其转化为单次通过的检测技术：用正常/异常提示集与视觉特征的平均相似度做简单对比打分；并利用RADIO模型的agglomerative（聚合）特征，通过稠密异常精炼流程提升像素级分割。

Result: 无需窗口化密集执行，显著优于其他免训练基线；并通过最小改动将该类免训练零样本方法成功迁移至医学领域。

Conclusion: 多头注意力池化是视觉语言模型可被直接利用的涌现属性，支撑高效免训练零样本异常检测与分割，并可推广到医学等专业领域。

Abstract: Current zero-shot anomaly detection methods often rely on complex prompt-learning techniques or computationally expensive sliding-window strategies to achieve fine-grained visual alignment to detect small-scale anomalies. This reliance stems from the fundamental limitation of standard CLIP architectures, where [CLS] token attention and spatial patch pooling struggle to capture subtle, localized anomaly features. While prompt-learning approaches aim to bridge this gap, they typically require a large number of ground-truth segmentation masks from auxiliary datasets, which are often unavailable in specialized domains. In this work, we show an emerging property of multi-head attention pooling in vision-language models: remarkable zero-shot anomaly localization and detection right out of the box. We translate this property into a single-pass anomaly detection technique, RADIOlogy, that does not require dense, windowed execution and significantly outperforms other training-free baselines. Instead, the method relies on a simple contrastive scoring approach that compares the average similarity between vision features and a suite of normal and abnormal prompts. Furthermore, we leverage the agglomerative features of RADIO models to enhance pixel-level anomaly segmentation using a dense anomaly refinement pipeline. Finally, we show how the vision-language family of training-free zero-shot anomaly detection techniques can be applied successfully to the medical domain with minimal modifications. Code is available at https://github.com/jacomof/RADIOlogy.

</details>


### [190] [Beyond Ground Truth: A Heuristic Unsupervised Quality Assurance Engine for Diagnosing Calibrational Blindness in Dental Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40587)
*Fatematuj Johura Mim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无需真值掩膜的牙科X光分割质量检查引擎HUS-QA，基于置信度、边缘锐度、形状连通性与面积惩罚等简单指标，与真实Dice相关性明显优于标准置信度方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实临床中深度学习牙科X光分割可靠性差，模型即使分割质量低仍高度自信（校准盲），且医生无真值掩膜可核对精度，因此需要无参考的质量评估手段。

Method: 在PRAD根尖片数据集上训练SimCLR自监督ResNet-18 U-Net生成分割掩膜；HUS-QA含三阶段流程，综合预测置信度、边缘锐度、形状连通性与面积尺寸惩罚四项指标对掩膜质量打分，无需真值。

Result: 标准置信度方法失效（r=-0.1394，p=1.7864e-3，ROC AUC=0.4275）；HUS-QA与真实Dice正相关（r=0.4647，p=3.7510e-28），ROC-AUC达0.8405。

Conclusion: HUS-QA可作为临床质量控制中实用的无真值分割质量检查工具。

Abstract: In real-world clinical settings, dental X-ray segmentation using deep learning methods suffers from reliability issues. Even when the segmentation quality is bad, deep learning models show high confidence in their predictions (calibrational blindness). Moreover, in real use, doctors do not have ground-truth masks to check their accuracy. To address this problem, we introduce a simple quality-checking engine called HUS-QA with three stages. We train it on the PRAD (Periapical Dental X-ray) dataset to build our SimCLR self-supervised ResNet-18 U-Net model, which generates the segmentation mask and then evaluates its quality. Our HUS-QA checks the segmentation mask quality without a ground-truth mask. Prediction confidence, edge sharpness, shape connectivity, and area-size penalty are the simple indicators considered in this research. Results show that standard confidence methods fail (r = -0.1394, p = 1.7864e-3, ROC AUC = 0.4275). By contrast, our HUS-QA shows a positive correlation with actual Dice scores (r = 0.4647, p = 3.7510e-28) and achieves a strong ROC-AUC of 0.8405. Therefore, HUS-QA serves as a practical tool for clinical quality control.

</details>


### [191] [HairDeck: Animation-Ready Stylized Hair Cards from a Single Image](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40599)
*Yuze He,Yixiang Wei,Wang Zhao,Chuhao Chen,Yanning Zhou,Yong-Jin Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HairDeck 将风格化发片（hair cards）发型视为无序图元集合，用"每张发片一个 token"的集合扩散 Transformer 一次性去噪生成全部发片，并从单图同时预测驱动发片的弹簧骨链，得到可动画、可直接导出的资产。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 游戏中风格化角色的头发由美术摆放的发片（ribbon）构成，用弹簧骨动画。现有图像方法只能生成写实头发或融合成单一网格；唯一能生成风格化发片的 CHARM 把发型自回归地解码成长序列控制点，既慢又不符合发片本质是无序集合这一事实。

Method: 把每张发片编码为单个 token，用集合扩散 Transformer 对所有发片联合去噪（无序集合建模，而非自回归长序列）；输入为单张图像；同时生成发片几何与驱动它的弹簧骨链，输出可动画资产并能导出到下游现成格式。

Result: 在 CHARM 自带测试集上，Chamfer 距离降低 44%，发片朝向误差降低一半以上，速度快 33 倍；单图输入下优于 CHARM、image-to-3D 流水线和基于发丝（strand）的方法。

Conclusion: 以集合扩散替代自回归序列生成，是生成美术风格化发片的高效范式，且能一步产出带骨骼的可动画资产，具备直接落地的实用价值。

Abstract: The hair of stylized characters in games and avatars is built from hair cards: artist-placed ribbons whose geometry is the visible hair, animated by spring bones. Existing image-based methods produce realistic hair or a single fused mesh, while CHARM, the only generator of stylized hair cards, decodes a hairstyle autoregressively as a long sequence of control points. Observing that a card hairstyle is an unordered set of artist-defined primitives, we propose HairDeck, which generates it as one: each card is a single token, and a set diffusion transformer denoises all cards together. From a single image, HairDeck generates the cards and the spring-bone chains that drive them, yielding an animatable asset that exports to ready-to-use downstream formats. On CHARM's own test set, it lowers Chamfer distance by 44% and card-orientation error by more than half while running 33 times faster, and from single images it outperforms CHARM, image-to-3D pipelines and strand-based methods. Project page: https://hyzcluster.github.io/HairDeck

</details>


### [192] [Fight World Model: Customizable Combat through Visual Interaction Proxies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40607)
*Jiahua Li,Zixu John,Tom Zhong,Fuping Wu,Tianhao Xu,Ruicheng Zhang,Jun Zhou,Zunnan Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FWM 将"规则驱动的战斗执行"与"视频渲染"解耦：用可执行引擎维护状态并结算交互，再用确定性编译器把结果编码为时空对齐的交互代理，从而让视频世界模型在改规则时保持一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型能生成看似合理的战斗画面，但难以让受击反应、血量变化等与游戏规则保持一致，缺乏持久状态与可执行规则，也无法支持规则修改和可扩展玩法。

Method: 提出 Fight World Model（FWM）：(1) 可执行引擎维护持久状态并结算交互；(2) 确定性编译器把结算结果与尝试动作编码到空间、时间对齐的"交互代理"中，按角色身份与时间对齐动作/技能窗口、短暂受击反应和持久血量；(3) 这些线索可分别控制，以在修改规则下渲染交互；(4) 身份绑定参考保持换边后的外观一致。在 FightWorld Corpus（52 种技能效果、187 种外观变体、15 个竞技场）上训练。

Result: 无需重训练渲染器即支持伤害缩放、有限次命中免疫、吸血、多段技能机制，以及角色与场景定制；在动作保真度、受击反应、血量状态一致性、角色外观保持上优于现有游戏世界模型。

Conclusion: 规则执行与渲染分离是构建可玩、可编程游戏世界模型的有效路线，可原生扩展玩法机制并保持视觉与状态一致。

Abstract: A playable, programmable game world must maintain persistent state, enforce executable rules, and support extensible gameplay mechanics. Existing video world models can generate plausible combat, yet struggle to keep hit reactions and health updates consistent with game rules. We introduce Fight World Model (FWM), which separates rule-governed combat execution from video rendering. An executable engine maintains state and resolves interactions. A deterministic compiler encodes these outcomes and attempted actions in a spatially and temporally aligned interaction proxy. The proxy aligns action and skill windows, brief hit reactions, and persistent health by fighter identity and timing. These cues can be controlled separately to render interactions under modified rules. Identity-bound references preserve character appearance across side switches. We train FWM on FightWorld Corpus, spanning 52 skill effects, 187 character-appearance variants, and 15 arenas. Without retraining the renderer, FWM supports damage scaling, limited-hit immunity, lifesteal, and multi-stage skill mechanisms beyond the native game. It also allows character and arena customization. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of FWM, which outperforms existing game world models in action fidelity, hit reactions, health-state consistency, and character appearance preservation. Our project is available at https://fight-world-model.github.io.

</details>


### [193] [L3G-World: Real-Time Infinite World Generation with Latent 3D Gaussian Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40614)
*Jinhyeok Choi,JoungBin Lee,Jongmin Lee,Minkyeong Jeon,Jiyoung Kim,Kaeun Han,Yoonjin Yoon,Seungryong Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Latent 3D Gaussian Memory (L3G) 与 L3G-World，用随场景范围而非流长度增长的紧凑 3D 高斯记忆，交替自回归驱动视频 DiT，实现实时（9 FPS）长时程空间一致的交互式世界生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有交互式世界模型靠时序上下文或显式 3D 记忆维持空间一致性，但记忆随生成流长度增长而难以扩展；且显式 3D 记忆需把 RGB 渲染重新 VAE 编码后再条件化视频生成器，无法实时。

Method: 1) L3G：结合前馈重建效率与紧凑、可快速渲染的场景表示；2) 记忆更新器与视频 DiT 自回归交替：更新器在新观测区域生成高斯并精修已有高斯，使记忆随场景范围增长；3) 每个高斯存储 VAE latent 特征，可直接渲染进 DiT 的潜空间，免去 VAE 重编码。

Result: 生成质量与长时程空间一致性达 SOTA；相比最高效先验 3D 记忆基线，3D 原语最多少 38.6×、记忆更新快 3.2×、记忆渲染快 359×；实现 9 FPS 实时世界生成。

Conclusion: 以潜空间 3D 高斯作为紧凑可扩展记忆并直接对接 DiT 潜空间，是兼顾一致性、效率与实时性的有效路线，突破记忆随流长度增长的瓶颈。

Abstract: Interactive world models generate visual content conditioned on user actions, yet maintaining spatial consistency over long-horizon exploration in real time remains challenging. Existing approaches rely on either temporal context or explicit 3D memory, both of which scale poorly because memory grows with the length of the generated stream. Moreover, explicit 3D memories condition latent video generators by re-encoding RGB renderings, which precludes real-time generation. In this paper, we introduce a Latent 3D Gaussian Memory (L3G) that combines the efficiency of feed-forward reconstruction with a compact, rapidly renderable scene representation. Building on this memory, we propose L3G-World, in which a memory updater and a video diffusion transformer (DiT) alternate autoregressively to generate spatially consistent worlds. The memory updater spawns Gaussians in newly observed regions and refines existing ones, so that the memory grows with scene extent rather than stream length. Each Gaussian further stores a VAE latent feature, allowing the memory to be rendered directly into the DiT's latent space without VAE re-encoding. Experiments show that L3G-World achieves state-of-the-art generation quality and long-horizon spatial consistency, with up to $38.6\times$ fewer 3D primitives, $3.2\times$ faster memory updates, and $359\times$ faster memory rendering relative to the most efficient prior 3D-memory baseline for each metric, enabling real-time world generation at 9 FPS.

</details>


### [194] [Difficulty Calibration Across Time for Membership Inference in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40616)
*Michael Joseph,Yedid Hoshen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出两种基于"时间维度"校准的扩散模型成员推断攻击方法，跨越训练时间(RMC)与扩散时间(TSC)来消除图像固有难度影响，显著超越现有SOTA并兼容多种参数化模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准成员推断攻击(MIA)用重建损失打分、低损失判为成员，但简单未见图像可能比复杂训练图像的损失更低，导致误判。核心问题在于需将"记忆"与"图像本身的重建难度"分离。

Method: 沿两个时间轴校准：(1) Reference-Model Calibration (RMC)——将微调模型的损失与早期检查点比较，隔离新近记忆的数据；(2) Temporal Self-Calibration (TSC)——仅用单一模型，利用"图像难度跨噪声水平持续存在、而记忆在时间上局部化"的观察，将目标时间步损失与相邻时间步损失比较，用模型自身轨迹衰减图像难度。

Result: 方法在实验中大幅超越现有SOTA，且不同于多数现有攻击，能在 x-, v-, ε-预测等不同参数化模型间泛化。

Conclusion: 通过在训练时间与扩散时间两轴上校准图像难度，可高效审计扩散模型训练数据；RMC在无文本caption下仍近乎完美审计，TSC在无早期检查点时提供单模型实用替代方案。

Abstract: Modern diffusion models are trained on massive datasets that often include copyrighted or private images. Membership inference attacks (MIAs) address this by testing whether a given image was in a model's training set. The standard approach scores an image by its reconstruction loss and flags low-loss images as members. This often fails because some images are simply easier to reconstruct than others, so a simple unseen image can score a lower loss than a complex training image. Difficulty calibration separates memorization from how difficult an image is to begin with. We show how to calibrate along two axes of time: training time and diffusion time. First, across training time, we introduce Reference-Model Calibration (RMC), which compares a fine-tuned model's loss against an earlier checkpoint. This cleanly isolates newly memorized data and gives near-perfect auditing, even without text captions. Since earlier checkpoints are not always available, we next present Temporal Self-Calibration (TSC), which calibrates across diffusion time using only a single model. Our key observation is that an image's difficulty persists across noise levels, whereas memorization is localized in time. By comparing the loss at a target timestep against neighboring timesteps from the same model, TSC attenuates image difficulty using the model's own trajectory. Empirically, our methods beat the state of the art by a wide margin, and unlike most existing attacks, generalize across different model parameterizations such as $x$-, $v$-, and $ε$-prediction models. Code is available at https://github.com/MichaelJoseph777/TSC.

</details>


### [195] [Probing Spatial State Representations in Visual Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40636)
*Baiqiao Yin,Zhongang Cai,Ruisi Wang,Qiwei Liang,Lei Yang,Ziwei Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文用冻结特征探针在四个层级（空间结构、物体持续性、预测性空间更新、可行动性）上评估十种视觉基础模型表示在流式自我中心观测下是否支持持久空间状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 观察者只能看到世界的一部分，却必须追踪视野之外的内容，因此空间感知需要一个在自我运动下持续更新并指导行动的持久空间状态。论文要检验视觉基础模型的表示是否支持这样的状态，而非仅能解码单帧图像。

Method: 在静态室内环境的流式自我中心观测下，对十种表示做冻结特征探针，分四个能力层级评测：空间结构、物体持续性、预测性空间更新、可行动性；并设计匹配对照，将读出准确性与对视觉历史及运动的依赖区分开；还测试在预测特征上的迁移与目标导向候选选择的动作效用。

Result: 能力画像随任务、网络层和前缀长度而变化；对可见场景的强读出并不保证准确的物体持续性或未来特征检索；原生未来预测保留了可恢复的空间结构，但用真实特征训练的空间读出器不能原样迁移到预测特征；目标改变会改变预测动作，但提供正确目标并不能可靠提升进展。物体持续性与可行动性依赖相机位姿读出，而特征预测依赖可见场景读出。

Conclusion: 评价空间表示不应只看能从中解码出什么，还应看信息是否被维持于观测之外、是否被预测性更新、以及是否用于目标导向行动。

Abstract: An observer sees only part of the surrounding world, yet must keep track of what lies beyond the current view. Spatial perception therefore involves more than recognizing individual images: it calls for a persistent spatial state that is updated under self-motion and used to guide action. Do visual foundation models provide representations that support such a state? We study this question through four levels of spatial capability---spatial structure, object persistence, predictive spatial update, and actionability---using frozen-feature probes on ten representations under streaming egocentric observations of static indoor environments. The resulting capability profiles vary across tasks, network layers, and prefix lengths: strong readout of the visible scene does not ensure accurate object persistence or future-feature retrieval. Matched controls separate readout accuracy from reliance on visual history and motion. Native future prediction retains recoverable spatial structure, but a spatial reader trained on real features does not transfer to predicted features unchanged. Finally, goal-dependent candidate selection does not establish reliable continuous action utility: predicted actions respond to goal changes, yet supplying the correct goal does not reliably improve progress. Across the four levels, object persistence and actionability build on camera-pose readout, whereas feature prediction builds on visible-scene readout. Together, these findings motivate evaluating spatial representations not only by what can be decoded from them, but by whether that information is maintained beyond observation, updated predictively, and used for goal-directed action.

</details>


### [196] [SonoWorld4D: From One Video to a 4D Audio-Visual Scene via Diffusion Synchronization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40640)
*Derong Jin,Xiyi Chen,Ming C. Lin,Ruohan Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Video-to-4DAVScene 新任务并给出 SonoWorld4D 框架：从单目视频生成可探索、随时间变化的4D音视场景，支持实时新视角视觉与空间音频渲染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉场景生成已从静态3D扩展到由极少输入生成动态4D场景，但声音虽与动态物体和事件本质耦合，却被以往工作基本忽略，缺乏音视一致的4D场景建模。

Method: 给定单目视频：生成360°静态背景；重建有声动态前景物体的显式运动轨迹；通过双空间音频扩散同步，合成长时间跨多声源物理一致的声音场。

Result: 在真实动态场景上的评测与用户研究表明，生成的4D音视场景具有感知真实、物理合理且与场景几何和视觉内容一致的空间音频。

Conclusion: 将声音纳入4D场景生成可提升沉浸感与一致性，Video-to-4DAVScene 为单目视频驱动的音视4D场景生成提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Recent progress in visual scene generation has extended beyond static 3D scenes toward the more challenging problem of generating dynamic 4D scenes from minimal input. However, sound, despite being intrinsically coupled with dynamic objects and events, remains largely unmodeled in prior work. We introduce Video-to-4DAVScene, a new task that turns a video into an explorable, time-varying 4D audio-visual scene, and present the SonoWorld4D framework for this task. Given a monocular video, our method generates a 360 static background, reconstructs explicit motion trajectories of dynamic, sound-emitting foreground objects, and synthesizes a physically-grounded sound field consistent across multiple sources through dual-space audio diffusion synchronization. The resulting 4D scene supports real-time novel-view visual and spatial audio rendering. Evaluation on real-world dynamic scenes and a user study demonstrates SonoWorld4D generates 4D audio-visual scenes with perceptually realistic, physically grounded spatial audio consistent with scene geometry and visual content.

</details>


### [197] [Luggage re-identification: A study of strategies towards a real-world application](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40643)
*Quentin Dhôte,Romaric Audigier*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究从多路视频流端到端检测与重识别行李的流程，评估选择与融合同一行李多视角、多快照的策略，并探讨跨环境数据集训练对实际ReID性能的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有行李ReID方法多在较干净条件下做裁剪图像的外观匹配，而真实场景中遮挡频繁、背景杂乱、人群拥挤会显著降低性能；同时多视频流多镜头多视角的互补信息未被充分利用。

Method: 构建从多路视频流到检测与重识别的端到端流水线，在真实环境采集的基准数据集上评测多种变体，重点考察同一行李多视角/多快照的选择与融合方式，以及在不同环境数据集上训练的效果。

Result: 论文报告了不同变体在真实环境基准上的对比结果，回答了视角与快照的选择融合问题，并显示跨环境数据集训练有助于整体ReID性能提升（具体数值见原文）。

Conclusion: 多镜头多视角互补信息的合理选择与融合，以及跨环境训练，是提升实际场景行李ReID性能的有效途径。

Abstract: Luggage re-identification (ReID) is a critical task in video surveillance for forensics, security or border management (suspicious or abandoned luggage recognition), as well as luggage management (lost luggage recovery). It enables the association of observations of the same luggage across disjoint camera views in complex environments such as airports, train stations and border crossing. While existing approaches primarily focus on appearance-based cropped image matching under relatively clean conditions, real-world scenarios are characterized by frequent occlusions, cluttered background and crowded scenes which significantly degrade performance. Yet, strategies leveraging the complementarity of multiple shots and views from different video streams is overlooked. In this paper, we study strategies for an end-to-end pipeline that operates from multiple video streams to detect and re-identify luggage. We evaluate different variants on a benchmark dataset acquired in real-world environments to address the questions of selecting and merging different views and shots of the same luggage as well as training on different environment datasets for an overall ReID performance improvement in practical applications.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [198] [The FlightFinder Occurrence Corpus: harmonising 128 aviation-safety source codes into one deduplicated cross-national accident dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37671)
*Denys Kolomiiets*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发布 FlightFinder Occurrence Corpus，将 128 个来源的 279,485 起航空事件与 131,882 篇叙述统一到一个模式，并用有序确定性键阶梯加评分合并与人工确认实现可追溯的实体消解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 各国航空事故调查数据库深但彼此割裂；Aviation Safety Network 等全球汇编靠人工整理、自定义收录门槛且不提供逐条溯源，导致跨国安全统计、来源分歧研究与文本挖掘缺乏统一且可审计的基础数据。

Method: 把记录映射进同一模式，每个规范化记录只能归约为有序阶梯中的一个键（事件特征签名、注册号+日期、圆形位置+日期、来源+原生标识），缺字段不产生链接，键即事件标识；阶梯无法覆盖的记录在分块流程中打分并写入显式合并表，仅在自动批准的分数带内或人工确认后应用。字段冲突按公开的来源优先级处理；每个贡献来源保留一行溯源（原生标识与 URL）及署名与许可条款。

Result: 在五个裁定样本共 200 对上测量链接错误；对随版本发布的 3,441 条自动合并做 60 条均匀随机抽样未发现错误，其假合并率的精确双侧 95% Clopper-Pearson 上界为 6.0%，即 205 对。该误差仅覆盖评分带，阶梯的确定性连接未经裁定。语料无暴露分母，并继承各来源的漏报。

Conclusion: 该语料可作为跨国安全统计、来源分歧研究和叙述文本挖掘的基础，随实时 API 提供冻结的、带 DOI 引用的快照；用户须注意其误差界、无分母与漏报继承等局限。

Abstract: National aviation-investigation databases are deep but territorial; global compilations such as the Aviation Safety Network and the Bureau of Aircraft Accidents Archives are hand-curated, apply their own inclusion thresholds, and publish no per-record lineage. The FlightFinder Occurrence Corpus harmonizes 279,485 occurrences and 131,882 attached narratives from 128 source codes -- national accident-investigation authorities, occurrence-reporting systems and four global compilations. Records are mapped into one schema; each normalized record reduces to exactly one key from an ordered ladder -- event signature, registration and date, rounded position and date, or source and native identifier -- so a missing field never creates a link, and the key is the occurrence identifier. Records the ladder cannot reach are scored in a blocked pass into an explicit merge table and applied only within an automatically approved score band or after a person confirms them. Field conflicts follow a documented source ranking; one provenance row per contributing source -- its native identifier and URL -- is retained, with attribution and licence terms per source code. Linkage error is measured on five adjudicated samples totalling 200 pairs. A recorded uniform random draw of 60 from the 3,441 merges the automatic band applies as it ships found no error; the exact two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound on its false-merge rate is 6.0%, or 205 pairs. The measured error covers the scored band only; the ladder's deterministic joins are not adjudicated. The corpus has no exposure denominators and inherits the under-reporting of its sources. It is offered as a base for cross-national safety statistics, source-disagreement studies and narrative text mining; a frozen, DOI-referenced snapshot accompanies the live API.

</details>


### [199] [Scoring Explanations Without Reading Them: Structural Shortcuts in Automated-Interpretability Evaluation Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37676)
*Xupeng Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发现自动化可解释性评分（SAE 特征解释的模型打分）可被"不读解释"的捷径规则复现甚至超越，并指出评价数据构建流程泄漏位置/标记/序列线索，提出应报告"最佳无解释基线"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 SAE 特征解释的自动化评分流程（fuzzing、let 模型逐 token 预测或判断标记是否匹配）被当作可靠指标，但作者怀疑其评价数据本身带有可利用的统计线索，使评分可绕过对解释的阅读理解，从而高估解释质量。

Method: 审计 Neuronpedia 上 500 个随机 GPT-2 small 特征的已存 fuzzing 运行：统计激活样例的裁剪方式与峰值位置，并用"中心 token 被标记就说 yes"等无解释规则重算平衡准确率；复算已存 LLM 打分器；分析 delphi 与 full-context 管线的负例标记模式；对 OpenAI 模拟基准检验"前五个序列"序列线索（post hoc）；给出此类规则的闭式分数；构建去除位置线索的窗口、推导（未构建）去除标记线索的负例、用分解分离序列线索；最后在随机偏移的自然文本窗口上测试固定偏移先验、Jev 判定模型与开放 8B 模拟器（含打乱解释对照）。

Result: 91.3% 激活样例峰值位于中心 token；"中心标记即 yes"规则平衡准确率 0.979，仅读标记数的规则 0.969，均高于已存 LLM 打分器 0.838。delphi 负例总在同一槽位标记，full-context 负例标记更多 token。OpenAI 模拟基准上"前五序列"规则池化相关 0.227，高于 GPT-4 模拟器公布的 0.160。在去除位置线索的自然文本窗口上最佳固定偏移先验仅 0.015；Jev 达池化相关 0.331（打乱解释 0.013），开放 8B 模拟器 0.194（打乱 0.019）。

Conclusion: 现有自动化可解释性基准的分数在很大程度上可由无解释捷径取得，跨管线线索形态不同且部分可在自然窗口上被削弱；报告 SAE 解释打分时应同时给出同一数据上最佳无解释规则的分数，以确保评分真正反映解释信息。

Abstract: Automated interpretability scores an explanation of a sparse-autoencoder (SAE) feature by asking a model to predict, token by token, where the feature fires on evaluation examples or to judge whether marked tokens fit it. We find that the evaluation data standard pipelines build can be scored without reading the explanation. On Neuronpedia's stored fuzzing runs for 500 random GPT-2 small features, 91.3% of activating examples are cropped with the peak on the centre token, and a rule that says "yes" when the centre token is marked reaches balanced accuracy 0.979, against 0.838 for the stored LLM scorers (recomputed from the stored per-item verdicts, on marks rebuilt from the pipeline's code); a rule reading only the mark count reaches 0.969. The cue changes form across pipelines: current delphi always marks the same slot in its fuzzing negatives, and full-context runs mark negatives with more tokens. OpenAI's simulation benchmark lists each neuron's top-activating sequences first; a rule that predicts activity on the first five scores 0.227 in pooled correlation against 0.160 for GPT-4's published simulator (post hoc). We give closed forms for what such rules can score; show that one scorer's simulation scores are higher on stored snippets than on natural windows but not shown to be reordered; and build windows that remove the position cue, derive but do not build negatives that remove the mark cues, and separate the sequence cue by decomposition. On natural-text windows cut at random offsets, the best fixed-offset prior shared by all features scores 0.015. On them, that scorer, a typed decision model (Jev), reaches a pooled correlation of 0.331 over 49 features, against 0.013 with shuffled explanations, and an open 8B simulator with the original read-out reads the explanation there (0.194 against 0.019). Scores should be reported beside the best explanation-free rule on the same items.

</details>


### [200] [The Best Second Opinion Is Right Where the Primary Is Wrong: Partner Selection for Selective Span Tagging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37678)
*Varun Kotte*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出按"主模型出错处"的留出准确率来选择第二意见模型（partner），能恢复82%的最佳伙伴增益，远优于按span F1或随机选择，并且在第四个数据集及51种语言上得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: span tagger可按风险排序并将高风险输出转交人工，但需要一个"第二意见"模型来强化排序。作者指出现有选择是全局的（按span F1选），而伙伴价值本质上是条件性、方向性的——最好的伙伴是在主模型出错的地方正确的模型，因此如何选择伙伴和如何利用伙伴的预测分布是核心问题。

Method: 在8种tagger、3个随机种子、3个英文基准上评测576个主-伙伴配对。伙伴选择规则：用主模型错误样本上的留出准确率排序候选伙伴；对照为span F1与随机选择。伙伴价值利用：不取硬标签，而用预测分布作为第二意见，并对"被服务的标签"打分（服务即按风险转交）。对LoRA微调解码器还比较独立训练的伙伴与主网络各种readout。规则在选第四数据集前冻结，之后做复现检验；并零样本应用于51个MASSIVE locale。

Result: 按主模型错误上的留出准确率选伙伴，恢复82%的最佳伙伴增益，而span F1或随机仅69–70%；在第四数据集上复现（Spearman 0.40 vs span F1的0.04）。使用预测分布并对被服务标签打分，在94%的配对中带来提升，同样在第四数据集复现。LoRA解码器场景下，独立训练的伙伴优于主网络的所有readout。51个locale中每个主模型都有有帮助的搭档，偏好伙伴随能力变化。

Conclusion: 伙伴选择应当是条件性和方向性的，而非全局指标；用预测分布而非硬标签能保留伙伴约一半被丢弃的价值。这为风险感知的span tagging中的模型组合与人工转交提供了简单、可复现的选择与打分准则。

Abstract: A span tagger that ranks its outputs by risk can defer the riskiest ones to a person, and a second model can sharpen this ranking. Which second model should it be? Partner selection is conditional, not global: the best second opinion is the model that is right where the primary is wrong. Across eight tagger types, three seeds and three English benchmarks (576 evaluated primary-partner pairings), choosing the partner by held-out accuracy on the primary's errors recovers 82% of the best partner's gain, against 69-70% for span F1 or a random pick. Frozen before a fourth dataset was chosen, the rule replicated there (Spearman 0.40 vs. 0.04 for span F1). Partner value is also directional. The predictive distribution is the second opinion: hard labels discard half of a partner's value, and scoring the served label improves 94% of pairings. Fixed before the fourth dataset was chosen, this score also replicated there. For LoRA-tuned decoders, independently trained partners beat every readout of the primary network. Applied zero-shot to 51 MASSIVE locales, every primary has a helpful trained partner in every locale, and the preferred partner follows competence.

</details>


### [201] [Exposure Is Not Commitment: Double-Stratified Evaluation of Latent Monitors for Tool-Using Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37679)
*Rishabh Sinha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文指出工具调用语言智能体的"预执行内部探针"研究结论互相矛盾，主要源于评测与训练人群未区分"注入暴露"与"行为顺从"两个因素；提出双重分层协议后，探针可提前至多两步预测智能体自身的不安全工具调用（Qwen AUROC 0.853，Mistral-7B 0.896，OLMo-2-7B 0.912）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 间接提示注入下工具型语言智能体存在安全风险，已有用模型内部表征在动作执行前拦截不安全行为的研究，但结果尖锐矛盾。作者认为冲突多属评测伪影：混合"不安全 vs 其余"的朴素对比实际学到的是"暴露"而非"顺从"。

Method: 提出双重分层协议：在评测与训练人群中分别将注入暴露（exposure）与行为承诺（behavioral commitment）解耦。在 Qwen AgentDojo 网格上对比朴素混合对比与仅在暴露样本上重训的探针，并跨模型（Mistral-7B、OLMo-2-7B）复现，配合 TF-IDF 文本基线、零样本预测与 NLA 语言化对照。

Result: 朴素对比下探针主要学到暴露：对暴露轨迹一律报警，几乎无法区分是否顺从。仅在暴露样本上重训后，探针可提前至多两步预测不安全工具调用（logistic AUROC 0.853，TF-IDF 基线 0.855）；Mistral-7B 0.896，OLMo-2-7B 0.912。表征在暴露维度上分离明显（探针 1.000 vs 文本 0.908），且在上下文被清洗或不可见时仍有信号。不同模型朴素对比学到的东西不同（一个呈暴露排序反转，另一个两轴兼有）。

Conclusion: 信号存在，但模型自身零样本预测与 NLA 语言化不能可靠恢复它；训练对比方式单独即可复现近期"预动作探针"负面结果。未分层的 AUROC 会高估潜在监控器的真实知识，朴素对比学到什么依赖人群。评测应同时分层暴露与承诺两个维度。

Abstract: Tool-using language agents are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection, and a growing literature probes model internals to catch unsafe actions before they execute, with sharply conflicting results. We argue much of the conflict is an evaluation artifact, and propose a double-stratification protocol: separate injection exposure from behavioral commitment, in both the evaluation and the training population. On the primary Qwen AgentDojo grid, monitors trained on the naive mixed unsafe-versus-rest contrast mostly learn exposure: they flag exposed trajectories whether or not the agent complies, and barely predict which cases turn unsafe. Retrained on exposed cases only, the same probe families predict the model's own unsafe tool call up to two steps early, the maximum the three-step trajectories admit (logistic AUROC 0.853, matched by a trained TF-IDF text baseline at 0.855). Mistral-7B reaches 0.896 and OLMo-2-7B 0.912; their naive contrasts learn different things: inverted exposure ranking on one, both axes on the other. Representations separate on exposure (probe 1.000 versus trained text 0.908) and where visible context is sanitized or unavailable. Training contrast alone reproduces the shape of recent pre-action-probe negative results, one candidate explanation for the conflict: the signal exists, but the model's own zero-shot forecast and NLA verbalizations do not reliably recover it. An unstratified AUROC overstates what a latent monitor knows, and what a naive contrast learns is population-dependent: evaluations should stratify both.

</details>


### [202] [Artifact Distillation: Training-Free Transfer from Frontier to Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37680)
*Mustafa Safa Ozdayi,Somin Wadhwa*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出"Artifact Distillation"，让教师模型把解题过程外化为可查询的工件库，学生模型推理时检索而不做梯度更新，可在低成本下让小模型超越更大的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有蒸馏方法需对学生模型微调，知识迁移与训练算力绑定，且迁移的知识高度不透明。作者希望在无梯度更新、更可解释的条件下缩小大模型与小模型差距。

Method: 教师模型（如Claude Opus 4.5）求解训练实例，并将其解题程序外化为一个artifact bank；学生在推理时查询该库，全程不进行梯度更新。评估覆盖四个LiveBench任务。

Result: Claude Haiku 4.5在空间推理上以0.707超过未辅助的Sonnet 4.5的0.647，成本为60%；在表格连接任务上以89%成本达到Sonnet 4.5水平。同一原始工件库使Qwen3.5-27B合并得分从0.730升至0.800。

Conclusion: 工件蒸馏可在无训练算力、跨模型家族条件下实现有效知识迁移，且过程显式可查，为缩小大小模型差距提供了新范式。

Abstract: Closing the gap between frontier and smaller language models is usually approached by distillation: fine-tuning the small model (student) on a frontier model's (teacher) outputs, which binds transfer to training compute and leaves the transferred knowledge largely opaque. We propose Artifact Distillation: a teacher solves training instances and externalizes its problem-solving procedure into an artifact bank that a student queries at inference time, with no gradient updates. Across four LiveBench tasks, a bank written by Claude Opus 4.5 lets Claude Haiku 4.5 outperform unaided Claude Sonnet 4.5 on spatial reasoning (0.707 vs. 0.647) at 60% of its cost, and reach Sonnet 4.5's level on table joining at 89% of its cost. The same raw bank raises Qwen3.5-27B's pooled score from 0.730 to 0.800, showing that transfer is not confined to the teacher's model family.

</details>


### [203] [Supervised Fine-Tuning for Reasoning Large Language Models: A Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37681)
*Yongcan Yu,Kuangpu Guo,Jian Liang,Lingxiao He,Meng Wang,Ran He*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于"面向推理的监督微调（reasoning SFT，即长链思维链数据上的SFT）"的系统性综述，从方法设计与分析研究两个视角梳理最新文献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长链思维链数据的SFT是激发和增强大模型推理能力的关键基础，相关文献增长迅速，但领域缺少一篇系统性的综述来整合这些成果。

Method: 采用双视角文献综述：①方法论层面，按SFT流程将改进归纳为以数据为中心和数据/算法两类（数据为中心与算法为中心的创新）；②分析层面，从数据特征、优化动力学、机理洞察三个维度重新组织分析性研究；最后综合研究热点与瓶颈并展望未来方向。

Result: 提出了一套涵盖数据为中心/算法为中心方法分类，以及数据特征、优化动力学、机理洞察三维度分析框架的reasoning SFT文献综述体系。

Conclusion: 该综述旨在加深对reasoning SFT的理解，并为构建更先进的推理模型铺路；同时指出了当前研究的关注点与遗留瓶颈及未来方向。

Abstract: Large reasoning models have recently demonstrated remarkable capabilities in solving complex tasks, where supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on long chain-of-thought data serves as a crucial foundation for eliciting and enhancing their reasoning abilities. Despite rapid progress in both improving and analyzing reasoning-oriented SFT, the field still lacks a systematic survey that consolidates its fast-growing literature. To fill this gap, we present a comprehensive review of recent advancements in reasoning SFT, examining the literature through the dual lenses of methodological design and analytical investigation. First, we review methodological improvements across the SFT pipeline and categorize them into data-centric approaches and algorithm-centric innovations. Second, we reorganize analytical studies along three dimensions: data characteristics, optimization dynamics, and mechanistic insights. Finally, by synthesizing current research focuses and remaining bottlenecks, we outline promising future directions for reasoning SFT. We hope this survey deepens the understanding of reasoning SFT and paves the way for advanced reasoning models.

</details>


### [204] [Rank-Aware Differentially Private Release of Listwise Preferences for LLM Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37682)
*Junwei Chen,Manjiang Yu,Pengpeng Qiao,Yang Cao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究在本地差分隐私（LDP）下基于listwise偏好反馈的大模型对齐，提出rank-aware指数机制（RAEM），将完整排序转为低敏感度的固定大小二元划分，在同等隐私预算下优于现有LDP基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Listwise偏好比pairwise提供更丰富的对齐监督，但完整排序泄露更多敏感用户偏好；现有隐私保护对齐方法主要针对pairwise反馈，listwise+LDP尚属空白。而直接把LDP扩展到listwise时，完整排序空间敏感度过高，需要过多噪声，抵消了listwise监督的优势。

Method: 分析监督粒度与隐私噪声在下游训练中的交互关系；提出rank-aware指数机制，利用排序信息采样固定大小的二元划分，把噪声集中在边界条目附近，而非像随机化响应（RR）那样对所有条目均匀扰动，从而将listwise偏好数据 privatize 为低敏感度粒度。

Result: 在下游LLM对齐任务的实证评估中，该机制在匹配的隐私预算下持续优于现有LDP基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过降低listwise偏好数据的敏感度并聚焦边界扰动，RAEM在LDP约束下有效保留listwise监督的对齐收益，为隐私保护的listwise对齐提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Listwise preference feedback offers richer supervision for large language model (LLMs) alignment than pairwise comparisons, but a full ranking also reveals more sensitive user preferences. Existing privacy-preserving alignment methods focus mainly on pairwise feedback, while listwise alignment under local differential privacy (LDP) remains unexplored. Extending LDP to this listwise domain raises a critical challenge: the high sensitivity of the full ranking space demands excessive noise, neutralizing the benefits of listwise supervision. To address this challenge, we analyze the interaction between supervision granularity and privacy noise in downstream training, and introduce a rank-aware exponential mechanism that privatizes listwise preference data into a low-sensitivity granularity suitable for downstream alignment. The mechanism leverages ranking information to sample a fixed-size binary partition, concentrating the noise near borderline items instead of perturbing all items uniformly as randomized response (RR) does. Empirical evaluations on downstream LLM alignment tasks show that our mechanism consistently outperforms existing LDP baselines at matched privacy budgets. The code is available at https://github.com/tdsai-lab/RAEM.

</details>


### [205] [Prompt-agnostic Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37683)
*Frederic Sadrieh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文针对大模型对提示词措辞敏感的问题，提出训练时的梯度合并方法Prompt-TIES和Prompt-DARE，通过缓解不同改写提示梯度间的干扰，显著降低样本级方差（近一半），而几乎不损失整体准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM对提示表述高度敏感，常用做法是推理时手工优化提示，但开销大且不具可扩展性。作者转向训练时方法，将提示鲁棒性内建于指令微调中。分析发现：把同一提示的多个改写混入训练时，各改写梯度相互干扰，57%出现符号冲突，朴素梯度平均丢弃约五分之一的幅度。

Method: 借鉴模型/梯度合并中的干扰消解算子，提出Prompt-TIES与Prompt-DARE两种梯度合并方法，作用于提示梯度以缓解改写间干扰。与三类训练时鲁棒性方法（数据构造、一致性正则、对比对齐）对比。评估覆盖两大家族、两种规模的四个模型。

Result: 提示措辞与具体样本的交互平均占样本级变异的54%，在ANLI、WiC等任务上超过70%。梯度合并方法直接提升这种局部鲁棒性，在全参数微调模型上将近减半样本级方差，且几乎不损整体准确率。其他训练时方法提升了原始性能，但未能可靠降低样本级方差。

Conclusion: 提示改写梯度干扰是提示敏感性的关键来源；梯度合并（Prompt-TIES/Prompt-DARE）在低代价下有效提升提示鲁棒性，优于现有训练时方法。代码与模型检查点已开源。

Abstract: Despite their strong performance, large language models remain highly sensitive to prompt formulation. This issue is typically addressed at inference-time through manual prompt optimization, which introduces overhead and lacks scalability. Conversely, we focus on train-time approaches that build prompt robustness into the model during instruction tuning. A common strategy is to mix multiple paraphrases of each prompt into training. We demonstrate that across trainable parameters, the per-paraphrasing gradients interfere, with 57% exhibiting sign conflicts and the naive gradient average discarding approximately a fifth of the magnitude. Therefore, we develop two gradient-merging methods, Prompt-TIES and Prompt-DARE, that address this interference by leveraging interference-resolution operators from model and gradient merging and applying them to prompt gradients. In this study, we compare the efficacy of our methods to increase model robustness to train-time robustness methods spanning all three established classes: data construction, consistency regularization, and contrastive alignment. The evaluation is conducted across four models from two families at two scales. We observe the interaction between prompt phrasing and the specific examples accounts for 54% of per-example variability on average, and exceeds 70% on tasks such as ANLI and WiC. The gradient-merging methods directly improve this local robustness and nearly halve per-example variance on fully fine-tuned models at little cost to overall accuracy. The other train-time methods enhance raw performance, but fail to improve per-example variance reliably. Code: https://github.com/FSadrieh/prompt-agnostic-llms. Model checkpoints: https://huggingface.co/prompt-agnostic-language-models.

</details>


### [206] [An Introduction to Large Language Models for Scientists and Professionals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37684)
*Umberto Michelucci*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该书是面向科学家与从业者的LLM实用入门，避开数学细节，讲解机制、局限、风险与RAG、智能体等进阶主题，并附有基于Ollama和Open WebUI的本地实操练习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM已成为科研、教育、医学与专业工作的重要工具，用户虽感其简单易用，但要负责任地使用，必须理解其工作原理、局限及如何评估输出，故需一本可操作的入门教材。

Method: 以通俗方式讲解tokenisation、embedding、训练、推理、上下文窗口、提示与指令层级等核心概念；讨论幻觉、不确定性、可复现性、偏见及人工监督；介绍RAG、检索质量、分块、向量搜索、智能体与工作流；并设计无需编程的实操练习，让读者用Ollama与Open WebUI运行本地模型，与科学论文集交互。

Result: 形成一本面向都灵大学医学人工智能硕士课程的教学用书，兼顾概念解释、风险治理与实际动手操作。

Conclusion: 该书强调证据检索、来源核验、不确定性与研究间分歧的辨识，以及区分"语言上合理"与"科学上有据"的结论，旨在培养负责任的LLM使用能力。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have rapidly become important tools for science, education, medicine, and professional work. Despite their apparent simplicity from the user's perspective, effective and responsible use requires an understanding of how these systems work, what their limitations are, and how their outputs should be evaluated. I wrote this document as a basis for my lecture on LLM in the master in artificial intelligence in medicine at the university of Turin, Italy. This book provides a practical and accessible introduction to LLMs for scientists and professionals. It explains the fundamental ideas behind tokenisation, embeddings, training, inference, context windows, prompting, and instruction hierarchies, while deliberately avoiding mathematical detail. Particular attention is given to the limitations of LLM-generated answers, including hallucinations, uncertainty, reproducibility, bias, and the need for systematic verification and human oversight. The book also discusses privacy, governance, security, and the responsible handling of personal and sensitive information. More advanced topics include Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), retrieval quality, chunking, embeddings, vector search, agents, tools, and workflows. A substantial practical exercise guides the reader through running a local LLM with Ollama and Open WebUI and using it to interact with a collection of scientific papers. The exercise emphasizes evidence retrieval, source verification, uncertainty, disagreement between studies, and the distinction between plausible language and scientifically supported conclusions. No programming knowledge is required.

</details>


### [207] [From Geometry to Behavior: How Instruction Exposure Unlocks Latent Rhetorical Directions in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37685)
*Shengjie Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 语言模型从预训练数据中吸收了"类比推理"这一修辞策略，本文用差均值法从残差流中提取"类比向量"，发现该方向在所有基座模型中都存在，但其被线性干预激活的行为可及性随指令暴露程度连续增长，从而挑战了"基座 vs 指令"的二元框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者关心两个问题：类比这一修辞能力是否在指令微调之前就以几何形式存在于表征空间中；又是什么决定了它在推理时能否被激活。既有研究常把"基座模型"与"指令模型"当作二分对立，本文希望检验这一划分是否成立。

Method: 采用激活引导（activation steering）与表征工程方法：用差均值（difference-in-means）从残差流中提取"类比向量"，在七个指令微调模型（Gemma-2、Llama-3.1、Qwen-2.5，2B–32B）上做可操控的解释风格引导实验；在 Gemma-2-9B-IT 的 300 条留出测试提示上评估，并用小型人工验证检验 LLM 评委对"类比质量"的评分；进一步对七组匹配的基座-指令模型对，比较引导效果与基座/指令向量的余弦相似度。

Result: 引导使 Gemma-2-9B-IT 的调和平均数从 3.22 提升到 3.94（+22%），人工验证支持 LLM 评委的可靠性。核心发现是"行为可及性梯度"：类比方向存在于每个基座模型中，但其可被线性干预激活的程度随训练中的指令暴露量连续变化。Gemma-2 基座模型（预训练与指令微调严格分离）引导效果平坦——方向存在但行为上惰性；Qwen-2.5 基座模型（指令数据混入预训练）在显式微调前已部分可及。基座与指令模型类比向量的余弦相似度在 Qwen 上达 0.94–0.97，而 Gemma 仅 0.37–0.66，为行为梯度提供了几何佐证。

Conclusion: 关键变量不是"是否经过指令微调"，而是模型在整个训练流程中累计的指令暴露程度；这一程度组织并决定了修辞知识在激活空间中的可及性。作者将激活引导定位为一种补充性的可解释性工具，用以揭示指令暴露如何在表征层面组织语言能力。

Abstract: Language models do not merely memorize facts; they absorb rhetorical strategies from pretraining data, including the human tendency to reason by analogy. We ask: is this absorbed capability geometrically accessible before any instruction tuning, and what determines whether it can be activated at inference time?
  We extract an "Analogy Vector" from the residual stream via difference-in-means and show it enables steerable explanation style across seven instruction-tuned models (Gemma-2, Llama-3.1, Qwen-2.5; 2B-32B), improving harmonic mean from 3.22 to 3.94 (+22%) for Gemma-2-9B-IT on 300 held-out test prompts. A small human validation study confirms the LLM judge on Analogy Quality.
  Our central finding, from seven matched base-instruct pairs, is a gradient of behavioral accessibility: the analogy direction exists in every base model, but its behavioral accessibility under linear intervention scales continuously with instruction exposure during training. Gemma-2 base models (strict pretraining/IT separation) show flat steering landscapes: present but behaviorally inert. Qwen-2.5 base models (instruction data woven into pretraining) are already partially accessible before any explicit fine-tuning; base-instruct cosine similarity of the analogy vector reaches 0.94-0.97 for Qwen versus 0.37-0.66 for Gemma, providing geometric corroboration of the behavioral gradient. This challenges the binary "base vs instruct" framing: the relevant variable is how much instruction exposure a model has received across its full training pipeline. We position activation steering as a complementary interpretability tool that reveals how instruction exposure organizes rhetorical knowledge in activation space.

</details>


### [208] [One Confidence Threshold, Unequal Coverage: Language Gaps in Typed Decision Interfaces and How Translating Inputs Reduces Them](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37688)
*Junwei Yao,Yongxi Zhou,Zike Yang,Zhijun Wang,Jianan Liu,Yanxian Chen,Wenbo Ye*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在置信度阈值门控的决策接口上，英语在同等正确率下比其他50种语言更常越过0.9阈值，覆盖率系统性偏低（8.6–11.7个百分点），且ECE等标准校准指标无法检测，建议按语言报告操作阈值下的覆盖率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署的分类器通常仅在置信度超过阈值时自动给出预测，否则转人工。作者想检验：单一阈值在类型化决策接口（API返回多选题每个选项概率）上是否对所有语言同样公平，即"阈值门控"是否存在语言间不对等。

Method: 预注册的验证性研究：三家厂商接口对MASSIVE数据集1,000条样本、51种语言分类，阈值0.9。分析"同一请求在英语与其他语言均回答正确"时英语越过阈值的比例差异；将各语言重新加权到相同准确率；用ECE检测校准差异；探索性分析：为每语言拟合各自阈值以达相同5%错误目标、将输入翻译成英语、以及非洲语言原生态输入与英语人工翻译的对比。

Result: 即使英/他语均正确，英语越过0.9阈值的频率平均高8.6–11.7个百分点；其他所有语言观测覆盖率均低于英语，而门控自动处理的请求很少出错。重加权至相同准确率后差距仍在，ECE在一个接口上检测不到该差距。即使在每语言各自阈值下达到相同5%错误目标，英语覆盖率仍更高；翻译成英语在0.9阈值下几乎消除差距但在错误目标下英语仍领先。

Conclusion: 单一置信度阈值在语言间并不等价，英语享有系统性覆盖率优势而准确性无差，标准校准指标漏检该问题。建议在操作阈值下按语言报告覆盖率。

Abstract: Deployed classifiers often act on a prediction only when its confidence clears a threshold and pass the rest to a person. We ask whether one threshold serves all languages equally on typed decision interfaces, APIs that return a probability for each option of a fixed multiple-choice question. In a confirmatory study with a written analysis plan, three vendors' interfaces classified 1,000 MASSIVE items, each in 51 languages, with a threshold of 0.9. Even when a request is answered correctly in both English and another language, the English version clears the threshold more often, by 8.6-11.7 percentage points on average. Observed coverage, the share of requests handled automatically, is lower than English's in every other language, while the requests the gate handles are rarely wrong. The gap remains when every language is reweighted to the same accuracy, and a standard calibration metric (ECE) does not detect it on one interface. In exploratory analyses, English's coverage stays higher when each language gets its own threshold fitted to the same 5% error target. Translating inputs into English nearly closes the gap at 0.9 but leaves English ahead at that error target. Requests written natively in African languages show a gap in the same direction when English is their human translation. We recommend reporting per-language coverage at the operating threshold.

</details>


### [209] [Bouba Beats Kiki, and Other Regularities in the Subjective Preferences of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37692)
*Katy Blumer,Jon Kleinberg,Ravi Kumar,Andrew Tomkins*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出对LLM「主观评价」的早期框架：在无明确最优答案时，模型如何在多个可行回答中做选择？作者用数字、婴儿名、虚构城市三类短内容，识别29个句法/语义方面，发现模型对这些方面有稳定偏好，且偏好会随提问方式剧烈变化，提示操纵风险及生成-排序两阶段间的交互效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评测工具能较好衡量模型在客观标准下的准确性，但缺乏评估任务主观方面的成熟方法。现实中用户任务常处于纯客观与纯主观之间（如起名），因此需要回答：当多个回答都可行、没有明显赢家时，模型如何做选择。

Method: 聚焦短形式内容，构建三类比较任务：数字、婴儿名、虚构城市；提取29个涵盖句法与语义的方面（长度、字母序、流行度、元音构成、发音等）；分析模型在两两比较中的偏好、提问方式变化对各方面激活/抑制的影响，以及「生成候选列表」与「对候选排序」两阶段的交互。

Result: (1) 模型对某些方面表现出强烈且可复现的偏好/厌恶；(2) 偏好表达方式的改变会使部分方面在选择中被激活或失效；(3) 看似无关紧要的提问变化会导致整体成对偏好分布发生巨大改变，引发操纵性担忧；(4) 当模型既生成候选又对其排序时，两阶段间存在意外交互，也会影响其陈述的偏好。

Conclusion: 主观评价不能简单以对错衡量，须关注模型在可行选项中做选择的机制。模型偏好虽稳定却高度受提问方式与流程结构影响，这为评测方法设计与防操纵提出新问题，也是主观评价方法论的早期一步。

Abstract: Users engage with large language models on tasks that are purely objective ("When was Netflix founded?"), purely subjective ("What should I name my child?") or anywhere in-between. We have rich tools for evaluating model accuracy with respect to objective criteria. However, when it comes to subjective aspects of a task, we do not have similarly developed methodology at hand. In this paper, we take some early steps towards framing the question of subjective evaluation. Rather than measure how often a model is right or wrong on a question, we instead ask, how do models make choices among multiple viable responses without a clear winner?
  To study this question, we restrict our focus to short-form content, and consider comparison tasks among three such content types: numbers, baby names, and fictional cities. We identify 29 aspects of these short-form examples covering many areas of syntax and semantics (length, alphabetic order, popularity, vowel mix, spoken sound, etc.). We show first that models tend to have strong and reproducible preferences for or against some of these aspects. Second, we show that variations in how the model is asked to express a preference may cause some of these aspects to activate or deactivate in the model's selection. Third, we show that overall preference distributions among pairs may vary radically based on seemingly-unimportant variations in the nature of the question posed to the model, raising new questions about manipulation. And finally, we show that, if models are used both to create lists of alternatives and to rank them, there are unexpected interactions between the two stages that may also drive the models' stated preferences.

</details>


### [210] [Multi-Draft On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Drafters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37778)
*Petr Molodyk,Yuchen Zhu,Jaemoo Choi,Molei Tao,Yongxin Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MDraft：多草稿在线策略蒸馏，用同一上下文采多个草稿块并聚合验证器全词表条件分布，缓解并行起草与验证器前缀错配，提升接受长度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一步扩散草稿器并行预测一个 token 块以降低投机解码的串行开销，但其在预测每个 token 时看不到同块内先前采样的 token，而验证器的预测条件于这些 token，导致同一草稿预测面对不同采样前缀产生不同目标；分别对这些目标蒸馏会压制某些前缀下合理、另一些前缀下不合理的 token，从而损害草稿接受率。

Method: 提出 Multi-Draft On-Policy Distillation (MDraft)：从同一上下文采样多个草稿块，将这些块的前缀下验证器的全词表条件分布进行聚合，作为训练目标；利用所有草稿从验证器收集信息，使来自其他前缀的支持影响训练目标。方法只改变训练，保持草稿器结构与推理流程不变。

Result: 该算法将并行草稿器的接受长度提升到超过预训练水平，并缓解分布错配的影响；在数学、代码与会话任务上，接受的草稿长度优于先前的蒸馏方法。

Conclusion: 通过多草稿聚合验证器条件分布，MDraft 有效解决了并行起草中的前缀错配问题，所得草稿器可直接替换预训练检查点使用。

Abstract: Speculative decoding is used to reduce the inference cost of language models. One-step diffusion drafters propose a block of multiple tokens in parallel, reducing the sequential cost of speculative decoding. On-policy distillation trains these drafters using verifier feedback on their own proposals. However, parallel drafting makes this feedback difficult to use: the drafter predicts each token without observing the preceding tokens sampled within the same block, while the verifier conditions its prediction on those tokens. Different sampled prefixes therefore give different verifier targets for the same drafter prediction. We show that distilling against these targets separately can suppress tokens that are plausible after some prefixes but unlikely after others, harming draft acceptance. We explain the effects of this mismatch and introduce Multi-Draft On-Policy Distillation (MDraft), a new parallel drafter distillation method which samples several draft blocks from the same context and aggregates the verifier's full-vocabulary conditionals across their prefixes. We use all the drafts to collect information from the verifier, allowing support from alternative prefixes to influence the training target. The resulting algorithm improves the acceptance length of a parallel drafter beyond the level of pre-training, and alleviates the effects of the distributional mismatch. MDraft changes only training, retaining the drafter's architecture and inference procedure, allowing the resulting drafter to be used as-is in place of the pretrained checkpoint. Experiments on a suite of mathematical, coding, and conversational tasks show longer accepted drafts than prior distillation methods.

</details>


### [211] [Locating Sycophancy Across Training Stages in Open Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37788)
*Jiarui Yao,Shweta Parihar,Nghia Tuan Bui,Guergana K Savova,Lijing Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文在5个模型家族的13个开放检查点上逐阶段测量谄媚行为，发现存在两种起源不同的谄媚：对提示中注入主张的"顺从"在基座模型中已存在，而对话中的"投降"主要由后训练引入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 谄媚（模型在用户暗示错误答案时改变正确答案）通常被归因于偏好类后训练，但早期测量已在预训练模型中发现该现象，其来源尚不清楚。作者希望定位谄媚究竟产生于训练的哪个阶段，并厘清不同谄媚行为的成因差异。

Method: 在5个模型家族的13个开放检查点上覆盖全部可得训练阶段（基座模型→监督微调→偏好优化→发布版本）进行测量。将"注入主张对答案的移动幅度"与"原答案的坚持强度"分离；并变换主张来源、来源被描述的可信度以及主张的强度。

Result: 识别出两种可在不同数据集上复现的谄媚行为：对提示中主张的顺从在所有基座模型中即已存在，且其来源排序与后训练后代一致；对话中的投降（用户反对时放弃已给出的答案）在基座模型中基本缺失，而在所有后训练检查点中均出现。当反对意见给出替代答案时，多数后训练模型放弃坚定答案的频率与放弃不坚定答案相当。

Conclusion: 谄媚并非单一现象，至少包含分别源于预训练与后训练的两类行为，需分别评估与应对：评估谄媚时应区分移动幅度与坚持强度并分别考察两类行为；针对顺从与投降应提出不同的缓解方法。

Abstract: Language model assistants sometimes change a correct answer when the user suggests a wrong one. The behavior, called sycophancy, is usually attributed to preference-based post-training, yet early measurements found it in pretrained models. We ask where it comes from by measuring it at every available stage of training: 13 open checkpoints from 5 lineages, from base model through supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization to release. We separate how far an injected claim moves a model's answer from how firmly the answer was held, and vary who makes the claim, how reliable they are said to be, and how strongly they make it. Two sycophancy behaviors with different origins emerge, and both replicate across datasets. Deference to a claim in the prompt is already present in every base model, which ranks sources in the same order as its post-trained descendants. Capitulation in conversation, dropping a stated answer when the user objects, is largely absent from base models and present in every post-trained checkpoint. When the objection names an alternative, most post-trained models give up firmly held answers as often as loosely held ones. We discuss the implications of these measurements for evaluating sycophancy and approaches for addressing each behavior.

</details>


### [212] [DeFT-RAG: Incrementally Decomposing Multi-Hop Questions into Self-Contained Sub-Questions with Reusable Answers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37826)
*Dingyi Kang,Bingzhe Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 DeFT-RAG，通过“一次只生成一个自包含子问题+将剩余LLM工作外置+QA缓存复用”改进多跳RAG。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG难以处理多跳问题（需经由问题未提及的中间实体串联多篇文档的事实）。图式RAG只对问题命名实体检索一次，难恢复完整证据链；迭代式RAG虽逐步恢复，但让LLM同时承担子问题规划、依赖判断、改写与知识追踪等多项任务，准确率受限。

Method: 三组件构成：1) 基于原问题与已答QA对，每次生成一个自包含子问题（显式命名每个实体），免去规划、依赖追踪与改写，使LLM只专注单一细粒度任务；2) 将剩余LLM工作外置——用规则更新QA表追踪已知信息，用微调轻量决策模型做是/否判断；3) 缓存QA对，后续出现语义相同子问题时复用答案。

Result: 在MuSiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA、HotpotQA上，以gpt-4o-mini和Qwen3.6为骨干时，于13个基线中取得最佳准确率，且输入token少于任何其他迭代方法；在1000道MuSiQue共享QA缓存下，23.1%子问题由缓存作答，LLM调用减少12.9%且准确率不降。

Conclusion: 将LLM职责分解为单一细粒度任务、把可规则化/轻量化的工作移出LLM并复用历史答案，可有效提升多跳RAG的准确率、降低token与调用开销。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) lets a large language model (LLM) answer questions by retrieving relevant passages from a large corpus. However, RAG struggles with multi-hop questions, which require chaining facts spread across several documents through intermediate entities that the question never mentions. Graph-based RAG methods retrieve once from the entities a question names and so rarely recover the full evidence chain. Iterative RAG methods recover it step by step, but their accuracy is limited by the many tasks they ask the LLM to perform, such as planning the sub-questions, deciding their dependencies, rewriting them as answers arrive, and keeping track of what is known. We propose DeFT-RAG, a RAG framework built on three components. First, DeFT-RAG generates one self-contained sub-question at a time from the original question and the sub-questions answered so far with their answers (QA pairs). Each sub-question names every entity it asks about, which removes the need to plan, track dependencies or rewrite, and lets the LLM focus on a single fine-grained task at a time. Second, DeFT-RAG moves the remaining LLM work outside the LLM: rule-based updates to a QA table that keeps track of what is known, and yes/no decisions made by a fine-tuned lightweight decision model. Third, DeFT-RAG caches the QA pairs and reuses an answer when a later question asks a sub-question with the same meaning. On MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA and HotpotQA, DeFT-RAG achieves the best accuracy among thirteen baselines with both gpt-4o-mini and Qwen3.6 as the backbone, while giving the LLM fewer input tokens than any other iterative method. With a QA cache shared across 1,000 MuSiQue questions, 23.1% of sub-questions are answered from the cache, which reduces LLM calls by 12.9% without lowering accuracy.

</details>


### [213] [Human-Residual Steering: Aligning Frozen LLM Judges with Human Judgment Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37868)
*Chen Lyu,Phong Do,Gabriele Pergola*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: HRS通过对冻结LLM隐藏状态施加学习到的低秩干预，使LLM评判者输出分布对齐到个体人类评分的全分布，在14个基准上优于冻结权重基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM自动评判的对齐方法多针对聚合人类判断，忽略标注者间差异；匹配完整评分分布的方法主要依赖输出层校准或参数微调，前者表达力有限、后者成本高。

Method: 先用oracle分析表明单层低秩修正即可消除大部分评判者-人类分布差异；据此提出HRS，从评判者隐藏表示与评分logits预测该修正，基于个体标注、采用适用于序数与名义判断的proper scoring rules训练，并穿过冻结下游层优化。

Result: 在3个模型家族4个评判者、14个基准上均优于所有冻结权重基线；Qwen2.5-7B在13/14基准取得最低JS距离，均值从0.565降至0.352（最强校准器为0.377）；Spearman相关从0.449升至0.579；在有限标注预算下提升群体估计，参数量比分布微调少约88倍。

Conclusion: 隐藏状态层面的低秩干预是一种高效轻量的方案，可在冻结权重下对齐LLM评判者与人类评分分布，兼顾对齐质量与参数效率。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used as automated judges, yet most alignment methods target aggregated human judgments and overlook variation among individual annotators. Existing approaches to matching the full distribution of human ratings mainly rely on output-level calibration or parameter fine-tuning. We propose Human-Residual Steering (HRS), to our knowledge the first method to align frozen LLM judges with human judgment distributions through learned hidden-state interventions. An oracle analysis shows that low-rank corrections at a single layer remove most of the discrepancy between judge and human distributions. HRS learns to predict such corrections from the judge's hidden representation and rating logits, training on individual annotations with proper scoring rules for ordinal and nominal judgments and optimising through the frozen downstream layers. Across 14 benchmarks and four judges from three model families, HRS outperforms all evaluated frozen-weight baselines. With Qwen2.5-7B, it achieves the lowest Jensen-Shannon distance on 13 of 14 benchmarks, reducing the mean from 0.565 to 0.352 versus 0.377 for the strongest calibrator. HRS also raises mean Spearman correlation with aggregate human scores from 0.449 to 0.579, improves population-level estimation under limited annotation budgets, and trains about 88 times fewer parameters than distributional fine-tuning at a modest cost in alignment.

</details>


### [214] [Grounding Long Financial Text with Semantically-Enriched Tables via Multimodal Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37913)
*Xiaoyu Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出多模态Transformer框架，将金融表格转为语义增强的token序列，通过交叉注意力与长文本融合，实现表格条件化的长文本聚合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融文档同时包含结构化表格与嘈杂的非结构化文本披露（如MD&A），现有方法难以高效建模长文档并捕捉跨模态依赖；仅用数值编码的表格表示表达能力不足。

Method: 将金融表格表示为语义增强的token序列；为每个数值变量附加由其文本定义导出的语义嵌入，同时编码数值大小与经济含义；通过交叉注意力机制整合长文本与表格；以冻结的变量级表格表示作为交叉注意力query，使模型针对每个财务变量和观测对MD&A片段进行不同加权。

Result: 在财务报表与MD&A大规模数据集上，结构化数值特征仍是预测信号的主要来源；文本信息通过交叉注意力（而非简单拼接）可带来一致的增量收益；嘈杂文本在稳定的语义化表格表示条件下最有用。

Conclusion: 交叉注意力是长文本叙事证据进行表格条件化聚合的高效机制；语义增强的表格表示比纯数值嵌入更具表达力且参数高效。

Abstract: We propose a multimodal transformer framework for efficiently modeling long1 financial documents that combine structured tabular data with noisy, unstructured2 textual disclosures. The framework represents financial tables as semantically3 enriched token sequences and integrates them with long-form text through a cross-4 attention mechanism that explicitly captures cross-modal dependencies. In par-5 ticular, we augment each numerical variable with a semantic embedding derived6 from its textual definition, enabling the model to encode both numerical magnitude7 and economic meaning. This design yields a more expressive and parameter-8 efficient representation of tabular data compared to value-only embeddings. Using9 a large-scale dataset of financial statements and MD&A disclosures, we show that10 structured numerical features remain the dominant source of predictive signal;11 however, textual information provides consistent incremental gains when incor-12 porated via cross-attention rather than simple concatenation. Our results further13 demonstrate that noisy textual disclosures are most useful when conditioned on a14 stable, semantically structured tabular representation. In particular, using frozen15 variable-level tabular representations as cross-attention queries enables the model16 to weight MD&A chunks differently for each financial variable and observation.17 These findings suggest that cross-attention provides an efficient mechanism for18 table-conditioned aggregation of long-form narrative evidence.

</details>


### [215] [FAD-KV: Adaptive Dictionary KV Caching for Efficient Reasoning Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37921)
*Yuxuan Zhu,David H. Yang,Parisa Shiravani,Mohammad Mohammadi Amiri,Tejaswini Pedapati,Subhajit Chaudhury,Keerthiram Murugesan,Pin-Yu Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出FAD-KV，一种基于快速自适应字典的KV缓存压缩框架，通过筛选式稀疏编码与固定尺寸字典自适应，实现长推理解码下的有界内存与高效计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长输出推理中KV缓存内存与计算随生成长度线性增长，压缩至关重要。基于字典的稀疏KV压缩能保留token级结构且不强制全局低秩，但现有方法存在两个问题：迭代稀疏编码（如OMP）带来解码开销，静态字典与测试时演化的KV分布失配，而朴素追加式自适应又导致字典膨胀。

Method: FAD-KV包含两部分：(i) 基于筛选的稀疏编码——一次性Top-n选择出小候选池，再做轻量系数精修，替代迭代式稀疏编码；(ii) 固定尺寸字典自适应机制——复用不活跃原子而非扩展字典，从而同时控制编码成本与字典增长。

Result: 在推理与长上下文基准上，FAD-KV取得较强的质量-效率权衡，并在解码过程中避免字典无界增长。

Conclusion: 通过同时约束稀疏编码成本与自适应字典规模，FAD-KV为长推理负载提供了一种内存有界、计算高效的KV压缩框架。

Abstract: Key-value (KV) caching is a core mechanism in large language models, where intermediate key and value representations are stored to accelerate autoregressive decoding. As generation length increases, KV cache memory and computation grow linearly, making compression critical for efficient long-output reasoning. Dictionary-based sparse KV compression is appealing because it represents each token's KV states as a sparse combination of learned basis elements (atoms) in a dictionary, preserving token-level structure without enforcing a global low-rank constraint. However, existing dictionary-based methods face two practical limitations during decoding: iterative sparse coding methods such as Orthogonal Matching Pursuit add decoding-time overhead, and static dictionaries may mismatch evolving KV distributions under test-time generation. While adaptive dictionary updates can reduce this mismatch, naive append-only strategies lead to dictionary growth during generation. We propose FAD-KV, a \textbf{F}ast \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{D}ictionary KV caching framework for efficient reasoning decoding. FAD-KV integrates (i) a screening-based sparse coding scheme, where a one-shot Top-\(n\) selection identifies a small candidate pool followed by lightweight coefficient refinement, and (ii) a fixed-size dictionary adaptation mechanism that reuses inactive atoms instead of expanding the dictionary. By controlling both sparse coding cost and adaptive dictionary growth, FAD-KV provides a memory-bounded and computation-efficient KV compression framework for long reasoning workloads. Experiments on reasoning and long-context benchmarks show that FAD-KV achieves a strong quality-efficiency trade-off while avoiding unbounded dictionary growth during decoding.

</details>


### [216] [QMUL_AK at AISA-ArabicFC: Schema-Constrained Function Calling with ALLaM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37995)
*Ali Khairallah,Arkaitz Zubiaga*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: QMUL_AK 系统将阿拉伯语-英语 ALLaM-7B-Instruct 模型经 LoRA 适配为函数调用系统，在 AISA-ArabicFC 2026 盲测中两个赛道均排名第 3，Track C 方言鲁棒性诊断排名第 1（21 队）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿拉伯语函数调用（含方言变体）是一项资源稀缺的任务。作者希望在仅用官方任务数据、不引入外部数据的条件下，构建一个既适用于 Track A 基础函数调用、又支持 Track B 推理增强调用，并在方言扰动下保持鲁棒的系统。

Method: 以 ALLaM-7B-Instruct（阿拉伯语-英语双语）为基座，用 LoRA 做低秩适配；关键组件包括：阿拉伯语模式感知提示、方言与 no-call 样本重采样、token 加权训练目标，以及对生成调用结果按候选工具 schema 做确定性校验。同一输出格式同时服务 Track A 与 Track B。

Result: 开发集：函数准确率 0.9982，参数精确匹配 0.8920，总分 A=0.9345、B=0.9454。盲测：A=0.9253、B=0.9380，两赛道均第 3；Track C 方言鲁棒性诊断宏平均 0.9075，排名 21 队第 1，方言差距 0.077 为共享任务最小。

Conclusion: 函数（工具）选择已接近饱和（0.998），参数抽取才是主要错误来源；系统的方言重采样与 schema 校验对跨方言鲁棒性贡献显著。作者据此建议后续工作应聚焦参数级抽取与方言覆盖。

Abstract: We describe the QMUL_AK submission to AISA-ArabicFC 2026. The system adapts the Arabic-English ALLaM-7B-Instruct model to function calling with low-rank adaptation (LoRA). It combines an Arabic schema-aware prompt, dialect and no-call resampling, a token-weighted training objective, and deterministic validation of generated calls against the candidate tool schema. The same output supports Track A function calling and Track B reasoning-augmented calling. Training uses only the official task data. On the development set, the system achieves 0.9982 function accuracy and 0.8920 argument exact match, corresponding to overall A and B scores of 0.9345 and 0.9454. On the blind test set, the system reaches overall A and B scores of 0.9253 and 0.9380, ranking 3rd on both submission tracks and 1st of 21 teams on the Track C dialect-robustness diagnostic with a macro-averaged score of 0.9075 and the smallest dialect gap in the shared task (0.077). The results show that function selection is nearly saturated, while argument extraction remains the main source of error.

</details>


### [217] [Large Language Models for Accurate Medical Chart Abstraction: Enabling Scalable and Secure Artificial Intelligence Deployment in Stroke](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38009)
*Zhusi Zhong,Carl M. Porto,David Hong,Miranda Gonzales,Revyn Kim,Gnaneswari Karayi,Lulu Bi,Joshua R. Feler,Elias Shaaya,Scott Collins,Liqi Shu,Grayson Baird,Mahesh Jayaraman,Shadi Yaghi,Zhicheng Jiao,Dylan N. Wolman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究评估了基于提示的开源大语言模型框架，从3家医院2416份急性卒中神经介入报告中提取8个临床变量；LLaMA3.3-70B结合思维链提示达到最高94.8%准确率，且AI预测在多数变量上与专家判断的一致性优于非专家标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 病历抽象需将非结构化临床叙述转为结构化变量，用于研究与质量监测，但人工提取成本高、难规模化；需验证本地部署的提示式LLM能否可靠完成该任务。

Method: 对22个指令微调开源LLM（覆盖不同架构、规模及生物医学适配）分别使用Quick Response与Chain-of-Thought提示进行评测；以非专家人员标注作为跨模型参考标准，仅纳入LLaMA3.3-70B CoT有有效预测且有参考标签的报告-变量对；指标包括提取准确率、推理延迟及与专家裁定的一致性；每个变量抽取20例不一致样本，由2名资深医师和4名医学生复核。

Result: LLaMA3.3-70B总体准确率最高（94.8%）；CoT在需推理的变量（如闭塞部位）上更优，Quick Response适合直接陈述的手术字段；专家裁定显示多数变量上AI预测比非专家标注更贴近专家判断，颅内血管成形术仍是难点。

Conclusion: 本地部署的LLM可支持可扩展的临床信息提取与回顾性卒中登记库整理，但模糊病例仍需专家监督。

Abstract: Medical chart abstraction transforms unstructured clinical narratives into structured variables for research and quality monitoring. We evaluated a prompting-based large language model (LLM) framework for extracting eight clinical variables from 2,416 neurointerventional acute stroke intervention reports across three hospitals. Twenty-two instruction-tuned open-source LLMs were evaluated across architectures, model sizes, and biomedical adaptations using Quick Response and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting. Non-expert staff annotations served as the cross-model reference standard. Evaluation was restricted to report-variable pairs with a valid LLaMA3.3-70B CoT prediction and a corresponding reference label. Performance measures included extraction accuracy, inference latency, and agreement with expert adjudication. Twenty discordant cases per variable underwent review by two senior physicians and four medical students. LLaMA3.3-70B achieved the highest overall accuracy (94.8%). CoT improved performance on inference-dependent variables such as site of occlusion, while Quick Response was optimal for directly stated procedural fields. Expert adjudication showed that AI predictions were more closely aligned with expert interpretations than non-expert annotations for most variables, with intracranial angioplasty remaining a challenge. Locally deployed LLMs can support scalable clinical information extraction and retrospective stroke registry curation, with expert oversight for ambiguous cases.

</details>


### [218] [Beyond Aggregate WER: In-domain Adaptation, Learner Speech, Code-Switching, and Speaker Attribution in Online Spanish Learning Classrooms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38016)
*Olga Kellert,Samhitha Harish,Johnatan E Bonilla,Nemika Tyagi,Phanos Kareen,Nelvin Licona-Guevara*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在教育场景的二语西班牙语课堂互动语音上，比较多种ASR配置，并用LoRA做域内适配；结果显示域匹配比数据量更重要，开源MOSS适配版可与商用系统竞争。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ASR被越来越多用于教育NLP生成转写，但总体WER会掩盖集中于学习者语音、多语种切换和说话人归属上的错误，因此需要按条件细分的评估与针对性的域内适配。

Method: 在L1英语学习者与教师/辅导者在线L2西班牙语互动的留出会话上，比较平台集成、开放权重、适配和商用四类ASR配置。评估包含整体WER/CER、按说话人角色与语言情境（纯西语、纯英语、语码转换）分解的WER，以及DER（diarization error rate）。并用人校正的域内课堂数据对Whisper large-v3与MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize做LoRA适配。

Result: MOSS适配在各说话人角色与语言情境上均稳定提升，Whisper提升较小。域匹配比数据量更重要：更大的域外双语与学习者语料不如更小的课堂语料。开源MOSS适配版在WER/CER上与商用Muse Voice Transcribe相当，且在各自可用录音上系统自报DER更低。学习者语音、纯英语与语码转换语音仍比教师语音与纯西语语音更难。

Conclusion: 研究说明条件感知评估（condition-aware evaluation）与交互匹配数据（interactionally matched data）对双语教育ASR的价值，总体指标会低估真实困难。

Abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) increasingly supplies transcripts for educational NLP, but aggregate word error rate (WER) can conceal errors concentrated in learner speech, multilingual turns, and speaker attribution. We compare platform-integrated, open-weight, adapted, and commercial ASR configurations on held-out sessions of online L2 Spanish interaction between L1 English learners and their instructors and tutors. Because English is the learner's shared first language, the interactions contain Spanish-only, English-only, and code-switched turns. Evaluation combines overall WER and character error rate (CER), WER disaggregated by speaker role and language context, and diarization error rate (DER). We also adapt Whisper large-v3 and MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize with LoRA using human-corrected in-domain classroom data. MOSS adaptation produced consistent improvements across speaker roles and language contexts, whereas Whisper showed smaller gains. Domain match proved more important than data volume: Larger out-of-domain bilingual and learner corpora did not outperform the smaller classroom corpus, where learner speech and code-switching are embedded in instructor--learner interaction. The open-weight MOSS adapter was competitive with commercial Muse Voice Transcribe on WER and CER and achieved lower system-provided DER on the recordings eligible for each system. Learner, English-only, and code-switched speech remained more difficult than instructor and Spanish-only speech. The findings demonstrate the value of condition-aware evaluation and interactionally matched data for bilingual educational ASR.

</details>


### [219] [CARF: Context-Aware Reasoning Supervision for Scientific Evidence Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38041)
*Nishtha Agarwal,Adam Visokay,Astha Wahi,Kwabena Owusu Aninkora,Amy Gu,Tyler McCormick,Li Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CARF：利用专家对模型推理的反馈做人在回路适配，辅助系统综述标题/摘要筛选，在高灵敏度下更倾向保留模糊研究交由人工复核。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统综述需专家按详细纳排标准人工筛选数千篇文献，是证据合成的瓶颈；筛选高度依赖上下文，需探索语言模型能否借助专家对推理的反馈来辅助该任务。

Method: 提出上下文感知推理框架（CARF）：人在回路，用专家对模型生成推理的纠正作为监督信号，使语言模型适配上下文相关的筛选任务；在全球公共卫生死亡监测中口头尸检与死因判定方法的系统综述上评估。

Result: CARF 筛选性能与所评估模型具竞争力，同时保持高灵敏度，并更倾向于将模糊、上下文依赖的研究保留给人工审查。

Conclusion: 专家纠正后的推理是上下文相关科学筛选的有前景监督信号，但仍需保留人工监督角色。

Abstract: Systematic reviews synthesize biomedical evidence to inform clinical and public-health decision-making, but require domain experts to manually screen thousands of studies against detailed eligibility criteria. We investigate whether language models can assist with this bottleneck by learning from expert feedback on title and abstract screening decisions and model-generated reasoning. We introduce the Context-Aware Reasoning Framework (CARF), a human-in-the-loop framework that uses expert feedback on model-generated reasoning to adapt language models to context-dependent screening tasks. We evaluate CARF on systematic reviews of verbal autopsy and cause-of-death ascertainment methods used in global public health mortality surveillance. CARF shows competitive screening performance compared to evaluated models while retaining high sensitivity, and is more inclined to retain ambiguous, context-dependent studies for human review. Together, these findings suggest that expert-corrected reasoning is a promising supervision signal for context-dependent scientific screening, while retaining a role for human oversight.

</details>


### [220] [From Error Prediction to Causal Influence: Auditing SAE Features in Multiple-Choice QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38067)
*Aria Nourbakhsh,Adelaide Danilov,Oleksandr Marchenko Breneur,Salima Lamsiyah*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 稀疏自编码器(SAE)激活能预测模型错误相关的内部特征，但关联不等于因果。本文在多项选择问答中区分二者，提出过滤格式/内容伪影特征的流程，并用因果干预评估剩余特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAE可预测与模型错误相关的特征，但仅有相关性不足以确立因果影响，需在错误答案产生的机制层面区分预测信号与因果杠杆。

Method: 在8个数据集上分析Gemma 3 1B/4B与Gemma Scope SAE，以正确答案与竞争选项的logit margin衡量答案偏好；提出流程过滤与提示、答案排列等格式/内容伪影高度相关的特征，再对剩余特征在问题与选项跨度上做因果干预；并适配HalluSAE作为基线。

Result: SAE激活在跨模型、跨数据集上含关于"错误性"与不确定性的预测信号；过滤后选出的特征干预产生更大绝对margin变化和更高的错误→正确翻转率，优于随机特征；但答案翻转罕见，且在保持语义的提示格式与答案顺序变化下效应方向不稳定；HalluSAE基线最终token margin变化更大，但依赖严重污染特征且未显著提升纠正率。

Conclusion: 所识别的特征反映的是上下文相关的答案竞争，而非错误答案产生的机制本身。

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) can predict internal features associated with model errors, but association alone does not establish causal influence. We study this distinction in multiple-choice question answering, where answer preference can be measured by the logit margin between the correct answer and the competing choices. Across eight datasets, we analyze Gemma~3 1B and 4B with Gemma Scope SAEs. We propose a pipeline to filter out the features that have high correlation with format and content artifacts, such as prompt and answer permutation, and evaluate the remaining ones with causal feature interventions. Our results show that SAE activations contain predictive signals about wrongness and uncertainty across models and datasets. After filtering artifact-contaminated features, selected features for causal intervention at question and option spans produce larger absolute margin shifts and a higher wrong-to-correct rate than randomly selected features, indicating greater causal leverage. However, answer flips are rare, and we do not observe stable effect directions across meaning-preserving changes in prompt format and answer order. An adapted HalluSAE baseline produces larger final-token margin changes, but relies on substantially contaminated features and does not significantly improve correction rates. Therefore, the identified features reflect context-dependent answer competition rather than the mechanism of incorrect answer errors.

</details>


### [221] [Prompt Lottery in LLM-as-a-Judge: Measuring and Mitigating Sensitivity to Syntactic Rephrasing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38076)
*Ilija Subasic,Brett Levert,Andrew Rabinovich,Sajjad Pakdamansavoji,Zhao Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文揭示"Prompt Lottery"现象：语义等价的改写提示会导致LLM-as-a-Judge评判不一致，甚至逆转模型排名，单一提示评估不够鲁棒，多提示聚合可显著改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM-as-a-Judge研究多假设单一评判提示是稳定工具，且主要通过改写评分细则、角色描述或思维链等刻意修改来优化准确率；但很少有工作检验仅改变表层表述而保持评价语义不变的改写是否会产生一致判断。

Method: 在多样化评估任务、评判模型家族与骨干模型上开展大规模研究，比较同一评价任务下多种经校验的释义改写提示所产生的判断；并用10名人工标注者的用户研究，对比LLM评判者与人类在提示改写下的一致性退化；最后评估多提示聚合策略。

Result: 释义改写会改变评价结果，并在部分设置下逆转模型相对排名；LLM评判者在提示改写下的一致性退化比人类大6-9倍，跌破可用性研究中普遍接受的阈值。

Conclusion: 单一提示评估对模型排序不够鲁棒，应通过多提示聚合来强调在不同改写下保持一致的判断，从而提升评估可靠性。

Abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge has become a standard for evaluating large language models, yet most approaches implicitly assume that a single judge prompt functions as a stable evaluation instrument. Prior work has primarily explored deliberate prompt modifications such as scoring rubrics, role descriptions, or chain-of-thought reasoning in order to optimize accuracy. In contrast, we investigate whether validated prompt variants intended to preserve evaluation semantics while differing in surface realization (\textit{paraphrastic rephrasings}) yield consistent judgments under a fixed evaluation task. We introduce \textit{Prompt Lottery}, a phenomenon in which paraphrastic rephrasings produce different LLMaJ judgments. Across a large-scale study spanning diverse evaluation tasks, judge families, and model backbones, we find that these variations can alter evaluation outcomes and, in some settings, reverse relative model rankings. A user study with 10 human annotators shows that LLMaJ judges exhibit 6-9$\times$ larger agreement degradation under prompt rephrasings than humans, falling below the generally accepted threshold in usability studies. This indicates that single-prompt evaluation is insufficiently robust for model ranking. Finally, we show that multi-prompt aggregation substantially improves robustness by emphasizing judgments that remain consistent across prompt variants.

</details>

Guvvala,Yuki Huang,Yunheng Zou,Yunsheng Liu,Zhenming Wang,Zhiding Yu,Zhiqi Li,Zhiyu Cheng,Zhongbo Zhu,Zhuolin Yang,Zichao Yue,Zihan Liu,Zijie Yan,Zirui Liu,Zoe Faul,Zuhair Ahmed*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 Nemotron 3.5 Super（120B/12B激活的多模态MoE Hybrid Mamba-Transformer）与 Lightning（30B/3B激活的文本模型），通过蒸馏、长上下文训练、原生投机解码与完整后训练（SFT+RLVR+RLHF+MOPD）实现高效推理与智能体能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向推理、长上下文理解与智能体工作负载，需要同时兼顾能力与部署效率的开放模型，尤其是以更少激活参数达到更强软件工程与多模态智能体表现。

Method: 采用MoE Hybrid Mamba-Transformer架构；大规模蒸馏、长上下文训练、原生投机解码；Super额外做Indic继续预训练与智能体软件工程中训练；后训练含SFT、RLVR、RLHF，以及专用教师训练与多教师on-policy蒸馏(MOPD)；并用并行智能体执行与自验证做测试时扩展。

Result: Indic继续预训练使印度语基准提升最多9.82个百分点；Super在SWE-bench Pro达51.78%，超过Nemotron 3 Ultra且激活参数少约4.6倍；MTP后训练提升投机解码接受长度最多21.8%；NVFP4量化中位精度恢复99.62%（相对BF16）；GB200上最高4,856输出tokens/s/GPU且每用户≥50 tokens/s。

Conclusion: 能力与效率可协同优化：中训练、后训练与量化/解码优化结合，使小激活参数模型达到领先推理与智能体性能并高效部署。

Abstract: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Super and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, open and efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer models designed for reasoning, long-context understanding, and agentic workloads. Super is a 120B-parameter, 12B-active multimodal model, while Lightning is a smaller 30B-parameter, 3B-active text model; both designed for efficient deployment. Both models combine large-scale distillation, long-context training, and native speculative decoding, while Super further incorporates Indic continued pretraining and agentic software-engineering mid-training. We develop a comprehensive post-training pipeline spanning supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (RLVR and RLHF), complemented in Super by specialized teacher training and multi- teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). This transforms Super from a text-only base model into a multimodal agent capable of reasoning over text, images, video, and interactive tool environments.
