However, LLM agents often falter on long-horizon tasks due to cognitive overload, as their working memory becomes cluttered with expanding and irrelevant information, which dilutes their attention and hinders effective planning and reasoning. To mitigate this challenge, we introduce Cognitive Resource Self-Allocation (CORAL), a novel reasoning paradigm that empowers agents to proactively optimize their context. Implemented as an agent-callable working memory management toolset, CORAL allows an agent to checkpoint its task progress and verified facts, and adaptively initiate a new problem-solving episode by resetting cluttered context while preserving only the checkpointed information, enabling it to resume reasoning from a clean state. We further enhance the agent's checkpointing capabilities using a Multi-episode Agentic Reinforced Policy Optimization algorithm. On the GAIA benchmark, CORAL with an 8B model achieves 42.8% average accuracy, with particularly strong gains on the most challenging long-horizon tasks (Level 2 and Level 3). Crucially, these gains come at a substantially lower inference cost: CORAL consumes 6-7$\times$ fewer input tokens than a ReAct agent. It also generalizes to multi-hop Knowledge QA benchmarks and to the considerably harder BrowseComp, where it improves a strong proprietary agent by 8.0 points.

</details>


### [294] [Scaling Mathematical Proof Supervision from Structured Textbooks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40394)
*Youqing Fang,Zhouqi Hua,Yinhao Tang,Yuzhe Gu,Lingkai Kong,Bin Liu,Weiming Zhang,Kai Chen,Yanan Sun,Wenwei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出教科书导向的数学证据语料库 TOME-Math，将 2,118 本大学数学教科书转为约 38 万条保留章节顺序、命题-证明链接与依赖关系的结构化监督记录，并借此研究课程学习与数据规模规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数学监督数据被扁平化为孤立的问题-解答对，丢弃了原始教材的课程组织与证据（证明）结构，限制了数据的可扩展性与对数据组织影响数学推理的研究。

Method: 构建 TOME-Math 语料：将 2,118 本覆盖大学数学核心科目的教科书转换为约 380K 条结构化证明监督记录，保留章节顺序、命题-证明对应、依赖引用与来源溯源；利用这些结构信号开展跨多数学科目的课程学习，并刻画监督数据量与来源广度上的缩放规律。

Result: 全量微调后，在留出评测与公开基准上的非加权平均分比基座模型提升 16.7 个百分点，总体上也超过三个公开指令数据基线。

Conclusion: 结构化教科书既是可扩展的数学监督来源，也是研究数据组织对数学推理影响的实证框架；语料将公开以促进后续研究。

Abstract: Mathematical supervision for language models is typically flattened into isolated problem-solution pairs, discarding the curricular organization and evidential structure of the original sources. We introduce TOME-Math (Textbook-Oriented Mathematical Evidence), a large-scale corpus that converts 2,118 textbooks spanning the core areas of university-level mathematics subjects into approximately 380K structured proof-supervision records while preserving chapter order, proposition-proof links, dependency references, and source provenance. Leveraging these structural signals, we explore curriculum learning across multiple mathematical subjects and characterize scaling patterns with supervision volume and source breadth. At full scale, fine-tuning on TOME-Math raises the unweighted mean score across our held-out evaluations and established public benchmarks by 16.7 percentage points over the base model, while exceeding all three public instruction-data baselines evaluated in aggregate. Our findings highlight structured textbooks as both a scalable source of mathematical supervision and an empirical framework for studying the impact of data organization on mathematical reasoning. We will release the corpus to facilitate further research on structured mathematical supervision.

</details>


### [295] [rTaste: Do Research Agents Have Taste? Evaluating Early Stage Research Judgment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40488)
*Art Kanke*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究检验前沿模型作为科研代理是否具备"品味"——即预判哪些实验值得做。让六个模型对七篇NLP论文提出最小可行实验(MVE)、预测成败并排序,再由执行者全部执行、由模型审计员评估。结果表明代理能产出大量有价值实验,但其排序相比随机或"直接选论文中第一个实验"并无显著优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究研究代理是否具备"品味",即在结果未知前判断哪些实验值得运行的能力,以及这种判断是否能真正改进实验选择。

Method: 给六个前沿模型七篇近期NLP论文,模型单独或组队提出最小可行实验(MVE),预测是否通过自设阈值并排序;独立执行者执行全部MVE(含排名最后者),三名模型审计员评判结果。

Result: 415个MVE中194个被评为可靠、有价值且新颖,但其中仅73个同时被认为超越种子论文且非显而易见。代理首选与审计员最看重实验的匹配率高于随机,但未优于"选论文中写下的第一个实验";预测优于基准率,但不比仅给论文与MVE的同一模型实例更准;组队成本更高但提案质量无明显提升。

Conclusion: 代理能产出许多有价值的实验,但证据表明其排序对"该运行哪个实验"的改进有限。评估框架与全部415个MVE(含预测与审计结果)已开源。

Abstract: Do research agents have taste, the judgment of which experiments are worth running before their outcomes are known? We give six frontier models seven recent NLP papers. Each model, working as a research agent alone or as a team, proposes minimum viable experiments (MVEs), forecasts whether each will pass a threshold it sets and ranks them. A separate executor then attempts every MVE, including those ranked last, and three model auditors judge the results. Of 415 MVEs, 194 are judged sound, valuable and new, but fewer than half of these (73) are also judged beyond the seed paper and non obvious. The agents' first choices match the auditors' most valued experiment more often than a random pick, but are not shown to improve on choosing the experiment written first. Their forecasts beat a base rate but are not measurably more accurate than those of a fresh instance of the same model given only the paper and registrations. Teams cost more without a clear overall improvement in proposal quality. The agents produce many worthwhile experiments, but the evidence that their rankings improve the choice of which to run remains limited. The evaluation harness and a dataset of all 415 MVEs, with their forecasts and audited outcomes, are available at https://github.com/ArtKanke/rTaste.

</details>


### [296] [A Low-Rank Space Captures Linear Alignment Between LLM and Human Neural Activity During Naturalistic Language Listening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40511)
*Zach Paris,Emily Finn*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 用ridge降秩回归发现LLM表示中仅1-3%维度即可复现全量神经编码性能，且该脑预测子空间与主成分方向不同，并可揭示神经活动额外偏好特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为人类语言加工计算模型被广泛使用，但究竟是表示的哪些成分驱动了与神经活动的对齐尚不清楚。

Method: 采用ridge降秩回归识别"脑预测子空间"；在三个自然语言聆听数据集（颅内电生理与fMRI）和六种模型条件（自回归、双向掩码、随机初始化）下比较，并与PCA主轴对比，再对学习到的子空间做特征解释。

Result: 仅1-3%原始嵌入维度即可恢复完整线性编码性能；低维子空间可跨被试泛化，跨数据集泛化较弱；PCA需更多维度才能达到同样预测；所得方向与最大方差方向不同。

Conclusion: LLM-大脑对齐由模型表示中一个小而有结构的子集支撑，该框架有助于理解对齐为何发生，并揭示神经活动中被过度表示的可解释特征。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as computational models of human language processing, yet it remains unclear which components of their representations drive alignment with neural activity. Here, we use ridge reduced-rank regression to identify the brain-predictive subspace of LLM representations: the representational directions that support linear prediction of neural responses. Across three naturalistic language-listening datasets spanning intracranial electrophysiology and fMRI, and six model conditions spanning autoregressive, bidirectional masked, and randomly initialized language models, we find that full linear encoding performance can be recovered using only 1-3% of the original embedding dimensionality. These low-dimensional subspaces generalize across held-out participants and, to a lesser extent, across datasets, suggesting that neural predictivity is concentrated in a compact and partially shared representational space. We next compare these brain-predictive directions with the principal axes of variation in the embeddings. Principal component analysis requires substantially more dimensions to recover neural prediction, demonstrating that the directions most useful for predicting neural activity are distinct from those capturing the most overall variance within LLM representations themselves. Finally, characterizing the learned subspaces allows us to surface interpretable features that are overrepresented in neural activity above and beyond the LLM representations. Together, these results show that LLM-brain alignment is supported by a small, structured subset of model representations and provides a framework for better understanding exactly why these representations align. Code can be found at: https://github.com/thefinnlab/low-rank-alignment

</details>


### [297] [How I Aligned Your Model: Scaling Up Multilingual Safety Training with Templates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40516)
*Max Neuwinger,Hanna Yukhymenko,Imanol Schlag*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出模板化增强流水线，构建覆盖60种语言的拒答与良性语料 MSafeTemp，揭示仅用英语评测会误判多语言安全性，并证明模板化安全数据可提升非英语对齐效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM安全对齐以英语为中心，多语言（尤其低资源语言）表现差；公开训练数据集规模有限，且缺乏按地区本地化的有害话题，难以实现跨文化对齐。

Method: 可扩展的模板式增强流水线：从有害提示中抽取安全模板，翻译后以文化真实的实体（有害与良性）填充槽位，批量生成多语言拒答与良性语料；据此发布经校验的60语言语料 MSafeTemp。

Result: 实验表明纯英语评测会误判多语言安全性：部分模型的攻击在英语中失败但翻译后成功；文化本地化变体能暴露翻译遗漏的更多失效。同时，模板增强的安全训练数据提升多样性与质量，带来英语之外更好的安全表现。

Conclusion: MSafeTemp及流水线旨在推动面向代表性不足文化的更安全、更负责模型的研发；多语言安全评测与训练需纳入文化与语言多样性。

Abstract: Safety alignment for Large Language Models is heavily focused on English with limited multilingual representation, particularly damaging low-resource language performance. Related open training datasets are often limited in size or do not follow region-localized harmful topics to broaden the scope of alignment beyond cultures. We propose a scalable template-based augmentation pipeline to produce massive multilingual refusal and benign corpora, extracting safe templates from harmful prompts, translating them and then filling in the slots with culturally authentic entities, both harmful and benign. As a result, we release MSafeTemp, a validated corpus spanning 60 languages useful for multilingual safety alignment and evaluation. Using the dataset, we show that English-only evaluation misjudges multilingual safety: for several models, attacks that fail in English succeed once translated, while culturally localized variants expose further failures that translation alone misses. We also confirm that augmenting safety training data through templates allows for higher diversity and quality of alignment, resulting in improved safety performance beyond English. MSafeTemp and the respective pipeline are aimed at facilitating research and development of safer and more responsible models for less-represented cultures.

</details>


### [298] [IndicIPR-QA: A Benchmark for Extractive Question Answering on Indian IPR Laws](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40518)
*M. Mohaiminul Islam,Muhammad Abulaish*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出IndicIPR-QA1，首个覆盖印度全部七部知识产权法案的抽取式问答基准，含4,462个问答对并为答案标注精确法条文本span，经多重自动校验与人工审计；实验显示BM25仅20.21 F1，微调InLegalBERT达85.02 F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向法条的抽取式问答在低资源、法系复杂场景下难度大，答案须精确且以法律为依据。现有工作尚无覆盖印度七部知识产权法案、并从法条原文中给出精确答案span的抽取式QA基准，因此亟需构建该基准并考察模型在此类任务上的真实能力。

Method: 构建IndicIPR-QA1：从七部法案的1,116个法条上下文中生成4,462个问答对，问题与答案由GPT-4o生成；通过九项自动质量检查、单模型与多模型LLM评估及200对人工审计进行验证；采用章节级划分避免训练/验证/测试集源上下文重叠；分析答案span长度、词汇重叠与多子句结构；以BM25为基线，并在统一滑窗推理协议下微调InLegalBERT。

Result: BM25取得20.21的token级F1，微调InLegalBERT达85.02 F1，二者差距显著；性能在七部法案间存在明显差异，表明答案抽取难度因法案而异。

Conclusion: 简单的词面匹配不足以回答法条类法律问题，需依赖领域预训练模型的语义理解；IndicIPR-QA1为低资源法律抽取式QA提供了可复现基准，但跨法案性能不均衡，提示未来需针对法系与条文结构差异开展更稳健的建模。

Abstract: Legal Question Answering (QA) over statutory texts is a challenging task in Natural Language Processing (NLP), especially in low-resource settings with complex legal systems. It requires answers that are precise and grounded in the law. However, to the best of current knowledge, no existing extractive QA benchmark provides exact answer spans from statutory texts across all seven Indian Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Acts. This paper presents IndicIPR-QA1, an extractive QA benchmark for Indian IPR laws. The proposed dataset contains 4,462 QA pairs from 1,116 statutory contexts across seven Acts. Questions and answers are generated using GPT-4o and validated through nine automatic quality checks, single and multi-model LLM evaluations, and a 200-pair human audit. Section-level partitioning prevents source-context overlap across the training, validation, and test sets. Further analysis examines answer span length, lexical overlap, and multi-clause structure across the corpus and individual Acts. BM25 achieves a token-level F1 score of 20.21, while fine-tuned InLegalBERT reaches 85.02 under a unified sliding-window inference protocol. The large performance gap between BM25 (20.21 F1) and InLegalBERT (85.02 F1) shows that simple word matching is not enough to answer these legal questions. Performance also varies across the seven Acts, indicating substantial differences in answer-extraction performance.

</details>


### [299] [Homebrewed SLMs: Autoregressive and Masked Diffusion Language Models Built at Home for Portuguese](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40533)
*Pedro Carvalho Brom*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该教程从零训练含分词器的小型语言模型（消费级单卡、11–12M参数），并给出面向专门领域任务的评测协议与缺陷目录；无新方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自建领域语言模型不应依赖数据中心；同时缺乏判断小型自训模型在专门领域（法律）是否可用的可靠测量手段。

Method: 单卡消费级GPU从零训练（含分词器）；发布Python包与两份葡语notebook，同一网络支持自回归与掩码扩散生成；预注册对比协议；仅用文本构建法律任务，设Kneser-Ney n-gram下限与公开基准；提供11–12M模型参考数值与测量暴露的缺陷清单。

Result: 巴葡散文与联邦法律（每次运行数分钟）：自回归在64轮达峰后记忆化，掩码扩散改进至256轮；测试最佳点扩散似然界高于自回归0.06 bits/byte（在预注册最小效应内）。留出法律及训练后法案上，与6-gram下限似然持平，续写劣于下限；篡改检测优于下限；在训练中未出现的“法令”体裁填交叉引用优于下限及160M/630M公开模型（后者近或低于随机），填空仅在组等权时占优，按条目与630M持平；法律任务上公开模型（算力高5×10²–10⁵倍）在篡改检测和续写上领先。盲人评读预注册但未纳入本版。

Conclusion: 小型自训模型在部分领域任务上可匹配或超越n-gram下限与更大公开模型，但优势高度依赖任务与体裁；测量而非直觉才能揭示其真实边界，需按任务分别判断“够用”。

Abstract: Building a language model of one's own no longer requires a data centre. This tutorial trains one from scratch, tokenizer included, on one consumer GPU, and shows how to tell whether it is good for the tasks of a specialist domain. It proposes no new method. It releases a tested Python package and two notebooks in Brazilian Portuguese with autoregressive and masked diffusion generation on one network, a preregistered comparison protocol, legal tasks built from text alone with a Kneser-Ney floor and public yardsticks, reference numbers for models of 11 to 12M parameters, and a catalogue of defects that only measurement revealed. On Brazilian prose and federal laws, at minutes per run, the autoregressive mode peaks at 64 epochs over the same text and then memorises it, while masked diffusion improves up to 256. At their best points on test, the diffusion bound exceeds the autoregressive likelihood by 0.06 bits per byte, within the preregistered minimum effect. On held-out laws and on acts published after training, the model ties a 6-gram floor in likelihood on the same windows, and it loses to the floor at continuing those acts. It beats the floor at detecting tampered text, and fills cross-references more often than the floor and public models of 160M and 630M parameters, only in decrees, a genre absent from training, where those scorers stay near or below chance, and in filling the blank only when each group weighs the same, since per item it ties the 630M model. On laws, the public models, trained with about 5x10^2 to 10^5 times its compute, lead in tampered text and continuation. The blind human reading is preregistered and not part of this version.

</details>


### [300] [Every Token Needs Its Own Teacher: Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40574)
*Yifu Luo,Chuang Ma,Zeyu Chen,Enkelejda Kasneci,Qi Chen,Gjergji Kasneci*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出首个token级自适应on-policy自蒸馏方法MTA-OPSD，通过多教师池让每个token自适应选择最优教师，在Qwen3数学推理任务上平均超越基线达+5.9。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OPSD方法将教师固定：要么全程使用完整参考，要么仅在response间自适应变化部分参考暴露，无法处理同一response内不同token对教师偏好的差异。

Method: 通过教师干预试点研究验证教师偏好在token间存在差异，并发现可通过多数投票与KL选择为每个token识别偏好教师；据此构建候选教师组成的多教师池，训练中让每个token自适应选择其偏好教师进行蒸馏。

Result: 在Qwen3模型的数学推理任务上，MTA-OPSD一致优于现有OPSD方法，相较基础模型平均增益最高达+5.9。

Conclusion: token级自适应教师监督至关重要；MTA-OPSD证明了细粒度教师选择的必要性，代码已开源。

Abstract: On-policy Self-distillation (OPSD) has proven effective for post-training large language models by constructing a teacher conditioned on privileged references. However, existing approaches keep the teacher fixed either throughout training by consistently exposing it to the full reference, or within each response by adaptively varying partial reference exposure only across responses. In this paper, we argue that neither of them is sufficient. Instead, every token needs its own teacher, as the teacher preference can vary token by token within the same response. Through a teacher-intervention pilot study, we validate that the teacher preference differs across tokens, and reveal that a preferred teacher can be identified for each token through majority voting and KL-based selection. Motivated by these findings, we propose Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-Distillation (MTA-OPSD), the first token-level adaptive OPSD method. Our method constructs a multi-teacher pool consisting of candidate teachers, and enables every token to adaptively select its preferred teacher during training. Experiments with Qwen3 models on mathematical reasoning tasks show that MTA-OPSD consistently outperforms existing OPSD approaches with an average gain of up to $+5.9$ over the base model, highlighting the importance of adapting teacher supervision at the token level. The code is available at https://github.com/xingzhejun/MTA-OPSD.

</details>


### [301] [PIVOT: Progressive Intervention via Online Teacher Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40576)
*Zhihao Yang,Boyuan Zheng,Puhui Tan,Yukun Chen,Kuan Zhang,Longze Chen,Jiaming Li,Renke Shan,Lu Wang,Xianpei Han*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: PIVOT 将教师纠错片段插入学生 rollout，并对这些片段施加 token 级 KL 监督，与 RLVR 目标联合训练，在困难逻辑游戏和数学推理上显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR 依赖稀疏的结果级奖励：当一个组内所有 rollout 都失败时没有学习信号。强教师可提供额外指导，但如何把教师信号纳入 RLVR，既保证成功轨迹可达、又保证学生可学习，是核心问题。

Method: 区分轨迹级干预（提高获得带奖励轨迹的概率）与 token 级监督（提供稠密目标）两种互补机制；受控实验表明单独使用任一机制都不够，因此提出 PIVOT：在学生 rollout 中插入教师生成的修正片段，并对这些片段施加 token 级 KL 监督，与 RLVR 目标共同优化；同时系统分析"在哪干预"与"如何监督"，形成有效指导的配方。

Result: 在困难逻辑游戏与数学推理基准上一致优于现有方法；逻辑游戏上平均 avg@8 从最佳基线的 19.5% 提升到 35.6%，接近翻倍。

Conclusion: 轨迹级干预与 token 级监督必须结合：PIVOT 通过教师纠错插入加片段级 KL 监督，有效解决 RLVR 稀疏奖励问题，并给出可复用的干预与监督设计配方。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) is limited by sparse outcome-level feedback on hard reasoning tasks: when all rollouts in a group fail, rewards provide no learning signal. Stronger teachers can provide additional guidance, but this raises a central question: how can such signals be incorporated into RLVR to support successful rollouts while remaining learnable for the student? We distinguish two complementary mechanisms: trajectory-level intervention, which improves access to reward-bearing trajectories, and token-level supervision, which provides dense targets to guide student learning. Our controlled experiments show that either mechanism alone can remain insufficient, motivating their combination. We therefore introduce PIVOT, which inserts teacher-generated corrections into student rollouts and applies token-level KL supervision to these segments alongside the RLVR objective. Beyond their combination, we systematically analyze where to intervene and how to supervise, yielding a recipe for effective guidance. Across hard logic games and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, PIVOT consistently outperforms existing methods, nearly doubling mean avg@8 on logic games from 19.5% for the best-performing baseline to 35.6%.

</details>


### [302] [Multi-View MoE: Letting Every Router Shape Expert Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40577)
*Zelin Zhao,Tianchi Ma,Junyuan Shang,Shuohuan Wang,Dianhai Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出多视图MoE(Multi-View MoE)，用多个路由器聚合选择专家，并复用路由偏好调制专家计算，在固定专家预算下提升模型能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏MoE中专家选择直接影响固定激活预算下的模型能力，但单路由器排序与专家效用评估排序一致性弱（尤其中深层）；用更丰富信号做选择/计算又会增加开销。

Method: Multi-Router子模块聚合多个独立初始化路由器的sigmoid分数，训练中形成差异化专家偏好；再用被选专家在各路由器间的相对分数，将学到的潜在视图混合进专家输入，实现选择与计算复用同一路由偏好。每个专家仅执行一次前向，保持激活专家数、专家FLOPs与all-to-all通信量不变。

Result: 24层10B-A1B模型、708B tokens训练：完整方法较基线九任务均值提升1.18个百分点；仅Multi-Router提升0.6个百分点，并提升路由分数与专家效用的秩相关（全局相对提升8.1%，单路由对齐最低层约58%）。可控混合干预显示模型利用依赖专家与token的输入差异。

Conclusion: 多路由器差异化偏好可改善专家选择，并可零额外计算/通信成本地复用于专家计算调制，为MoE路由设计提供有效方向。

Abstract: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models expand parameter capacity by activating a small subset of experts per token. Expert selection directly affects model capabilities under a fixed active-expert budget. Dense evaluation of all experts reveals weak agreement between single-router rankings and expert-utility evaluation rankings, especially in middle and deep layers. Richer signals for selection and computation incur additional cost: selection based on internal expert activations requires preliminary computation, while processing multiple full representations separately through the same expert repeats its computation. We propose Multi-View MoE to improve expert selection with multiple routers and reuse their preferences to modulate expert computation under a fixed expert budget. Its Multi-Router submodule aggregates sigmoid scores from independently initialized routers. These routers develop highly differentiated expert preferences during training, allowing experts strongly favored by one router or jointly supported by several routers to be selected. Multi-View further uses each selected expert's relative scores across routers to mix learned latent views into its input, reusing routing preferences for both selection and computation. Each selected expert executes one forward pass, preserving the active-expert count, expert FLOPs, and all-to-all communication volume. On a 24-layer 10B-A1B model trained on 708B tokens, full Multi-View MoE improves the nine-task downstream mean by 1.18 percentage points over the baseline. Multi-Router alone yields a 0.6-percentage-point gain and improves the rank correlation between router scores and evaluated expert utility, with relative increases of 8.1% globally and approximately 58% in the layer with the lowest single-router alignment. Controlled mixing interventions show the model uses input differences that depend on both the expert and the token.

</details>


### [303] [When to Assist and What to Suggest: Joint Gating and Memory-Grounded Hint Generation in One Compact Decoder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40611)
*A. J. A. Jubayer Talukder,Mohammad Ariful Haque*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 统一评估主动助手"何时提示+提示什么"的端到端表现，并证明单个1B解码器可同时完成门控与生成，在精度和算时上优于双模型流水线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主动助手系统把"判断是否提示（门控）"与"生成提示内容"拆成两个模型，缺乏联合的端到端评估，且不清楚门控带来的计算收益到底多大、记忆画像对提示质量影响如何。

Method: 在28,058个决策点上联合评估门控与生成，比较oracle门控上限与真实门控的端到端指标；消融记忆画像、检索、生成器规模；提出单模型方案——用1B解码器从中间层退出做门控、同一遍前向完成生成；辅以1,144条评分/32段对话的人工评测。

Result: 真实门控下端到端精确匹配0.2619（上限0.2971）、精度0.2387，仍有提升空间；门控的计算节省随生成器缩小而下降（8B为4.39×，1B为1.38×）；移除记忆画像损失24.7个EM点（BERTScore 0.57→0.35），而检索与更大生成器在EM上无增益；单模型自动指标持平或超过双模型，墙钟时间少1.31–1.76×，三个种子下深层退出与独立门控持平；人工评测支持记忆效应，单模型与匹配的1B流水线相当、低于8B。

Conclusion: 记忆画像是提示质量的主要驱动；门控的价值在于精度与算力节省；单解码器门控+生成是一条高效可行的路线。分级指标与LlamaPIE原生评判比精确匹配更贴近人工评分，故EM应视为严格下界。

Abstract: Proactive assistants offer short, memory-grounded hints during a conversation, deciding when to assist and what to suggest. Current systems split this between a gate and a larger generator; we evaluate both together on 28,058 decision points. Stage-wise generation scores are oracle-gate ceilings: behind a real gate, end-to-end exact match is 0.2619 against a ceiling of 0.2971, and end-to-end precision is 0.2387, leaving substantial headroom. A gate pays off through precision and compute, whose saving falls from 4.39x with an 8B generator to 1.38x with a 1B one. The memory profile drives hint quality: removing it costs 24.7 exact-match points (rescaled BERTScore 0.57 to 0.35), while retrieval and a larger generator add nothing on exact match. One 1B decoder can do both, gating from an intermediate layer and generating in the same pass. At its final checkpoint it matches or exceeds the two-model pipelines on automatic end-to-end measures with 1.31-1.76x less wall-clock time than the matched 1B pipeline; across three seeds, its deeper exit ties the separate gate. A human evaluation (1,144 ratings over 32 dialogues) supports the memory effect and rates the single model level with the matched 1B pipeline and below the 8B one. Graded metrics and LlamaPIE's native judge track human ratings more closely than exact match, which we report as a strict lower bound.

</details>


### [304] [ShallowDefend: Harnessing Shallow Safety Alignment for Multi-Turn Defender](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40627)
*Qiyao Ma,Xiaodong Liu,Weiwei Yang,Mingqian Feng,Chengquan Guo,Jialin Song,Carolyn Buractaon,Zhe Zhao,Junshan Zhang,Sandeep Atluri,Christopher White,Jianfeng Gao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出"评估→决策→回应"(Assess→Decide→Respond)框架，在多轮对话的载荷轮次用强化学习训练模型先给出显式可解析的安全决策标签，再据此生成回答；利用"浅层安全"特性反制攻击，在多模型家族与14项基准上取得最强多轮安全性，同时保持实用性与一定帮助性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全对齐是"浅层"的：安全行为集中在模型最初几个输出token上，导致直接请求能被拒绝，但把同一有害请求分散到多轮对话中往往仍能成功。现有防御继承这一弱点，只监督回答的表面形式，从不给模型一个显式的安全决策去学习。作者反向利用浅层性：既然短跨度决定整段回答走向，就抢先占据该高杠杆位置。

Method: Assess→Decide→Respond 三阶段框架：防御方先评估用户意图，提交一个显式、可解析的安全决策（作为token跨度），再以该决策为条件生成回复；承诺环节在载荷轮次(payload turn)通过强化学习训练。奖励可两种形式：(1) 自验证规则奖励——将承诺标签与对话已知性质比对，无需judge和标注；(2) LLM-as-judge奖励——在分级决策空间上打分并支持安全重定向。

Result: 在两个模型家族、涵盖安全性/实用性/帮助性的14个基准的受控对比中，取得最强的多轮安全性；在保持实用性的同时以适度帮助性代价维持安全领先。逐token KL分析与干预性探针表明：训练效果集中于决定回答轨迹的简短"思考"片段，且该处承诺的决策是因果控制点。

Conclusion: 攻击者所利用的"浅层性"恰好成为防御机制：将显式安全决策前置于高杠杆的短跨度token上，可把浅层对齐转化为可靠的多轮安全控制点。

Abstract: Safety alignment has enabled large language models to reliably refuse harmful requests directly, yet the same request distributed across a multi-turn conversation still succeeds far too often. This brittleness has a mechanistic root: Alignment is shallow, with safety behavior concentrated in a model's first few output tokens, and existing defenses inherit the weakness, supervising the surface form of the response without ever giving the model an explicit safety decision to learn. We take the opposite view of shallowness: if a short span determines the trajectory of an entire response, that span is the highest-leverage place to intervene, and the defender can occupy it first. We propose Assess $\to$ Decide $\to$ Respond, a framework in which the defender assesses the user's intent, commits to an explicit, parseable safety decision, and only then generates a reply conditioned on it, with the commitment trained by reinforcement learning at the payload turn. Because the decision is a token span, the reward can be a rule: a self-verified reward checks the committed label against the conversation's known nature, requiring no judge and no annotation, while the same format also supports an LLM-as-judge reward over a graded decision space with safe redirection. Across two model families and fourteen benchmarks spanning safety, utility, and helpfulness, our defenders achieve the strongest multi-turn safety in a controlled comparison, maintaining their lead in safety while preserving utility at a modest cost to helpfulness. A per-token KL analysis and interventional probes confirm why this works: training concentrates its effect on the brief deliberation that sets a response's trajectory, and the decision committed there is a causal control point. The very shallowness attackers exploit becomes the mechanism of defense.

</details>


### [305] [Elucidating the Design Space of LM Data Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40655)
*Steven Yu,Sheng-Yu Wang,Kimia Hamidieh,Antonio Torralba,David Bau*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出可控归因基准CATT（用虚构知识提供无歧义ground truth），系统改变单一数据集属性来诊断LM数据归因失败原因；发现因果证据高度局部化，改用负对数几率梯度并仅聚合top token分数，召回率提升35–72个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LM数据归因评测同时变动多个数据集属性，无法单独定位归因算法失败的原因。

Method: 构建CATT基准：在完全虚构的知识上微调LLM，获得明确真值，并可一次只改动一种配置（如文档冗余、词汇干扰项）。在此基础上考察两个被忽视的设计选择：计算梯度的损失函数，以及将token级归因分数聚合为文档分数的方式。

Result: 冗余和干扰项稳定地降低归因性能；真实因果证据在训练文档中高度局部化，而全文档平均会将其稀释为噪声；用负对数几率梯度替代交叉熵梯度可凸显关键token，仅聚合top token分数使召回提升35–72个百分点；该修正可泛化到FTRACE-TREX，反事实重训练性能最高提升4.9倍。

Conclusion: 归因失败常源于评估不可控与聚合方式不当而非估计器本身；可控基准与损失/聚合设计（负对数几率+top-token聚合）是提升数据归因的有效方向。

Abstract: Data attribution methods for Language Models (LMs) are typically evaluated using downstream tasks like fact retrieval. However, existing evaluations vary multiple dataset properties simultaneously, making it impossible to isolate exactly why an attribution algorithm fails. To diagnose these failures, we explore the design space of LLM data attribution, with a primary focus on evaluation. We introduce the Controlled Attribution Benchmark (CATT) for fact tracing, in which we fine-tune LLMs on entirely fictitious knowledge, providing unambiguous ground truth for attribution. This synthetic setup allows us to systematically alter one dataset configuration at a time, such as document redundancy and lexical distractors. With this configurable evaluation, we demonstrate that redundancy and distractors consistently degrade attribution performance. Rather than proposing a new estimator, we examine two design choices that are underexplored: the loss used to compute gradients and how per-token attribution scores are aggregated into a document score. We find that the true causal evidence within a training document is highly localized, but standard methods dilute this evidence into noise by averaging attribution scores across the entire document. We find that replacing standard cross-entropy loss gradients with the negative log-odds gradients surfaces the critical tokens from other uninformative ones. We can then aggregate only the top token scores to improve ground truth recall by 35 to 72 percentage points across multiple baselines on our diagnostic benchmark. The negative log-odds correction also generalizes to FTRACE-TREX, improving counterfactual retraining performance for every method we test, by up to 4.9x.

</details>

### [306] [Cassette-Editor: A Video Editing Agent That Edits the Way You Do](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37690)
*Zhixin Zeng,Jiahao Zhong*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 提出 Cassette-Editor，一个接口极简的视频剪辑智能体：一读一写两个工具，所有写操作经统一执行器/规则/提交服务，原子提交或带定位诊断的拒绝，模型保留创作决策权。实验显示模型能修复几乎全部自己损坏的剪辑，且定位问题可将纠错所需输入token减半。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言智能体越来越多在持久化产物（如代码库）上调用工具，每步结果影响下一步。视频剪辑是该模式的严苛场景：帧的呈现依赖所有片段的裁剪、变速、裁切与嵌套，素材知识只在特定用法下成立，非法编辑会破坏时间线结构。现有智能体靠批评者智能体、审查者或受限输出格式维持编辑合法性，代价高且不灵活。

Method: Cassette-Editor 采用刻意简化的接口：一个工具读项目、一个工具写项目。所有写操作都经过与用户手动编辑相同的执行器、规则和提交服务，要么原子提交，要么被拒绝并返回定位诊断与修复选项；模型负责创作决策并自行决定如何恢复。读操作把存储的素材分析与时间线上的每次具体用法关联起来。

Result: 在受控实验中，让真实模型查看其 277 次已提交但被破坏的编辑：在完整或最小反馈下，模型几乎纠正了每一次调用；定位问题使单次纠错所需输入 token 降至不足一半；其纠错时误删模型自己写入的其他值的次数从 7 次降到 1 次。

Conclusion: 将合法性保障从智能体外部的批评者/格式限制转移到与用户共享的统一提交机制，并配以精准定位诊断，可在保持模型创作自主性的同时高效、可靠地修复剪辑错误。

Abstract: Language agents increasingly work by calling tools on a persistent artifact, such as a code repository, and the result of each call shapes their next step. Video editing is a demanding case of this pattern: what a frame shows depends on how every clip is trimmed, retimed, cropped, and nested, so knowledge about the footage holds only for particular uses of it, and an invalid edit can leave the timeline structurally broken. Existing video editing agents keep their edits valid with critic agents, reviewers, or restricted output formats. We present Cassette-Editor, a video editing agent with a deliberately simple interface: one tool reads the project and one tool writes to it. Every write passes through the same executor, rules, and commit service as the user's manual edits, and either commits atomically or is rejected with located diagnostics and repair options, while the model keeps the creative choices and decides how to recover. Reads relate stored analysis of the footage to each use of it on the timeline. In a controlled experiment, a real model is shown 277 of its own committed edits after damaging them. It corrected nearly every call with full or minimal feedback, but locating each problem cut the input tokens a correction needed to less than half, and its corrections dropped other values the model had written in one case rather than seven.

</details>


### [307] [TSM diff: A new Parallel-Tree-Traversal Algorithm for the Comparison of Music Score Files](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38545)
*Xiaobo Wang,Florent Jacquemard*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 提出基于图结构抽象表示（Tree Score Model, TSM）的数字乐谱比较算法与工具，可计算差异列表、时间距离与表层距离并归一化为相似度，已用C++实现并提供Python模块。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 乐谱文件比文本文件更难比较，因为其内容更复杂且组织为层次结构，缺少类似Unix diff的可用于乐谱处理的工具。

Method: 将两份乐谱（如MusicXML或MEI等编码）转换为Tree Score Model（TSM）图结构抽象表示，然后联合计算三项度量：按时间位置定位的差异列表、时间距离（差异时间段累计时长）、表层距离（基于与时间无关的记谱属性的编辑距离）；后两者归一化并合并为相似度距离。C++实现，提供Python模块。

Result: 初步实验显示即使在具挑战性的数据上也有很好的效率；以莫扎特钢琴奏鸣曲不同版本及不同演奏者对同一爵士标准曲的单声部soli转录为概念验证演示。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了乐谱比较工具的空缺，提供可同时给出局部差异、时间距离与表面距离的实用工具，并已验证其效率与适用性。

Abstract: Music score files are more difficult to compare than their text-based equivalents, as their content is more complex and organised into hierarchical structures. This explains the lack of tools for processing music scores similar to the widely used old Unix diff command. We propose a new algorithm and tool for comparing digital music scores in various encodings, such as MusicXML or MEI, based on a graph-structured abstract representation called Tree Score Model (TSM). Given two scores, after conversion into TSM, our procedure calculates jointly: A list of differences, localised by time positions in the input scores; A time distance, cumulated duration of time-spans where scores differ; An edit distance, called surface distance, based on notational attributes not related to time. The two later measures are normalised and combined into a similarity distance between scores. Our procedure has been implemented in C++ and is available as a Python module. Our first experiments have shown a very good efficiency even on challenging data. As a proof of concept, we propose two demos based on different versions of some Mozart's piano sonata, and transcriptions of monophonic soli on the same jazz standards by different performers. https://tsm-diff-lbd-7a7e2a.gitlab.io/demo.html

</details>


<div id='cs.GT'></div>

# cs.GT [[Back]](#toc)

### [308] [Market Attention and Information Quality in On-Chain Prediction Markets: Evidence from Polymarket](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37669)
*Davide Mancino,Hasret Ozan Sevim,Luca Pennella,Huy Hoang Le*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文用Polymarket订单簿交易数据检验该链上预测市场究竟是"信息市场"（货币押注把分散信念压缩为追踪真相的价格）还是"注意力市场"（资金流向最显眼的合约而非最有信息量的合约）。结果显示68.2%的交易量集中在校准良好的合约上，支持信息市场解读；注意力成分真实但小且集中于少数头条合约。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测市场理论上能聚合信息，但在平台上资金可能被知名度而非信息量吸引；作者希望实证区分"信息市场"与"注意力市场"两种功能定位。

Method: 使用2024年1月至2026年3月Polymarket CLOB逐笔数据，采用单边交易所合约口径避免maker/taker重复计数，取taker侧美元成交量前1000个市场。对每个市场构造：注意力得分（成交量、交易笔数、活跃钱包数的样本内百分位排名）与信息质量得分（已结算Yes/No市场上1减去结算前7天YES价格与真实结果的绝对距离），并将市场定位在注意力/信息平面上。

Result: 68.2%的分析样本成交量位于校准良好的市场（平均7天误差0.03，结算前1天降至0.02），分布在679个合约中的515个。一个可由识别的高注意力/低信息集群含19个合约，占22.1%成交量，但其中79%来自2024年美国大选这一窗口内最接近的宏观政治事件。

Conclusion: Polymarket主要是信息聚合器；注意力成分确实存在但规模小，且集中于少数结果事前最难预测的头条合约。

Abstract: This paper asks whether the leading on-chain prediction market, Polymarket, behaves more as an information market, in which monetary stakes compress dispersed beliefs into a price that tracks the truth, or more as an attention market, in which capital flows toward the most visible contracts rather than the most informative ones. Using trade-level data from Polymarket's central-limit-order-book (CLOB) markets from January 2024 through March 2026, and a one-sided exchange-contract convention that avoids double-counting maker and taker fills, we study the top 1,000 markets by taker-side dollar volume. For each, we build an attention score from the within-sample percentile ranks of volume, transaction count, and active trader wallets, and an information-quality score on resolved Yes/No markets equal to one minus the absolute distance between the YES-token price seven days before resolution and the realised outcome. Placing markets on this attention/information plane answers the question in favour of the information-market reading: 68.2% of analysis-sample volume sits in well-calibrated markets (average 7-day error of 0.03, falling to 0.02 one day before resolution), spread across 515 of 679 contracts. A narrower, identifiable cluster of 19 high-attention/low-information contracts captures 22.1% of analysis-sample volume, but 79% of that mass is the 2024 US Presidential Election, the single closest macro-political event of the window. Polymarket is therefore primarily an information aggregator; the attention component is real but small and concentrated in a handful of headline contracts whose outcomes are hardest to forecast ex ante.

</details>


### [309] [Toward Understanding the Value of Anarchy: Empirical Studies on Best Response Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38081)
*Will Wesley,Philip N Brown*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该文通过实验研究随机生成加权动作网络化多智能体优化问题中的最佳响应动态(BRD)，发现BRD实际表现优于PoA预测值和随机均衡选择，并显示BRD偏向选择高性能均衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PoA作为多智能体优化解的性能度量，可能因最坏情况实例在实践中罕见而被高估；作者希望检验这一疑虑并寻找更理想的度量指标。

Method: 在随机生成的加权动作网络化多智能体优化问题中（效用为智能体对系统目标的边际贡献），运行BRD实验，与文献中的边际贡献PoA及均匀随机选择均衡的期望值进行比较，并考虑智能体无法观测所有其他智能体动作的情形。

Result: 简单的BRD机制往往优于PoA预测值和均匀随机均衡选择；当存在多个均衡时，BRD似乎偏向绩效更高的均衡，即表现优于平均水平。

Conclusion: 证据支持对PoA实用性的质疑，表明需要研究更稳健的多智能体优化解度量，并推动探究这种偏向更优均衡的现象在更一般情形下是否成立。

Abstract: We study experimental results of best response dynamics (BRD) in randomly generated weighted action networked multiagent optimization problems where agent utility is the agent's marginal contribution to the system objective. We compare those results to the Price of Anarchy (PoA) established in the literature for marginal contribution and to the expected value of randomly choosing from the available equilibria. PoA is used as a metric to describe the performance of various solutions to multiagent optimization problems, but the utility of this metric may be overrated if such worst-case instances are rare in practice. Our study provides evidence to support this doubt, showing that simple best response mechanics tend to out perform the PoA prediction and a uniform random equilibrium selection, even when agents are unable to observe all other agents' actions. In the process of seeking a more ideal metric, we discover that BRD appears to perform better than average. That is, when multiple equilibria exist, BRD appears to be biased toward the higher-performance ones. This evidence also demonstrates that further investigation into a more robust metric for multiagent optimization solutions is warranted and pushes us to understand whether the bias toward better equilibria hold in more general cases.

</details>


### [310] [What Can Firms Do in the Face of Model Distillation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38088)
*Diptangshu Sen,Jibang Wu,Juba Ziani*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文从经济理论视角研究生成式AI中的模型蒸馏问题，刻画在位者模型特征如何影响蒸馏者激励、蒸馏对市场结果（用户剩余、在位者效用）的影响，并重点分析两类防蒸馏干预（可检测攻击下的惩罚性监管、不可检测下的自我蒸馏）的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小公司可用从闭源强模型对话中蒸馏出的数据低成本训练模型，除安全担忧外，蒸馏还会扭曲市场竞争结果，但缺乏经济学理论层面的系统分析，因此作者启动这一研究。

Method: 构建双主体（在位者与蒸馏型竞争者）经济学理论模型，分析在位者模型特征对竞争者蒸馏程度的激励影响，并考察两种设定：以随蒸馏程度上升的检测概率实施惩罚性监管；以及在攻击无法可靠检测时在位者采用自我蒸馏作为缓解策略。

Result: 在可检测设定下，惩罚性监管能非常有效地完全遏制蒸馏，但可能对市场竞争和用户剩余产生不利影响；在不可检测设定下，在位者可用自我蒸馏缓解，其有效性取决于在位者以多高成本效率将新的自我蒸馏模型投放市场，且自我蒸馏在一定程度上能保持竞争、保护用户剩余。

Conclusion: 惩罚性监管虽能杜绝蒸馏但可能损害竞争与用户福利；自我蒸馏在无法检测时是有前景的替代缓解手段，其效果依赖部署成本效率，且对竞争和用户剩余的负面影响更小。

Abstract: Model distillation has become a major concern in the rapidly growing generative AI discourse. In its simplest form, distillation is the phenomenon where smaller firms can use data distilled from transcripts of conversations with powerful proprietary closed-weight models to train their own models, thus achieving reasonably high model quality but at much lower costs. Besides the legitimate safety and security concerns associated with distillation, another major issue is how it can also distort marketplace outcomes. This motivates us to initiate an exploration of the problem from an economic theory lens. We consider a setting with two players: an incumbent and a distilling competitor and characterize how the incumbent's model characteristics drive the incentives around how much the competitor should distill. We also consider the impact of distillation on key market outcomes like user-side surplus and the incumbent's utility. Our key contribution, however, is to study interventions for preventing or limiting distillation attacks. In this context, we study two settings: i) when it is possible, with a certain probability (which grows in the extent of distillation conducted), to detect an attack on the incumbent's model; and ii) when a distillation attack cannot be reliably detected. In the first setting, we show that penalty-based regulations can be very effective in completely deterring distillation, although it can have potentially adverse effects on market competition and user surplus. In the latter setting, we show that the incumbent can use self-distillation as a mitigation strategy. Importantly, the effectiveness of self-distillation depends on how cost-efficiently the incumbent can deploy a new self-distilled model on the market. On the positive side, self-distillation can preserve market competition thus protecting user surplus to some extent.

</details>


### [311] [Vendster: An Evaluation Arena to Investigate How Forecasting Tool Quality Affects LLM Agent Behaviors in Buyer-Vendor Negotiation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38292)
*Charin Polpanumas*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 提出 Vendster 评测平台，用 LLM 智能体买卖折扣谈判衡量时间序列预测的"决策价值"，发现预测偏差方向与智能体对预测的敏感度比预测精度更能预测下游结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列预测器几乎只按精度指标排序，但预测的决策价值（对下游决策的影响）未必与精度一致，且很少被测量；叠加 LLM 智能体把预测器当作工具、经由随机不透明的策略中介，问题进一步放大。

Method: 构建 Vendster 评测擂台：在两个 LLM 智能体间进行买方—供应商折扣谈判，测量预测偏差与预测区间宽度如何改变谈判结果。参考实例 Vendster-M5 从 M5 数据集采样基础需求模式，评测 Claude Opus 4.6、GPT-5.6 Sol、DeepSeek-V3.2、Qwen3-235B-A22B 四个模型；并注入带受控偏差与区间宽度的合成预测以做因果分离。

Result: 模型生成预测使销售目标达成率最高提升 +17 个百分点（p<0.001），但 relWQL、MASE 等标准指标无法显著预测谈判结果。合成预测下，低偏差显著改善对预测更敏感的智能体的结果，剂量反应斜率 -0.387 与 -0.416（p<0.001）；零偏差时区间宽度无显著效应。

Conclusion: 预测偏差方向与智能体对预测的反应敏感度比预测精度与下游结果关联更强；Vendster 完全可定制并以 CC BY-NC 4.0 发布于 https://github.com/amazon-science/Vendster。

Abstract: Time-series forecasters are ranked almost entirely by accuracy metrics, but a forecast's decision value, its effect on the downstream decision, need not track accuracy and is rarely measured. This problem compounds as large language model (LLM) agents increasingly consume forecasters as tools, mediating them through stochastic, opaque policies. We present Vendster, an evaluation arena measuring how a forecaster's bias and prediction-interval width change the outcome of a buyer--vendor discount negotiation between two LLM agents. In the reference instance Vendster-M5, sampling base demand patterns from the M5 dataset, we evaluate two frontier-closed LLM families (Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.6 Sol) and two open ones (DeepSeek-V3.2 and Qwen3-235B-A22B). Model-generated forecasts raise sales target attainment by up to +17 percentage points (p<0.001), yet standard forecast evaluation metrics such as relWQL and MASE do not predict negotiation outcomes at a statistically significant level. To isolate the causal structure, we substitute in synthetic forecasts with controlled bias and interval width. Under-prediction bias significantly improves outcomes for agents that react more to the forecasts---dose-response slopes -0.387 and -0.416 (p<0.001). Interval width has no statistically significant effect at zero bias. These findings indicate that the direction of forecast bias and agent forecast-reactivity are more strongly associated with downstream outcomes than forecast accuracy. Vendster is fully customizable and released under CC BY-NC 4.0 at https://github.com/amazon-science/Vendster.

</details>


### [312] [Simultaneous Gradient Learning in First-Price Auctions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38487)
*Janik Bürgermeister,Julius Durmann,Martin Bichler,Mete Şeref Ahunbay,Bary Pradelski,Marco Scarsini*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 论文提出"贝叶斯半粗相关均衡"(BSCCE)概念,证明其位于BCE与BCCE之间,给出多项式规模的LP刻画,并表明在离散化加密时BSCCE集合收缩至唯一连续贝叶斯纳什均衡,从而解释梯度学习在一价拍卖中的稳健性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续极限下对称独立私人价值一价拍卖存在唯一BCE,但经典no-regret理论只能保证收敛到BCCE;BCCE即使离散化很细仍可能很大、远离竞争均衡。需弥合这一理论与实践的差距,解释梯度类学习动态为何表现稳健。

Method: 以离散化贝叶斯博弈中的一价拍卖为试验台,研究私有信息下梯度学习动态。定义BSCCE:通过将偏离限制为与投影梯度动态一致的概率保持变换,对BCCE进行精炼;给出变量与约束均为多项式规模的线性规划刻画,并证明包含关系BCE ⊆ BSCCE ⊆ BCCE。

Result: BSCCE集合在许多情形下随离散化加密而收缩;即使先验使BCCE不集中,BSCCE多面体直径仍趋于零,表明收敛到连续博弈的唯一Bayes-Nash均衡。

Conclusion: 梯度类学习动态所选的均衡集合比标准no-regret理论预测的更小(即BSCCE),这为离散化贝叶斯博弈中梯度学习的稳健性提供了原理性解释。

Abstract: We study equilibrium learning in discretized Bayesian games, focusing on first-price auctions as a testbed for gradient-based learning dynamics under private information. While the symmetric independent private values model admits a unique Bayesian correlated equilibrium (BCE) in the continuous limit, standard convergence guarantees for gradient-based learners do not apply: classical no-regret theory predicts convergence only to Bayesian coarse correlated equilibria (BCCE), which can remain large and far from the competitive equilibrium even under fine discretizations.
  To bridge this gap, we introduce the notion of Bayesian semicoarse correlated equilibrium (BSCCE), an equilibrium concept that refines BCCE by restricting deviations to probability-preserving transformations consistent with projected gradient dynamics. We provide a linear programming characterization of BSCCE with polynomially many variables and constraints and establish the inclusion hierarchy $BCE \subseteq BSCCE \subseteq BCCE$.
  Our main finding is that the BSCCE set contracts in many cases as the discretization of the Bayesian game is refined. Even with priors for which BCCE fails to concentrate, the diameter of the BSCCE polytope shrinks toward zero, indicating convergence to the unique continuous-game Bayes-Nash equilibrium.
  These results provide a principled explanation for the observed robustness of gradient-based learning in discretized Bayesian games, showing that these dynamics select a smaller equilibrium set than standard no-regret theory predicts.

</details>


### [313] [RARE: Response-Aware Rational Equilibrium in Pricing Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38897)
*Bhaskar Ray Chaudhury,Jugal Garg,Xin Huang,Eklavya Sharma*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 论文研究预算约束买家市场中的定价博弈，因纯纳什均衡常不存在，作者提出"响应感知理性均衡"(RARE)概念——任一偏离都可被其他卖家的回应所阻止，且回应者收益不低于偏离后瞬时收益。证明在买家购买连续变化假设下，竞争性商品及等预算非竞争性商品市场总存在RARE，且该RARE可榨取买家全部预算；预算不等时存在近似RARE，偏离增益上界为平均预算与最小预算之比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预算约束买家的定价博弈中纯纳什均衡常常不存在，而纳什均衡假设其他卖家在某一卖家偏离时保持价格不变，这与现实中受损卖家会做出反应（如价格匹配）不符，因此需要一个新的均衡概念来刻画这种响应式市场。

Method: 提出Response-Aware Rational Equilibrium (RARE)：任一对卖家有利的偏离都能被其他卖家的回应所阻止，且无回应者收益低于偏离刚发生时的水平；所有纳什均衡均为RARE。假设买家在最优选择中的购买随价格连续变化，证明采用两层嵌套的KKM引理构造存在性；并对卖家反复提价以获取可保证收益的自然动态进行分析。

Result: 竞争性商品市场及等预算非竞争性商品市场总存在RARE，且所构造的RARE能榨取买家全部预算；非竞争性且预算不等时存在近似RARE，偏离者收益增幅至多为b_avg/b_min；自然提价动态在⌊B/δ⌋轮内到达加性误差δ的近似RARE。主要结果已在Lean 4中形式化验证。

Conclusion: RARE为预算约束定价博弈提供了比纳什均衡更贴合现实、且保证存在的均衡概念，覆盖竞争性与非竞争性商品市场并给出近似与动态收敛保证，且经Lean 4机器验证增强了结果可靠性。

Abstract: We study a pricing game in markets with budget-constrained buyers, where each seller offers a single good at a price she sets, and each buyer chooses a utility-maximizing bundle subject to her budget. We consider both the rivalrous setting, such as markets for physical goods, and the non-rivalrous setting, such as markets for datasets. Pure Nash equilibria often fail to exist in this game. However, Nash equilibrium assumes that the other sellers keep their prices fixed when one seller deviates, whereas in practice, sellers harmed by a price change may respond, for example, by matching the new price.
  We propose a new equilibrium notion called Response-Aware Rational Equilibrium (RARE). At a RARE, every deviation by a seller can be deterred by a response from the other sellers, in which no responder earns less than she did right after the deviation. Every Nash equilibrium is a RARE. Assuming that buyers' purchases (among their optimal choices) change continuously with prices, we show that a RARE always exists for rivalrous goods, and for non-rivalrous goods when buyers have equal budgets. Moreover, the RARE that we construct extracts the buyers' entire budget. For non-rivalrous goods with unequal budgets, we show that an approximate RARE exists, where a deviating seller can increase her revenue by a factor of at most $b_{\mathrm{avg}}/b_{\min}$, the ratio of the average budget to the minimum budget. Our proof uses two nested applications of the KKM lemma. We also study a natural dynamic in which sellers repeatedly raise their prices to earn the revenue that they could guarantee themselves by deviating, and show that it reaches an approximate RARE, with additive error $δ$, within $\lfloor B/δ\rfloor$ rounds, where $B$ is the buyers' total budget. The main results of this paper are formally verified in the Lean 4 proof assistant (https://github.com/sharmaeklavya2/dm-rare).

</details>


### [314] [Persistence of Bounded Rationality in Financial Markets: An Evolutionary Game-Theoretic Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39198)
*Cheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文将金融市场建模为理性交易者(R)与有限理性交易者(N)的生态竞争系统，用复制者动态刻画类型构成演化。当两类交易者互补且摩擦差异适中时，存在唯一内点均衡且全局渐近稳定，有限理性可内生地持续存在；当二者对抗时该点变为双单型均衡的临界阈值。降低纪律化交易成本（如算法与AI交易）只能连续地推动构成向理性倾斜，除非成本优势超过明确阈值，否则无法消除有限理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典理论预测非理性交易者会亏损并被逐出市场，但噪声交易、羊群行为和启发式交易在高发达市场仍持续存在，这一现实与理论相悖，需要解释有限理性为何能内生地存续。

Method: 构建两类交易行为（相对理性R与有限理性N）的生态学模型，采用复制者动态(replicator dynamics)描述构成随相对绩效演化；个体适应度取决于另一类型的份额及摩擦成本，并区分互补型与对抗型交互、分析摩擦差异的影响。

Result: 互补交互且摩擦差异适中时，存在唯一内点构成且全局渐近稳定；对抗交互时同一点转为两种单型均衡之间的 tipping 阈值。比较静态表明，降低纪律化交易成本会连续地将构成推向理性交易，但除非成本优势超过显式阈值，有限理性不会被消除。

Conclusion: 有限理性并非市场不完善下的暂时现象，而是可由交易者类型间的生态互补性内生维持的稳定结果；即使AI/算法交易显著降低理性交易成本，也仅能部分挤出有限理性，存在明确的消除阈值。

Abstract: Classical theory predicts that irrational traders lose money to rational traders and are eventually driven out of the market. Yet noise trading, herding, and heuristic trading persist even in highly developed markets. We model a financial market as an ecology of two trading-behavior types, relatively rational (R) and boundedly rational (N), whose composition evolves under replicator dynamics according to relative performance. Each type's fitness depends on the share of the other type and on frictions. When the interaction is complementary, that is, rational traders profit from the mispricing created by boundedly rational traders while the latter benefit from the liquidity and price correction supplied by the former, and when the difference in frictions is moderate, a unique interior composition exists and is globally asymptotically stable: bounded rationality persists endogenously. When the interaction is antagonistic, the same point becomes a tipping threshold between two one-type regimes. Comparative statics show that lowering the costs of disciplined trading, as algorithmic and AI-based trading does, shifts the composition toward rational trading continuously but does not eliminate bounded rationality unless the cost advantage exceeds an explicit threshold.

</details>


### [315] [Fragmented Obedient Equilibria in Routing Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39225)
*Zhengyang Wang,Achilleas Anastasopoulos*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究非原子群体竞争性中介路由博弈，提出"碎片化服从均衡"（FOE），给出流一二阶矩的精确重构与SDP求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典路由博弈通常假定用户直接选路，而现实中中介（如导航平台）向固定用户群体推荐路径。中介随机化推荐时，用户可能不服从以谋求更优路径，需要在"服从容忍度"约束下刻画中介最优与用户服从的均衡。

Method: 定义FOE：中介为最小化本群体期望成本选择随机流分配，用户偏离推荐的条件期望收益不超过容忍度ε。在服从策略对应下半连续性假设下证明存在性；在仿射边延迟与中介独立抽样下，用流量的一阶、二阶矩精确重构问题并保持最优响应与均衡；可行矩对可由有限支撑策略实现；路线数≤4时最优响应为精确SDP；并在Braess网络数值验证。

Result: FOE在弱假设下存在；矩重构无损失，可行矩对均有有限支撑实现；≤4条路线时最优响应可写成精确SDP；Braess网络实验显示放松服从可降低FOE成本，但与社会最优及最优服从式汇聚的差距可能持续存在。

Conclusion: 提出并分析了中介竞争下的服从容忍路由均衡框架，给出可计算的矩重构与SDP刻画，说明适度放松服从可改善均衡效率但无法保证达到社会最优。

Abstract: We study routing games in which competing mediators recommend routes to fixed nonatomic populations. Each mediator chooses a randomized flow allocation to minimize its population's expected travel cost, subject to users having no conditional expected gain above a tolerance $ε$ from disregarding their recommendations. We define a fragmented obedient equilibrium (FOE) by combining user obedience with mediator optimality, and establish existence under a lower-hemicontinuity assumption on the obedient policy correspondences. Under affine edge latencies and independent mediator sampling, we derive an exact reformulation in first and second flow moments that preserves best responses and equilibrium profiles. Every feasible moment pair admits a finitely supported realizing policy. When the network has at most four routes, each mediator's best-response problem is an exact semidefinite program. A numerical illustration on the Braess network shows that relaxing obedience can reduce FOE costs, while gaps relative to the social optimum and optimal obedient pooling can persist.

</details>


### [316] [First-Order Bilevel Optimization for Non-truthful Auction Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40403)
*Shing-Hei Ho,April Niu,Ellen Vitercik,Kai Wang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文将非真实（non-truthful）拍卖机制设计建模为含多个策略型跟随者的Stackelberg博弈，提出全一阶优化算法，并给出超梯度近似的非渐近收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动机制设计已能用神经网络学习拍卖机制，但非真实拍卖中投标人的均衡策略依赖于机制本身，会随机制优化而演化，因此设计难度大。

Method: 将拍卖设计表述为含多个策略型跟随者的Stackelberg博弈，开发仅用一阶信息（fully first-order）的收入优化算法，并对超梯度近似进行理论分析。

Result: 在标准光滑性假设与强单调性假设下，方法用 Õ(ε⁻²) 次一阶预言机调用达到 O(ε)-稳定点；在对称/非对称单物品与多物品拍卖实验中，收敛快于二阶与零阶基线，且随投标人数增加扩展性更好，所得拍卖收入接近真实机制基线。

Conclusion: 该工作为超越真实拍卖的自动机制设计提供了可扩展的框架。

Abstract: Automated mechanism design has enabled the learning of complex auction mechanisms using neural networks. However, designing non-truthful auctions remains challenging because bidders' equilibrium strategies depend on the auction mechanism and thus evolve as the mechanism is optimized.
  In this work, we formulate auction design as a Stackelberg game with multiple strategic followers and develop a fully first-order algorithm for revenue optimization in non-truthful auctions.
  We establish non-asymptotic guarantees for hypergradient approximation and show that, under standard smoothness and strong-monotonicity assumptions, our method reaches an $O(ε)$-stationary point using $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(ε^{-2})$ first-order oracle calls.
  Experiments on symmetric and asymmetric single-item auctions, as well as multi-item auctions, show that our method converges faster than second- and zeroth-order baselines and scales better as the number of bidders increases. Our method also discovers auctions that achieve revenue close to truthful baselines. These results provide a scalable framework for automated mechanism design beyond truthful auctions.

</details>


### [317] [Finding Competitive Equilibria in Online Marketplaces with Platform Fees, Taxes, and Subsidies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40626)
*Taihei Oki,Ryosuke Sato*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究带广义全替代估值与代理/交易特定分段线性转移函数的多单位交易网络的均衡计算，提出上升价格程序求得最小均衡价格向量并高效恢复均衡分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线市场中平台费、税、补贴、会员折扣等会形成代理和交易特定的转移函数，已有上升拍卖技术难以同时处理买卖之间的互补性与这类转移。

Method: 以不同速率提价的上升程序，将原对偶技术推广到多单位交易网络；通过子模流建模处理买入与卖出间的互补性，并处理广义全替代估值。

Result: 算法有限步达到最小均衡价格向量，每轮在强多项式时间内可实现（给定预言机与算术模型），均衡分配可高效恢复。

Conclusion: 框架推广了Sun-Yang(2009)与Shioura-Yang(2015)的双轨拍卖到投标者与商品特定转移，适用于单卖家含替代与互补的市场。

Abstract: We study equilibrium computation in multi-unit trading networks with valuations satisfying generalized full substitutes and agent- and transaction-specific piecewise-linear transfer functions. These transfers model platform fees, taxes, subsidies, and membership discounts in online marketplaces. Our ascending procedure raises prices at different rates and reaches the minimum equilibrium price vector in finitely many iterations, each implementable in strongly polynomial time under our oracle and arithmetic models. An equilibrium allocation can then be recovered efficiently. The method extends primal-dual techniques developed for ascending auctions to handle complementarities between purchases and sales through a submodular flow formulation. In single-seller markets with substitutes and complements, our framework also extends the double-track auctions of Sun and Yang (2009) and Shioura and Yang (2015) to bidder- and good-specific transfers.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [318] [ICALL-BENCH: Benchmarking LLM Interprocedural Reasoning in Binary Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37871)
*Shenglong Yao,Zirui Liu,Xiangchi Yuan,Wenke Lee*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 ICALL-BENCH 基准，以间接调用目标恢复为探针，直接评估 LLM 与智能体对二进制程序跨过程语义的理解与推理能力；覆盖 50 个真实 C/C++ 程序与三类分析范式，结果显示现有模型程序级可验证成功率在 23%–81% 之间，深度跨过程推理仍是主要瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准存在评测盲区：函数级基准看不到跨函数关系；整程序基准评估的是最终结果，任务可能靠局部线索、探索、工具调用、执行或检索即可完成，难以把"跨过程推理"单独剥离出来衡量。因此需要直接、可控地评测 LLM 对编译后二进制中过程间语义的推理能力。

Method: 提出 ICALL-BENCH 基准，选择"间接调用目标恢复"作为可度量的推理探针。基准包含 50 个完整真实 C/C++ 程序，覆盖不同复杂度与多种编译优化配置，平均每程序约 74,746 行代码、941 个函数。并设计三种分析范式：纯模型推理、静态工具增强智能体、联网开放世界智能体，以区分内在推理、主动信息获取与外部知识的各自贡献；评测 5 个近期 LLM 及其对应智能体。

Result: 不同模型与智能体之间差距明显，程序级可验证成功率从 23% 到 81% 不等。更多信息获取并不必然带来更好结果，在最难样本上提升尤为有限，说明深度跨过程推理仍是首要瓶颈。模型间表现不均衡，即使在偏乐观的评测设定下也频繁出现可验证失败。

Conclusion: 稳健的二进制跨过程推理仍是未解难题；单纯增加工具、联网或信息访问无法弥补推理能力不足，未来需要更针对跨过程语义推理的方法与更强的内在推理能力。ICALL-BENCH 为这一能力提供了可分离、可复现的评测手段。

Abstract: Recent benchmarks show that LLMs achieve strong performance in both function-level binary understanding and end-to-end binary reverse engineering tasks, but whether LLMs can reason over interprocedural semantics in compiled binaries remains unclear. Function-level benchmarks offer limited visibility into cross-function relationships, while whole-program benchmarks typically evaluate final outcomes of tasks that may be solvable from local clues alone, making it difficult to disentangle interprocedural reasoning from exploration, tool use, execution, and retrieval. To address this limitation, we introduce ICALL-BENCH, a benchmark that directly evaluates whether LLMs and agents can understand and reason over interprocedural semantics in binary programs, using indirect-call target recovery as a measurable probe. ICALL-BENCH covers 50 complete real-world C/C++ programs spanning different complexity levels and multiple optimization configurations, with an average of 74,746 lines of code and 941 functions per program. We further introduce three analysis regimes spanning model-only reasoning, static tool-augmented agents, and Internet-enabled open-world agents to examine how intrinsic reasoning, active information acquisition, and external knowledge each contribute to interprocedural binary analysis. We evaluate five recent LLMs and their corresponding agents. Our results reveal a wide separation across current models and agents, with program-level verifiable success rates ranging from 23% to 81%. They also show that greater information access does not consistently lead to better results, with particularly limited gains on the hardest cases, where deeper interprocedural reasoning remains the primary bottleneck. Uneven performance across models and frequent verifiable failures even under an optimistic evaluation indicate that robust binary interprocedural reasoning remains an open challenge.

</details>


### [319] [Cognitive Debt in the GenAI Era - Listening to Practitioners' Voices on the Loss of Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37888)
*Theocharis Tavantzis,Bianca Trinkenreich,Michaela Greiler,Júlia Condé Araújo,Marina Condé Araújo,Italo Santos,Alexander Serebrenik,Margaret-Anne Storey,Maria Teresa Baldassarre*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过对76篇灰色文献（博客与网络讨论）的综述，梳理了AI辅助软件开发中"认知债务"（cognitive debt）的概念、表现、成因、后果及应对实践。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI辅助开发加快编码速度，却可能削弱开发者对所构建系统的理解，形成"认知债务"。该现象在实践者博客和网络讨论中已被广泛讨论，但学术研究尚未系统捕捉，需要对其加以整理以指导后续研究与实践。

Method: 采用灰色文献综述，分析76个来源（博客文章与在线讨论），围绕认知债务的概念化与表现、成因、后果，以及预防、检测与缓解的实践进行归纳。

Result: 认知债务可在代码可运行、测试通过的情况下悄然积累，尤其在开发者不加理解地接受AI生成方案时。实践者报告的后果包括维护与调试更困难、团队知识碎片化、生产力下降；提出的实践包括记录设计理由、以评审规模控制变更、理解力门槛、知识共享仪式，并提出可靠性指标等检测信号。

Conclusion: 研究为软件团队提供了AI辅助开发中新兴实践的结构化视图，强调在加速代码生产的同时必须维护人类理解，以避免认知债务累积。

Abstract: Fast-paced AI-assisted software development risks reducing developers' understanding of the systems they build. This growing gap between what the system does and what developers understand about it, described as ``cognitive debt'', is not new, but AI has exacerbated it. This has led to a recent surge in blog posts and online discussions, in which practitioners recognize and write about cognitive debt, and share their experiences well before academic studies can capture them. To understand their concerns and inform future research and practice, we conduct a grey literature review of 76 sources, focusing on how cognitive debt is conceptualized and manifests, its contributing factors, its consequences, and the practices to prevent, detect, and mitigate it. We find that cognitive debt can accumulate unnoticed behind working code and passing tests, particularly when developers accept AI-generated solutions without building understanding. Practitioners report consequences such as harder maintenance and debugging, fragmented knowledge in the team, and reduced productivity. They propose practices such as documenting design rationale, review-sized changes, comprehension gates, and knowledge-sharing rituals, along with signals like reliability metrics to detect it. Our findings give software teams a structured view of emerging practical approaches in AI-assisted development and stress the need to preserve human understanding alongside faster code production.

</details>


### [320] [Do Open-Source Video Ad Clients Follow VAST 4.3? An Empirical Study of Player Conformance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39093)
*Prashant Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了6个开源VAST客户端对VAST 4.3规范的符合度：共提取108条需求、69个测试向量，在多运行时（Node.js与3个引擎的5款浏览器）及36个版本上测试，发现78个问题、每配置3–21处must级偏离，并揭示Wrapper宏、超时异常、粘连广告归属及运行时依赖等偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频广告计数依赖客户端HTTP请求，跟踪错误可能不影响播放却导致各方计数不一致；需量化开源VAST客户端是否履行VAST 4.3的播放器职责，并考察结论是否依赖运行时。

Method: 从规范提取108条需求构成目录；6个开源客户端（8种配置）在Node.js和5款浏览器（3个引擎）下运行69个构造测试向量与IAB样例标签，记录全部请求；辅以网格、模糊测试及36个版本回溯扫描，并以闭源Google IMA SDK作对比。

Result: 开源客户端共78项发现，每配置3–21个must级偏离；跟随重定向（Wrapper）链的开源客户端均未在Wrapper请求中填充所需宏（IMA 3.794.0可）；某库超时抛出无法捕获的异常致Node进程终止；pod场景下某播放器将完结广告的完成事件计入下一条（5.3.0修复）；某库在jsdom下通过却在Chrome/Safari系全部偏离。

Conclusion: 被测客户端在业界用于计数与诊断广告的职责上存在分歧；在真实浏览器中运行共享一致性测试套件可暴露大多评分级偏离；测试框架与向量已开源发布。

Abstract: Context. Video ads reach streaming and connected-TV apps through VAST documents, and companies count ads from the HTTP requests the player's client library sends. A tracking error can leave playback intact and surface later as disagreeing counts.
  Objective. To measure how far open-source VAST clients meet the player duties of VAST 4.3, whether verdicts depend on the runtime, what generated inputs add, and when deviations were introduced.
  Method. A catalog of 108 requirements was extracted from the specification. Six open-source clients in eight configurations ran against 69 crafted test vectors and the IAB's sample tags, under Node.js and in five browsers on three engines, with every request recorded. Grids, fuzzing and a sweep over 36 releases extend the catalog; Google's closed IMA SDK is a comparison.
  Results. The open-source clients have 78 findings and 3 to 21 must-level deviations per configuration. None of the tested open-source clients that follow redirect (Wrapper) chains fills the required macros in a Wrapper's request; the archived IMA 3.794.0 configuration tested does. One library's timeout throws an exception no caller can catch, ending a Node.js process. In a pod (ads played back to back), one player credits a finishing ad's completion to the next ad, fixed in release 5.3.0. A library can conform under jsdom and deviate in every tested Chrome- and Safari-family browser.
  Conclusions. The tested clients diverge on the duties other companies use to count and diagnose ads. A shared conformance suite run in real browsers could expose most graded deviations; the harness and vectors are released.

</details>


### [321] [Reusable LLM-Based Plans with Probabilistic Guarantees for Self-Adaptive Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38039)
*Asher Tempest Arya,Rajan Maghera,Nicholas Wu Jiang,Federico Mora,Aren A. Babikian,Marsha Chechik*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出验证器引导的框架，将LLM编写的控制器与概率模型检验结合，为不同环境族实例提供逐实例的概率需求保证，实现控制器复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应系统需应对环境变体构成的环境族，每个实例有概率需求。控制器通常针对单一实例合成，环境尺寸与结构变化使"保留/复用/新建控制器"的决策变难。现有LLM写控制器的方法多针对确定性场景，概率模型检验仅停留在单实例初步研究。

Method: 提出verifier-guided框架，显式支持环境族。核心是将LLM编写的控制器与概率模型检验新颖结合，用模型检验反馈引导控制器生成，从而在每个实例上验证概率需求并提供保证，同时支持控制器的保留、复用与新构建决策。

Result: 在三个基准、三种LLM上评测。网格世界中，LLM规则列表在约90%的留出实例上通过验证，基线最多77%；验证已存规则列表比逐实例合成快15–103倍；复用服务大多数episode且成本仅为生成或逐实例合成的一小部分；模型检验反馈相比独立重启提升了验证覆盖率。

Conclusion: 验证器引导的LLM控制器复用框架可有效支持环境族下的概率需求保证，显著提升验证覆盖率并大幅降低成本，模型检验反馈对生成质量有实质帮助。

Abstract: Self-adaptive systems are designed to accommodate variants of their environment, which form a family of instances whose uncertainty is captured by probabilistic models, and must meet probabilistic requirements on each instance. Within such a family, changes in size and structure complicate the fundamental adaptation decision: whether to retain, reuse, or construct a new controller, since controllers are often synthesized for and specific to an instance. Large language models (LLMs) have recently been used to write reusable controllers, but existing approaches largely target deterministic domains, and probabilistic model checking of their output remains limited to preliminary single-instance studies. In this paper, we propose a verifier-guided framework for controller reuse with explicit support for families of environments. The framework introduces a novel combination of LLM-written controllers with probabilistic model checking to provide per-instance guarantees for probabilistic requirements. We evaluate our approach using three LLMs on three benchmarks, assessing its effectiveness and cost with respect to baseline implementations, the distribution of adaptation decisions, and the impact of individual framework components. On grid worlds, LLM-written rule lists are verified on about 90% of held-out instances, against at most 77% for the baselines, and verifying a stored rule list is 15 to 103 times faster than per-instance synthesis. Reuse serves most episodes at a small fraction of the cost of generation or per-instance synthesis, and model-checking feedback increases verified coverage over independent restarts.

</details>


### [322] [Understanding Post-Quantum Cryptography Adoption: Practices, Challenges, and Evolution in Open-Source Software](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38054)
*Souhardya Saha Dip,Moshood A. Fakorede,Krishna Upadhyay,Umar Farooq*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 通过挖掘179个开源仓库的114,361次提交与5,713个issue，实证刻画PQC（后量子密码）在软件项目中的落地与维护现状。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PQC标准已确立，但缺乏关于软件项目如何实现与维护PQC支持的大规模实证证据。

Method: 挖掘179个开源仓库的114,361条提交和5,713个issue；采用人工标注与经验证的LLM分类，识别提交中的PQC算法、采纳状态与部署模式，并从issue中提取技术挑战；再用时间序列分析与首次实现事件，对照NIST标准化里程碑。

Result: 90%的PQC相关提交属于既有支持的维护；构建了11类技术挑战分类体系，其中构建/打包/依赖失败与功能缺陷约占已分类issue的一半；2024年标准化后，标准算法名称出现在80%以上的PQC开发变更中，但Kyber等旧名称仍持续出现；开发活动整体上升，但里程碑未带来首次实现的显著增长。

Conclusion: 迁移计划应预期长期维护负担，优先保障构建可靠性与集成测试，并同时追踪标准名称与前身算法名称；数据集、分类体系、标注与分析流水线已公开。

Abstract: Post-quantum cryptography (PQC) standards establish algorithms for quantum-safe systems, but empirical evidence about how software projects implement and maintain PQC support remains limited. We investigate this implementation and maintenance work by mining 114,361 commits and 5,713 issues across 179 open-source repositories. We use human annotation and validated LLM classification to identify PQC algorithms in commits, classify their adoption status and deployment mode, and identify technical challenges in issue discussions. The commit classification for PQC algorithms reveals that 90% of commits concern maintenance of existing support. From the issue discussions, we construct an 11-category taxonomy of recurring technical challenges. Build, packaging, and dependency failures, along with functional defects, account for approximately half of categorized issues. To examine how PQC support evolves, we use time-series analysis and first implementations of individual algorithms within repositories around NIST standardization milestones. After the 2024 finalization, standardized algorithm names appeared in more than 80% of the PQC development changes analyzed, although earlier names such as Kyber continued to appear. Development activity increased over the observation period. Our milestone analysis, however, did not find a significant increase in first implementations. Migration plans should therefore account for sustained maintenance, prioritize build reliability and integration testing, and track both standardized and predecessor algorithm names. We make the dataset, taxonomy, annotations, and analysis pipeline publicly available.

</details>


### [323] [Template-Free Dynamic Invariant Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38130)
*Erfan Arvan,Michael D. Ernst,Martin Kellogg*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Oca 用 LLM 替代/补充模板来提出动态不变量，并通过插桩、停滞监控与 delta debugging 控制副作用与死循环，在真实 Java 项目上比 Daikon 更表达力强、误报少（18% vs 76%）、更能发现真实缺陷，且成本更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统动态不变量检测器从固定模板库中提出不变量（如方法前置/后置条件），再由运行时排除不成立者，但这受限于模板表达能力；LLM 可提出更丰富的不变量，然而 LLM 生成的不变量在求值时可能执行任意代码，导致副作用或无限循环。

Method: 用合适的提示与上下文让 LLM 提出不变量；采用新插桩策略：包装每个候选且每线程同时只求值一个不变量，防止嵌套求值无限触发；对非嵌套挂起监控运行停滞并在递增时间预算下重试；因无法预先证明候选无副作用，用对失败测试期间已求值不变量的 delta debugging 隔离并禁用副作用候选而保留其余运行结果。实现为 Oca。

Result: 在真实开源 Java 项目上与 Daikon 对比：Oca 平均 28% 的保留不变量调用项目特定方法（Daikon 模板无法表达）；人工检查误报率 18% vs Daikon 76%；作为 property-based testing 属性，暴露 25 个真实缺陷中的 9 个 vs Daikon 4 个；成本 566 分钟与 27 GB 磁盘，Daikon 为 2,817 分钟与 827 GB。

Conclusion: LLM 提出的不变量在表达力、有效性、实用性上均优于模板式检测器，且推理成本更低；其执行任意代码的风险可通过插桩、停滞监控与 delta debugging 有效缓解。

Abstract: A dynamic invariant detector proposes invariants, such as method pre- and postconditions, and rules out those that do not hold at run time. Traditional detectors propose invariants from a fixed library of templates, which limits their expressiveness. A large language model (LLM) can propose invariants instead of, or in addition to, template-derived ones. With the right prompt and context choices, we found that this idea can both improve the invariants' expressiveness and reduce the cost of inferring the invariants.
  Greater expressiveness brings complications: an LLM-proposed invariant can execute arbitrary code during invariant evaluation, causing side effects or infinite loops. Our novel instrumentation strategies mitigate these problems. We wrap each candidate and evaluate only one invariant per thread at a time, so nested invariant evaluations cannot trigger one another indefinitely. To recover from non-nested hangs, we monitor each run for stalls and retry it under a growing time budget. Because we cannot prove a candidate side-effect-free in advance, we use delta debugging over the invariants evaluated during a failing test to isolate and disable a side-effecting candidate without discarding the rest of the run.
  We compared our implementation, Oca, to the popular template-based Daikon invariant detector on real open-source Java projects. Oca produces more expressive invariants: on average, 28% of its held invariants call a project-specific method, which Daikon's templates cannot express. Its invariants are more often valid, with a false-positive rate of 18% in a manual inspection, vs. 76% for Daikon, and more useful: as properties for property-based testing, they exposed 9 of 25 real bugs, compared with 4 for Daikon. Oca also costs less, using 566 minutes and 27 GB of disk, compared with 2,817 minutes and 827 GB for Daikon.

</details>


### [324] [Mentorship, Interrupted: How GenAI Disrupts the GSoC Pipeline and Why Mentors Matter More](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38167)
*Ruizhe Xing,Zixuan Feng,Mary Radomile,Stephanie Taylor,Sophia Vargas,Anita Sarma*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 研究生成式AI如何改变Google Summer of Code中的导师制，发现AI降低了新人成果作为能力证据的可信度，导师需额外核查，消耗项目自我延续所需的时间与善意，并提出AIM决策框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GenAI使开源贡献更易产出，却更难反映贡献者真实能力；导师制依赖"从作品判断新人理解"和"新人从反馈中学习"，这一评估基础正被削弱。

Method: 筛选2022年11月至2026年3月GSoC受限导师邮件列表全部讨论串，并访谈15名导师与组织管理者。

Result: GenAI有助于入门引导、协调和初审，但提案、入门贡献和新人的回答作为能力证据变弱；导师以额外核查弥补，挤占项目传承所需的时间与善意，已有组织退出GSoC。各组织态度从禁用GenAI到接受不一，其划定的边界决定了由谁承担核查。

Conclusion: 提出AIM决策框架，将可接受的GenAI使用、指导流程整合与导师精力三者关联，帮助开源组织选择可持续的应对策略。

Abstract: Generative AI (GenAI) makes open source software (OSS) contributions cheaper to produce, and it makes them say less about the people who produced them. In OSS mentoring, that matters: mentors judge what newcomers understand from their work, and newcomers learn from mentors' feedback. We studied how GenAI is changing mentoring in Google Summer of Code (GSoC), a program in which today's mentees can become tomorrow's mentors. We screened every thread on GSoC's restricted mentors' mailing list from November 2022 through March 2026 and interviewed 15 mentors and organization administrators. GenAI helped with onboarding, coordination, and first-pass review, but proposals, entry contributions, and mentees' answers became weaker evidence of what newcomers could do. Mentors made up the difference by checking, and that checking drew on the same time and goodwill the program needs to renew itself; one organization had withdrawn from GSoC. Responses ranged from banning GenAI to accepting it, and the boundary an organization drew determined who did the checking. We propose AIM, a decision framework that links acceptable GenAI use, integration into the mentoring pipeline, and mentoring capacity, to help organizations choose responses they can sustain.

</details>


### [325] [Skeleton Coding: Program Structure as a Specification for Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38214)
*Aditya Golatkar,Alessandro Achille,Renos Zabounidis,Vlad Sobal,Yangruibo Ding,Baishakhi Ray,Jonathan Buck,Guy Van den Broeck,Maryam Fazel,Pietro Perona,Wei Xia,Stefano Soatto*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出"骨架编程"(Skeleton Coding)：开发者与智能体共同指定高层代码结构（数据类型/模块/函数分解）和行为规格，理论证明骨架可指数级减少所需测试数量，实测降低测试误差48.4%，缩小模型规模差距约52.4%，实现成本降低15-26倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码智能体仅接收端到端行为规格（测试、输入输出样例），但需要多少规格、哪些规格才能使智能体产出开发者意图的程序无法先验确定，因为其取决于智能体自行决定的实现结构。同一组测试对一种结构充分，对另一结构可能严重欠约束，导致开发者需逆向推理数千行生成代码才能保证规格完整。

Method: 引入 Skeleton Coding：开发者在生成前以高层、类代码的格式显式指定程序结构（骨架），与行为规格联合提供。理论上将AI辅助编码建模为控制问题，分析结构先验对所需测试数量的影响。

Result: 理论上证明骨架可指数级减少引导智能体所需测试数量；实证上在4个模型、3个基准上，最佳骨架规格相比最佳端到端行为规格使平均测试误差降低48.4%；即使智能体可查询完整参考实现，加骨架仍相对降低测试误差达27.0%；小与大模型间平均差距缩小约52.4%，实现成本降低15-26倍，代码侵蚀平均减少24.7%。

Conclusion: 将结构指定权部分交还开发者、与行为规格联合指定，是提高代码智能体可控性与效率的有效途径；骨架作为结构先验既能大幅降低规格负担，又能提升小模型性能并降低成本。

Abstract: Coding agents are typically provided end-to-end behavioral specifications that the code they produce should satisfy, such as tests and input--output examples. How many such specifications must a developer provide, and which ones, for the agent to produce the developer's intended program? We argue that this cannot be determined a priori, for it depends on the structure of the implementation, which is left to the agent to decide. An agent first commits to a structure---a decomposition into data types, modules, and functions---which fixes a class of candidate programs; behavioral specifications then select a program within that class. A set of tests that suffices for one structure may leave another badly underdetermined, requiring different edge cases or exponentially more examples. Since the structure is chosen by the agent, developers cannot ensure their specification is complete without reverse-engineering it from thousands of lines of generated code. To resolve this, we introduce Skeleton Coding, in which developers jointly specify the structure---in high-level, code-like format---alongside behavioral specifications. Theoretically, we model AI-assisted coding as a control problem, and show that skeletons can reduce exponentially the number of tests developers must supply to steer an agent toward an acceptable program. Empirically, across four models and three benchmarks, the best-performing skeleton specifications reduce mean test error by 48.4% relative to the best end-to-end behavioral specifications. Even when the agent can query a complete reference implementation, adding a skeleton reduces mean test error relatively by up to 27.0%. Skeletons also narrow the average gap between small and large models by about 52.4% while lowering implementation cost by 15--26x, and reduce code erosion by 24.7% on average.

</details>


### [326] [Precedent or Intent? What Coding Agents Follow When Evolving Existing Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38244)
*Haichao Zhu,Geyang Xu,Zhaorui Yang,Jiyuan Wang,Qian Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文通过双向受控实验（5,625次试验、4个编码智能体、6对实现）及4个开源仓库验证，研究了编码智能体在"遵循已有代码"与"遵循新任务指令"冲突时如何决策：智能体默认实现偏好高度一致，但强烈遵循仓库先例；先例影响力取决于文件位置与数量；显式书写的优先级规则能显著提升任务意图兑现成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码只体现过去的实现决策，却不解释其背后的理由，当智能体开发新功能或修改旧功能时，旧决策可能与新任务指令冲突。论文要回答的核心问题是：当多种实现都满足同一功能需求时，编码智能体如何决定是遵循已有代码还是新任务指令。

Method: 在专门构建的仓库中进行双向受控实验，隔离三类竞争性引导来源：（1）智能体默认偏好；（2）仓库先例；（3）显式任务指令。共开展5,625次试验，覆盖4个编码智能体、6对实现方案，并在横跨3种编程语言的4个开源仓库中验证。此外对比"书面优先级规则"与"仅代码示例"两种引导方式的效果。

Result: 智能体默认实现选择高度一致；当仓库先例与默认冲突时，智能体压倒性地遵循先例（359/360）。并非所有先例影响力相同：3个支持性本地文件带来96%采纳率，而同级资源文件仅4%；仅改变文件放置方式即可在示例数量固定时使采纳率从0%跳到100%。当新任务意图与现存代码冲突时，书面优先级规则的联合成功率为59/60，远高于仅代码示例的38/60；在开源仓库中，harness加载的规则使联合成功率从0/120提升至117/120。

Conclusion: 编码智能体的行为受仓库先例强烈支配，且先例影响力对文件位置等因素高度敏感，单纯依靠代码示例难以传达新任务意图。研究因此提出应建立"设计决策可追溯性"，不仅记录实现选择，还要保存指导未来变更的理由与优先级。

Abstract: Existing code reveals past implementation decisions but rarely explains the reasoning behind them. When coding agents implement new features or modify existing functionality, past decisions may conflict with new task instructions. This raises a fundamental question for agentic software evolution: when multiple implementations satisfy the same functional requirements, how do coding agents decide whether to follow existing code or new task instructions? We investigate this question through bidirectional, controlled experiments in purpose-built repositories, followed by validation in real-world open-source repositories. Our approach isolates three competing sources of guidance: (1) agents' default preferences, (2) repository precedents, and (3) explicit task instructions. We conduct 5,625 trials across four coding agents and six implementation pairs, with validation in four open-source repositories spanning three programming languages. We find that agents share the same default implementation choices, yet overwhelmingly follow repository precedent when it conflicts with those defaults (359/360 trials). Crucially, not all precedents carry equal influence: three supporting local files yield 96% adoption, compared with only 4% for sibling-resource files, and changing file placement alone can shift adoption from 0% to 100% at a fixed example count. When new task intent conflicts with existing code, written priority rules achieve substantially higher success than code examples alone (59/60 versus 38/60 joint successes for two agents on two implementation pairs). The effectiveness of explicit rules also extends to open-source repositories, where a harness-loaded rule raises joint success from 0/120 to 117/120. These findings motivate design-decision traceability that preserves not only implementation choices but also the rationale and priorities that should guide future changes.

</details>


### [327] [Detecting Incorrect LLM Explanations for Automated Program Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38311)
*Lam Nguyen Tung,Chenxi Gu,Xiaoning Du,Haoye Tian,Aldeida Aleti,Neelofar Neelofar*

Main category: cs.SE
