### [512] [After One-Click Video: The Inflow of Service-Type Content, the Failure of the Recommendation Pool Mechanism, and the BoLe System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37695)
*Bo Zou,Chao Xu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 作者认为"一键视频"（让LLM写程序生成解说视频）的普及不只是个体创作力的提升，而是从深层改变了内容产业结构：服务型内容因门槛低而激增，与受限的"作品型内容"比例失衡，叠加固定注意力总量与平台分层试看机制，推荐池机制将在新内容超过某一倍数后失效，并据此提出"BoLe系统"作为出路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2026年9月新LLM发布后，"让模型写程序、程序生成视频"的一键视频内容在各大平台大量涌现。作者不满足于"个体创作力上升"的表层解读，希望揭示其对内容产业结构的影响，并预警平台推荐机制的失效风险。

Method: 概念性论证+简化数学模型。提出两类内容划分（服务型内容：为满足需求而看；作品型内容：为内容本身而看）；论证AI同时加速两者生产，但服务型内容人人可入、作品型内容受"有话可说的人"数量限制，故比例逐渐失衡；再结合"免费平台通过多层试看筛选内容、消耗固定总量用户注意力"以及失衡稀释优质内容，用简化模型推导推荐池机制失效的条件（新内容增长超过某倍数）。

Result: 在给定假设成立的前提下，简化数学模型的结论是：当新增内容增长超过某一倍数阈值时，推荐池机制会失效——试看筛选消耗注意力、内容比例失衡以及优质内容被稀释共同导致该结果。

Conclusion: 文章提出一种可能出路"BoLe系统"：由机器与准入规则判断服务型内容是否达标，由可信赖的人判断作品型内容；并简要展望两类内容未来的发展走向。

Abstract: In September 2026, a new large language model was released. Soon after, a new way of making explainer videos became very popular: people asked the model to write a program, and the program produced the video. "One-click video" content then appeared in large amounts on many platforms. On the surface, this is a rise in creative power at the level of the individual. We argue that, at a deeper level, it changes the structure of the content industry. This judgment rests on two observations. First, this wave of content is service-type content. People watch it to meet a need, not to enjoy the content itself. The other kind is work-type content. AI makes both kinds faster to produce. But anyone can come in and make service-type content, while work-type content is limited by the number of people who have something to say. So the ratio between the two slowly becomes unbalanced. Second, free platforms choose content through layers of trial viewing, and this uses up user attention. The total amount of attention is fixed. The unbalanced ratio also dilutes good content. A simplified mathematical model shows that, as long as these conditions hold, the recommendation pool mechanism will fail once new content grows past a certain multiple. Based on this, we discuss one possible way out. Machines and entry rules judge whether service-type content passes the bar. Trusted people judge work-type content. We call this the BoLe system. At the end, we briefly imagine how the two kinds of content may develop from here.

</details>


### [513] [chATLAS: A Retrieval-Augmented Conversational Assistant for the ATLAS Experiment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37697)
*Joe Egan,Ben Elliot,Samuel Van Stroud,Alex Sopio,Ki Ryeong Park,Daniele Dal Santo,Zhaohui Li,Runze Li,Jeremy Couthures,Joe George,Cary Randazzo,Juerg Beringer,Daniel Murnane,Gabriel Facini*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: chATLAS 是部署于 CERN ATLAS 实验的 RAG 助手，覆盖 3 万余份内部文档，通过混合稠密-稀疏检索、领域微调与上下文检索实现带来源引用的对话式知识访问。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型科学协作产生的内部文档分散在异构系统中，通用大模型无法访问这些专有资料，协作者难以检索和复用已有知识。

Method: 构建基于自动生成问答对的领域基准；研究嵌入模型选择与领域微调、上下文检索、排序策略与生成器选型；采用部署在 CERN 基础设施上的稠密-稀疏混合检索；系统集成意图路由、安全处理、Mattermost 接入及面向智能体工作流的 MCP 服务器。

Result: 微调结合上下文检索使技术难度最高的文档源上正确文档进入首位结果的比率提升一倍以上；基准用于指导检索与生成性能评估及设计决策。

Conclusion: 领域适配的 RAG 能为协作知识提供带来源归属的专有领域访问，可作为科学协作组织及其他依赖准确、及时检索专有文档机构的实用基础。

Abstract: Large scientific collaborations produce extensive internal documentation spread across heterogeneous systems, making it difficult for collaborators to locate and reuse existing knowledge. We present chATLAS, a deployed Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) assistant developed for the ATLAS experiment at CERN. The system provides conversational access to more than 30,000 documents from several collaboration resources, material largely unavailable to general-purpose language models, using hybrid dense--sparse retrieval deployed on CERN infrastructure. A domain-specific benchmark built from automatically generated question--answer pairs is used to evaluate retrieval and generation performance and to guide design choices. We study the selection and domain-specific fine-tuning of an embedding model, contextual retrieval, ranking strategies, and generator choice. Fine-tuning combined with contextual retrieval more than doubles how often the correct document is returned as the top result on the most technically challenging documentation source. The deployed system also includes intent routing, safety handling, Mattermost integration, and an MCP server for future agentic workflows. chATLAS demonstrates that domain-adapted RAG can provide source-attributed, domain-specific access to collaboration knowledge, and offers a practical foundation for scientific collaborations and other organisations that rely on accurate, up-to-date retrieval from proprietary documentation.

</details>


### [514] [DuQUAD: A Dual-View Framework with Quality-Aware Evidence Pruning for Multi-Document Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37701)
*Yeonjun Choi,Seyeon Jeong,Jong Wook Kim,Beakcheol Jang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: DuQUAD是一个多文档问答框架，通过双视角推理与质量感知证据剪枝缓解"Lost in the Middle"位置偏差，平均准确率提升3.0%，金标准证据召回率提升9.4%，并显著降低计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG大模型在多文档上下文中系统性低估中部证据（Lost in the Middle）。现有的文档重排、注意力引导等方法虽能降低边界偏差，但在噪声场景下脆弱：相关性估计不准与虚假文档仍会掩盖中部有效证据。

Method: DuQUAD结合两个智能体：由结构融合分数（Structural Fusion Score）引导的局部智能体，负责定向证据恢复；以及在全文档集上推理的全局智能体，提供整体上下文理解。框架进一步用显式质量打分过滤候选证据，并在句子级别精炼以降低噪声。

Result: 在多个强基线（混合检索与重排、多智能体推理、上下文优化方法）上持续领先：相较最强竞争基线平均准确率提升3.0%，金标准证据召回率提升9.4%，同时相较现有多智能体框架大幅降低计算成本。

Conclusion: 通过局部-全局双视角推理与质量感知、句子级证据剪枝，可在噪声条件下稳健缓解位置偏差，在准确率、证据召回与效率之间取得更优平衡。

Abstract: Large language models with retrieval-augmented generation systematically underutilize evidence in the middle of multi-document contexts, a phenomenon known as Lost in the Middle. Existing mitigation strategies, such as document reordering and attention steering, can reduce boundary bias but remain brittle in noisy settings, where inaccurate relevance estimation and spurious documents still obscure useful evidence in central positions. We propose DuQUAD, a multi-document QA framework that mitigates positional bias through dual-view reasoning and quality-aware evidence pruning. DuQUAD combines a Local Agent guided by a Structural Fusion Score with a Global Agent that reasons over the full document set, providing both targeted evidence recovery and broad contextual understanding. The framework further filters candidate evidence using explicit quality scoring and refines it at the sentence level to reduce noise. DuQUAD consistently outperforms strong Lost-in-the-Middle mitigation baselines, including hybrid retrieval and reranking, multi-agent reasoning, and context optimization methods, improving accuracy by 3.0% on average over the strongest competing baseline and gold evidence recall by 9.4%, while substantially reducing computational cost compared to existing multi-agent frameworks.

</details>


### [515] [Relevance-Guided Residual Calibration for Spectral Compression of Dense Retrieval Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37707)
*Yongkang Li,Panagiotis Eustratiadis,Evangelos Kanoulas*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: RRC 是一种闭式方法，用相关性判断校正谱压缩中各主方向的权重，在保留压缩器整体谱趋势的同时提升稠密检索效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 谱压缩（如 PCA、Whitening、SpecTemp）把嵌入投影到更小的主子空间以降低存储与打分成本，但其基于语料库的加权规则让所有保留方向共用一个谱趋势，未直接考虑各方向对相关性的贡献。

Method: 基于正负样本沿各保留方向的得分贡献的均值与方差估计 margin 权重；保留估计权重为正的方向，将其对数权重分解为拟合的幂律趋势与残差，再把残差加到压缩器该支撑集上的对数权重中；可直接并入文档与查询共享的既有变换，无需迭代训练或额外推理阶段，适用于 PCA、Whitening 与 SpecTemp。

Result: 3 个编码器、9 个数据集（BEIR 与 BRIGHT）上，SpecTemp+RRC 在各目标维度下取得最高平均效果；BRIGHT 五个数据集在 768 维上平均提升 2.34 nDCG@10；在标量量化与乘积量化下增益依然存在，改善了每文档存储与检索效果的权衡。

Conclusion: 利用相关性判断对单个谱方向做残差校正，可在不改变压缩器整体谱趋势的前提下提升谱压缩稠密检索的性价比。

Abstract: Spectral compression reduces the storage and scoring costs of dense retrieval by projecting embeddings onto a smaller principal subspace. However, its corpus-derived weighting rules tie all retained directions to a shared spectral trend, without directly accounting for their individual contributions to relevance. To address this, we propose Relevance-Guided Residual Calibration (RRC), a closed-form method for refining spectral weights using relevance judgments. RRC estimates margin-based weights from the means and variances of positive--negative score contributions along each retained direction. It retains directions with positive estimated weights, decomposes their log weights into a fitted power-law trend and a residual, and adds the residual to the compressor's log weights on this support. This allows relevance judgments to adjust individual directions while preserving the compressor's overall spectral trend. RRC applies to PCA, Whitening, and SpecTemp, and incorporates the corrections into the existing transformation shared by documents and queries, without iterative model training or an additional inference stage. Experiments with three encoders on nine datasets covering conventional and reasoning-intensive retrieval show that SpecTemp + RRC achieves the highest mean effectiveness among tested compressors on the BEIR group and BRIGHT at every target dimension. On the five evaluated BRIGHT datasets, it improves over SpecTemp by an average of 2.34 nDCG@10 points at 768 dimensions. The gains also persist under scalar and product quantization, improving the trade-off between per-document storage and retrieval effectiveness. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/rrc-spectral-compression-B5CE/

</details>


### [516] [Beyond Similarity Search: Knowledge Graph Metadata Enrichment for Enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37728)
*Fakabbir Amin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文在 SEC EDGAR 数据快照上对比 text-to-SQL、向量 RAG 与两阶段 GraphRAG 三种检索架构，GraphRAG 在 20 题基准中三试全对 16 题，显著优于 text-to-SQL（10）与向量 RAG（3）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业文档由多团队跨时间创建，无法用组织文档职责范围之外的最新信息与元数据来富化内容，这使 RAG 检索面临挑战。作者想验证用知识图谱存储元数据与频繁变化的信息，能否优于基于嵌入相似度的检索。

Method: 构建一个季度的 SEC EDGAR 快照（167,050 份 filings、10,511 家公司、508,714 个嵌入块），并建 430,257 节点、561,144 边、每条边带 accession number 的知识图谱。对比三种架构：typed columns 上的 text-to-SQL、基于 HNSW 余弦检索的稠密向量 RAG、两阶段 GraphRAG。三者共用同一模型与温度，由 LLM 作为裁判对 20 题（4 类）每题 3 次作答进行程序化评分。

Result: GraphRAG 三试全对 16/20，text-to-SQL 为 10，向量 RAG 为 3。GraphRAG 在结构化聚合题上失分；向量 RAG 在其本应取胜的单文档类别上 15 次仅过 3 次（GraphRAG 15/15），因该规模下公司归属无法从余弦相似度中恢复。基准中全部 6 个自信错误均来自 text-to-SQL 混淆同姓的不同人物，而 GraphRAG 未出现此类错误。

Conclusion: 采用"先解析身份到标识符、再读文本"的结构化图设计可避免相似度检索的归属与身份混淆问题。作者声明该优势仅限此语料、此模型与此题集，不外推。

Abstract: A key challenge of RAG systems is retrieving information from enterprise documents created by multiple teams over time, where it is not possible to enrich the information using the latest information and metadata available outside the scope of organizational documentation responsibility. We investigated whether using a knowledge graph to store metadata and frequently changing information would improve upon knowledge retrieval over similarity search over embeddings. To perform the experiment, we created a snapshot of the SEC EDGAR dataset for a quarter, comprising 167,050 filings from 10,511 companies and 508,714 embedded chunks of risk-factor text. To simulate the enrichment, we created a knowledge graph of 430,257 nodes and 561,144 edges carrying an accession number on every edge. To evaluate the gain obtained via a graph-based design, we evaluated three architectures: text-to-SQL over typed columns, dense-vector RAG with HNSW cosine search, and a two-stage GraphRAG design. All architectures share the same model and temperature to allow comparison. Results are scored programmatically by an LLM as judge over 20 questions divided across four categories, each question asked three times. GraphRAG solved 16 of 20 questions on all three attempts, compared to 10 for text-to-SQL and 3 for vector RAG. GraphRAG lost on structured aggregation queries. Vector RAG lost the single-document category it was expected to win, passing 3 of 15 where GraphRAG passed 15 of 15, because company attribution is not recoverable from cosine similarity at this scale. All six confident falsehoods in the benchmark were text-to-SQL conflating distinct people who share a surname, the failure that resolving identity to an identifier before reading any text prevents structurally; GraphRAG made none. We claim no advantage beyond this corpus, this model and this question set.

</details>


### [517] [Statistical Detection of Positional Bias in LLM-Based Recommender Systems: Methodologies and Empirical Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37962)
*Carlos Peláez-González,Francisco Herrera,Andrés Herrera-Poyatos*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文研究基于RAG的LLM推荐系统中候选商品在提示中出现顺序导致的位置偏差，提出两种检测方法（POB-ICM和POB-UNBP）并在2000条查询×20种排列的受控测试台上验证偏差在所有SOTA模型中均显著存在，且为结构性而非解码随机性所致，主张对部署系统进行常规审计与治理（如顺序随机化）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM通过RAG作为对话推荐系统的推荐生成器带来新的结构性偏差来源，而现有研究缺乏对"候选呈现顺序影响top-1推荐"这一位置偏差的系统性检测与量化手段。

Method: 在真实商品目录上构建受控RAG测试台（固定提示模板、2000条模板生成查询、每条20种排列，共40000实例）；提出两种检测方法：(i) POB-ICM——基于列联表分析与卡方独立性检验；(ii) POB-UNBP——基于置换评估下的均匀性零模型，支持随机解码并具统计保证；并提出三项指标：排列敏感度、位置偏差、强位置偏差（后者针对位置将推荐推向明显更不相关商品的情形）。

Result: 在所有评估的SOTA模型上，两种方法均拒绝"位置独立且均匀"的零假设；跨候选集规模与解码温度的稳健性分析表明偏差是结构性的、模型相关的，而非确定性解码或候选规模的副产物。

Conclusion: 位置偏差是所评估场景下提示介导推荐流水线可测量、可复现的特性，应在部署的LLM推荐系统中纳入常规审计与治理控制（如顺序随机化、标准化提示），代码已开源。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as recommendation generators in conversational recommender systems (RS) via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). This flexible design introduces new sources of structural bias. This paper studies positional bias in top-1 and single-turn LLM-based RS: systematic dependence of the recommended item on the order in which candidates are presented in the prompt. We propose two complementary detection methodologies: (i) POB-ICM, based on contingency matrix analysis and Chi-square independence testing, and (ii) POB-UNBP, a sample-efficient approach derived from a uniformity null model under permutation-based evaluation, enabling stochastic decoding with formal statistical guarantees. Using a controlled RAG testbed for product recommendation, built on a real product catalog, a fixed prompt template and 2000 template-generated user queries with 20 permutations each (40,000 instances), both methodologies reject the null hypothesis of positional independence and uniformity in all evaluated state-of-the-art models. We introduce three complementary metrics -- permutation sensitivity, positional bias, and strong positional bias -- to quantify this effect, the latter targeting cases where the position displaces the recommendation towards clearly less relevant items rather than only choosing among comparably relevant ones. A robustness analysis across candidate-set size and decoding temperature shows that the bias is structural and model-dependent, not an artifact of deterministic decoding or candidate-set size. These results establish positional bias as a measurable, reproducible property of prompt-mediated recommendation pipelines in the evaluated setting and motivate routine auditing and governance controls (e.g., order randomization, standardized prompting) for deployed LLM-based RS. Source code is publicly released.

</details>


### [518] [Merge and Branch: Efficient Tree-Structured Supervised Fine-Tuning of LLMs for Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37973)
*Yunqin Zhu,Yao Xie*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 Merge and Branch（M&B），通过将历史交互的 SID 与文本压缩为少量学习 token，并用同一压缩历史同时预测多个目标 SID，配合树形 FlashAttention 与树形 KV 缓存，大幅提升 LLM 生成式推荐的训练与解码效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 生成式推荐需读取长文本交互历史，却只生成很短的语义标识符（SID），这种不对称导致监督微调低效：编码历史代价高，而每条历史通常只提供单个目标作为监督信号。

Method: Merge 将每个历史 item 的 SID 和文本压缩为少量可学习 token；Branch 用压缩后的历史预测多个目标 SID。为共享历史计算同时保持各目标独立，把每个样本组织为浅而宽的树形结构，并设计树形 FlashAttention 一次处理共享历史、让所有分支的梯度端到端回传；再用树结构 KV 缓存将历史共享扩展到受限解码阶段。

Result: 在公开基准上，M&B 优于多个强推荐基线，同时显著提升训练和解码效率。

Conclusion: 通过压缩历史表示与多分支监督相结合，M&B 有效缓解了生成式推荐中输入昂贵、监督稀疏的问题，在效果与效率上均取得改进。

Abstract: LLM-based generative recommendation reads long, text-rich interaction histories but generates only short semantic identifiers (SIDs). This asymmetry makes supervised fine-tuning inefficient: encoding the history is expensive, yet each history usually provides supervision for only one target. We present Merge and Branch (M&B) to reduce input cost and learn more from each encoded history. Merge compresses each historical item's SID and text into a small number of learned tokens. Branch uses the compressed history to predict multiple target SIDs. To share history computation while keeping these targets independent, M&B organizes each example as a shallow, wide tree. We develop tree FlashAttention to execute this layout efficiently, processing the shared history once and propagating gradients from every branch for end-to-end training. A tree-structured key/value cache extends history sharing to constrained decoding. Experiments on public benchmarks show that M&B outperforms strong recommendation baselines while substantially improving training and decoding efficiency.

</details>


### [519] [Predicting What Answer Engines Cite: Open Decision Models, Rerankers and a Distilled 4B Student on Ten Engines under Controlled Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38090)
*Elisha Bajemon,Andre-Louis Rochet*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出并评测生成引擎优化（GEO）中的"引用份额打分器"，比较预训练重排器、托管/开源决策模型与蒸馏学生模型，并发布 GEO Citation Ranker 4B 与 GEO-Bench 基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GEO 需要一个能按"页面在答案中获得的引用份额"对候选页面排序的打分器，但缺乏系统性评测，且大模型应用成本高，因此需明确最优打分方案并探索可蒸馏的小模型。

Method: 在 GEO-Bench 查询上，让十个引擎在提示中接收相同候选源并作答；比较预训练重排器、托管类型化决策模型 Jev、八个开源决策模型及蒸馏学生；用低秩适配（LoRA）在 Qwen3-Reranker-4B 上以教师标签微调；分析逐段落打分、教师类型（Jev 标签 vs 观测引用）对学生的影响。

Result: 同查询多引擎组内 Spearman 相关为 0.704；Jev 与两个 27B 开源决策模型零训练即最强（0.575–0.578）；GEO Citation Ranker 4B 三随机种子达 0.542–0.549，与 27B 及 Jev 的差异在 229 查询上不显著；逐段落打分可消除学生与 Jev 间大部分差距；教师标签与观测引用训练效果相当，0.6B 下仅用 Jev 标签即可匹配双教师目标。

Conclusion: 小规模蒸馏学生可在统计上逼近大型教师模型，逐段落打分与教师标签选择是关键因素；作者开源模型、基准、各打分器预测与代码以推动 GEO 研究。

Abstract: Generative engine optimization needs a scorer that ranks candidate pages by the share of an answer they will receive as citations. We measure pretrained rerankers, a hosted typed decision model (Jev), eight open decision models and distilled students on GEO-Bench queries answered by ten engines that receive the same candidate sources in their prompt. Where several engines answer the same query, they agree with one another at a within-group Spearman correlation of 0.704. Jev and two open 27B decision models, used without training, are the strongest scorers at 0.575 to 0.578. A Qwen3-Reranker-4B fine-tuned with low-rank adapters on teacher labels for other GEO-Bench queries, released as GEO Citation Ranker 4B, reaches 0.542 to 0.549 across three seeds, and its differences with the 27B models and with Jev are not distinguishable from zero on 229 queries. Most of the remaining distance between the student and Jev disappears when Jev scores one passage at a time, as the student does. Students trained on teacher labels and on observed engine citations reach the same level, and labels from Jev alone match the two-teacher target at 0.6B. We release the model, the benchmark, the predictions of every reported scorer and the code.

</details>


### [520] [Towards Reliable, Scalable, and Value-Aligned Generative Recommendation for Large-Scale Advertising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38378)
*Yatong Xiao,Yibo Sheng,Lixiang Wang,Mingjie Sun,Yunhao Sha,Pengfei Zhang,Shengyu Wang,Peng Wang,Wenjin Wu,Peng Jiang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: GR4AD-X 通过多路径SID构建、多维度容量扩展与统一价值对齐，解决工业级生成式推荐在快手广告中的三大瓶颈，线上A/B累计提升收入3.07%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已部署的GR4AD暴露三方面局限：确定性SID分配对语义边界敏感；传统主干（加宽/加深）在严格服务约束下收益递减；序列级价值优化对中间SID决策的信用分配不足，导致似然式beam search过早剪掉潜在高价值候选。

Method: 三项改进：(1) 多路径（Multi-Path）SID分配增强SID可靠性；(2) 沿多个互补维度扩展模型容量而非仅加宽加深，以获得更优效果—效率折中；(3) 统一价值引导的生成与判别（UniVGD），通过前缀级奖励优化、价值引导的beam剪枝与统一模型内的判别式重排，使生成对齐商业价值。

Result: 快手广告平台大规模线上A/B测试显示，相比已部署的GR4AD基线，GR4AD-X在满足严格时延与吞吐约束下实现累计收入提升3.07%。

Conclusion: 工业级生成式推荐的价值不仅取决于模型规模，还依赖SID构建可靠性、服务高效的容量设计与前缀级价值对齐；三者协同可在严格服务约束下取得稳定在线收益。

Abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) reformulates item retrieval as autoregressive generation of discrete semantic identifiers (SIDs), offering a unified paradigm for personalized recommendation. GR4AD, as an industrial generative recommendation framework, has greatly improved advertising revenue while enabling efficient real-time serving in Kuaishou.However, continued deployment has exposed three limitations: deterministic SID assignment remains sensitive to semantic boundaries; conventional backbone scaling provides diminishing revenue gains under strict serving constraints; and sequence-level value optimization provides limited credit assignment to intermediate SID decisions, causing likelihood-based beam search to prematurely prune potentially high-value candidates. We present GR4AD-X, which addresses these limitations through reliable SID construction, serving-efficient capacity scaling, and unified value alignment. Specifically, GR4AD-X improves SID reliability through Multi-Path assignment. It expands model capacity along multiple complementary dimensions rather than relying solely on wider or deeper backbones, achieving a better effectiveness-efficiency trade-off under strict serving constraints. Finally, Unified Value-Guided Generation and Discrimination (UniVGD) aligns generation with commercial value through prefix-level reward optimization, value-guided beam pruning, and discriminative reranking within a unified model. Large-scale online A/B tests on the Kuaishou advertising platform demonstrate that GR4AD-X achieves a cumulative revenue improvement of 3.07% over the deployed GR4AD baseline while satisfying strict latency and throughput constraints.

</details>


### [521] [Quantum-Inspired Pairwise Ranking Aggregation via Active LLM Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38683)
*Quan Mai,Susan Gauch,Gibson Nkhata*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: LLM-IRA将量子启发的交互式排序聚合框架首次扩展到文档重排，仅用LLM做高分歧文档对的成对判断来学习融合权重，最终用极快的逐点线性融合产出排名，在6个基准中的5个上匹配或超过强静态融合基线，且LLM调用量比零样本LLM重排器少一个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多检索器排序聚合在现代检索与RAG系统中有效但研究不足；成对判断信号丰富而LLM全成对矩阵或listwise prompting成本过高，因此希望在低成本约束下利用LLM判断学习有原则的融合权重。

Method: LLM-IRA：把量子启发的交互式排序聚合框架扩展到文档重排；LLM仅对高分歧文档对做成对判断，交互式学习各检索器的融合权重；报告两种权重更新变体——动量混合与全累积历史重拟合；最终排名为简单的逐点线性分数融合，无需完整成对矩阵或listwise提示；无需训练数据与微调。

Result: 在BEIR与TREC DL track上，以Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct为judge，6个基准中5个匹配或数值超过强静态融合基线；动量与累积重拟合两变体合计在6个中的4个上对最佳无监督聚合器达到统计显著（Wilcoxon，p<0.05；DL19动量、DL20/DBpedia/NFCorpus累积重拟合，后者整体更强）；在DL19/DL20上每查询仅约5次LLM调用即超过最佳无监督基线，典型预算约25–30次；成本效益与SOTA零样本LLM重排器相当，调用量少一个数量级。

Conclusion: 高分歧对的选择性成对判断加线性融合，是实现低成本、免训练、可解释的多检索器聚合的有效路径；累积历史重拟合为更强的默认配置，进一步工作可探索更多judge模型、基准与预算调度策略。

Abstract: Ranking aggregation from multiple retrievers is a powerful yet under-explored technique in modern retrieval and RAG systems. We introduce LLM-IRA, the first extension of the quantum-inspired interactive ranking aggregation framework to document reranking. By leveraging large language models (LLMs) solely for pairwise judgments on high-disagreement document pairs, our method learns fusion weights in a principled, interactive way. The final ranking is a simple, ultra-fast pointwise linear fusion of scores, no full pairwise matrix or expensive listwise prompting is required. Experiments on the BEIR benchmark and TREC Deep Learning tracks with an open-weight instruction-tuned judge (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct) show that LLM-IRA matches or numerically exceeds strong static fusion baselines on 5 of 6 evaluated benchmarks. We report two weight-update variants: momentum blending and a full accumulated-history refit, which together reach statistical significance (Wilcoxon signed-rank, p<0.05) over the best unsupervised aggregator on 4 of 6 benchmarks (DL19 under momentum; DL20, DBpedia, and NFCorpus under accumulated refit, which is the stronger of the two configurations overall). On the benchmarks we profiled (DL19, DL20), it already clears the best unsupervised baseline within as few as 5 LLM calls per query, well before exhausting its typical ~25--30 call budget. LLM-IRA also achieves cost-effectiveness comparable to state-of-the-art zero-shot LLM rerankers at an order of magnitude fewer LLM calls, and requires no training data or model fine-tuning.

</details>


### [522] [PALATE: Pretrained Autoregressive LATent Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39090)
*Sizhang Zhao,Praveen Gondhi,Bin Li,Utsaw Kumar*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本地生活与外卖平台的广告排序器通过训练GPT式生成模型对用户交互序列建模，将其末位隐状态作为共享用户嵌入，三大设计适配重购场景，离线AUC提升约0.6%，线上收入与转化率均显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生产排序器仅依赖手工构造的个人化信号（聚合互动计数、类别嵌入、无序池化历史），缺乏学习到的用户序列表示；而用户原始交互历史稀疏且基数高，需更强个人化。

Method: 训练GPT式生成模型预测用户接下来几次互动，取末token隐状态作为用户嵌入，冻结后经每日任务刷新，作为各广告面共享的稠密特征。三项核心设计：探索加权损失（对用户未接触的新商家加权）、两阶段课程（点击预训练保持广度探索→转化微调强化购买意图）、构造负样本集（固定热门商家池+曝光未下单商家+随机与批内负样本）。

Result: 离线为排序AUC阶梯中单特征最大增益：浏览Feed相对Eval-AUC +0.59%，搜索面+0.57%。线上作为捆绑重训组件：Discovery收入+0.79%、转化率+1.17%；Search收入+0.94%、转化率+1.50%。

Conclusion: 用生成式序列模型产出的单一冻结用户嵌入可高效赋能多广告面个人化，且针对性设计的损失、课程与负采样对重购型市场至关重要，具备显著线上业务收益。

Abstract: Local-commerce and food-delivery marketplaces run large ads businesses: across hundreds of thousands of stores, merchants pay to be surfaced on browse and search surfaces, and a ranker decides which ads each consumer sees. Ranking well demands strong per-consumer personalization, yet a consumer's raw interaction history is sparse and high-cardinality. Our production ranker had personalized only through hand-engineered signals: aggregate engagement counts, categorical embeddings, and order-agnostic pooled history, with no learned per-consumer sequence representation. We learn one by training a GPT-style generative model of the consumer's engagement sequence to predict their next few engagements, and read its last-token hidden state as the consumer embedding. That single frozen vector becomes one shared personalization input for every ad surface: a daily job refreshes it, and each ranker consumes it as an ordinary dense feature. Offline it is the largest single-feature gain in our ranking-AUC ladder, a relative Eval-AUC gain of +0.59% on a browse-driven feed and +0.57% on a query-driven search surface. Online, it shipped as one component of bundled ranker retrains on both surfaces: Discovery (revenue +0.79%, conversion rate +1.17%) and Search (revenue +0.94%, conversion rate +1.50%). Three design choices adapt the generative objective to a repurchase-heavy marketplace, and are the core of our contribution: an exploration-weighted loss that up-weights businesses new to the consumer over ones already engaged; a two-stage curriculum: a click pretrain that keeps the representation broad and exploratory, then a conversion fine-tune that sharpens purchase intent; and a designed negative set that pairs a fixed popular-business pool and businesses shown but not ordered with random and in-batch negatives.

</details>


### [523] [PRISM: Personalized Item Representations in User History](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39175)
*Renzhi Wu,Zikun Cui,Junjie Yang,Li Sheng,Yongjun Xie,Jerry Fu,Nipun Mathur,Sri Reddy,Hong Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出在用户历史序列中将物品表示个性化（PRISM），使同一物品在不同用户历史中拥有表达"该用户与物品关系"的嵌入，从而为后续序列建模提供更丰富证据，并在十亿级推荐场景验证其优于VISTA且随历史长度呈幂律增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有序列推荐器用跨用户共享的嵌入表构建历史输入，同一物品对不同用户产生完全相同的初始嵌入，忽略了用户与物品关系的差异，浪费了本可提供的个性化证据。

Method: 将个性化作为历史输入本身的属性。具体实现PRISM：复用上游排序计算产生个性化物品嵌入，用一个自编码器将用户塔、用户–物品塔以及同请求候选混排的各层状态联合压缩为每个"用户–物品打分对"的单一嵌入，供下游序列重放使用。

Result: 在十亿级推荐面Surface 1的离线评估中，PRISM在相近历史长度下平均NE下降0.15%（VISTA为0.07%）；并发现序列长度缩放规律：历史长度26–240事件范围内，NE增益按幂律拟合，指数0.468，增益从0.06%升至0.17%。

Conclusion: 用户历史中的个性化物品表示为提升推荐质量提供了一个新的缩放维度：增益随历史长度稳定增长，可作为独立于模型规模的扩展方向。

Abstract: Sequential recommenders typically construct history inputs from item identifiers or content features using an embedding map shared across users. The same item therefore yields the same initial embedding representation, even when users have different relationships to the item. We propose personalized item representations in user history, where each item's embedding expresses its relationship to the user. Personalization becomes a property of the history inputs themselves, supplying richer evidence for later sequence modeling.
  We instantiate this idea with PRISM, which reuses upstream ranking computation to generate personalized item embeddings. An autoencoder jointly compresses all layer states from a user tower, a user--item tower, and same-request candidate mixing into one embedding per scored pair for downstream replay. Offline evaluation on Surface 1, a major recommendation surface at billion scale, reports an average downstream normalized entropy (NE) change of $-0.15\%$, compared with $-0.07\%$ for VISTA at similar history lengths. We further identify an empirical sequence-length scaling law: over history lengths of 26--240 events, NE gain follows a fitted power law with exponent 0.468, increasing from 0.06\% to 0.17\%. Therefore, personalized item representations in user history provide a new scaling dimension for improving recommendation quality.

</details>


### [524] [Read More, Reason Deeper: Latent Workspaces for Long-Sequence Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39188)
*Renzhi Wu,Li Sheng,Zikun Cui,Junjie Yang,Tai Guo,Keke Zhai,Yan Li,Jerry Fu,Nipun Mathur,Sri Reddy,Hong Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent Workspace Ranker (LWR)，将「可寻址证据」与「传播状态」解耦：用持久类型化证据库存储历史，只传播固定大小的候选局部工作区，使历史长度与推理深度可独立扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长序列推荐把证据扩展（更长历史）与推理扩展（更深层）耦合在一起：序列编码器把每个新增事件都逐层传播，而一次性选择又使后续层无法回看被省略的证据，导致两者不能独立控制、joint scaling 效率低。

Method: LWR 将类型化证据保存在持久 bank 中，仅传播固定大小的候选局部 workspace；每层从演化中的 workspace 重新读取 bank，并归档紧凑的交互后状态。实验在固定深度下比较证据扩展、固定 10K 历史下比较推理扩展，以及联合 compute-efficient frontier，对比四种架构。

Result: LWR 在长历史上领先所有架构族，随推理算力持续提升；在联合 frontier 上以最快拟合速率将训练算力转化为质量增益。10K 历史下 NE 较 HSTU 提升 0.19%，前向 GFLOP/请求降低 69.6%，并在两个十亿级排序场景优于现有基线。

Conclusion: 把可寻址证据与传播状态分离，使「读更多」和「想更深」可独立控制且联合增益，为长序列推荐提供可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: Long-sequence recommendation can improve along two axes: \emph{evidence scaling} exposes longer histories, while \emph{reasoning scaling} adds layers that interpret that evidence for a candidate. Existing models couple them: sequence encoders propagate every added event through depth, whereas one-shot selection prevents later layers from revisiting omitted evidence. We introduce the Latent Workspace Ranker (LWR), which keeps typed evidence in persistent banks and propagates a fixed-size candidate-local workspace. Each layer rereads the banks from its evolving workspace and archives compact post-interaction state, allowing history length and reasoning depth to grow independently. We compare four architectures across various history--depth configurations using evidence scaling at fixed depth, reasoning scaling at fixed 10K history, and their joint compute-efficient frontier. LWR leads all families at long histories, continues improving with reasoning compute, and converts additional training compute into quality gains at the fastest fitted rate on the joint frontier. At 10K history, it improves NE by 0.19% over HSTU while using 69.6% fewer forward GFLOP/request. It also outperforms existing baselines on two billion-scale ranking surfaces. These results show that separating addressable evidence from propagated state makes reading more and reasoning deeper independently controllable and jointly useful.

</details>


### [525] [A Sequential Decision Framework for Evaluating LLM-Guided Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39231)
*Siqing Huo,Andrew Parry,Debasis Ganguly,Mark Smucker,Charles L. A. Clarke*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出一个统一框架，用 select/spawn 两种基本动作建模 RAG 与"深度研究"式检索搜索策略，并提供有原则的评估方法与强化学习解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主式 RAG/"deep research" 系统需自动决定探索哪些搜索轨迹、优化什么目标，但缺乏用于推理这类搜索策略并加以原则性评估的统一框架。

Method: 将搜索环境建模为一组排序列表，行为由两种原始动作构成：select（沿已有排序推进判断）与 spawn（通过查询生成/改写产生新排序）。每个动作产出一个待检文档、更新搜索状态并给出任务相关奖励；不同检索策略可表达为同一环境上的策略，目标通过奖励与轨迹权重函数表达，并可自然映射为强化学习问题。以 high-recall IR（HRIR）为例进行说明与实验。

Result: 实验表明，底层检索方法与所采用的"deep research"策略都会实质性影响性能。

Conclusion: 该框架能统一描述和推理经典检索任务与新兴 LLM 引导搜索系统的策略，为搜索策略评估提供原则性基础。

Abstract: Recent systems applying retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and "deep research" iteratively generate queries, retrieve documents, and examine their contents, using the resulting information to guide subsequent search steps. When this process is carried out autonomously rather than by a human searcher, the system must make explicit decisions about which search trajectories to explore and what objective the search is intended to optimize. We introduce a simple framework for reasoning about such search policies, providing a principled approach to evaluation. The framework models the search environment as a set of ranked lists and represents behavior using two primitive actions: select, which advances judgment through an existing ranking, and spawn, which generates a new ranking through query generation or reformulation. Each action produces a document to inspect, yields information that updates the search state, and contributes a reward for a task-specific objective. Within this abstraction, a variety of existing retrieval strategies can be expressed as policies operating over a common environment, while common retrieval objectives can be represented through reward and weighting functions over the resulting search trajectory, and the resulting formulation admits a natural reinforcement learning interpretation. We illustrate the approach using high-recall information retrieval (HRIR), where the goal is to identify as many relevant documents as possible with limited judging effort, showing how the framework provides a unified way to describe and reason about strategies for both classical retrieval tasks and emerging LLM-guided search systems. Through experiments, we demonstrate that both the underlying retrieval method and the "deep research" policy employed can materially affect performance.

</details>


### [526] [CASH: A Capability-Aware Subsidy Harness for Advertiser Subsidy Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39244)
*Minmao Wang,Huihuang Lin,Likang Wu,Hongke Zhao,Shijie Yi,Fei Pan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出CASH框架用于广告补贴分配(ASA)：结合知识引导LLM与数据驱动数值响应模型，通过"能力许可证"机制在账户/补贴级别上选择可靠来源，并用EPCG指导有限反馈预算投入；一个月在线实验(A/B, 60%流量)中账户收入+15.35%、ADVV+19.86%，补贴率基本不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ASA实践依赖业务规则、广告主分层与运营目标配置补贴，属于层级化策略：随广告主规模扩大，既无法刻画单个账户在不同补贴档位下的响应，也难以在单账户粒度上分配共享预算，进而难以在平台级补贴率约束下最大化折现总收入。

Method: CASH = 知识引导LLM + 数据驱动数值响应模型的双源混合。模型从实际结果中学习各来源在"账户×补贴档位"局部上的可靠性，转化为显式能力许可证(capability licenses)，用于治理来源选择、智能体评审与预算分配；引入Expected Policy Coverage Gain (EPCG)，将有限反馈预算导向预期能扩展高价值可靠覆盖的证据，反馈回流以改进数值模型并更新能力估计。

Result: 在某大型广告平台为期一个月的在线实验中，CASH承接60%流量；相对对照组，单账户收入提升15.35%，ADVV提升19.86%，补贴率基本持平，并在收入质量、LTV与留存上有进一步收益。

Conclusion: 将LLM业务知识与数值响应模型按局部可靠性显式融合，可把"经验配置"升级为可审计、可决策的账户级补贴分配；EPCG式主动反馈能高效利用有限实验预算。局限：缺乏与基线的离线细节与显著性/长期效应说明，可靠性估计的稳定性与跨平台泛化待验证。

Abstract: Advertising platforms subsidize advertisers through billing discounts, and Advertiser Subsidy Allocation (ASA) chooses a subsidy level for every account to maximize total discounted revenue under a platform-wide subsidy-rate constraint. In practice, operators configure these subsidies from business rules, advertiser tiers and operating goals. Such configuration draws on rich business experience, yet as the advertiser base grows, tier-level policies can neither resolve how individual accounts respond across subsidy levels nor allocate a shared budget at the granularity of single accounts. We propose CASH, a Capability-Aware Subsidy Harness for ASA. CASH pairs a knowledge-guided large language model (LLM) with a data-driven numerical response model, learns from realized outcomes where each is locally reliable across accounts and subsidy levels, and turns this reliability into explicit capability licenses that govern source selection, agent review and budget allocation. Its Expected Policy Coverage Gain (EPCG) directs a limited feedback budget toward evidence expected to expand high-value reliable coverage, and the resulting feedback further improves the numerical model and updates capability estimates. In a one-month online experiment with CASH serving 60% of a large-scale advertising platform's traffic, CASH raises revenue per account by 15.35% and ADVV by 19.86% over Control at an essentially unchanged subsidy rate, with further gains in revenue quality, LTV and retention.

</details>


### [527] [PFA: Attention Can Be Progressively Focused in Long-Sequence Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39273)
*Pengjie Zhou,Weiqin Yang,Haibo Xing,Hao Deng,Jinxin Hu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 针对生成式推荐长序列解码开销大的问题，作者发现注意力"渐进聚焦"与"跨步排序一致"两个性质，提出PFA稀疏解码框架：首步全注意力，随后跨束加权聚合共享重要性排序、将选中KV重排为连续内存并几何收缩预算，在公开与工业数据及线上A/B测试中均优于SOTA且低延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长用户行为序列能提升生成式推荐（GR）效果，但自回归束搜索解码时对长历史做全注意力导致在线推理延迟高。现有静态历史压缩会丢失关键语义，动态top-k稀疏注意力则因重复token选择和非连续内存访问带来显著开销。

Method: 先系统分析GR解码中的注意力模式，揭示两个性质：(i)渐进聚焦——注意力逐步集中到少量关键历史token；(ii)跨步排序一致——这些token的重要性排名在后续解码步中相对稳定。据此提出渐进聚焦注意力PFA：初始解码步保留全注意力以探索全局历史偏好；然后通过跨束加权聚合建立共享重要性排序，并将选中token的KV缓存重排为连续内存布局；后续解码步复用该排序并几何式缩减token预算。

Result: 在两个公开基准和大规模工业数据集上，PFA优于SOTA基线；在大型电商广告平台的7天线上A/B测试中，PFA在保持低推理延迟的同时带来显著业务收益。

Conclusion: 通过利用解码注意力的渐进聚焦与排序一致性，PFA在保留关键语义的同时降低计算与内存访问开销，实现长序列GR的高效稀疏解码，并已在真实工业场景验证有效。

Abstract: Long user behavioral sequences improve the performance of generative recommendation (GR), but computing full attention over long histories during autoregressive beam search decoding incurs substantial online inference latency. To accelerate long-sequence decoding, existing approaches typically rely on static history compression or dynamic top-k sparse attention; however, the former risks losing critical semantics, whereas the latter incurs significant overhead from repeated token selection and non-contiguous memory access. In this work, we thoroughly analyze attention patterns during GR decoding and reveal two key properties: (i) progressive attention focusing, where attention progressively focuses on a small subset of critical historical tokens; and (ii) cross-step ranking consistency, where their importance rankings remain relatively stable across subsequent decoding steps. Motivated by these observations, we propose Progressively Focused Attention (PFA), an efficient sparse decoding framework for long-sequence GR. PFA retains full attention at the initial decoding step to explore global historical preferences. It then establishes a shared importance ranking through cross-beam weighted aggregation and reorders the key-value cache of the selected tokens into a contiguous memory layout. Subsequent decoding steps reuse this ranking and geometrically reduce the token budget, preserving critical semantics while lowering computational and memory access overhead. Extensive experiments on two public benchmarks and a large-scale industrial dataset demonstrate that PFA outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. A 7-day online A/B test on a large-scale e-commerce advertising platform further confirms that PFA delivers substantial business gains while maintaining low inference latency. Our code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PFA-review-088D.

</details>


### [528] [Federated Recommender Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39289)
*Jaehyung Lim,Woojoo Kim,Junyoung Kim,Dongha Kim,Wonbin Kweon,Hwanjo Yu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 FedRecAgent，通过自然语言知识在本地保留交互历史的条件下实现联邦式推荐代理协作，无需更新 LLM 参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 驱动的推荐代理依赖推理与记忆实现个性化，但集中式访问用户信息引发隐私问题，而孤立代理又无法从他人经验中学习。

Method: 将本地经验表示为 Condition-Transition-Reasoning (C-T-R) 单元，按条件与转移层次化整合推理，合并相关解释并区分不同转移下的推理；每个客户端维护语义记忆与决策记忆以指导共享推理的检索与选择。

Result: 在三个领域的稠密与稀疏设置下，推荐性能优于联邦式与 LLM 基线；消融实验支持个性化记忆与结构化推理整合的贡献。

Conclusion: FedRecAgent 在保护隐私的同时实现代理间知识协作，验证了结构化推理整合与个性化记忆的有效性。

Abstract: LLM-powered recommender agents use reasoning and memory for personalization, but centralized access to user information raises privacy concerns, while isolated agents cannot learn from others' experiences. We formulate Federated Recommender Agents, a setting where local agents collaborate through natural-language knowledge while keeping interaction histories and personal memories local. We propose FedRecAgent, which enables this collaboration without updating LLM parameters. Its central challenge is determining which reasoning to integrate, since similar behavioral contexts can lead to different choices. FedRecAgent represents local experiences as Condition-Transition-Reasoning (C-T-R) units and hierarchically integrates reasoning by condition and transition. Within this structure, it consolidates related explanations and discriminates reasoning across alternative transitions. Each client maintains semantic and decision memories to capture preferences and conditional choice tendencies, guiding the retrieval and selection of shared reasoning for recommendation. Experiments across three domains under dense and sparse settings demonstrate improved recommendation performance over federated and LLM-based baselines, while ablations support the contributions of personalized memories and structured reasoning integration.

</details>


### [529] [Does the Citation Matter? Quality, Grounding, and Physician-Rubric Accuracy of Google's AI Overviews for Medical Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39339)
*Sam Agnoli,Brigid Reilly,Lily Barna,Emőke-Ágnes Horvát*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该研究评估Google AI Overviews在健康信息场景下的表现，发现其来源选择、引用扎实度与医学准确性均显著劣于传统搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI Overviews成为用户搜索结果首屏内容，将来源筛选与评估工作从用户转交给Gemini；考虑到健康信息的风险与Google传统算法对优质来源的优先设计，这一转变可能带来严重后果，故需系统评估其健康信息质量。

Method: 对3,611个基准健康问题进行评估，将每个AIO与对应问题的前五条传统搜索结果在来源选择与质量上进行比较；评估AIO陈述对其引用来源的支撑程度（grounding），并按医生撰写的评分标准（rubric）评估AIO的准确性。

Result: 96.4%的问题出现AIO，但其证据来源与传统搜索差异显著：仅44.4%的前五结果被AIO引用，AIO过度 نمای商业健康出版方（如WebMD、Healthline），牺牲学术与政府来源；AIO引用页面在6项可信度标准中4项得分更低。经分类器误差校正后，仅56.7%的引用陈述获来源支持，另有20.8%的陈述为无引用的事实性主张。按医生评分标准，AIO仅获得38.2%的分数（准确性54.2%、完整性21.6%）；在医生预判存在有害主张的子集中，22.2%的AIO确实包含该有害内容。值得注意的是，AIO准确性与陈述扎实度不相关。

Conclusion: AIO健康信息在来源质量、引用扎实度与准确性上均不达Google自身健康排名标准；建议开展面向用户的AIO素养干预，并要求AIO至少遵守Google既有的健康排名规范。

Abstract: Google's AI Overviews (AIOs) are the first result users encounter when searching the web, shifting the work of selecting and evaluating sources from the user to Gemini. This may be especially consequential for health information, given that Google's traditional algorithm was designed to prioritize quality sources, and inaccurate information carries health risks. We evaluated 3,611 benchmark health questions, comparing each AIO against that question's top five traditional results on source selection and quality. We also evaluated the AIOs' statement grounding in their cited sources and how accurate AIOs were against physician-written rubrics. Overviews appeared for 96.4% of questions but drew on substantially different evidence than traditional search: only 44.4% of the top five results were cited by the corresponding AIO, which instead overrepresented commercial health publishers (e.g., WebMD, Healthline) at the expense of academic and government sources (e.g., Cleveland Clinic, National Health Service). AIO-cited pages scored lower than traditional results on four of six well-established credibility criteria. The grounding of AIO statements to their sources was poor: after correcting for classifier error, an estimated 56.7% of cited statements were supported by their cited page, and a further 20.8% of all statements were factual claims with no citation at all. When AIOs were graded against physicians' rubrics, they earned 38.2% of all available points (e.g., accuracy 54.2%, completeness 21.6%), and among the subset of AIOs whose physician rubric anticipated a specific inaccurate or potentially harmful claim, 22.2% of AIOs contained the harmful content. Notably, the accuracy of AIOs was unrelated to the grounding of their statements. We recommend AIO literacy interventions for users and holding AIOs at least to Google's own health-ranking standards.

</details>


### [530] [Try Before You Evolve: Ranking-Scored Trials for Recursive Self-Improvement of Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39352)
*Xu Huang,Jiawei Feng,Jiancan Wu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出RecRSI，从当前模型诊断生成多样的训练配方候选编辑，并用"早期排序反馈"（每个候选先做短试训练，用held-out探针用户的完整排序NDCG@10打分）选出一个做完整重训，在同等重训预算下显著优于现有自进化智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推荐系统训练配方需针对每个数据集重新调参；LLM智能体可改写配方实现递归自我改进（RSI），但推荐器编辑改变的是"如何训练"，无法像程序/补丁那样靠执行直接打分。两个挑战：(1) 排序反馈延迟——编辑效果须完整重训后才知，预算大量浪费在被丢弃的编辑上；(2) 重训前的信号不可靠——采样训练损失看似已解决但全排序性能可能仍差，且在不同loss或采样器之间不可比。

Method: RecRSI：1）基于当前模型的诊断生成多样化候选编辑（而非每轮只提一个）；2）对每个候选给一次"短试"——即其完整训练运行的最初若干步；3）用held-out探针用户上的全排序NDCG@10对短试结果打分；4）依据早期排序反馈选出唯一候选进行完整重训。

Result: 在两个序列推荐器、三个数据集、相同完整重训次数的设定下，RecRSI在每个设置中都显著优于现有自进化智能体；在两个Amazon数据集上，其第一轮就达到其他方法五轮都未达到的排序质量。

Conclusion: 以"短试+全排序探针NDCG"作为编辑的早期筛选信号，能有效缓解排序反馈延迟与预训练信号不可靠问题，使推荐系统的递归自我改进在有限重训预算下更高效。

Abstract: Recommenders on Web platforms such as e-commerce and music streaming need their training recipes re-tuned for each dataset. Large language model (LLM) agents can now rewrite these recipes, enabling recursive self-improvement (RSI) of recommender systems. Existing agents propose one edit per round, fully retrain the recommender, and keep the edit only if its ranking quality improves. Unlike programs or patches that can be scored by execution, a recommender edit changes how the model is trained, which raises two challenges. First, ranking feedback is delayed: an edit's ranking quality is known only after full retraining, so much of the retraining budget goes to edits that are later discarded. Second, the signals available before retraining are unreliable: sampled training losses can look solved while full-ranking performance remains poor, and they are not comparable across edits that change the loss or sampler. We propose RecRSI, which generates diverse candidate edits from a diagnosis of the current model and selects one for full retraining using early ranking feedback: each candidate receives a short trial, the first steps of its full training run, scored by full-ranking NDCG@10 on held-out probe users. With two sequential recommenders on three datasets and the same number of full retrainings, RecRSI significantly outperforms existing self-evolving agents in every setting, and on both Amazon datasets reaches in its first round a ranking quality that none of them reaches in five.

</details>


### [531] [UGR: Unified Generative Ranking for Heterogeneous E-commerce Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39426)
*Zonghe Shao,Huabin Chen,Sitong Lu,Fangmei Zhu,Yingcai Ma,Ge Fan,Jinguo Gao,Wei Shi,Yanfang Liu,Huiping Chu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出统一生成式排序(UGR)，在请求级多业务异构候选集(约千个)上做候选感知自回归解码，联合建模推荐分与广告价值(GSP)，并以加权SFT与排列偏好优化利用曝光后反馈，线上A/B在淘宝"猜你喜欢"显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电商列表排序需同时平衡用户效用与商业价值，覆盖自然内容、广告及其他业务候选，并建模候选间交互与序列依赖。已有生成式排序方法多从曝光序列学习、仅处理单一业务的截断候选集，未充分利用曝光后反馈信号；对异构多业务候选的生成式排序、以及GSP拍卖下推荐分与广告价值的联合建模仍研究不足。

Method: UGR在整个请求级多业务异构候选集(生产中约一千候选)上生成排序：采用候选感知自回归解码直接生成多业务排序列表；引入加权监督微调与排列偏好优化作为补充反馈监督，分别利用观察到的曝光后反馈和由反馈导出的排列偏好；使用训练期广告去偏塔建模历史广告曝光效应，serving时结合当前广告价值，同时保持现有分配与GSP定价规则；多价值序列检索生成候选排序列表，由现有下游评估器选出最终曝光列表。

Result: 离线实验显示排序质量持续提升；淘宝"猜你喜欢"线上A/B相对生产基线：核心IPV提升1.76%，成交笔数提升3.29%，GMV提升2.10%。

Conclusion: UGR表明在全量多业务异构候选上进行生成式排序、并以曝光后反馈与排列偏好补充监督、在保持GSP机制下集成广告价值是可行且有效的，可在真实大规模推荐系统中同时提升用户体验与商业收益。

Abstract: List-wise ranking in e-commerce recommendation must balance user utility and commercial value across organic content, ads, and candidates from other businesses, while modeling candidate interactions and sequential dependencies. Existing generative ranking methods typically learn from logged exposure sequences and operate on truncated candidate sets from a single business. Exposure-sequence learning may not fully exploit post-exposure feedback signals. Meanwhile, generative ranking over heterogeneous, multi-business candidates remains less explored, particularly when recommendation scores and advertising value must be jointly modeled under generalized second-price (GSP) auctions. We propose Unified Generative Ranking (UGR), which performs generative ranking over the full request-level multi-business heterogeneous candidate set, typically comprising around a thousand candidates in production, and directly generates multi-business ranking lists through candidate-aware autoregressive decoding. To go beyond exposure-sequence imitation, UGR introduces complementary feedback supervision through weighted supervised fine-tuning and permutation preference optimization, which respectively leverage observed post-exposure feedback and feedback-derived preferences among permutations. UGR uses a training-time advertising debiasing tower to model historical ad exposure effects and incorporates current ad value during serving while preserving the existing allocation and GSP pricing rules. Multi-value sequence retrieval produces candidate ranking lists, and the existing downstream evaluator selects the final list for exposure. Offline experiments demonstrate consistent gains in ranking quality, while online A/B tests on Taobao's Guess You Like recommendation service yield improvements of 1.76% in Core IPV, 3.29% in Transaction Volume, and 2.10% in GMV over the production baseline.

</details>


### [532] [RoFiGR: Coarse Routing, Fine Refinement via Level-Adaptive Distillation in Multimodal Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39470)
*Ji Dai,Zhipeng Wei,Zhuang Zhuang,Rongfeng Guo,Jie Chen,Quan Fang,Fei Pan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: RoFiGR是一个双树生成式推荐器，在SID构建与生成两个阶段都注入协同信息，通过对齐累积L1-L2码向量与冻结协同嵌入、串行化历史中编码距离与来源层级，并在生成时引入顺序教师与固定粗层权重+有界自适应残差，从而缓解粗粒度路由错误导致的召回缺失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式推荐逐码预测SID，早期码决定粗分支，一旦路由出错会在细粒度预测前就排除相关物品；多模态场景下粗粒度决策还需同时反映协同偏好与物品语义，而现有方法主要依赖语义信息。

Method: 提出双树推荐器RoFiGR：(1) 将累积L1-L2码向量与冻结的协同物品嵌入对齐，使粗层码承载协同信号；(2) 在序列化历史中显式编码物品距离与来源层级；(3) 生成阶段用顺序教师监督合法分支，粗层权重固定以保持路由监督，并叠加有界自适应残差按师生需求分配额外权重。

Result: 在Instruments、Arts、Games三个数据集上，五项排序指标均优于所评估的外部基线；五随机种子配对检验经Holm校正后支持主要NDCG@10提升。与替代协同监督目标和分词器的比较支持该设计，匹配的任务与解码分析区分了训练曝光、流融合与候选预算的影响。

Conclusion: 将协同信息同时注入SID构建与生成过程可有效改善生成式多模态推荐的排序性能，固定粗层监督加有界残差的权重方案具有实证支持，但增益主要结论限于NDCG@10且需在更多场景验证。

Abstract: Generative recommenders predict an item's semantic identifier (SID) one code at a time. Early codes select broad branches, so a routing error can exclude relevant items before fine-grained prediction begins. In multimodal recommendation, these coarse decisions must reflect collaborative preferences as well as item semantics. We introduce RoFiGR, a two-tree recommender that uses collaborative information in both SID construction and generation. It aligns cumulative L1-L2 code vectors with frozen collaborative item embeddings and explicitly encodes item distance and source level in the serialized history. During generation, a sequential teacher supervises legal branches. Fixed coarse-level weights maintain routing supervision, while a bounded adaptive residual allocates additional weight according to teacher-student demand. On Instruments, Arts, and Games, RoFiGR improves all five ranking metrics over the evaluated external baselines. Five-seed paired tests with Holm correction support the main NDCG@10 improvements. Comparisons with alternative collaborative supervision objectives and tokenizers support the proposed design. Matched task and decoding analyses distinguish the effects of training exposure, stream fusion, and candidate budgets.

</details>


### [533] [GistRank: Gist-Compressed Listwise Ranking with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39610)
*Guo Chen,Wenhan Liu,Reed Li,Qianwen Ma,Yu Lu,Haibo Shi,Bingbing Xu,Junjie Huang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 GistRank，用三阶段训练让 LLM 以仅 4 个 gist token 压缩每篇文档做 listwise 排序，在仅损失约 0.89 nDCG@10 的情况下获得 14× 推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM listwise 排序需将每个候选逐字序列化进 prompt，输入长度随候选数量与文档长度线性增长，推理代价高；滑动窗口需重复重编码，硬压缩又丢失细粒度判别信息。作者因此系统研究软压缩（gist）方案，并发现朴素 gist 表示不适合排序：严格因果编码削弱了 gist token 对整段文本的吸收，且该表示从未被训练以暴露区分相近候选的相对偏好结构。

Method: GistRank 三阶段训练框架：(1) 在半双向注意力机制下学习忠实的 gist token 表示；(2) 通过 pairwise 训练注入判别性比较能力；(3) 让模型适配 listwise 排序目标。最终每篇文档压缩为 K=4 个 gist token。

Result: 相比一次性全文排序获得 14× 加速；在 TREC DL19/20 与五个 BEIR 子集上平均 nDCG@10 达 59.17，与最强全上下文基线相差仅 0.89。

Conclusion: 软压缩可用于 LLM listwise 排序，但需针对压缩表示设计忠实编码与判别训练；GistRank 在保留接近全上下文效果的同时显著提升效率，适合真实搜索场景。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become a powerful tool for listwise relevance ranking, which can improve web search by comparing retrieved passages jointly. However, processing every candidate verbatim and generating a permutation autoregressively can make inference costly, every candidate must be serialized verbatim into the prompt and the input therefore grows linearly with both the number and the length of the passages. While sliding-window ranking handles context limits through repeated re-encoding of overlapping blocks, hard compression techniques sacrifice the fine-grained details required for accurate discriminative judgment. To better understand and mitigate this trade-off, we conduct a comprehensive study of soft compression for LLM-based listwise ranking. Our findings reveal that a vanilla gist representation is ill-suited to ranking for two reasons: strictly causal encoding weakens how thoroughly each gist token absorbs its passage, and the representation is never trained to expose the relative-preference structure that separates closely competing candidates. To this end, we propose GistRank, a three-stage training framework that equips a large language model with gist-compressed passage representations by learning faithful gist tokens under a semi-bidirectional attention scheme, instilling discriminative comparison through pairwise training, and adapting the model to the listwise objective. GistRank collapses each passage into only $K{=}4$ gist tokens, this gives 14$\times$ speedups over one-shot full-text ranking while reaching 59.17 average nDCG@10 over TREC DL19/20 and five BEIR subsets within 0.89 of the strongest full-context baseline. Overall, GistRank provides an effective means to enhance efficiency for searches in real-world environments.

</details>


### [534] [Efficient LLM-based Subgraph Retrieval for Multi-Hop Knowledge Base Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39667)
*Duanyang Yuan,Sihang Zhou,Xiaoshu Chen,Haoyuan Chen,Ke Liang,Jian Huang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出基于LLM的子图检索方法M-ER，用MCTS将子图探索转为树搜索并过滤无关节点，在WebQSP上Hits@1达78.88%且效率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于信息检索的多跳KBQA从全库抽取子图时，常混入弱相关或无关节点；缺乏节点过滤机制，随跳数增加无关节点膨胀，浪费大量计算资源。

Method: 提出M-ER框架：用蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)将子图探索建模为树结构搜索；在选择阶段优先纳入与问题高度相关的节点，避免遍历全库；引入大语言模型(LLM)精炼搜索方向，保持探索聚焦；对选中节点定量打分并反馈至节点选择，过滤无关候选以提升子图质量。

Result: 在WebQSP基准上Hits@1达到78.88%，同时提升计算效率，验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: M-ER通过MCTS+LLM的节点筛选与打分反馈机制缩小搜索空间、提升多跳KBQA效率，为性能与效率的平衡提供了可行技术路径。

Abstract: Multi-hop Knowledge Base Question Answering (KBQA) aims to find answer entities in the knowledge base that are multiple hops away from the entities in the question. Information retrieval-based (IR-based) methods extract a pivotal subgraph from the entire KB to locate candidate answers and then evaluate their plausibility through semantic matching with the question. However, we observed that the extracted subgraphs often include nodes that are weakly related or irrelevant to the question. Without a proper node filtering mechanism, the number of irrelevant nodes grows as the number of hops increases, leading to excessive consumption of computational resources. To address these challenges, this study introduces an efficient LLM-based subgraph retrieval method for multi-hop knowledge base question answering, M-ER. The framework leverages Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to transform subgraph exploration into a tree-structured search process. During the MCTS selection phase, nodes that are highly relevant to the question are prioritized for inclusion in the subgraph, eliminating the need to traverse all nodes in the KB. The framework further incorporates a large language model (LLM) to refine the search direction, ensuring that exploration remains focused on nodes relevant to the question. In addition, selected nodes are quantitatively scored, and these scores are fed back into the node selection process to effectively filter out irrelevant candidates, thereby improving the quality of the subgraph. This mechanism not only narrows the search space but also enhances the overall efficiency of multi-hop KBQA. Experiments on the WebQSP benchmark demonstrate that M-ER achieves 78.88\% on the Hits@1 metric, while also improving computational efficiency. These results not only validate the effectiveness of M-ER, but also offer a viable technical path to balance performance and computational efficiency.

</details>


### [535] [R2QRec: Learning Recommendation Queries from Retrieval Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39984)
*Weixin Chen,Shuchang Liu,Hailan Yang,Yuhan Zhao,Li Kang,Xuefeng Zhang,Chenghao Zhang,Xinyuan Wang,Hanchen Yang,Yinghao Wu,Hua Huang,Yandong Bai,Fan Yang,Xiang Li,Chunjie Chen,Li Chen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 R2QRec，用固定检索系统自动构造查询监督信号，通过"检索验证+策略精炼"训练生成式查询改写器，无需查询标注或奖励模型即可提升基于查询的推荐效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于查询的推荐将"表达需求"与"匹配物品"解耦，核心难题是交互日志不含查询标注，难以把物品交互转化为有效的检索请求。现有方法要么依赖查询标注，要么需要学习奖励模型，成本高且不泛化。

Method: 两阶段框架，仅训练查询生成器，检索器与物品索引保持固定：1）检索验证：用固定检索系统筛选能召回已观测物品的生成表达式，作为监督微调目标，使检索行为决定目标措辞；2）策略精炼：用新生成查询集合的融合推荐列表中观测物品的排名（log-rank 反馈）作为奖励信号，区分推荐截断之外的结果，并加入相对监督参考模型的 KL 惩罚约束策略漂移。

Result: 在三个公开数据集上，R2QRec 在所评估方法中取得最优整体推荐性能；大量实验验证了设计有效性，并在不同生成器与不同领域上表现出良好泛化性。

Conclusion: 以检索结果作为查询监督与评估信号，可在无查询标注、无奖励模型条件下有效训练查询生成器；验证阶段负责"该模仿什么"，精炼阶段负责"如何提升融合排序"，二者分工互补。

Abstract: Query-based recommendation separates expressing user needs from locating matching items. Its central learning problem is how to turn item interactions into effective retrieval requests when interaction logs do not annotate queries. We present R2QRec, which uses a fixed retrieval system to construct query supervision and evaluate recommendation outcomes. Retrieval verification first selects generated expressions that recover observed items as supervised fine tuning targets, allowing retrieval behavior to determine the target wording. Policy refinement then evaluates generated query sets by the observed item's rank in their fused recommendation list. Log-rank feedback distinguishes outcomes beyond the recommendation cutoff, while a KL penalty constrains policy change relative to the supervised reference. The stages have distinct roles: verification identifies expressions to imitate, and policy refinement improves the combined ranking produced by newly generated queries. Only the query generator is trained; the retriever and item index remain fixed, and no query annotations or learned reward model are required. Across three public datasets, R2QRec achieves state-of-the-art overall recommendation performance among the evaluated methods. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed design and its generalization across generators and domains.

</details>


### [536] [Beyond IPS: Reliable Counterfactual Evaluation in Multi-Stage Ad Systems without Logged Propensities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40112)
*Mohsen Malmir,Mohamed A. Radwan,Houssam Nassif,Murat Ali Bayir*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出混合加权奖励建模的DM式离线评估方法，解决多阶段广告排序中propensity缺失及分布偏移导致的评估偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多阶段投放系统中广告排序策略的离线评估困难：action propensity常不可得，限制了IPS；基于奖励模型的DM虽无需propensity，但当候选策略诱导的曝光分布与日志数据不一致时会引入偏差。

Method: 形式化DM式反事实重放（counterfactual replay）；用多分类域分类器估计密度比，将日志数据重加权到候选策略分布的混合上，实现mixture-weighted奖励建模；用overlap、cold-start、replay三项界定各候选价值估计误差，并推导基于cold-start质量的渐近规则，决定信任离线选择还是转线上A/B测试；进一步结合doubly robust校正。

Result: 在广告投放模拟器和大规模CTR排序系统生产流量上，混合加权奖励模型均优于未加权版本，模拟中低overlap时增益最大；结合DR校正后，在生产数据及模拟的低/中overlap情形下取得最高Top-1准确率。

Conclusion: 混合加权奖励建模能在无propensity条件下缓解分布偏移偏差，并通过理论误差界与渐近规则为离线/线上评估选择提供依据，与DR校正结合效果最佳。

Abstract: Offline evaluation of ad-ranking policies in multi-stage delivery systems is challenging because action propensities are often unavailable, limiting inverse propensity scoring (IPS). Reward-model-based estimators such as the Direct Method (DM) avoid propensities but can be biased when candidate policies induce impression distributions that differ from the logged data. We formalize DM-based counterfactual replay and propose mixture-weighted reward modeling, which reweights logged data toward a mixture of candidate-policy distributions using density ratios from a multiclass domain classifier. We bound each candidate's value-estimation error by overlap, cold-start, and replay terms, and derive an asymptotic rule that uses the cold-start mass to decide whether to trust offline selection or route candidates to online A/B testing. On an ads-delivery simulator and on production traffic from a large-scale CTR ranking system, the mixture-weighted reward model improves policy selection over its unweighted counterpart in both settings, with the largest gains at low overlap in simulation. Combined with a doubly robust correction, it attains the highest Top-1 accuracy in production and at low and medium overlap in simulation.

</details>


### [537] [xPRT: Cross-Passage Retrieval Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40122)
*Danush Khanna,Himanshu Singhal,Pranjal A. Chitale,Bishal Santra*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: xPRT是一种无监督检索预训练框架，通过利用整篇文档中分布的关键信息及段落间联系来学习更丰富的检索信号，在MTEB English v2上平均超越最强基线3.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稠密检索器训练依赖昂贵的标注查询-文档对，现有无监督预训练方法多仅针对文档内短片段优化语言建模或对比目标，未能充分利用单篇文档的丰富信息。

Method: 提出xPRT（Cross-Passage Retrieval Pretraining），从整篇文档分布的关键信息及段落间连接中提取学习信号进行无监督预训练；实验从公共无监督检查点继续预训练，固定语料、调度与训练流程，对比五种SOTA目标。

Result: 在MTEB English v2各任务类型上平均超越最强基线3.2%；持续预训练设定下多数基线显著退化，而xPRT相对初始检查点带来最大互补增益；消融验证增益源于跨段落信号。

Conclusion: 单篇无标注文档是比以往假设更丰富的检索信号来源，xPRT提供与现有检索器所捕获信号互补的增益。

Abstract: Dense retrievers are a foundational component underlying modern RAG and search systems. Training these models typically requires a curated collection of annotated query-document pairs, which are prohibitively expensive to obtain outside a handful of well-resourced domains. This has motivated a line of work that leverages large-scale unsupervised retrieval pretraining from unlabelled text alone. Most such methods learn by optimizing a language modelling or contrastive learning objective over short spans within a document. This raises the question: how can we extract richer learning signals from a single document for retrieval pretraining? To address it, we introduce xPRT (Cross-Passage Retrieval Pretraining), an unsupervised framework that learns from the key information distributed across an entire document and the connections between its parts. We evaluate xPRT against five state-of-the-art objectives on MTEB English v2, continuing pretraining from a public unsupervised checkpoint while holding the corpus, schedule, and training procedure fixed. Across diverse tasks spanning all task types, we observe that xPRT consistently outperforms the strongest baseline by 3.2% on an average. Notably, in this continual pretraining setting, many baseline methods incur substantial performance regressions, whereas our method delivers the largest complementary gains over the initial pretrained checkpoint. Controlled ablations confirm that xPRT's performance gains stem from its proposed cross-passage signals. xPRT demonstrates that a single unlabelled document is a much richer source of retrieval signal than prior work assumed and offers complementary gains to what current retrievers already capture.

</details>


### [538] [Decompose, Estimate, Select: Coverage-Aware Context Construction for Long-Form RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40314)
*He Tu,Aleena Bosco Kurumthottam,Torsten Suel*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出覆盖感知检索流程，通过子问题分解、覆盖训练双编码器、跨编码器覆盖矩阵预测与贪心最大边际覆盖选择，提升多面向复杂问题的证据覆盖，并引入有依据的自反馈循环提升答案完整性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于相关性的检索对多面向复杂问题会返回冗余证据，导致部分信息需求面向缺乏支撑，即检索覆盖不足。

Method: 1) 将查询分解为子问题；2) 用覆盖训练的双编码器对候选排序；3) 用跨编码器预测文档×子问题的覆盖矩阵；4) 用贪心最大边际覆盖选择文档；5) 进一步提出有依据的自反馈循环，模型从首轮答案中识别未被充分利用的证据并重新生成，无需金标监督。

Result: 在 TREC RAG 2024 上，α-nDCG@10 从 0.625 提升到 0.702，接近金标 nugget 上界 0.718 且不牺牲相关性；发现 oracle 检索虽覆盖率更高，但答案 nugget 覆盖并未更高；自反馈循环两轮将 V_strict 提升 0.086 且基本保持忠实性。

Conclusion: 答案完整性不仅取决于检索到何种证据，也取决于生成器对证据的利用效率；覆盖感知检索与生成端自反馈结合是提升多面向复杂问答的有效方向。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds a language model's output in retrieved evidence, but for complex questions spanning multiple aspects of an information need, relevance-based retrieval may return redundant evidence while leaving some aspects unsupported. We propose a coverage-aware retrieval pipeline that decomposes queries into subquestions, ranks candidates with a coverage-trained bi-encoder, predicts a document\,$\times$\,subquestion coverage matrix with a cross-encoder, and selects documents by greedy maximum-marginal coverage. On TREC RAG 2024, our approach improves $α$-nDCG@10, which rewards newly covered nuggets and discounts redundant evidence, from $0.625$ to $0.702$, approaching the $0.718$ gold-nugget upper bound without sacrificing relevance. We then find that ground-truth oracle retrieval, despite substantially higher retrieval coverage, delivers no more nugget coverage to the answer than our estimated selection. This suggests that answer completeness depends not only on what evidence is retrieved, but also on how effectively the generator uses it. To address this, we introduce a \emph{grounded self-feedback loop} in which the model identifies underused evidence from its first answer and generates again without gold supervision, raising $V_{\mathrm{strict}}$, the fraction of vital reference nuggets fully supported by the answer, by $0.086$ over two passes while largely preserving faithfulness.

</details>

### [539] [FPGAFly: A 166.7k-Neuron Fruit-Fly Connectome on One FPGA via Deferred Spike Expansion and Shared-Codeword States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38118)
*YE Ziyang*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: FPGAFly 在单块 FPGA 上实现了完整果蝇中枢神经系统连接组（16.67 万神经元、2560 万突触）的实时仿真，首次做到全脑级 LIF 网络单芯片运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 突触分辨率的果蝇连接组使逐神经元全脑仿真成为可能，但现有全脑模型依赖高算力软件或多块神经形态芯片，单 FPGA 方案仅能支持小规模或统计性网络。扩展到完整连接组面临两大瓶颈：逐突触脉冲展开使队列流量随扇出（最高 11.2k）急剧增长；41 位神经元状态需 6.83 Mbit，超出目标器件 6.27 Mbit 的片上 BSRAM 容量。

Method: (1) 保序延迟展开队列：每个脉冲仅存一个 64 位描述符并按源 ID 排序，避免按扇出展开；(2) 24 位状态编码：在正常、不应期和量化越界状态间共享码字，压缩存储开销。

Result: 外部存储流量降低 54.5%–57.9%，队列峰值数据降低 95.6%–96.5%，且结果逐位一致；BSRAM 由 438 块降至 270 块，仅增加 1245 个 LUT，1 万次 MNIST 预测结果完全不变。在 Gowin GW5AST-LV138 上以 80 MHz 运行，100 ms 窗口平均 86.83 ms 完成，2000 次测试最坏 93.05 ms。

Conclusion: FPGAFly 首次在单块 FPGA 上完成完整果蝇中枢神经系统的连接组仿真，并满足实时（每个 100 ms 生物时间窗内完成）约束，为中等规模生物神经网络的全脑实时建模提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Synapse-resolution fruit-fly (Drosophila) connectomes enable neuron-by-neuron simulation of entire insect nervous systems, yet whole-brain models still require computationally demanding software or multiple neuromorphic chips, and single FPGAs support only small or statistical networks. Scaling to the full connectome, per-synapse spike expansion scales queue traffic with fan-out up to 11.2k, while 41-bit neuron states require 6.83 Mbit, exceeding the 6.27 Mbit on-chip block static RAM (BSRAM) of the target device. FPGAFly runs the 166.7k-neuron, 25.6M-connection leaky integrate-and-fire male central nervous system (CNS) connectome on one FPGA. Order-preserving deferred expansion queues one 64-bit descriptor per spike in source-ID order, cutting external memory traffic by 54.5%-57.9% and peak queue data by 95.6%-96.5% with bit-identical results. A 24-bit encoding shares codewords across normal, refractory, and quantized out-of-range states, reducing BSRAM usage from 438 to 270 with 1245 extra LUTs and zero changes across 10,000 MNIST predictions. At 80 MHz on a Gowin GW5AST-LV138, each 100 ms window finishes in 86.83 ms on average and within 93.05 ms across 2000 tests, realizing the first complete Drosophila CNS connectome simulation on one FPGA.

</details>


### [540] [GC-LIF: Spiking Group-Equivariant Neural Network With Group-Coupled Membrane Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39601)
*Nhan Trong Luu,Duong Trung Luu,Thang Cong Truong*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文研究脉冲神经网络(SNN)中的旋转等变性：证明在G-等变卷积后接LIF神经元保持逐时刻等变的充要条件是神经元参数(a, v_th)在群作用的联合轨道上为常数，据此提出Group-Coupled LIF (GC-LIF)并构建SGE-Net，在多个数据集上实现无需旋转增强的C4/D4不变性且优于带旋转增强的普通SNN。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SNN在视觉任务中只能靠数据增强获得旋转不变性；群等变CNN虽有架构内建对称性，但缺少忠实的脉冲对应版本——因为等变卷积后的LIF神经元的膜电位递归可能破坏等变性。因此需要明确等变保持的条件。

Method: 给出LIF层逐时刻保持等变的充要条件：神经元参数(β, v_th)沿群作用在(群,空间)索引联合轨道上为常数；闭式求解，适用于任意逐元素有状态神经元。将满足条件的逐通道参数化方案命名为GC-LIF，与p4、p4m等变卷积及脉冲率群最大池化组合成SGE-Net；在MNIST、KMNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100上用干净测试集及其群变换副本评估，并做算子级验证与能量估计。

Result: SGE-Net在无旋转训练下对C4和D4不变，在10个数据集-群对中有9个优于带旋转增强的普通SNN；非等变基线最坏情况损失达72个百分点。算子级测试在训练前后均验证理论；能量估计显示SGE-Net为普通CNN算术能耗的1.7倍，在8个时间步下比对应ANN低2.3倍。

Conclusion: 逐神经元异构参数是SNN破坏群等变性的根源，而沿群轨道耦合参数的GC-LIF可严格保持等变性，实现架构级旋转不变性，同时保持SNN的低能耗优势。

Abstract: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) promise event-driven, low-power inference, but on vision tasks they still acquire rotation invariance only through data augmentation. Group-equivariant CNNs build such symmetries into the architecture, yet a faithful spiking analogue is missing: a leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) neuron placed after a $G$-equivariant convolution can break equivariance through its membrane recurrence. We give a necessary and sufficient condition for this not to happen. The layer is equivariant at every time step if and only if the neuron parameters $(β, v_{\mathrm{th}})$ are constant along the joint orbits of the group action on the (group, space) index. We solve it in closed form, and it covers any elementwise stateful neuron. Its sufficiency half specialises a known result for equivariant recurrent networks; its necessity half rules out the heterogeneous per-neuron parameters common in SNNs. The per-channel parameterisation that satisfies it, Group-Coupled LIF (GC-LIF), is combined with $p4$ and $p4m$-equivariant convolutions and a spike-rate group max-pool into SGE-Net. On MNIST, KMNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, evaluating each checkpoint on the clean test set and all its group-transformed copies, SGE-Net trained without rotations is invariant under $C_4$ and $D_4$ and outperforms a plain SNN trained with rotations in nine of ten dataset-group pairs, whereas non-equivariant baselines lose up to $72$ percentage points in the worst case. Operator-level tests confirm the theory before and after training, and an analytical estimate places SGE-Net at $1.7\times$ the arithmetic energy of a standard CNN and $2.3\times$ below its ANN counterpart at eight time steps.

</details>


### [541] [Diagnosing Optimizer-Landscape Interaction via Representation in Subset Selection Multitasking: Evidence from Piano Fingering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39779)
*Ananda Phan Iman,Tingyang Wei,Chang Wook Ahn*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 该文通过适应度景观分析，揭示连续松弛编码如何重塑适应度景观并影响进化多任务优化中的知识迁移效果，指出表征设计是有效迁移的关键因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续松弛是进化多任务优化（EMTO）中常用的编码方案，可将异构任务统一到同一搜索空间；但连续表征会重塑诱导的适应度景观，其对优化行为与知识迁移的影响尚缺乏研究。

Method: 以钢琴指法估计这一子集选择问题为代表性案例，引入多种编码变体，借助适应度景观分析研究表征诱导的景观与优化器行为之间的交互作用，考察其对搜索动态和解质量的影响。

Result: 分析表明，迁移效果与表征诱导的景观特征变化密切相关，而不单纯由算法因素决定。

Conclusion: 表征设计是多任务优化中实现有效知识迁移的关键因素，应作为EMTO设计的重点考量。

Abstract: Continuous relaxations are commonly used as an encoding scheme for evolutionary multitasking optimization (EMTO), allowing heterogeneous tasks to be optimized within a unified search space. However, these continuous representations fundamentally reshape the induced fitness landscape, and their impact on optimization behavior and knowledge transfer remains underexplored. In this work, we bridge the gap by analyzing the interaction between the representation-induced fitness landscape and optimizer behavior through fitness landscape analysis. Using piano fingering estimation as a representative case of the subset selection problem, we introduce several encoding variants and investigate how their induced landscapes influence search dynamics and solution quality under EMTO. Our analysis indicates that transfer efficacy is strongly associated with changes in representation-induced landscape characteristics, rather than algorithmic factors alone, highlighting the representation design as the key factor of effective knowledge transfer in multitasking optimization.

</details>


### [542] [HEMO: Harness Self-Evolution for Multi-Objective Combinatorial Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40023)
*Jianghan Zhu,Cong Zhang,Ni Zhang,Yifan Yang,Yew Soon Ong,Zhiguang Cao*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: HEMO将自动算子设计（AOD）的"框架本身"作为自演化优化目标，通过一次更新一个模块、折扣UCB调度和持久化记忆文件系统，实现搜索发现过程的自进化，在8个MOCO任务和2种进化骨干上优于传统进化、神经网络及LLM-based AOD基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM-based AOD方法只演化算子本身，而发现算子的流程（如检索哪些经验、改进哪些算子、选择哪些父代、如何编排搜索步骤）保持固定，难以适应新的Pareto权衡与算子交互变化。

Method: 维护持久化的harness状态，每次只更新一个模块（经验检索逻辑、算子改进目标、父代选择、搜索步骤编排）；以下游解质量与运行时间作为反馈信号；用折扣UCB调度器根据模块效用变化引导自适应；用持久记忆文件系统跨harness状态保存候选结果与诊断反馈。

Result: 在8个MOCO任务、2种结构不同的进化骨干上与常规进化、神经网络及LLM-based AOD基线对比表现强劲，并能有效迁移到相关任务。

Conclusion: HEMO把自动算子设计从"演化单个算子"扩展到"改进发现算子的搜索过程"。

Abstract: Automatic operator design (AOD) has increasingly adopted large language models (LLMs) to generate problem-specific search and variation operators for multi-objective combinatorial optimization (MOCO). Yet most methods evolve the operators while leaving the process that discovers them fixed. This limits adaptation as new Pareto trade-offs and operator interactions change where and how the search should proceed. We introduce HEMO, which makes the AOD harness itself a self-evolving optimization target. HEMO maintains a persistent harness state and updates one module at a time, revising the logic that determines which experience to retrieve, which operators to improve, which parents to select, and how to formulate the orchestration of search steps. Downstream solution quality and runtime guide these updates, while a discounted UCB scheduler directs adaptation toward promising modules as their utility changes. A persistent memory filesystem preserves candidate outcomes and diagnostic feedback across harness states, enabling successive states to build on accumulated optimization experience. Experiments across eight MOCO tasks and two structurally distinct evolutionary backbones demonstrate strong performance against conventional evolutionary, neural, and LLM-based AOD baselines, together with effective transfer to related tasks. HEMO extends automatic operator design beyond evolving individual operators to improving the search process that discovers them.

</details>


### [543] [Dynamic Powergrid Optimization with FPGA-based Neuromorphic Higher-order Ising Machines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40522)
*Saptarshi Maiti,Shantanu Chakrabartty,Chetan Singh Thakur*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 提出基于AMD Versal FPGA的神经形态高阶Ising机，将配电网重构(DNR)以PUBO形式直接映射为高阶Ising交互，只需179自旋（较二次型减少6倍），每20 ns并行更新，求解33/51/69节点网络中位延迟1.6–29.3 ms，比Gurobi首次最优解快7–58倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态配电网重构(DNR)需实时优化开关配置以降低阻性损耗和电费，属复杂组合优化问题；新兴大规模高密度FPGA（如AMD Versal）为神经形态Ising机提供高效硬件平台，可实现前所未有的优化性能。

Method: 将DNR通过多项式无约束二值优化(PUBO)形式直接映射为高阶Ising交互；在AMD Versal Premium VP1802 FPGA上实现神经形态高阶Ising机架构，每20 ns执行并行自旋组更新。

Result: IEEE 33节点网络仅需179个自旋，比标准二次型减少6倍；求解33/51/69节点基准网络中位延迟1.6–29.3 ms，比Gurobi求首次最优解快7–58倍；扩展开关灵活性使功率损耗降低80.71 kW(57.83%)；每10 s自适应重构在时变需求下相比静态日重构每日省131.16 kWh。

Conclusion: 高阶Ising硬件在快速、自适应智能电网管理方面具备显著潜力。

Abstract: The advent of large, high-density FPGAs such as the AMD Versal enables efficient hardware implementation of neuromorphic Ising machines, unlocking unprecedented performance for complex combinatorial optimizations. A critical application for this computing paradigm is dynamic powergrid optimization, specifically Distribution Network Reconfiguration (DNR), which seeks to mitigate severe resistive losses and reduce electricity costs by optimizing network switch configurations in real time. This paper presents an FPGA-based neuromorphic higher-order Ising machine for high-speed, adaptive DNR. By directly mapping DNR onto higher-order Ising interactions via a polynomial unconstrained binary optimization (PUBO) formulation, the proposed architecture requires only 179 spins for the IEEE 33-bus network, which represents a 6 times reduction compared to standard quadratic formulations. Implemented on an AMD Versal Premium VP1802 FPGA, the architecture executes parallel spin-group updates every 20 ns and solves 33-, 51-, and 69-bus benchmark networks with median latencies of 1.6-29.3 ms, yielding a 7-58 times speedup over Gurobi to the first optimal solution. Using the solver with expanded network-switching flexibility reduces power loss by 80.71 kW (57.83%), while adaptive reconfiguration every 10 s under time-varying demand saves 131.16 kWh/day over static daily reconfiguration, highlighting the potential of higher-order Ising hardware for fast, adaptive smart grid management.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [544] [Moment-Guided Optimizers for Noisy Deep Learning: MGO-SC as a Simple Consistency Gate for Adam-Style Updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37712)
*Alicem Koyun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MGO-SC优化器：用梯度的符号EMA构造坐标级一致性门控，信任符号稳定的坐标、压低符号波动的坐标；并给出"均值保持"变体，在标签噪声下稳定优于AdamW。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应优化器在强随机性和标签噪声下表现退化，此时梯度的符号与幅度不稳定。作者希望在不再引入二阶信息或逐样本过滤的前提下，利用梯度符号一致性这一廉价信号来改进优化稳健性。

Method: 对Adam式方法做轻量修改：计算符号的指数滑动平均(EMA)，由其幅度导出逐坐标的一致性门控。朴素门控只能缩小更新，导致有效步长损失；因此提出均值保持变体，在坐标间重新分配"信任"，保持每张量净步长幅度不变。使用匹配学习率与解耦权重衰减。

Result: 在CIFAR-10/ResNet-18上，匹配学习率下均值保持MGO-SC在干净、对称与非对称标签噪声下均稳定优于AdamW：40%对称噪声下+1.4个点，配对bootstrap 95%CI不含零，Wilcoxon p<0.01；同时给出匹配种子的效应量、非参数bootstrap置信区间与配对显著性检验。

Conclusion: 符号一致性门控有效，但必须以均值保持形式实现才能避免有效步长损失；该方法无需二阶信息或样本过滤，即能在标签噪声下带来稳定且统计显著的增益，并开源代码与原始日志。

Abstract: Adaptive optimizers are widely used in deep learning, yet their behavior can degrade under heavy stochasticity and label noise where the sign and magnitude of gradients can be unstable. We study MGO-SC (Moment-Guided Optimizer with Sign-Consistency), a lightweight modification of Adam-style methods that derives a coordinate-wise consistency gate from the magnitude of a sign exponential moving average (EMA): coordinates whose gradient sign is stable are trusted, while coordinates whose sign fluctuates are down-weighted. We show that the naive form of this gate, which can only shrink updates, loses effective step size and underperforms when the learning rate is matched to the baseline. We therefore introduce a mean-preserving variant that reallocates trust across coordinates without changing the net per-tensor step magnitude. On CIFAR-10 with ResNet-18, under a matched learning rate and decoupled weight decay, mean-preserving MGO-SC consistently improves over its AdamW baseline across clean, symmetric, and asymmetric label noise (e.g., +1.4 points at 40% symmetric noise; paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero; Wilcoxon p<0.01), while adding no second-order information or per-sample filtering. We report matched-seed effect sizes, nonparametric bootstrap confidence intervals, and paired significance tests, and we release code and raw logs.

</details>


### [545] [What a Weight Update Buys: Leverage Across Training Stages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37719)
*Shikhar Shiromani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"杠杆率"(leverage)——权重的Fisher二次型与同尺度随机方向Fisher二次型之比，作为量化"单位权重变化买来多少行为变化"的精确度量。在Olmo-3、Tülu-3、Zephyr、OLMo-2上，杠杆率跨越四个数量级地区分预训练(≈随机水平)、SFT(约5倍)、RL(400–1500)、DPO(400–23000)。据此发现预训练在散文上只是累积噪声；bf16无fp32主副本会冻结36–99%坐标并使杠杆率降7倍；并推导并验证了DARE重用损伤的sign-flip定律。
