<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练使权重变化仅约范数的千分之一却显著改变行为，预训练变化达三分之一却效果缓慢——现有指标无法刻画"每单位权重变化买到多少行为改变"。作者需要一种可精确计算、可跨checkpoint比较的度量，以解释不同训练阶段与精度设置下权重更新的"效率"差异，并为模型合并/复用中的随机丢弃重缩放提供预测理论。

Method: 定义leverage=更新的Fisher二次型(每个方向一次前向模式自动微分求得)÷同checkpoint同尺度随机方向的同一二次型。在Olmo-3、Tülu-3、Zephyr、OLMo-2的checkpoint上按训练窗口(30k–1M步)测量，比较预训练/SFT/RL-Zero/RLVR/DPO；分析训练精度(bf16无fp32主副本 vs fp32)对冻结坐标比例、杠杆率及更新幅度与对角Fisher对齐性的影响；推导sign-flip零模型下随机drop-and-rescale(DARE)在保留率p时的相对损伤公式(1-p)/(p·ρ_sign)并实验验证；设计对照：(i)fp32主权重下SFT/DPO轨迹的杠杆率变化，(ii)从锚点按公开配方重跑DPO，比较位移与杠杆率，并做组件消融(长度归一化损失、batch size 128)。

Result: 杠杆率在四个数量级上排序各阶段：预训练窗口在散文上处于随机水平，SFT约5倍，RL-Zero与RLVR为400–1500，DPO为400–23000。预训练30k–1M步窗口在散文上不比同尺度随机方向更有影响，符合SGD的噪声二次模型。bf16无fp32主副本冻结36–99%坐标、杠杆率最多降7倍，并产生fp32训练所无的更新幅度与对角Fisher对齐。sign-flip定律在DARE成功处与实测相差不超过2倍。对照实验：fp32主权重下SFT与DPO轨迹随训练推进杠杆率下降；两次按公开配方重跑DPO与原发布的位移误差在1%内、杠杆率误差在4%内，而朴素配方读数低5–6倍；消融表明水平由长度归一化损失及其batch size 128共同决定。

Conclusion: Leverage是一个精确、可复现、跨阶段可比的"权重变化效率"仪器；它揭示预训练在散文上近似无效的噪声累积、不同后训练算法的效率层级、精度设置(bf16主副本缺失)对更新结构与可用性的实质性扭曲，并给出可验证的DARE重用损伤定律。该度量可作为评估训练配方、checkpoint复用与模型合并的通用诊断工具。

Abstract: Post-training moves a language model's weights by about a thousandth of their norm and changes its behavior sharply; pretraining moves them by a third and buys a slow drift. We introduce leverage, an exact measure of what a unit of weight change buys: the Fisher quadratic form of an update, computed with one forward-mode pass per direction, divided by the same form for random directions of the same size at the same checkpoint. Leverage orders released Olmo-3, Tülu-3, Zephyr, and OLMo-2 checkpoints over four orders of magnitude: pretraining windows sit at the random level on prose, SFT five times above it, RL-Zero and RLVR at 400-1,500, and DPO at 400-23,000. With this instrument we find that pretraining accumulates into noise: windows of 30k to 1M steps are no more consequential on prose than random directions of their size, as a noisy quadratic model of SGD predicts. We find that training precision changes what an update looks like: training bf16 parameters without an fp32 master copy freezes 36-99% of coordinates, lowers leverage up to sevenfold, and creates an alignment between update magnitudes and the diagonal Fisher that fp32 training does not show. We derive and verify a law for reuse: the sign-flip null predicts the relative damage of random drop-and-rescale (DARE) at keep rate $p$ as $(1-p)/(p\,ρ_{\mathrm{sign}})$, within a factor of two of measurement wherever DARE succeeds. Two controls make these readings reliable: every controlled SFT and DPO trajectory with fp32 master weights loses leverage as it moves, and two re-runs of a released DPO stage from its anchor with its published recipe land within 1% of the released displacement and 4% of its leverage, where a plain recipe reads five to six times lower; leaving one component out traces the level to the length-normalized loss and its batch size of 128 together.

</details>


### [546] [Threshold Compatibility and Support-Selection Diagnostics in Neural Discovery of Partial Differential Equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37726)
*Zeen Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文用有限诊断实验刻画神经PDE发现中"支持集选择"与"系数回归精度"的脱节：准确回归不等于正确方程，阈值、稀疏化状态与评分选择相互冲突。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经PDE发现（如稀疏回归框架）常隐含假设：只要回归准确就可恢复正确方程。作者希望检验这一假设，并厘清支持选择失败的具体机制。

Method: 针对中位数/样本标准差阈值，推导精确的两信号保留边界与全向量扰动界；在平流-扩散库上做支持集重拟合；用固定顺序阈值岭回归做对照；用条件验证/能量池化检验候选；构造"精确替换库与目标"的换序实验；对Burgers扩散收益设定判据并扫描权重与预算。

Result: 精确平流-扩散库在系数达数值精度时仍丢失扩散项；40个稀疏状态的真支持重拟合降低扩散误差但未复原全部导数精度；60个理想对照中阈值岭回归精确恢复，60个学习态中全部多选；条件验证拒绝全部正确候选，事后能量池化在60态均保留更高最小损失；240次物理残差比较中供给支持优于原选中方程；换序在59/60态发生；加权两损失在所有预算下均不满足Burgers扩散收益判据。

Conclusion: 这些有限诊断区分了三类失效：阈值不相容、重拟合损伤、评分拒绝，并表明不存在自动修正或一般性的恢复与预测稳定性保证。

Abstract: Accurate regression need not yield the correct equation after support selection. For a median/sample-standard-deviation threshold in neural PDE discovery, we derive an exact two-signal retention boundary and a complete-vector perturbation bound. Exact advection-diffusion libraries lose diffusion despite coefficient recovery to numerical precision. True-support refits of forty saved sparse states reduce diffusion error without restoring all derivative accuracy. A fixed sequential threshold ridge comparator recovers exact support in sixty ideal controls but selects extra terms in every learned state. All-fold correct-support candidates are rejected by conditional validation; post hoc energy pooling preserves their higher minimum loss in all sixty states. Supplied-support estimates outperform unchanged selected equations in all 240 physical-residual comparisons on four unused analytic trajectories. With coefficients, observation points and weights fixed, exact replacement of the learned library and target reverses their learned-row ordering in 59/60 states. Weighting both losses also fails the specified Burgers diffusion-benefit criterion at every tested budget. These finite diagnostics distinguish threshold incompatibility, refit damage and score rejection; they establish neither automatic correction nor general recovery or predictive stability.

</details>


### [547] [MulClip: A table-free activation function with monotonic and folding regimes for reservoir computing on microcontrollers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39343)
*Guren Matsumura,Masato Takemoto,Shinzo Koyama*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出轻量级激活函数 MulClip，用于微控制器上的储备池计算，硬件状态更新时间仅为 tanh 的 0.34 倍且性能更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在环形储备池等稀疏 RC 拓扑中，乘累加运算很少，但 tanh 的求值在 Cortex-M4 上占状态更新时间的 75%，成为主要瓶颈，需要更廉价的激活函数。

Method: MulClip 仅用比较、取绝对值、乘法和减法引入曲率；其截断阈值不设在极值处，而设在响应越过极值后回到零的点，使单一函数同时具备单调区与非单调折叠区，由常规超参数搜索（如输入尺度）决定使用哪一区间，无需任务特定阈值调参。

Result: 硬件测量状态更新时间为 tanh 的 0.34 倍，短于所评估的 11 种 tanh 近似；PC 评估中三阶 MulClip 在 NARMA-20 上 NMSE 比 tanh 低 22%，在 8 位奇偶校验上准确率由单调变体的 0.76–0.78 提升至 0.97–0.98；两个任务上片上推理与 PC 结果几乎一致。

Conclusion: MulClip 以极低计算成本兼顾单调与折叠响应，显著加速 MCU 上的 RC，且在非线性任务上精度不降反升，适合嵌入式储备池计算部署。

Abstract: This letter proposes MulClip, a lightweight activation function for reservoir computing (RC) on microcontrollers (MCUs). In a ring reservoir, a representative sparse RC topology, multiply-accumulate operations are few, and evaluating tanh accounted for 75% of the state-update time on a Cortex-M4. MulClip introduces curvature into the response using only comparison, absolute value, multiplication, and subtraction, and places its clipping threshold not at the extremum but at the point where the response returns to zero after passing the extremum. As a result, a single function has both a monotonic regime and a nonmonotonic folding regime that increases the expressiveness of a single unit. Which regime is used is determined by the usual hyperparameter search, e.g., over the input scale, so no task-specific threshold tuning is required. The state-update time measured on hardware was 0.34 times that of tanh and shorter than that of any of the 11 evaluated tanh approximations. In PC-based evaluation, third-order MulClip achieved a 22% lower NMSE than tanh on NARMA-20, where the pre-activations remained in the monotonic regime, and on 8-bit parity it raised the accuracy from 0.76-0.78 for the monotonic-clip variant without folding to 0.97-0.98. For these two tasks, on-device inference yielded nearly the same values as on the PC.

</details>


### [548] [Predicate Neuron: Differentiable Quantization of Predicate Relations in Gradient-based Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37727)
*Ioannis Konstantoulas,Iliana Loi,Kyriakos Sgarbas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Native Predicate Neuron（谓词神经元），一种可微的一阶逻辑推理神经模块，通过单一可训练参数学习交替逻辑运算，并用"硬操作执行+可微回传"的双重梯度机制将符号推理原生融入FC/CNN/RNN/Transformer，在MNIST、Wikitext上加速收敛、提升精度并降低损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统符号推理依赖静态架构，难以与深度神经网络和基于梯度的优化结合；而标准深度学习在处理不连续性和单调推理类任务上表现不佳。

Method: 设计Native Predicate Neuron模块，基于一阶逻辑量化，用单一可训练参数学习在运算之间交替切换以实现关系逻辑建模；采用定制梯度机制，训练时执行硬逻辑操作同时保持反向传播可微性；对输入与选择状态进行量化，从而可逼近连续与非连续函数、化解不连续性问题；在Keras和PyTorch中实现，并嵌入FC、卷积、循环和Transformer架构。

Result: 在MNIST、Wikitext等基准上，引入谓词神经元整体上加速收敛、提升精度、降低损失，在需要单调推理或处理不连续性的任务中改进尤为显著。

Conclusion: 谓词神经元可原生集成进标准神经网络以实现模糊逻辑运算，代码在Keras和PyTorch中公开可用。

Abstract: In machine learning, symbolic reasoning approaches often rely on static architectures that hinder integration into deep neural networks and gradient-based optimization. To address this, we introduce the Native Predicate Neuron, a differentiable logic-reasoning neural module that enriches standard architectures with symbolic reasoning capabilities via first-order logic quantization. The proposed neuron models relational logic by learning to alternate between operations using a single trainable parameter. It features a tailored gradient mechanism with a dual-nature formulation: executing hard logical operations during training while maintaining differentiability for backpropagation. By quantizing both its input and choice state, the Predicate Neuron approximates continuous and non-continuous functions, effectively resolving discontinuities that standard deep learning architectures struggle with. We evaluate the Predicate Neuron across Fully-Connected, Convolutional, Recurrent, and Transformer architectures on benchmarks like MNIST and Wikitext. Results show that incorporating Predicate Neurons accelerates convergence, boosts accuracy, and lowers loss in general, with particularly strong improvements in tasks requiring monotonic reasoning or handling discontinuities. Overall, the Predicate Neuron natively integrates into standard neural networks to enable fuzzy logic operations and is available in Keras and PyTorch.

</details>


### [549] [Selective Transfer Learning for Groundwater Level Anomaly Forecasting: Accuracy-Risk Trade-offs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37733)
*Yaxuan Wu,Ali Mohammed Mansoor Alsahag,Seyed Sahand Mohammadi Ziabari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文研究荷兰多井地下水异常预测中的上下文感知选择性迁移学习（CASL），通过在冻结的无迁移与固定迁移父模型间做校准训练的约束性上下文混合，缓解固定迁移对异质水井的损害，并坦承结果为精度-风险权衡而非滚动部署有效性证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 源域预训练虽能提升平均精度，但在相当比例的异质水井上会造成性能下降，固定迁移并非普遍可靠，因此需要一种按上下文选择性利用迁移的方法。

Method: 在457口井、13,718个测试窗口、5个预定义种子上评估；冻结四单元maxsim0.60源池（仅用Always-TL验证RMSE选择）。对比CASL（基于校准训练的约束性上下文混合，父模型为冻结的无迁移与固定迁移模型）、Global Convex Blend（同样父模型，但每个种子只拟合一个校准权重）与No TL、Fixed TL。任务要求9个月连续观测输入与精确3个日历月目标，不做插值。

Result: 固定迁移损害18.38–51.86%的水井。CASL的RMSE比No TL低0.424–1.084%，部分挽救97.53–99.50%、完全挽救23.46–43.78%的被固定迁移损害水井。Global Convex Blend在4个种子中保护更多水井，CASL在4个种子中汇总RMSE略低。

Conclusion: CASL与Global Convex Blend互不占优；部分挽救可由凸混合结构本身产生，不能证明上下文优越性。结果仅支持固定切分上的精度-风险权衡，而非滚动部署有效性。

Abstract: This work studies context-aware selective transfer learning for multi-well groundwater anomaly forecasting in the Netherlands. Source-domain pretraining can raise average accuracy but is not uniformly reliable: it degrades performance on a substantial fraction of heterogeneous wells. Context-Aware Selective Learning (CASL) uses calibration-trained, constrained contextual blending of frozen no-transfer and fixed-transfer parents. Global Convex Blend uses the same parents with one calibration-fitted weight per seed. The corrected task requires nine consecutive observed monthly inputs and an exact three-calendar-month target, without interpolation. Evaluation covers 457 wells and 13,718 test windows under five predefined seeds, with the four-cell maxsim0.60 source pool frozen using Always-TL validation RMSE alone. Fixed transfer harms 18.38-51.86% of wells. CASL has 0.424-1.084% lower RMSE than No TL, partially rescuing 97.53-99.50% and fully rescuing 23.46-43.78% of fixed-harmed wells. Partial rescue can arise structurally from convex blending and does not establish contextual superiority. Global Convex Blend protects more wells in four seeds, while CASL has slightly lower pooled RMSE in four. Neither dominates: the results support an accuracy-risk trade-off on the fixed split, not rolling deployment validity.

</details>


### [550] [AI at a Turning Point: From ChatGPT through Neural Networks to Neuromorphic AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39796)
*Volker Kempe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是一部关于脉冲神经网络(SNN)与神经形态计算的专著，以ChatGPT的文本生成模块为例，将Transformer类AI的原理、优雅之处与计算成本，同SNN的编码、学习与网络设计方法进行对比，并说明二者在混合系统中互补而非替代的关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连接主义AI能耗巨大（训练与运行大型模型耗电达吉瓦时至太瓦时级），而人脑仅约20瓦；神经形态方法（SNN）以事件驱动、局部学习、时间编码等"节俭"机制提供低功耗替代，因此需要系统梳理两条技术路线的张力与互补可能。

Method: 以通俗但数学严谨的方式综述：以ChatGPT文本生成模块为例剖析Transformer的计算原理与代价；系统介绍SNN的脉冲时序依赖可塑性、群体编码与时间编码、神经工程框架(Neural Engineering Framework)、从Loihi 2到商用边缘处理器的神经形态硬件；并始终以人类神经系统机制作为参照模型。

Result: 形成一部覆盖编码、学习、网络设计与硬件落地的SNN专著式综述，建立了连接主义AI与神经形态AI在原理和成本上的对照框架，并指出混合系统中可在各自擅长之处分别部署两种方法。

Conclusion: SNN并不取代当今AI，而是对其的扩展；经典AI与神经形态AI可在混合系统中互补互促，共同拓展人工智能的方法论边界。

Abstract: The tension between the established technologies of connectionist AI and their neuromorphic challengers is attracting growing attention, above all because of the enormous energy demand of the former and the low power consumption of the latter. Developing and running large AI models consumes gigawatt- to terawatt-hours of energy, while the human brain operates on a continuous 20 watts. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) counter this energy demand with a frugal approach and bring elements of self-organization into the methodological repertoire of AI: local learning instead of global error backpropagation, event-driven computing, and time as a carrier of information. They do not replace today's AI but extend it; in hybrid systems each approach can be deployed where its strengths lie. This monograph explains the field in a generally accessible yet mathematically rigorous way. Using the text-generation module of ChatGPT as an example, the principle, elegance, and computational cost of transformer-based AI are presented and compared with the coding, learning, and network-design methods of SNNs. Throughout, relevant mechanisms of the human nervous system serve as model and reference point. Topics include spike-timing-dependent plasticity, population and temporal coding, the Neural Engineering Framework, neuromorphic hardware from Loihi 2 to commercial edge processors, and the prospects for classical and neuromorphic AI to complement and extend each other.

</details>


### [551] [Anisotropic Trust Region Warping for Prior-Data Fitted Networks in Bayesian Optimisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37737)
*Samuel Younger,Tinkle Chugh,George De Ath*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PFN在高斯过程中代理贝叶斯优化中用单次前向代替反复拟合，但先验在元训练时固定。作者发现当目标函数长度尺度超出先验模态时，PFN预测对数似然落后于重拟合GP并影响优化。提出Anisotropic Trust Region (ATR) warping：按维估计长度尺度并用仿射缩放输入空间匹配PFN期望长度尺度，信任域筛选观测，不改变推理代价，在Matérn-3/2函数两端极端尺度下均提升优化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PFN省去超参数重拟合，代价是先验在元训练时固定。实践发现目标函数长度尺度一旦偏离元训练先验的模态，PFN预测似然显著劣于重拟合GP且传导到优化效果。需要在不重训网络前提下纠正这种不匹配。

Method: 提出Anisotropic Trust Region (ATR) warping。逐维长度尺度用核目标对齐（kernel target alignment）估计；对输入空间做仿射重缩放，把目标映射到PFN期望的长度尺度；以锚点为中心的信任域决定保留哪些观测。这样PFN的O(d·N²)推理代价不变。

Result: 在Matérn-3/2核采样的函数上，ATR warping在长度尺度范围的两个极端都提升了PFN的优化性能；并给出实验证据说明PFN预测对数似然随长度尺度增大落后于重拟合GP。

Conclusion: ATR warping是一种无需重训即可纠正PFN先验-数据长度尺度不匹配的轻量方法，保持推理成本，改善贝叶斯优化性能，实现已开源。

Abstract: Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs) replace the hyperparameter refitting of Gaussian Process (GP) surrogates in Bayesian optimisation with a single forward pass, at the cost of a prior that is fixed at meta-training time. We show empirically that a PFN's predictive log-likelihood falls increasingly behind that of a refitted GP as the objective function's lengthscale grows beyond the mode of the PFN's meta-training prior, and that this deficit carries over to optimisation performance. To correct the mismatch without retraining the network, we introduce Anisotropic Trust Region (ATR) warping. Per-dimension lengthscales are estimated by kernel target alignment, and an affine rescaling of the input space maps the objective onto the lengthscale the PFN expects, with a trust region around the anchor determining which observations are retained, leaving the PFN's $\mathcal{O}(d \cdot N^2)$ inference cost unchanged. On functions drawn from a Matérn-3/2 kernel, ATR warping improves optimisation performance of the PFN at both extremes of the lengthscale range. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/youngers2006/Trust-Region-Warping-For-PFNs.

</details>


### [552] [Nonlinear Dynamical Systems as Scalable and Efficient Physical Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40471)
*Tyler King,Magnus Saebo,Jeremie Laydevant,Haoting Zhen,Maxwell G. Anderson,Tatsuhiro Onodera,Peter L. McMahon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过在物理神经网络（基于非线性动力系统的物理系统）上应用现代ML训练实践，如模型压缩和MLP-Mixer启发的参数高效架构，在仿真中实现了接近数字神经网络的精度（MNIST 99.2%，CIFAR-10 86.4%/92.2%），并估计推理能效与速度可能比数字电子神经网络提升数个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理神经网络因潜在高能效被视为有前景的ML加速器，但既往研究报告的推理精度远低于常规数字神经网络，因此需探究能否通过现代训练实践缩小这一精度差距。

Method: 在仿真研究中，对多种基于非线性动力系统的候选物理神经网络采用现代ML训练实践（包括模型压缩）；并针对某一动力系统，将其作为受MLP-Mixer启发的参数高效架构的核心构建模块。

Result: MNIST手写数字识别精度高达99.2%；CIFAR-10图像分类中，Mixer架构使精度从64%提升至86.4%（结合预训练与知识蒸馏达92.2%），且可训练参数比基线少5倍以上；粗略估计在推理能效与速度上相比数字电子神经网络可能实现数个数量级的提升。

Conclusion: 现代ML训练实践与参数高效架构设计可显著提升物理神经网络的推理精度，使其接近最先进水平，并有望在能效和速度上相较数字电子神经网络带来数量级优势。

Abstract: The rapid growth in the size of state-of-the-art machine-learning (ML) models has led to increasing compute demands, spurring the development of energy-efficient hardware accelerators. Physical systems trained to perform ML inference, known as physical neural networks, have been proposed as accelerators in part because of their potential to be highly energy efficient. However, the ML inference accuracies reported in most investigations of physical neural networks have been substantially below the state of the art for conventional digital neural networks. In this work, we show in simulation studies that by applying modern ML training practices, including model compression, various candidate physical neural networks based on nonlinear dynamical systems can achieve accuracies as high as 99.2% on MNIST handwritten-digit recognition. We also show for one dynamical system that using it as the core building block of a parameter-efficient ML architecture inspired by MLP-Mixers enables accuracies of up to 86.4% on CIFAR-10 image classification (92.2% with pretraining and knowledge distillation), compared with 64% for the same system without the mixer architecture. The mixer approach achieved its accuracy while using $>5\times$ fewer trainable parameters than the baseline. Finally, we present back-of-the-envelope estimates for inference energy efficiency and speed when using an example physical dynamical system, suggesting that orders of magnitude improvements may be possible over digital-electronic neural networks.

</details>


### [553] [Spokes, not a Ring: Revisiting the Weekday Manifold in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37796)
*Diksha Gupta,Rieke Fruengel,Stefan Heimersheim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文检验"连续流形假设"：以星期几流形为原型，发现其表示实为沿圆环排列的七个离散状态，而非连续环。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究假设大模型将某些概念表示为多维流形而非单一方向，并将其用于解释或操控表示时，往往默认沿流形移动对应概念的连续变化。作者要检验这一"连续流形假设"是否成立。

Method: 以典型的星期几（weekday）流形为对象：(1) 分析流形上的局部敏感性，考察其与各工作日的对应关系及引导（steering）下表示与行为的映射；(2) 检验是否存在其他概念（一天中的时刻、不确定性、自然文本）占据七个离散状态以外的中间空间。

Result: 局部敏感性存在七个极小值，与七个工作日对齐，沿流形引导时表示—行为呈现阶梯式映射；中间空间既不由时刻、不确定性填充，也不由自然文本填充。

Conclusion: 星期几流形应理解为圆环上排列的七个离散状态而非连续环，这挑战了流形的连续性解读，并提示需检验其他表示流形上的移动是否对应有意义的表示与行为变化。

Abstract: Recent work has hypothesised that large language models may represent some concepts as multi-dimensional manifolds instead of single directions. Using these manifolds to interpret or steer representations often assumes that moving along them corresponds to a continuous change in the represented concept. In this work, we test this continuous manifold assumption on the prototypical weekday manifold. Despite its striking circular geometry, we find that the weekday representations behave more like seven discrete states arranged in a circle than a continuous ring. First, we show that local sensitivity has seven minima aligned with the weekdays, producing a step-like mapping between representation and behaviour under on-manifold steering. Second, we test whether any concepts are represented along the manifold outside the seven discrete states, and find neither time of day, uncertainty, nor natural text populate the intermediate space. Together, these results challenge the continuous interpretation of the weekday manifold and motivate testing whether movement along other representation manifolds correspond to meaningful changes in model representations and behaviour.

</details>


### [554] [Responsible Quantum Machine Learning for Medical Imaging: A Fairness Audit Across Sensitive Subgroups](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37819)
*Giovanni dos Santos Franco,Felipe Mahlow,Ellison Fernando Cardoso,José Adenaldo Santos Bittencourt,Felipe Fanchini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对经典与量子分类器在医学影像任务上进行公平性审计，发现量子模型在聚合性能可比的同时仍存在亚组差异，且部分"差距最小"的配置因整体判别力下降而不具临床可接受性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子机器学习（QML）被越来越多用于医学分类，但其在亚组公平性准则下的行为缺乏研究。作者假设QML并非天然公平，希望通过实证审计检验这一假设。

Method: 在两个场景上评估：DDI皮肤病变（敏感属性为Fitzpatrick皮肤类型）与CheXpert胸片（敏感属性为年龄段）。基于ResNet-18嵌入训练SVM、MLP、QSVM、QCNN，设置基线及三种缓解策略：可微Equalized Odds正则、梯度反转学习（GRL）、二者结合；并以PanDerm、EVA-X等基础模型作外部参照。每个缓解方案还对照预设的非劣性边际检验。

Result: 量子分类器可获得有竞争力的聚合性能但仍显示亚组差异。若干差异最小的配置（如DDI上QCNN+GRL）因全局判别力下降而不满足非劣性，临床不可接受。DDI上QSVM+GRL+EO表现最佳，接近PanDerm的性能/公平折中；CheXpert上QCNN+GRL聚合性能最高但差异增大，EVA-X仍更强。

Conclusion: 公平性效果依赖模型与数据集，QML需进行实证的亚组感知评估；较小AUC差距可能源于拉低最优组而非提升最差组，故须结合非劣性判据。所有量子模型均为经典模拟，不主张量子优势。

Abstract: Quantum machine learning (QML) is increasingly explored for medical classification, yet its behaviour under subgroup-aware fairness criteria remains understudied. We present an empirical fairness audit of classical and quantum classifiers for medical imaging, assuming QML is not inherently fair. Two scenarios are evaluated: dermatological lesions on DDI (sensitive attribute: Fitzpatrick skin type) and chest X-rays on CheXpert-derived data (sensitive attribute: age group). Using ResNet-18 embeddings, we train SVM, MLP, QSVM and QCNN under a baseline and three mitigation settings: differentiable Equalized Odds (EO) regularisation, Gradient Reversal Learning (GRL), and both combined. Foundation models (PanDerm, EVA-X) serve as external references. Quantum classifiers may achieve competitive aggregate performance while still exhibiting subgroup disparities. Since a smaller subgroup AUC gap may stem from degrading the best group rather than improving the worst, each mitigation is also tested against a pre-specified non-inferiority margin relative to its baseline. Under this criterion, several configurations with the smallest disparity, notably QCNN with GRL on DDI, are not clinically acceptable due to loss of global discrimination. On DDI, QSVM with GRL+EO performed best and approached PanDerm in the performance/fairness trade-off; on CheXpert, QCNN with GRL achieved the highest aggregate performance but increased disparity, and EVA-X remained stronger. Fairness effects are model- and dataset-dependent, so QML requires empirical subgroup-aware evaluation. All quantum models run in classical simulation; we claim no quantum advantage.

</details>


### [555] [Learning Without Clocks: Partition-Invariant Neural Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37823)
*Han Wang,Jingyuan Bao,Juntao Wu,Saiao Zhou,Yuman Nie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究异步事件传感器（事件相机、脉冲耳蜗等）的"切片不变性"问题：提出时间介导的非交换（TM）模型类，证明输出对事件顺序/时间戳的连续性与鲁棒性等价于事件更新的两两交换性，并构造最小TM层（CFE层），在事件数据上优于相同规模的加性模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习系统把异步事件流先分帧/打包，输出依赖切片方式。作者追问：除了逐事件更新、事件间闭式演化之外，还需什么条件才使输出 (i) 与同时事件的处理顺序无关、(ii) 对时间戳连续（即使两事件时间交错）、同时 (iii) 保持时间顺序敏感性。

Method: 对任意非线性事件模型，证明 (i)(ii) 各自等价于事件更新的两两交换性；交换后所有顺序依赖来自更新与事件间动力学的不交换性，且随时间间隔线性消失。据此定义 TM 模型类并给出分辨率鲁棒性界；构造最小 TM 层——可学习、可证 Lipschitz 的 Hassenstein-Reichardt 相关器推广；证明单个加性层无法一致表示有序对交互而三维 TM 状态可以；给出 TM-k 高阶构造与保三性质的堆叠规则；实例化为线性于事件数的 CFE 层、无拓扑点过程变体。

Result: 开发集初步实验中，TM 状态相比相同结构加性状态在 DVS128 Gesture 上高 3.5–9.1 分，在 SHD 和 Speech Commands 上分别高 24.5 和 30.6 分。

Conclusion: 切片不变性、顺序不敏感性与时间戳连续性由事件更新交换性刻画，而真正的时间敏感性来自其与事件间动力学的非交换；最小 TM 层实现这一原理，且显著优于加性基线，并提供时钟鲁棒性评估协议。

Abstract: Event cameras, spiking cochleas and similar sensors emit asynchronous events, yet most learning systems first bin them into frames or packets, so the output depends on how the stream was sliced. Networks whose state is updated exactly at every event and evolves in closed form between events are invariant to this slicing. We ask what more makes the output (i) independent of the processing order of simultaneous events and (ii) continuous in the time stamps, even when two events cross in time, while (iii) staying sensitive to temporal order. For arbitrary nonlinear event models we prove that (i) and (ii) are each equivalent to pairwise commutation of the event updates, and that once updates commute, all order dependence comes from their non-commutation with the inter-event dynamics and vanishes linearly in the time lag. This identifies a class of time-mediated non-commutative (TM) models and yields a resolution-robustness bound for any model. We construct the minimal TM layer, a learnable, provably Lipschitz generalization of the Hassenstein-Reichardt correlator; prove that no single additive layer can uniformly represent ordered pair interactions, whereas a three-dimensional TM state can; show that each TM layer adds two levels of temporal nesting versus one for additive layers; and give a single-layer higher-order construction (TM-k) and a stacking rule preserving all three properties. We instantiate these results as the Clock-Free Event (CFE) layer, linear in the number of events, give a topology-free variant for temporal point processes with closed-form likelihoods, and specify a preregistered clock-robustness protocol with a physical-time threat model for spike-retiming attacks. In preliminary development-set experiments, the TM state beats an otherwise identical additive state by 3.5-9.1 points on DVS128 Gesture and by 24.5 and 30.6 points on SHD and Speech Commands.

</details>


### [556] [Learning Lotteries with Minimal Stakeholder Violations from Membership Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37828)
*Nicholas Teh,Paul W. Goldberg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究在只有二元查询反馈下，从 m 个候选系统中选择彩票（混合部署）以最小化拒收agent数量的问题，并给出复杂度与算法结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI开发者可混合部署多个系统版本，但各利益相关方（安全团队、监管者、客户）只在期望性能满足其未知阈值时才接受该混合，且阈值只能通过二元查询学习。先前工作要求让所有agent接受，但当需求冲突时可能不存在这样的彩票，因此需改为最小化拒收者数量。

Method: 将问题建模为对 n 个 agent 在 m 个备选上选彩票，每个 agent 接受恰好落在某未知半空间内的彩票，并可回答二元成员查询。证明即使半空间已知且效用为0/1时问题也是APX-hard；设计m为常数时的多项式时间精确算法，以及在最优彩票与阈值有常数间隔η时的拟多项式时间算法；对只能查询部分agent的情形，用均匀采样给出与n无关样本量的加性与相对保证，并用线性规划给出任意m的多项式时间方法；分析仅查询K个agent的确定性算法下界。

Result: 问题在强限制下仍APX-hard；m常数时可多项式精确求解，η间隔假设下可拟多项式求解；采样方法样本量与n无关并具加性/相对保证；m≥3时任何仅查询K个不同agent的确定性算法无法保证少于n-K的额外拒收，且该界可达；小规模合成实验表明最坏情形界在随机实例上偏保守。

Conclusion: 在阈值未知、反馈仅为二元查询的设定下，最优混合部署问题计算上困难，但在参数化或间隔假设下可有效求解；部分查询不可避免带来最坏情形下的严重损失，采样与LP是可实践的替代方案，且实验显示实际表现优于最坏界。

Abstract: An AI developer often has several candidate versions of a system and can deploy a mixture of them, sending each request to a randomly chosen version, as in A/B testing. Each stakeholder (e.g., a safety team, a regulator, or a customer with private test data) accepts a mixture exactly when its expected performance (e.g., its rate of harmful replies) meets the stakeholder's own standard, which the developer can learn only by asking whether a proposed mixture is acceptable. We model this as choosing a lottery over $m$ alternatives for $n$ agents, each of whom accepts exactly the lotteries in an unknown halfspace and answers such binary membership queries. While Choo et al. (ICML 2026) sought a lottery that every agent accepts, none may exist when, say, safety and helpfulness requirements conflict, so we minimize the number of rejecting agents. We show that this problem is APX-hard even when all halfspaces are known and all utilities are $0$ or $1$. We then give exact algorithms that run in polynomial time when $m$ is constant, and in quasi-polynomial time when, for a constant $η$, some optimal lottery has no accepting agent within $η$ of its threshold. When only some agents can be queried, optimizing over a uniform sample of agents gives additive and relative guarantees for the whole population, with a sample size that does not depend on $n$, and a linear program gives a polynomial-time method for any $m$. On the other hand, for $m\ge 3$, a deterministic algorithm that queries only $K$ distinct agents cannot guarantee fewer than $n-K$ extra rejections, and this is achievable; in other words, it can guarantee nothing for the agents it does not ask. Small synthetic experiments indicate that our worst-case bounds are conservative on random instances.

</details>


### [557] [Depth through Recurrence: Towards Ultra-Efficient On-Device ASR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37833)
*Chen Feng,Tianyi Xu,Ramchalam Kinattinkara Ramakrishnan,Yicheng Lin,Shaojie Zhuo,Zhaocong Yuan,Chenzheng Su,Xiaopeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出块循环（block-recurrent）ASR架构，用小量权重共享的循环块替代参数化深度，以少一个数量级的参数保留大模型97.4%的准确率，并支持端侧个性化与低能耗推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代ASR靠加深加宽提升精度，但带来内存、能耗和算力负担，在手表、眼镜等资源极受限的边缘设备上难以部署。核心问题是：能否不扩大参数量而保持深层ASR模型的强表征能力。

Method: 作者重新审视深度作用，发现多数层学习功能相似的变换（层间表征动态相似）。据此用一小组循环块替代参数化深度，每块由权重共享层构成，在保留有效深度的同时大幅压缩模型；再结合表征引导的层分组与知识蒸馏来保住精度。紧凑骨干还支持轻量MoE-LoRA适配实现端侧个性化。

Result: 在Open ASR Leaderboard基准上，仅含两个共享块的模型平均恢复大模型97.4%的准确率，参数量少一个数量级；MoE-LoRA个性化模型可匹配或超过通用ASR系统且推理成本更低；跨循环步复用权重降低了内存访问开销与推理能耗。

Conclusion: 无需大规模参数化即可获得高质量ASR；结构化循环为超压缩、节能、个性化的端侧语音识别提供了有原则的路径。

Abstract: Modern automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems have achieved remarkable accuracy by scaling model depth and capacity, but at the cost of increased memory, energy, and computational demands. On edge devices where ASR is often most needed, such as watches and glasses, deploying such large models is infeasible due to extremely constrained resources. This raises a fundamental question: can we achieve high representational power in deep ASR models without scaling up parameterization? In this work, we revisit the role of depth and identify layer wise representational dynamics, in which most layers learn functionally similar transformations. Motivated by this insight, we propose a block-recurrent ASR architecture that replaces parameterized depth with a small set of recurrent blocks, each consisting of weight-shared layers, thereby preserving effective depth while drastically reducing model size. Through representation-guided grouping and knowledge distillation, block-recurrent models retain the accuracy of large reference models while using an order of magnitude fewer parameters. Across Open ASR Leaderboard benchmarks, a model with only two shared blocks recovers 97.4% of the accuracy of large models on average. The compact backbone further enables efficient on-device personalization through lightweight MoE-LoRA adaptation, allowing user-specific models to match or surpass the accuracy of general-purpose ASR systems with significantly lower inference cost. By reusing weights across recurrent steps, the proposed architecture reduces memory-access overhead and inference energy consumption. Together, these results show that high quality ASR can be achieved without large parameterization, and that structured recurrence provides a principled path towards ultra-compressed, energy-efficient, and personalized speech recognition on the edge.

</details>


### [558] [Improving Data-Constrained Scaling with Hyperparameter Transfer and Ensembling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37842)
*Ethan Baron,Shmuel Berman,Anirudh Satheesh,Akshay Vegesna,Samip Dahal,Andrew Gordon Wilson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出联合调节超参数随规模缩放规律与集成分配的计算/数据受限缩放律，在FineWeb 100M token上比先前配方降低0.15 nats验证损失（困惑度降14%），并通过集成实现随计算单调改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算预算增长快于高质量训练数据增长，需在计算与数据双重约束下训练LLM。已有数据受限缩放配方有两个缺陷：一是固定权重衰减等关键超参数不随规模变化，而最优超参数实际随模型大小与训练轮数大幅变化；二是忽略集成这一有潜力的缩放维度，甚至导致损失随计算预算增加而上升。

Method: 拟合幂律来规定超参数如何随规模迁移，并拟合包含集成策略的缩放律来指导计算分配；配方基于较小规模实验拟合，再在至多12倍更大计算预算上验证。

Result: 在FineWeb的100M token上训练，相比先前配方验证损失降低超过0.15 nats，困惑度下降14%，且通过集成实现随计算预算的单调改进。

Conclusion: 联合考虑超参数随规模迁移与集成分配，可修正数据受限缩放配方中损失随计算上升的异常，获得可外推至更大预算的稳健缩放方案。

Abstract: As growing compute budgets outpace the growth of high-quality training data, large language models must be trained with both compute and data constraints in mind. Unfortunately, existing prescriptions for data-constrained scaling suffer from two important limitations. First, past works hold key hyperparameters such as weight decay fixed with scale, despite the fact that optimal hyperparameters vary wildly with model size and number of epochs. Second, past works neglect ensembling, a promising axis for scaling under data constraints. As a surprising consequence, prior prescriptions can lead to loss that increases with compute budget. We address both limitations by fitting power laws that prescribe how to transfer hyperparameters with scale and scaling laws that prescribe how to allocate compute with ensembling. Training on 100M tokens from FineWeb, our recipe reduces validation loss by over 0.15 nats compared to prior recipes, a 14% decrease in perplexity, and achieves monotonic improvements with compute through ensembling. These gains are achieved using prescriptions fit to smaller runs and validated at up to 12$\times$ larger compute budgets.

</details>


### [559] [Interpretable neural equation learning for high-dimensional materials data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37880)
*Philip Jacobson,Prasad Iyer,Remi Dingreville,Saaketh Desai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 nn-EQL 方程学习框架，从稀疏高维材料数据中发现可解释方程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方程学习方法少有针对稀疏、高维材料数据集发现并解释所学方程的工作流，需兼顾紧凑性、可解释性与高维输入适配。

Method: nn-EQL：对具备用户自定义神经元级激活函数的神经网络进行迭代训练—剪枝—再训练生成候选方程；用受最小描述长度（MDL）启发的评分对候选排序以平衡误差与稀疏性；并做诊断分析（逐项贡献、输入缩放敏感度、不确定性），通过标准编码器接入表格与高维数据。

Result: 在 AI-Feynman 标准基准以及多尺度高维材料数据（异质材料有限元模拟、高通量薄膜沉积实验）上验证有效，能学习方程并解释各术语含义。

Conclusion: nn-EQL 为高维材料数据中的方程发现提供可行工具；结合物理可解释表示、多模态/多保真数据与自适应数据采集后，有望用于构建并检验机理假设。

Abstract: Equation learning seeks to discover compact, interpretable equations from data using various machine-learning techniques. However, few workflows discover and interpret learned equations in sparse, high-dimensional materials datasets. We present nn-EQL, an equation-learning framework that generates candidate equations through iterative training, pruning, and retraining of a neural network with customizable, user-specified neuron-level activation functions. Candidate equations are ranked using a minimum description length (MDL)-inspired score, balancing error and sparsity, and diagnosed to assess term-wise contributions, input-scaled sensitivities, and uncertainties. We demonstrate nn-EQL on standard AI-Feynman benchmarks as well as multiscale high-dimensional materials datasets such as finite-element simulations of heterogeneous materials, and high-throughput experimental thin-film deposition data. nn-EQL integrates with tabular data and high-dimensional data via standard encoder models, learning equations and providing insight into learned terms. Looking forward, integrating physically interpretable representations, multimodal and multi-fidelity data, and adaptive data acquisition could enable equation learning to formulate and test mechanistic hypotheses.

</details>


### [560] [SAC-GCL: Structure-Aware Compression for Graph Contrastive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37898)
*Muhammad Ifte khairul Islam,Tanvir Hossain,Esra Akbas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SAC-GCL，用结构分解与图压缩作为图对比学习的视图生成策略，替代随机扰动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GCL依赖随机增强（边扰动、节点掩码），缺乏结构感知，易破坏关键拓扑、引入语义不一致视图；自适应方法仅关注局部邻域，无法捕捉对图分类至关重要的高阶宏观结构。

Method: 先通过结构分解提取内聚子图（采用多种内聚子图模型获得互补视图），再将其压缩为超节点构建粗化图视图；随后用分层视图编码器处理压缩视图，并以共享权重的内聚子图嵌入初始化超节点特征，捕捉多分辨率信息。

Result: 在六个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，结构感知压缩优于随机扰动，可产生更鲁棒、更具判别力的图表示，提升图分类性能。

Conclusion: 结构感知压缩是随机扰动的一种强有力替代方案，为图对比学习的视图生成提供了保持局部密度与高阶结构的新范式。

Abstract: Graph Contrastive Learning (GCL) has achieved remarkable success in self-supervised representation learning by maximizing agreement between augmented views of a graph. Although augmented view generation is the central step in GCL, existing models rely on stochastic augmentation of the input graph, such as edge perturbation and node masking, which lack structural awareness and frequently destroy critical topology or introduce semantically inconsistent views. While recent adaptive methods improve upon random perturbations, they primarily operate on localized node or edge neighborhoods and fail to capture higher-order, macro-level structural organization crucial for graph classification. To address this limitation, we propose Structure-aware Compression for Graph Contrastive Learning (SAC-GCL), a novel framework that employs structural decomposition and graph compression as a principled view generation strategy. Moving beyond random augmentations, SAC-GCL leverages structural decomposition techniques to extract cohesive subgraphs and condense them into supernodes, constructing coarsened graph views that preserve local density and capture higher-level structural patterns while reducing noise and redundancy. We leverage multiple cohesive subgraph models to derive complementary views of the graph, each capturing distinct structural properties. To capture multi-resolution information, a hierarchical view encoder processes these compressed views by initializing super-node features with shared-weight cohesive subgraph embeddings. Our results from extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets demonstrate that structure-aware compression provides a powerful alternative to random perturbations, yielding more robust and discriminative graph representations for graph classification tasks.

</details>


### [561] [Think Twice: The Metis-1.6 Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37903)
*Giulianno Vollmer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Metis-1.6 是单个研究者从零训练的两个 MoE 语言模型（Praxis 2.94B/0.46B 激活，Logos 10.23B/1.18B 激活），采用 Mamba-2+注意力混合专家并每 token 跑两遍；共 1.02T token 训练。综合性能中等（Logos 平均 52.93，17 模型第 7），但数据量与激活参数均处于帕累托前沿；数学突出（AIME 2025 67.50%），代码/指令跟随/长上下文较弱。报告重点在于失败复盘与修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者主张以更好的数据、训练方法与新架构，在远低成本和参数规模下获得竞争力，而非追逐前沿模型的绝对性能；同时希望公开坦诚的失败经验。

Method: 混合 Mamba-2 与注意力的 MoE 堆栈，每 token 重复两次（second look）；训练流程为 804.76B 预训练 + 18B 上下文扩展至 131,072 token + 200B 监督微调，共 1.02T token。附 MoRE（递归专家混合）结构的 10B token 消融实验。

Result: 40 项后训练基准上 Logos 均分 52.93，列 17 个模型中第 7，与 Qwen3-4B 相差约 1 分，但训练数据约为披露同类的 1/12，且每 token 激活参数少于所有胜过它的模型，处于两项指标的帕累托前沿。数学排名 30 个模型中第 2（AIME 2025 67.50%，HMMT 2026-02 63.64%）。代码、指令跟随、长上下文为弱项。失败点：配置的优化器从未运行、预训练全程用 AdamW；1.77B 参数 n-gram 记忆自行关闭；五个微调选择损害能力；组均值归一化下的长度奖励在组通过率超 2/3 后将符号反转、惩罚正确长解，作者给出证明与一行 clamp 修复。

Conclusion: Metis-1.6 以极小预算证明数据、训练方法与架构设计可部分替代参数规模，并在数学上表现突出，但并非前沿模型挑战者。论文价值更多在于可复用的负面经验与具体修正（优化器失效、长度奖励符号反转等），并为 Metis-1.7 的 MoRE 循环架构做铺垫。

Abstract: Metis is a bet that better data, better training methods and new architectures can buy what a bigger parameter count cannot, at a fraction of the cost. Metis-1.6 is its latest step: two language models built from scratch by a single researcher, Praxis (2.94B parameters, 0.46B active per pass) and Logos (10.23B parameters, 1.18B active per pass). Both run a hybrid Mamba-2 and attention mixture-of-experts stack twice for every token, so each token gets a second look. Each was trained on 1.02T tokens in total: 804.76B of pretraining, 18B of context extension to 131,072 tokens, and 200B of supervised fine-tuning. Metis-1.6 was never meant to challenge frontier models, and across 40 post-trained benchmarks it mostly does not: Logos averages 52.93, seventh of 17 models in its comparison set and within a point of Qwen3-4B. But it gets there on roughly a twelfth of the median training data of the comparators that disclose it, and with fewer active parameters per token than any model that beats it, which puts it on the Pareto frontier for both. In mathematics it ranks second of 30 models, with 67.50% on AIME 2025 and 63.64% on HMMT February 2026. It is weak at code, instruction following and long context. The rest of the report is the part I found most valuable: what went wrong. The optimizer I configured never ran, and attention trained with AdamW for all of pretraining. A 1.77B-parameter n-gram memory learned to switch itself off. Five fine-tuning choices cost capability. And a length reward under group-mean normalization punished correct solutions for being long once a group's pass rate passed 2/3, a sign inversion I prove and fix with a one-line clamp. I close with the 10B-token ablations behind MoRE (Mixture of Recursive Experts), the looped architecture of Metis-1.7.

</details>


### [562] [TERRA: Task-Oriented Edge AI for Regional Fire Detection with Identity-Free Reporting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37909)
*Mohammad Kazemi,Julie A. McCann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出边缘AI框架TERRA，用任务导向本地推理与无序区域证据聚合实现区域级火灾监测，两种上报模式在小载荷下达到高AUPRC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式火灾监测中多设备共享上行链路，业务目标常是识别有火区域而非恢复各设备测量值，故希望减少上报的信息量与身份开销。

Method: TERRA由三部分组成：任务导向本地推理、无身份标识但带区域标签的上报、置换不变的区域证据聚合。两种模式：TERRA-Score上报量化本地火灾概率；TERRA-Feature上报紧凑学习表征，接收端用置换不变的DeepSets聚合。基于EN54室内火灾报警数据集全部15个数值传感模态，在按重复划分的三折交叉验证下评估区域（episode级）推断，并考察表征大小、载荷量化、上报可用率及漏报/虚报消息鲁棒性。

Result: 9条上报且消息完美恢复时，TERRA-Feature以24比特载荷取得平均AUPRC 0.990，TERRA-Score仅用6比特达0.987；两者在FAR≤1%下MDR均为1.81%。可靠恢复时TERRA-Feature的AUPRC略高，而更紧凑的TERRA-Score对虚假消息污染增长更不敏感。

Conclusion: 任务导向、无身份的区域上报可在极低载荷下有效支撑区域火灾检测，特征模式精度略优，分数模式更省比特且更抗虚假消息，可按链路条件选择。

Abstract: Distributed fire-monitoring systems may involve many sensing devices reporting over a shared uplink, even though the operational objective is often to identify regions exhibiting evidence of fire rather than to recover device-specific measurements. We introduce TERRA (Task-Oriented Edge Representation and Regional Aggregation), an edge-AI framework that combines task-oriented local inference, identity-free region-tagged reporting, and permutation-invariant regional evidence aggregation. TERRA supports two reporting modes: TERRA-Score, in which each device communicates a quantized local fire probability, and TERRA-Feature, in which it communicates a compact learned representation for receiver-side aggregation using a permutation-invariant DeepSets model. Using all 15 numerical sensing modalities of the distributed indoor EN54 fire-alarm dataset as a proof-of-concept testbed, we evaluate regional inference for an episode-level fire-scenario target under repetition-disjoint three-fold cross-validation. We study representation size, task-payload quantization, report availability, and robustness to missed and false recovered messages. With nine reports and perfect message recovery, TERRA-Feature achieves mean AUPRC 0.990 using a 24-bit task payload, while TERRA-Score achieves 0.987 using only 6 bits; both attain an MDR of 1.81% at FAR $\leq$1%. TERRA-Feature achieves slightly higher AUPRC under reliable recovery, whereas the more compact TERRA-Score is less sensitive to increasing false-message contamination.

</details>


### [563] [Generative modeling for fusion: a large-scale benchmark of stellarator fast-ion simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37910)
*Misha Padidar,Teresa Huang,Mark Goldstein,Michael Czekanski,Jeffrey Soules*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发布BoSS数据集（含18万个仿星器平衡的导向中心模拟结果与轨迹），并定义生成建模与代理建模两类任务，基线表明ML可加速仿星器设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿星器设计需高保真导向中心模拟评估性能，计算代价高，难以直接进入优化环路，通常只作诊断；而ML应用缺乏大规模、兼顾设计多样性与高保真输出的数据集。

Method: 构建Benchmark of Stellarator Simulations (BoSS)：180,000个不同MHD平衡的导向中心模拟数据（含热沉积与粒子轨迹）；设立两组任务——生成式建模（生成粒子约束良好的仿星器构型）和代理建模（预测热沉积图样与粒子轨迹）。

Result: 基线方法可生成多样且性能良好的仿星器构型，并提供有效的代理预测；同时暴露长时程轨迹预测与分布外生成两大关键挑战。

Conclusion: BoSS为ML加速仿星器设计提供首个大规模导向中心模拟基准，展示ML潜力，并指出提升科学ML模型适用性的未来方向。

Abstract: Stellarators offer a promising magnetic confinement approach for achieving controlled nuclear fusion. However, stellarator design remains challenging, as evaluating configuration performance requires computationally expensive, high-fidelity simulations. In particular, key performance metrics derived from guiding center simulations are costly to include directly in the design optimization loop, and are almost exclusively used as diagnostics. Machine learning has the potential to advance fusion research by enabling rapid generation and evaluation of new stellarator configurations. Effectively applying ML for fusion demands large-scale datasets that capture both design diversity and high-fidelity simulation outputs. In this work, we introduce the Benchmark of Stellarator Simulations (BoSS), a dataset of stellarator designs paired with guiding center simulation results and trajectories. The BoSS is the first large-scale dataset of guiding center simulations, containing simulation data for 180,000 distinct magnetohydrodynamic equilibria spanning a wide range of magnetic geometries and confinement properties. To exemplify the utility of ML to accelerate stellarator design, we formulate and address two sets of modeling tasks: generative modeling for designing stellarators with good particle confinement, and surrogate modeling for predicting stellarator heat deposition patterns and particle trajectories. The tasks reveal the potential impact ML can have in the stellarator field and important opportunities to improve the applicability of ML models in the sciences. Our baselines generate diverse, performant stellarators and provide useful surrogate predictions, and point to long-horizon trajectory forecasting and out-of-distribution generation as key directions for future work. The BoSS can be accessed through https://boss.flatironinstitute.org/.

</details>


### [564] [Muon Makes the First Mixture-of-Experts Layer Harder to Balance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37914)
*Marcos Hernanz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在55M/108M MoE模型中，Muon会显著放大第一MoE层路由偏置的极差（span），导致负载失衡；该现象源自Muon训练网络其余部分，可通过减去路由输入的批均值或降低Muon学习率缓解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源MoE模型多以Muon替代AdamW，并用以每步调整的路由得分偏置来平衡负载，但各家做法在"路由器是否也由Muon训练"上不统一，缺少对该选择的实证依据。

Method: 在55M与108M激活参数模型上，测量每层专家路由偏置的极差（最大值−最小值）作为平衡难度指标；在短程调好的学习率下做多种子对比，考察Muon与AdamW训练路由器、以及路由器输入去批均值等干预的影响。

Result: Muon在所有随机种子下都抬高第一MoE层的偏置极差，平均约翻倍，其他层变化很小；该上升来自Muon训练网络其余部分，与路由器优化器无关。第一层路由输入共享同一方向，warmup后最热专家负载达公平份额的4–7倍；前3000步减去批均值可消除过载而几乎不影响损失。较小模型上Muon学习率减半可消除大部分上升并略微改善损失；仅把路由器改为AdamW会使warmup期间负载波动更大并略微升高损失。

Conclusion: 该规模下结果支持路由器继续用Muon训练；MoE负载失衡主要来源于Muon对非路由部分的训练，使路由输入出现共享方向，可通过输入去均值或调节学习率缓解。

Abstract: Many open mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models train with Muon instead of AdamW. Most balance the load with a bias on each expert's routing score, adjusted after every step. Their recipes disagree on whether Muon should also train the router. In models with 55M and 108M active parameters, we measure how the optimizer changes the span of these biases, the largest minus the smallest in a layer. The span grows when all tokens favor the same experts, so it shows how hard a layer is to balance. At learning rates tuned on shorter runs, Muon raised the span of the first MoE layer at every seed, roughly doubling it on average, while the other layers changed much less. The rise came from Muon on the rest of the network, whichever optimizer trained the router. In those runs, the inputs to the first router shared a direction, and soon after the warmup its busiest expert averaged four to seven times its fair share. Over the first 3,000 steps, subtracting the batch mean from these inputs removed this overload while barely changing the loss. On the smaller model, halving Muon's learning rate removed most of the rise and slightly improved the loss. Moving only the router to AdamW made the loads shift more during the warmup and slightly raised the loss, so at this scale the results favor keeping the router on Muon.

</details>


### [565] [Bi-Phase Training: Learning Efficiently From Scratch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37934)
*Abel Gurung,Joseph Campbell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出双阶段训练(BPT)，一种参数高效预训练方法，用可训练对角矩阵与低秩适配器的组合模拟全参数优化中的高秩学习动态，通过周期性合并实现方向空间的复合扩张，在远少可训练参数下接近全参数预训练效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着模型规模扩大，基础模型的全参数预训练计算代价极高；现有参数高效方法难以复现全参数优化中观察到的高秩学习动态，导致预训练效果存在差距。

Method: BPT将每个权重更新参数化为"受约束的高秩左/右变换"的组合，由可训练对角矩阵与低秩适配器构成，并将适配器更新周期性合并进冻结的基础权重，从而在训练过程中复合并扩张可及的方向空间。

Result: 在FineWeb-Edu(10B与100B tokens)上从头预训练Qwen2.5(100M–1.5B)与OLMo-2-1B：验证困惑度接近全参数基线；1.5B规模下可训练参数减少66%且困惑度差距很小；多下游任务评估显示保留了大部分全参数模型的下游性能。

Conclusion: BPT以显著更少的可训练参数实现了接近全参数预训练的效果，说明在参数高效预训练中保持高秩更新动态与周期性合并方向扩张是有效的设计方向。

Abstract: Pre-training foundational models is computationally expensive as models scale. In this work, we introduce Bi-Phase Training (BPT), a parameter-efficient pre-training method that preserves the high-rank learning dynamics observed in full-parameter optimization with substantially reduced trainable parameters. BPT parameterizes each weight update as a composition of constrained high-rank left/right transformations via trainable diagonal matrices and low-rank adapters whose updates are periodically merged into the frozen base weights, resulting in a compounding expansion of accessible directions during training. Across language-model pre-training from scratch (Qwen2.5 models from 100M to 1.5B parameters and OLMo-2-1B) on FineWeb-Edu (10B and 100B tokens), BPT achieves validation perplexity close to full-parameter baselines while using far fewer trainable parameters; e.g., at the 1.5B scale, BPT uses 66% fewer trainable parameters with only a small validation-perplexity gap. Additionally, a comprehensive evaluation across diverse downstream tasks shows that BPT preserves much of the full-parameterized model's downstream performance.

</details>


### [566] [Finite-Step Geometry of Marginal-Preserving Velocity Fields in Generative Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37936)
*Ewsey Obzherin,Valentin Khrulkov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究生成流中诱导相同连续边缘演化但在数值离散化后行为不同的速度场，在固定边缘路径和数值方法的条件下分析有限步非等价性问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成流可存在多个速度场，它们在连续极限下产生相同的边缘分布演化，但经数值离散化（有限步）后表现不同。作者希望固定边缘路径与数值方法，深入刻画这种有限步的非等价性及其对生成质量的影响。

Method: 提出"投影修正方程"（projected modified equations）来刻画改变边缘律的局部积分误差分量，并给出更高边缘收敛阶的充分条件。对仿射固定形状分布，刻画精确有限步可达性，推导谱障碍及最邻近可达的Wasserstein误差精确值。对扩散概率流ODE，构造精确分数下保持边缘路径不变的斜对称分数扰动（skew-score perturbations），并量化其在分数误差下的泄漏。

Result: 理论分析刻画了有限步误差中影响边缘律的分量、收敛阶的充分条件、仿射情形下的谱障碍与最邻近可达Wasserstein误差的精确表达，以及斜对称分数扰动引起的误差泄漏。受控高斯与混合分布实验验证了所预测的收敛阶、可达性与障碍现象。

Conclusion: 不同类型的速度场在有限离散步下并不等价，其差异可通过投影修正方程及各理论工具精确刻画；数值实验证实了理论预测的收敛阶、可达性与谱障碍现象，为设计数值上更稳健的生成流提供了依据。

Abstract: Generative flows can admit different velocity fields that induce the same continuous marginal evolution but behave differently after numerical discretization. We study this finite-step non-equivalence while keeping the marginal path and numerical method fixed. Projected modified equations characterize the component of local integration error that changes the marginal law and give sufficient conditions for higher marginal convergence order. For affine fixed-shape distributions, we characterize exact finite-step reachability and derive spectral obstructions and sharp nearest-reachable Wasserstein errors. For diffusion probability-flow ODEs, we construct skew-score perturbations that preserve the exact marginal path under exact scores and quantify their leakage under score error. Controlled Gaussian and mixture experiments recover the predicted order, reachability, and obstruction phenomena.

</details>


### [567] [SAG-Sep: Sparse Augmented Graphs and Onion-Guided Search for Rounded Capacity Cut Separation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37952)
*Haoran Liu,Guanyi Wang,Yu Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SAG-Sep：用稀疏增广图编码LP解、单次前向打分，配合无训练Onion-Sweep解码器生成嵌套RCC割，在N=1000上根间隙较最强NeuralSEP基线降17.7%，神经分离提速约30倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RCC是CVRP松弛中最有效的割之一，但精确分离大规模下不可行；现有启发式与神经分离器虽快，却常在实际分离预算内产生不了足够多有效割。

Method: SAG-Sep将LP解编码为稀疏增广图（加入流量引导的多跳边以捕捉长程路径结构而不稠密化注意力），一次编码器前向即输出各车辆数层级下节点属于诱导子集的分数，避免NeuralSEP式迭代predict-and-coarsen。观察到高价值精确RCC通常嵌套成"洋葱状"子集族，且分数与嵌套深度相关，据此提出Onion-Sweep：按分数排序客户，一次向量化评估所有前缀的违反度，输出每个replica最违反前缀及跨replica的嵌套族提议，无需调阈值或探测带。

Result: 在NeuralSEP基准N=1000实例上，SAG-Sep+OS相比最强NeuralSEP基线平均根间隙降低17.7%，单次前向分离器每轮神经分离速度约提升30倍。

Conclusion: LP感知的稀疏编码与高价值割的嵌套结构是可推广至更广泛神经分离任务的结构性规律。

Abstract: Rounded capacity cuts (RCCs) are among the most effective cuts for capacitated vehicle-routing relaxations, but exact separation is computationally prohibitive at scale. Existing heuristic and neural separators can be fast, but often fail to produce sufficiently many effective cuts within practical separation budgets. We introduce SAG-Sep, a separator that scores node membership in RCC-inducing subsets across vehicle-count levels from a fractional LP solution in a single encoder forward pass, avoiding the iterative predict-and-coarsen inference used by NeuralSEP-style separators. SAG-Sep encodes the LP solution as a Sparse Augmented Graph (SAG), adding flow-informed multi-hop edges that expose long-range routing structure without densifying attention. Beyond LP-aware sparse encoding, we observe that high-value exact RCCs are typically nested, organizing into onion-like subset families, and SAG-Sep's node scores track subset nesting depth. This motivates Onion-Sweep (OS), a training-free decoder that ranks customers by their scores, evaluates the RCC violation of every prefix of the ranking in one vectorized pass, and emits the most violated prefix of each replica together with a cross-replica family of nested proposals, converting independent node scores into structurally coordinated RCC candidates without a tuned threshold or probing band. On the NeuralSEP benchmark with N=1000 customer instances, SAG-Sep with OS reduces the average root gap by 17.7% relative to the strongest NeuralSEP baseline, while the single-pass SAG-Sep separator achieves a roughly 30-fold per-iteration neural separation speedup. Our findings suggest that LP-aware sparse encoding and the nested structure of high-value cuts are structural patterns worth leveraging in neural separation more broadly.

</details>


### [568] [Self-Supervised Latent Action-Conditioned World Modeling for Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37963)
*Chia-Han Kuo,Chengshuai Zhao,Huan Liu,Lo Pang-Yun Ting*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ACTS-WM是一个自监督的潜在动作条件世界模型框架，通过推断时序转移背后的潜在动作并以此条件化预测，提升时间序列表示学习效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于JEPA的时序编码器主要在潜空间做预测，却忽视了支配时序观测间转移的潜在因素（即"动作"）。作者假设显式建模时序变化背后的信息能促进时序建模。

Method: 1) 潜在动作建模：无需显式动作标注，从时序转移中推断潜在的"动作"信息；2) 构建基于JEPA的编码器与动作条件世界模型，以学到的潜在动作和任务信息为条件预测目标时序表示。

Result: 在22个数据集、4类代表性任务（单变量/多变量预测与分类）上评估，ACTS-WM相比预训练JEPA编码器通过学到互补表示提升了下游性能。

Conclusion: 显式建模时序转移背后的潜在动作是有效且通用的自监督时序表示学习方向，可无缝增强现有JEPA类编码器。

Abstract: Time-series data play an important role in various tasks, such as weather forecasting, web traffic analysis, and speech recognition. Recently, pioneering studies have increasingly adopted Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) based encoders to learn time-series representations through latent-space prediction. However, they often overlook the underlying factors governing transitions between time-series observations. In this work, we hypothesize that explicitly modeling the information behind changes in time series can facilitate time-series modeling. Building on this hypothesis, we propose ACTS-WM, a self-supervised latent action-conditioned world model framework for time-series analysis. First, we introduce a latent action modeling approach that infers the underlying information behind time-series transitions as latent actions, without requiring explicit action annotations. We then develop a JEPA-based encoder and an action-conditioned world model to predict target time-series representations conditioned on the learned latent actions and task information. We evaluate ACTS-WM across 4 representative tasks on 22 datasets from diverse domains, covering univariate and multivariate forecasting and classification. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that ACTS-WM can improve downstream performance over pretrained JEPA-based encoders by learning complementary representations.

</details>


### [569] [Application of PDE emulators for a multi-material, multi-physics simulation problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37972)
*Diane Oyen,Morgan Jones,Adithan Kathirgamaraju,Abu Bucker Siddik,Alexander Most,David Schodt,Christine Sweeney,Kyle Hickmann,Michael McCann,Jemma Stachelek,Alexius Wadell,Michal Kucer,Mahindra Rautela,Siddharth Mansingh,James Amarel,Gerd J. Kunde,Emily Casleton Taylor,Soumi De,Ayan Biswas,Aimee Hungerford,Nathan Debardeleben,Earl Lawrence*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文评估多种计算机视觉架构作为代理模型在多材料计算物理任务上的表现，揭示迁移预训练模型（含Transformer）的实现挑战，并强调稀疏/不平衡数据学习、空间编码与物理一致性适配的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ML模拟器代理模型多在流行PDE基准上验证，但缺少对更贴近工业与工程应用的真实数据集的评估，需检验其在多材料、多物理场景下的实际可行性。

Method: 在涉及多材料、有挑战性的计算物理任务上，训练并评估多种基于计算机视觉的架构作为代理模型，记录适配预训练模型时的实现障碍。

Result: 发现某些预训练模型（尤其Transformer类架构）难以适配；结果表明需要针对稀疏与不平衡数据设计学习算法，并改进空间编码适配与物理一致性度量。

Conclusion: 针对多物理多材料数据集，研究应重视数据不平衡处理、空间编码与物理一致性技术，以及降低训练数据生成成本的方法。

Abstract: Machine learning (ML) architectures are being developed for fast emulation of numerical simulators to accelerate both scientific discovery and engineering design. While these approaches are well-tested on popular PDE (partial differential equation) benchmarks, it is necessary to evaluate their performance on datasets that more accurately reflect industrial and engineering applications. We evaluate several computer vision-based architectures trained as surrogate models on a challenging computational physics task involving multiple materials, revealing significant implementation challenges for adapting certain pre-trained models, including transformer-based architectures. For such multi-physics multi-material datasets, our results underscore the importance of learning algorithms designed for sparse and imbalanced data, techniques for adapting spatial encodings and physical consistency metrics, in addition to methods for reducing the cost of generating sufficient training data.

</details>


### [570] [Sometimes less is more: Investigating inductive biases of MLPs and Transformers on noisy k-parity features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37976)
*Alasdair Paren*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文用含噪声k-parity特征的数据集实证比较MLP与Transformer，发现二者在训练动力学与归纳偏置上有显著差异：Transformer对噪声特征更鲁棒但难学复杂低可用性特征，MLP相反且随数据增加稳定提升；固定训练预算下增加样本量甚至会降低Transformer最终精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLP和Transformer在不同数据条件下学习行为差异的机制尚不清楚，缺乏可精确控制"特征可预测性"与"特征可用性"的实验平台，难以系统比较二者归纳偏置。

Method: 构造含一个或多个由噪声k-parity编码特征的合成数据集，通过噪声控制每个特征的可预测性与可用性；在多种数据分布、数据规模和模型规模下，对比MLP与Transformer的训练动力学和最终精度，并分析训练预算与样本数的交互影响。

Result: Transformer对噪声特征更鲁棒，但难以学习复杂、低可用性特征；MLP趋势相反，且随数据量增加稳步提升。固定训练预算下，增加唯一样本数会拖慢Transformer优化，导致小数据集反而精度更高；该现象是优化速度效应，随预算按数据规模放大而减弱但未消失。

Conclusion: 噪声k-parity提供了可精确控制特征的测试平台，为理解Transformer与MLP何时、为何学习不同提供了起点，也有助于针对这些差异设计数据与训练预算策略。

Abstract: We empirically investigate how MLPs and Transformers differ when trained on data sets containing one or more features encoded by noisy k-parity. Noisy k-parity gives us hard synthetic data sets in which we can control the predictivity and availability of every feature. Across a range of data distributions, data scales and model sizes, we find large differences in the training dynamics and inductive biases of the two architectures: Transformers are more robust to noisy features but struggle to learn complex, low-availability features, whereas MLPs show the opposite trend and improve steadily with more data. We also find that, under a fixed training budget, increasing the number of unique training examples can slow Transformer optimisation enough to reduce final accuracy, so that a smaller data set performs better. Training-accuracy results show this is an optimisation-speed effect; it shrinks, but does not vanish, when the budget is scaled with the data set size. By giving precise control over feature predictivity and availability, this testbed offers a clear starting point for understanding when and why Transformers and MLPs learn differently, and for designing data and training budgets that exploit those differences.

</details>


### [571] [Separability Is Not Alignability: Representations for Spectrum-to-Molecule Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37979)
*Karol Musielinski,Fanurs C. E. Teh,Takahiko Koyama,Artur Dubrawski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文审计"预训练+冻结对齐"路线用于小分子从串联质谱鉴定。在MassSpecGym上重训无测试集污染的光谱编码器后发现：对齐所需度量无法被预测式目标确定，候选式目标还会奖励与光谱无关的先验；最终真正缓解数据稀缺的是模拟光谱而非冻结几何表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 串联质谱鉴定小分子受限于成对（谱-结构）数据稀缺。受视觉-语言与 Platonic Representation Hypothesis 启发，研究者希望用基础模型规避这一稀缺：在无标注光谱上预训练谱编码器、在大量结构上预训练分子编码器，再对齐两个冻结表示。本文检验该路线是否真正有效。

Method: 在 MassSpecGym 上做审计：重训光谱编码器以排除测试折污染；分析对齐所需"区分不同分子的度量"是否可由现有目标产生；理论上证明某些预测式目标会固定分子身份却不固定该度量；识别并隔离候选式目标对基准 decoy 集合的谱无关先验；并与模拟光谱增强方案对比。

Result: 对齐路线存在根本性缺陷：预测式目标无法确定正确度量，候选式目标可利用与光谱无关的 decoy 先验获得虚高表现（该先验被单独量化）。相较之下，模拟光谱的性能超过冻结几何表示。

Conclusion: 解决数据稀缺的关键不在架构或表示对齐，而在数据本身——模拟光谱比冻结的预训练几何更有效。基础模型对齐范式在质谱-分子任务上需谨慎对待。

Abstract: Identifying a small molecule from its tandem mass spectrum is limited by paired data. Foundation models offer a way around this scarcity: pretrain a spectrum encoder on unlabeled spectra and a molecule encoder on a large corpus of structures, then align the two frozen representations, as in vision-language and as the Platonic Representation Hypothesis suggests. We audit this route on MassSpecGym with spectrum encoders retrained free of test-fold contamination. Alignment needs a metric relating distinct molecules, but the objectives that produce spectrum encoders never see molecular structure: we prove that some predictive objectives fix molecular identity without fixing that metric. Moreover, we find that a candidate-based objective rewards a spectrum-independent prior over the benchmark's decoys, which we isolate. What ultimately addresses data scarcity is not architectural: simulated spectra surpass frozen geometry.

</details>


### [572] [Predicting Sparse Observables in Parameterized Unsteady Flows Using Coarse-Mesh Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37986)
*Brener Ramos,William R. Wolf,Tarcísio C. D. Oliveira,Scott T. M. Dawson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出在粗网格上直接部署图神经网络（GNN）的降阶模型，跳过全状态重构，仅预测所需自由度，在参数化2D/3D流动问题上兼顾精度、效率与泛化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维非线性流动的全阶代理模型往往没必要——许多应用只需少数选定自由度（探针点、积分量）。传统降阶方法需先重构全状态，代价高；希望绕开全状态重构直接建模。

Method: 1）在粗网格上直接部署GNN构建降阶代理，无需重建求解器分辨率全状态；2）动力学信息驱动的自适应采样，依据频谱变化选样；3）噪声增强的多步展开（unrolled）训练，提升长时自回归预测。

Result: 在参数化2D/3D受限圆柱绕流及非均匀加热腔体（雷诺数/瑞利数范围）上，模型可泛化到未见工况，准确预测稀疏探针与积分量；粗网格GNN匹配或优于细网格代理且训练时间与内存更低（含3D混沌动力学）；自适应采样比均匀采样最大误差降一个数量级且成本可忽略；优于参数化DMD、稀疏MLP、U-Net、FNO且成本更低，并支持系统辨识与稀疏观测状态估计。

Conclusion: 粗网格表示+自适应采样+噪声增强展开训练构成高效降阶建模框架，可对参数化非定常流动建模而无需按求解器分辨率重构；粗网格训练还使噪声增强多步展开变得可行。

Abstract: Full-order surrogates for high-dimensional nonlinear flows are often unnecessary when applications require only selected degrees of freedom. We propose reduced-order models that bypass full-state reconstruction by deploying graph neural networks (GNNs) directly on coarse meshes. Applied to parameterized 2D/3D confined cylinder flows and an unevenly heated cavity over Reynolds/Rayleigh-number ranges, the models generalize to unseen conditions and accurately predict sparse probe locations and integrated quantities. Coarse-mesh GNNs match or outperform finer-mesh surrogates while reducing training time and memory, even for 3D chaotic dynamics. A dynamics-informed adaptive sampling strategy guided by frequency-spectrum variations reduces maximum errors by an order of magnitude versus uniform sampling at negligible cost. Coarse-mesh training also makes noise-augmented multi-step unrolling practical, improving long-horizon autoregressive predictions. The approach outperforms parametric DMD, sparse MLPs, U-Nets, and Fourier neural operators at lower cost, and enables system identification and state estimation from sparse observations. These results show that coarse-mesh representations, adaptive sampling, and noise-augmented unrolled training form an efficient framework for reduced-order modeling of parameterized unsteady flows without solver-resolution reconstruction.

</details>


### [573] [Deep learning for non-transvenous ICD screening: tailored neural network architectures, extended experiments, and explainability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37993)
*Bartosz Morawski,Samuel J. Ward,Alex Touze,Lin-Thiri Toon,Paul R. Roberts,John Paisey,Alain B. Zemkoho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出覆盖S-ICD与EV-ICD的24小时动态筛查框架，并设计直接作用于ECG信号的1D CNN模型AmpRatioNet，用于预测超感知风险（T:R、P:R比），性能全面优于基于2D相空间重构图像的现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非经静脉ICD虽避免了导线并发症，但易发生超感知并引发不当放电、增加死亡率；而S-ICD仅用10秒ECG筛查、EV-ICD无正式筛查流程，且T:R、P:R比在24小时内动态变化。

Method: 构建24小时动态筛查框架；首次在EV-ICD队列中做T:R分析、首次全面评估P:R预测；提出AmpRatioNet系列1D CNN架构，直接处理原始ECG信号，与2D相空间重构图像方法对比；使用89例患者、4605个医师标注10秒片段，采用患者级10折交叉验证与bootstrap置信区间；并借助可解释经典峰值标注算法进行可解释性分析。

Result: AmpRatioNet-SE在所有设定与指标上均表现最优，且无需针对设备或比值重新设计；在易超感知片段上，其误差增幅比经典峰值标注算法小最多14倍。

Conclusion: 片段级预测可聚合为24小时时间线，将S-ICD筛查从10秒拓展至全天，并为EV-ICD提供可行的筛查路径（仍待器械级验证）。

Abstract: This paper studies two non-transvenous implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICDs), namely the Subcutaneous ICD (S-ICD) and the Extravascular ICD (EV-ICD). Both avoid the complications of transvenous leads but are prone to oversensing, which can trigger inappropriate shocks associated with increased mortality. Oversensing risk is predicted by the ratio of T- or P-wave amplitude to R-wave amplitude (T:R, P:R), and these ratios vary over a 24-hour period. Yet S-ICD screening uses a single 10-second electrocardiogram (ECG) segment, and the EV-ICD has no formal screening protocol whatsoever. We present a 24-hour ambulatory screening framework for both devices which includes the first T:R analysis in an EV-ICD cohort and the first full evaluation of P:R prediction. We introduce AmpRatioNet, a family of 1D convolutional neural network architectures operating directly on the ECG signal, and benchmark it against the best existing approach - based on 2D phase space reconstruction images. Evaluation uses 4,605 clinician-annotated 10-second segments from 89 patients, with patient-level 10-fold cross-validation and bootstrap confidence intervals. AmpRatioNet-SE demonstrates superior performance on every metric in each setting with no device- or ratio-specific redesign. An explainability analysis against interpretable classical peak labelling algorithms shows that AmpRatioNet-SE's increase in error on oversensing-prone segments is up to 14 times smaller than theirs. Segment-level predictions are aggregated into a 24-hour timeline, extending S-ICD screening beyond 10 seconds and offering a plausible EV-ICD screening pathway pending device-level validation.

</details>


### [574] [Towards Generalizing Pretrained All-Atom Representations to Unified Binder Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37994)
*Maojiang Su,Jiale Chen,Qijie Zhu,Shang Wu,Jiayi Wang,Jihai Zhao,Guo Ye,Yibo Wen,Han Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PairFuse通过轻量级逐层适配器，将预训练全原子表征融合进独立的几何隐扩散模型，实现统一的生物分子结合剂设计，并在抗体、多肽和小分子基准上超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全原子模型擅长模态特定的结合剂设计，几何隐扩散模型擅长统一设计，两者优势互补；作者希望把预训练全原子表征泛化到统一结合剂设计中。

Method: 提出PairFuse，参数高效：用轻量级逐层适配器把预训练全原子表征接入独立预训练的几何隐扩散模型，包含两种机制——丰富扩散模型的分子块特征，以及将成对结构信息注入去噪器。

Result: 理论上证明增强去噪器保持几何性质，且成对注意力融合比仅特征融合提供更强的注意力表达能力；实验上在抗体、多肽、小分子结合剂设计基准上优于预训练扩散模型和现有表征融合基线。

Conclusion: 全原子表征可通过表征融合有效迁移至统一结合剂设计，且参数高效、跨模态通用。

Abstract: PairFormer-based all-atom models demonstrate strong capabilities in biomolecular binder design. However, existing methods often use all-atom representations for modality-specific binder design, such as protein and peptide design. In contrast, recent geometric latent diffusion models pursue unified binder design by representing molecular blocks from different modalities in a shared latent space. These complementary strengths motivate us to investigate how to generalize the use of pretrained all-atom representations to unified binder design. We introduce PairFuse, a parameter-efficient method that enables this generalization through representation fusion. Specifically, we use lightweight layerwise adapters to integrate pretrained all-atom representations into an independently pretrained geometric latent diffusion model. Our adapters integrate pretrained all-atom representations through two mechanisms: enriching the diffusion model's molecular block features and incorporating pairwise structural information into the geometric diffusion model's denoiser. Theoretically, we prove that the augmented denoiser preserves geometry and pairwise attention fusion provides additional attention expressivity beyond feature-only fusion. Experimentally, across antibody, peptide, and small molecule binder-design benchmarks, PairFuse achieves stronger performance than the pretrained diffusion model and existing representation-fusion baselines.

</details>


### [575] [Preserving Safety During Sequential Fine-Tuning: A Factorial and Geometric Analysis of Replay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38001)
*George Ruellan,Diana Benavides-Prado*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文解耦"监督回放暴露"与"logit蒸馏"两种策略，研究它们在顺序LoRA微调中对安全行为与拒绝几何结构各自的贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 良性微调会侵蚀安全对齐，顺序适配更会叠加放大这一风险。已有方法分别用有害提示拒答回放、良性合规样本回放或基座模型logit蒸馏来缓解，但监督暴露与蒸馏各自对安全行为及拒绝几何的具体作用尚不清晰。

Method: 将监督回放损失与logit蒸馏损失因子化分离，在Mistral-7B与Llama-3-8B上，跨不同任务序列（代码生成、德语摘要、科学问答）进行顺序LoRA微调；用HarmBench ASR、OR-Bench-hard过度拒绝率评估行为，并抽取拒绝方向做消融分析几何效应。

Result: 监督回放使Mistral的ASR较基座平均降51.1点，但过度拒绝率升53.4点；纯logit蒸馏（无监督回放损失）ASR仅降5.4点、过度拒绝仅升5.1点，即以极小代价基本防止安全侵蚀。Llama呈现同样的策略间不对称性。二者结合可缓和过度拒绝且不影响下游任务分数。几何上，Mistral中蒸馏比暴露更保留基座拒绝方向；而Llama中暴露后的拒绝行为在消融所提取方向后仍大体存续。

Conclusion: 监督暴露与蒸馏在安全-有用性权衡上存在显著不对称，蒸馏更具性价比，组合可平衡。模型间几何解离表明，保留基座拒绝方向并非行为安全的可靠代理指标。

Abstract: Benign fine-tuning can erode safety alignment in large language models, and sequential adaptation substantially compounds this risk. Prior work mitigates this erosion by replaying harmful-prompt refusals and benign-compliance examples, while other work instead matches base-model logits via distillation. However, the individual contributions of supervised exposure and distillation to safety behavior and refusal geometry during sequential adaptation remain unclear. We factor these two strategies apart and study their behavioral and geometric effects during sequential LoRA fine-tuning of Mistral-7B and Llama-3-8B across diverse task sequences (code generation, German-language summarization, and science question-answering). Behaviorally, supervised replay exposure yields the largest reduction in HarmBench attack success rate (ASR) on Mistral, averaging 51.1 points below base, but at a substantial over-refusal cost, averaging 53.4 points above base on OR-Bench-hard. Logit distillation, without any supervised replay loss, largely prevents safety erosion at a fraction of this cost: an average 5.4-point ASR reduction against only a 5.1-point rise in over-refusal. Llama shows the same asymmetry between the two strategies. Combining exposure and distillation moderates exposure's over-refusal while leaving downstream task scores largely unaffected. Geometrically, the two models diverge: on Mistral, distillation preserves the base refusal direction more closely than exposure does, whereas on Llama, refusal behavior after exposure largely survives ablation of the extracted refusal direction. This dissociation between models indicates that preserving the base refusal direction is not a reliable proxy for behavioral safety.

</details>


### [576] [Are Seismic Foundation Models More Than Glorified Feature Extractors?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38003)
*Laura Laurenti,David Liu,Brian Kulis,Men-Andrin Meier,Christopher Johnson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统比较了地震波形基础模型的不同自监督目标，发现改变学习目标只是"重新分配"下游能力而非提升总体能力；作者认为根本瓶颈在于学习目标本身，需要跨事件（多时间尺度）定义的预训练目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地震序列在两个分离时间尺度上随机：单次地震的波传播是秒到分钟级，而地震发生本身是秒到月尺度的稀疏自激发过程。现有地震波形基础模型直接沿用了音频/视觉的学习目标——这些目标都从单一固定长度窗口计算，只能捕捉一次波传播的波形实例，永远无法覆盖决定地震何时发生的"发生过程"。因此存在开放挑战：如何在同一个训练目标中同时尊重两个时间尺度。

Method: 构建九个模型设计，共享同一个Mamba编码器-解码器，在固定的300万个窗口语料上训练，系统改变自监督目标、量化瓶颈和混合器（mixer）。其中两项关键对比是架构匹配、仅改变目标的对照实验。每个检查点以冻结方式在三个下游任务上评估。

Result: 改变目标只是重新分配下游技能而非提升技能，且没有任何检查点在所有任务上获胜。在最强分类器上加入掩码压力会使其重新特化而非成为通才：少样本P波拾取精度提升6.9个点，但少样本分类准确率下降9.6个点。容量、架构和领域接近性等控制实验都无法解释"技能迁移而非提升"的现象。与任务专用基线相比，优势依赖数据情形：少样本下在分类和地震动预测上胜出，全量数据下落后。

Conclusion: 按源自语言和视觉的标准，这些模型更接近特征提取器而非真正的基础模型。作者认为核心约束是学习目标本身，要解决这一问题需要定义跨事件的学习目标——也就是让地震活动性具有随机性的那个时间尺度。

Abstract: Earthquake sequences are stochastic on two separated timescales: the seismic waves of any individual earthquake propagate over seconds to minutes, while the earthquakes themselves arrive as a sparse, self-exciting occurrence process, with inter-event intervals from seconds to months. Respecting both scales in one training objective is the open challenge. Foundation models (FMs) for seismic waveforms instead import their learning targets from audio and vision, where every target is computed from a single fixed-length window. Such a window holds one realization of the wave propagation (an earthquake trace), never the occurrence process that decides when earthquakes happen. We develop nine model designs sharing one Mamba encoder-decoder, trained on a fixed corpus of 3M windows, varying the self-supervised objective, quantization bottleneck and mixer; the two key comparisons are architecture-matched, varying the objective alone. Each checkpoint is evaluated frozen on three downstream tasks. Varying the target redistributes downstream skill rather than raising it, and no checkpoint wins everywhere. Adding masking pressure to our strongest classifier re-specializes it rather than making it a generalist: it gains 6.9 points of few-shot P-wave picking precision and loses 9.6 points of few-shot classification accuracy. By the standard imported from language and vision, these models are feature extractors rather than FMs. Controls on capacity, architecture, and domain proximity do not explain why skill moves rather than rises. Against task-specific baselines the advantage is regime-dependent: our checkpoints beat them few-shot on classification and ground-motion prediction, and trail them on full data. We argue the binding constraint is the target, and that settling the question requires a learning target defined across events, the timescale that makes seismicity stochastic in the first place.

</details>


### [577] [Measured or Real? When Model-Derived Measurements Can Be Corrected or Compared](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38015)
*Yifeng Li,Ziang Ni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究"从训练模型计算出的数值（如样本难度、模型基准领先量）在种子与提示词变化下能否被校正或比较"，指出教科书式可靠性校正会失效（产生相关系数>1、MSE 无穷），提出仅在两项可靠性均通过显著性检验时才校正、并用上置信界相除的有界新规则，并对提示词设置引起的排名反转给出分层比较与族错误率控制方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型测量值（难度分数、基准得分差）随随机种子和提示词设置波动，导致跨模型比较不可靠。现有教科书做法"除以两估计可靠性之积的平方根"在实践中会给出荒谬结果（CIFAR-100 上 100 个类中 70 个出现相关>1），因此需要理论分析与更稳健的校正/比较准则。

Method: 1) 理论证明：即使相关性与可靠性用不同种子估计，经典校正的均方误差为无穷；2) 提出新规则：仅当两可靠性均通过显著性检验时校正，且除以上置信界，保证输出有界（覆盖性保证基于高斯噪声假设）；3) 提示词敏感性：将比较限制在每个提示词设置内部，并用固定提示网格、以条目数为渐近量的族错误率控制；4) 跨种子对齐嵌入坐标以提升维度级可靠性。

Result: 经典校正在实测中失效；新规则在可靠性估计良好后（500 个模拟单元）将误差减半以上；提示词可反转排名（ARC 上 Qwen2-1.5B 无示例落后 Llama-3.2-3B 3.8 分、两示例时反超前 16.6 分），四个基准上对 16 个此类反转中的 15 个，两种设置分别取名次后可给出一致赢家；嵌入坐标对齐使留出集每维可靠性从 0.003 升至 0.813。

Conclusion: 不可靠/不显著的测量不该被硬性校正：应采用有界、带检验门槛的校正规则，并在提示词设置内部做受族错误率控制的比较，同时对嵌入做跨种子对齐；这些做法使模型测量在噪声下既可解释也可比较。

Abstract: Numbers computed from trained models, such as an example's difficulty or a model's benchmark lead, change with seed and prompt. We ask when such measurements can be corrected or compared. Noise shrinks correlations, and the textbook correction divides by the square root of two estimated reliabilities. On two CIFAR-100 difficulty scores, it returned correlations above one in 70 of 100 classes. We prove that its mean squared error is infinite even when the correlation and the reliabilities use separate seeds. Our rule corrects only when both reliabilities pass a significance test, then divides by their upper confidence bounds. Its output is always bounded, and its coverage guarantees assume Gaussian noise. It helps once reliability is well estimated, more than halving the error with 500 simulated units. Prompt settings can reverse rankings. On ARC, Qwen2-1.5B trails Llama-3.2-3B by 3.8 points with no examples in the prompt and leads by 16.6 with two. Across four benchmarks, averaging the two settings names one winner for 15 of 16 such reversals. We compare models within each setting, controlling family-wise error asymptotically in the number of items for a fixed prompt grid. Aligning embedding coordinates across seeds raises held-out per-dimension reliability from 0.003 to 0.813.

</details>


### [578] [Contextual Embeddings Beyond the Gold Chunk](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38854)
*Sedigheh Eslami,Markus Krimmel,William Barber,Antoine Chaffin,Maximilian Schall,Jonas Golde,Louis Milliken,Ekaterina Glazkova,Denis Bykov,Bo Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出情境化嵌入模型 pplx-embed-v2-context（9B/0.6B），通过查询感知的上下文压缩模型蒸馏分档块级相关性，无需金块标注；并发布两个标注"答案块+证据块"的基准，在多项检索基准及视觉检索上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有情境化嵌入模型在训练与评测时都假设一个相关文档只含一个相关块，但真实场景中检索器既要找到分散在多个块中的答案，也要给出验证答案所需的证据。

Method: 从查询感知的上下文压缩模型蒸馏"分档"的块级相关性作为训练目标，摆脱对金块标签的依赖并使目标与分块方式无关；采用视觉-语言骨干训练，发布 9B 与 0.6B 两个共享嵌入空间的模型。评测方面构建 Context-bench（受控诊断）和基于真实搜索查询的 Q2D-Chunk（并作为公开榜单）。

Result: 9B 模型在 Context-bench、Q2D-Chunk 及 ConTEB 上均刷新 SOTA；在视觉检索 ViDoRe-V3 上达到稠密检索器 SOTA，且更细粒度的图像分块带来性能提升，显示视觉检索能力从视觉-语言基座迁移而来。

Conclusion: 多块答案与证据检索应成为检索器评测的核心；蒸馏式分档监督可替代金块标注，且同一框架可扩展到图像块检索。

Abstract: Contextual embeddings represent chunks of a document with respect to the document's global context. These models are typically trained and evaluated under the assumption that a relevant document contains only a single relevant chunk. In this work, we argue that in real-world use cases a retriever should not only find answers spread over several chunks but also surface the evidence needed to verify them. To address this, we introduce pplx-embed-v2-context, a family of contextual embedding models trained by distilling graded chunk-level relevance from a query-aware context compression model. This removes the need for gold-chunk labels and makes the training targets independent of the chunking. We utilize a vision-language backbone for training and release pplx-embed-v2-context in 9B and 0.6B sizes with compatible embedding spaces. On the evaluation side, we introduce two benchmarks that label both the chunks that answer a query and the evidence needed to verify the answer. Context-bench is a controlled diagnostic, and Q2D-Chunk is built from real-world search queries. To encourage further research, we also publish Q2D-Chunk as a public leaderboard. Our 9B model sets a new state of the art on both benchmarks and ConTEB.
  We find that the visual retrieval capabilities of our 9B model transfer from its vision-language base model and propose to extend chunking to image inputs. We demonstrate that our models achieve state-of-the-art performance among dense retrievers on visual ViDoRe-V3 and that performance improves with granular image chunking.

</details>


### [579] [Detecting Brain Cancer Progression Through Signatures of Wearable Accelerometry Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38021)
*Rishit Das,Barbora Barancikova,Matt Williams*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 利用腕带加速度计数据，通过粗糙路径签名与签名核MMD（SigMMD）量化胶质母细胞瘤患者步行行为变化，经个体化归一化后可作为区分肿瘤稳定与进展的候选数字生物标志物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高级别胶质瘤预后差且功能逐渐衰退，现行进展评估依赖每2-3个月一次的增强MRI，昂贵、易致幽闭恐惧且间隔长；可穿戴加速度计可连续监测患者功能，但其数据噪声大、高度个体化，常规时间序列方法与汇总统计难以检测临床有意义的变化。

Method: 将BrainWear研究中HGG患者的腕带加速度记录转换为步行路径片段，采用粗糙路径签名提取特征，并用签名核最大均值差异（SigMMD）量化步行行为变化；针对患者间异质性，以患者肿瘤稳定期的自然波动为基准进行个体化归一化。
