This pronounced improvement demonstrates that incorporating reliable intermediate checkpoints into reward design is essential for sustaining complex mathematical reasoning.

</details>


### [719] [When to spend privacy: optimal allocation in private learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39954)
*Umberto Biccari,Yongcun Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将DP-SGD的噪声方差调度视为在组合zCDP预算约束下的开环控制问题，提出PB-AMD算法求解精确预算单纯形上的最优调度，并给出理论保证与实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐私会计只能度量DP-SGD的累计隐私成本，却无法决定如何把一个固定隐私预算分配到各迭代上；因此需要把"调度选择"本身纳入优化，寻找预算最优分配方案。

Method: 将完整高斯噪声方差调度建模为组合零集中差分隐私(zCDP)约束下的开环控制问题，并显式考虑调度选择。针对期望二次终端跟踪目标，证明所有局部极小点都耗尽认证预算，从而化为精确预算单纯形问题；提出Privacy-Budget Adjoint Mirror Descent (PB-AMD)，结合路径伴随梯度与保持正性、费用下限及预算的熵更新。

Result: 在正则性与强制性假设下证明了最优调度的存在性与预算稳定性、设计到训练的效用稳定性，以及确定性、随机与样本平均意义下的平稳性保证；线性二次简化得到显式平方根分配律。实验显示跟踪性能优于多种分配规则，在学习率重启设定下预测优于均匀分配（学习率分配表现相近），且在相同平稳性容差下调度优化时间少于投影梯度下降。

Conclusion: 该框架通过非线性训练动力学把认证隐私会计与优化连接起来，为固定隐私预算的迭代级噪声分配提供了有理论保证且计算高效的求解方法。

Abstract: Privacy accounting bounds the cumulative privacy cost of Differentially Private Stochastic Gradient Descent but does not determine how to allocate a fixed budget across iterations. We formulate the complete Gaussian noise-variance schedule as an open-loop control under a composed zero-Concentrated Differential Privacy constraint, explicitly accounting for schedule selection. For expected quadratic terminal tracking, we prove that every local minimizer exhausts the certified budget, yielding an exact-budget simplex formulation. We introduce Privacy-Budget Adjoint Mirror Descent (PB-AMD), combining pathwise adjoint gradients with entropic updates that preserve positivity, charge floors, and the prescribed budget. Under regularity and coercivity assumptions, we establish existence and budget stability of optimal schedules, design-to-training utility stability, and deterministic, stochastic, and sample-average stationarity guarantees. A linear-quadratic reduction yields an explicit square-root allocation law. Experiments demonstrate tracking improvements over several allocation rules and predictive improvements over uniform allocation in a learning-rate restart setting, where learning-rate allocation performs similarly. Comparisons at a common stationarity tolerance show lower schedule-optimization times than projected gradient descent on the tested problems. The framework connects certified privacy accounting with optimization through nonlinear training dynamics.

</details>


### [720] [Observability-Aligned Evidential Masked Pretraining for Reliable VRU Motion Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39958)
*Shang Gao,Franz Götz-Hahn,Konrad Doll,Bernhard Sick*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: eCoMAE：一种证据式掩码预训练方法，用NIG解码器与三项"可观测性对齐"机制，让预测证据随可见程度自适应，提升分布偏移下的可靠性与精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VRU预测需在部分可观测与分布偏移下工作，不确定性可靠性至关重要；现有时间序列掩码自编码方法多为确定性、未约束置信度如何随可观测性变化。

Method: 块级时间步掩码 + Normal-Inverse-Gamma解码器，并引入三种可观测性感知机制：(1)对掩码视图与参考视图共同可见位置做不确定性加权均值一致性；(2)对掩码位置做证据抑制；(3)跨随机掩码的表示一致性。

Result: IMPTC 留一环境天气偏移VRU意图预测：OOD准确率0.7971→0.8068，OOD AURC 0.0718→0.0648；行人轨迹预测在IMPTC、Waymo、nuScenes、inD四数据集微调MSE均最优。

Conclusion: 可观测性对齐的证据式预训练能在偏移下提升可靠性，且在主基准之外仍具泛化效果。

Abstract: Vulnerable road user (VRU) prediction must operate under partial observability and distribution shift, so reliable uncertainty matters alongside accuracy. Masked pretraining is attractive in this setting because it naturally exposes the model to missing content during self-supervision, but existing time-series masked autoencoding methods are typically deterministic and do not constrain how confidence should change with observability. We introduce eCoMAE, an evidential masked pretraining method for multivariate time series that explicitly aligns predictive evidence with what is observed. eCoMAE combines block-wise time-step masking with a Normal-Inverse-Gamma decoder and three observability-aware mechanisms: uncertainty-weighted mean consistency on positions visible in both a masked view and a reference pass, evidence suppression on masked positions, and representation consistency across stochastic masks. On IMPTC benchmark for VRU intention prediction under leave-one-environment-out weather shift, eCoMAE improves the strongest baseline from 0.7971 to 0.8068 in OOD accuracy and from 0.0718 to 0.0648 in OOD AURC. Additional evaluation on pedestrian trajectory forecasting across IMPTC, Waymo, nuScenes, and inD further yields the best fine-tuning MSE on all four datasets. These results show that observability-aligned evidential pretraining improves reliability under shift and remains effective beyond the primary benchmark.

</details>


### [721] [A physics-informed uncertainty-aware surrogate for $p$-$n$ junction diodes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39993)
*Suchita Kulkarni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种可感知不确定性、物理约束的一维 p-n 结二极管代理模型，以器件长度、掺杂和偏压为条件，基于内部状态计算端电流、耗尽宽度等关注量，并能判断代理结果是否满足用户容差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统数值求解 p-n 结器件方程计算代价高，需要快速且可靠（带精度保证）的代理模型来预测内部状态与多类器件关注量。

Method: 构建以器件长度、掺杂浓度和偏压为输入的物理信息代理模型，输出静电势与载流子密度的内部状态；据此构建关注量测试套件（端电流、耗尽宽度、峰值场、存储电荷）；发展不确定性分析以验证结果在用户指定容差内有效；方法可扩展至非对称结与二维二极管。

Result: 一维对称结代理在静电势上取得 0.11% 中位 L₁ 误差，电子与空穴密度误差分别为 1.5% 和 0.61%。

Conclusion: 该代理模型在保证精度与不确定性可信度的同时可快速评估器件关注量，且具有向非对称与二维器件扩展的能力。

Abstract: We develop an uncertainty-aware physics-informed surrogate for a one-dimensional $p$-$n$ junction diode, conditioned on device length, doping and bias. Using the internal state of the device as predicted by the surrogate we develop a test-suite of quantities of interest including the terminal current, depletion width, peak field and stored charge. The formalism and the quantities are can be extended to asymmetric junction and two-dimensional diodes as shown by means of benchmark analysis. For the one-dimensional symmetric junction surrogate, we obtain 0.11% median $L_1$ error on the electrostatic potential, and 1.5% and 0.61% on the electron and hole densities. Finally, we develop an uncertainty analysis which determines the validity of surrogate answer within the user-specified tolerance.

</details>


### [722] [Enhancing Atrial Fibrillation Detection Through Hyperparameter Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40001)
*Sara Gjorgjieva,Ilinka Ivanoska,Marjan Gusev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究系统比较了遗传算法、Hyperband、Optuna和SMAC3四种超参数优化方法在房颤检测中的效果，发现Hyperband优化的XGBoost模型在PhysioNet数据集上取得最优F1分数96.95%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 房颤检测中机器学习与深度学习模型性能高度依赖超参数选择，但不同HPO策略对模型准确性与鲁棒性的影响缺乏系统评估，尤其在类别不平衡与患者间/患者内数据划分等真实场景下。

Method: 对比三类机器学习分类器（决策树、随机森林、XGBoost）与三种深度学习架构（RNN、DNN、Siamese网络），并分别用遗传算法、Hyperband、Optuna、SMAC3进行超参数优化；采用患者间与患者内数据划分评估泛化性与鲁棒性，数据集为PhysioNet心电数据。

Result: Hyperband优化的XGBoost模型表现最佳，峰值F1分数达96.95%，优于其他所有模型与优化方法组合。

Conclusion: 合适的HPO策略对提升房颤分类的准确性与鲁棒性至关重要，Hyperband与XGBoost的组合在临床场景下具有较强应用潜力。

Abstract: This study explores the role of hyperparameter optimization (HPO) in enhancing the detection of Atrial Fibrillation (AF) using both machine learning and deep learning models. We evaluated a range of standard classifiers - Decision Tree, Random Forest, and XGBoost classifiers, alongside deep learning architectures including Recurrent Neural Networks, Deep Neural Networks, and Siamese Neural Networks. To fine-tune these models, we applied four HPO methods: Genetic Algorithm, Hyperband, Optuna, and SMAC3. The experiments were conducted using inter-patient and intra- patient data splits to assess model generalization and robustness in the presence of class imbalance, which is reflective of real-world AF occurrence. Our results, based on PhysioNet electrocardiogram datasets, showed that the Hyperband-optimized XGBoost model outperformed all others, achieving a peak F1 score of 96.95%. These findings highlight the critical role of suitable HPO strategies in enhancing the accuracy and robustness of AF classification outcomes in clinical settings.

</details>


### [723] [FIDE: Fiber-Informed Differentiable Experimental Design for Reference-Relative Law Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40009)
*Pietro Zanotta,Ján Drgoňa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FIDE（纤维信息可微实验设计）框架，用相对共同冻结参考的信息投影补全候选设计的聚合约束，并以实现该补全路径所需的最小均方速度修正（Full action）对各设计排序，从而在保留基线的设定下解决聚合测量留下的残余设计自由度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚合测量通常使演化群体的规律欠定，多个测量系统可能同等地"科学上够用"却约束规律的不同方面，如何消除这一残余设计自由度缺乏准则；且需要一种保持现有动力学模型为工作基线的设计原则，而非通用的"恢复真实规律"目标。

Method: FIDE通过相对共同冻结参考的信息投影，为每个候选设计的聚合约束补全完整路径；再以动力学修正量（Full action，即补全路径所需的最小均方速度修正；其平方根等于梯度归一化Sobolev类上的尖锐参考相对期望率差异）对科学上合格的设计排序，形成条件最小修正原则。

Result: 实验表明该偏好会改变传感器选择；对留出的下游预测可有益也有害，取决于基线可靠性；可由聚合预测前瞻性地使用；在32维配置规律上计算上仍可用。

Conclusion: FIDE为基线保持型实验设计提供了条件最小修正原则，是一种与通用真值恢复不同的设计目标，兼顾可行性、可解释的变分刻画与高维计算可用性。

Abstract: Aggregate measurements generally leave an evolving population law underdetermined, so different measurement systems can be equally adequate for a scientific task while constraining different aspects of the law. We study how to resolve this residual design freedom in baseline-preserving settings, where an existing dynamical model remains the working baseline outside quantities explicitly valued by the task. \textbf{F}iber-\textbf{I}nformed \textbf{D}ifferentiable \textbf{E}xperimental Design (\textbf{FIDE}) completes each candidate's aggregate constraints by information projection relative to a common frozen reference, then ranks scientifically adequate designs by the dynamical revision required to realize the resulting completed paths. The resulting \emph{Full action} is the minimum mean-squared velocity correction needed to realize a completed path; equivalently, its square root is the sharp reference-relative expectation-rate discrepancy over a gradient-normalized Sobolev class. This defines a conditional minimum-revision principle for baseline-preserving design rather than a generic truth-recovery objective. Experiments show that this preference changes sensor selection, can help or harm withheld downstream predictions depending on baseline reliability, can be used prospectively from aggregate predictions, and remains computationally usable for a $32$-dimensional configuration law.

</details>


### [724] [Coupled Guidance for Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40109)
*Mateo Clémente,Léo Maxime Brunswic,Rui Heng Yang,Amir Rasouli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文理论分析了flow-matching中引入guidance的问题，指出直接套用diffusion guidance会破坏训练时的耦合分布，从而提出基于几何视角、利用耦合结构的Coupled Guidance方法，在机器人与图像生成任务上提升样本质量与引导稳定性且无额外开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Diffusion guidance虽成熟，但flow-matching与diffusion虽有相似性，现有flow-matching引导框架只是diffusion方法的直接移植，存在不稳定性；需要从理论上理解其失败原因并设计专用机制。

Method: 理论分析flow-matching中的guidance，证明朴素迁移diffusion guidance会破坏训练所用的coupling distribution、削弱采样精度控制；据此从几何角度提出Coupled Guidance，利用flow-matching训练中固有的耦合结构构建引导机制。

Result: 在ManiSkill3自定义机器人避障任务、Adroit四个灵巧操作任务，以及ImageNet-128与CelebA-HQ-256上的inpainting、超分、去模糊三项图像任务中，均提升样本质量与引导稳定性，且无额外计算开销。

Conclusion: flow-matching需要专门的引导机制；Coupled Guidance通过保持耦合结构实现稳定有效的引导，兼具理论依据与跨任务实证效果。

Abstract: Guidance methods are essential tools for steering the generation process in diffusion models, improving the generalizability of stochastic robotic controllers and enabling high-quality controlled image synthesis. Despite strong parallels between flow-matching and diffusion, integrating guidance into flow-matching models remains quite challenging. Recent work has proposed general guidance frameworks for flow-matching, however, they are direct adaptations of diffusion guidance methods and can prove unstable. In this work, we conduct a theoretical analysis of guidance in flow-matching and show that a naive translation of diffusion-based guidance to flow-matching breaks the coupling distribution used during training, resulting in weaker control over sampling accuracy. Building on this insight, we propose Coupled Guidance, a flow-matching-specific guidance mechanism derived from a geometric perspective that leverages the coupling structure inherent to flow-matching training. To validate the effectiveness of our approach, we conduct extensive experimentation on a custom robotic collision avoidance task using ManiSkill3, four robotic dexterous manipulation tasks from the Adroit benchmark, and three image generation tasks, namely inpainting, super-resolution, and deblurring, using the ImageNet-128 and CelebA-HQ-256 datasets. Our findings show that our framework improves sample quality and guidance stability across all tasks, without imposing any additional overhead.

</details>


### [725] [D-MOD: Diffusion mode estimation for accelerated MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40110)
*Md Kawsar Ahmed,Mathews Jacob*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: D-MOD 提出一种快速确定性加速 MRI 重建算法，直接给出后验众数而非后验采样，单次重建即超过多种采样式方法的 10 样本 MMSE 估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散模型加速 MRI 方法多为后验采样器，返回后验的随机抽样，需平均大量样本才能得到可重复的高质量重建，计算成本高。

Method: 在平滑对数后验的下界上使用 minorize-maximize 算法（可证明目标单调上升）。每轮在当前噪声水平下对当前估计采样 S 个含噪样本，用预训练扩散模型去噪，将其均值与实测 k 空间通过共轭梯度（CG）求解结合；并随噪声水平退火，因为下界与目标差距随噪声二次衰减。

Result: 在 fastMRI 脑部（T1、T2、FLAIR）上，单次 D-MOD 重建的 PSNR 超过 DPS、DAPS、SNORE-P 的 10 样本有限 MMSE 估计，与最强基线（DiffPIR、DDS）相差仅 0.31 dB 以内；比 MMSE 估计快 11–73 倍。

Conclusion: D-MOD 提供了快速、确定性的重建算法，适合临床场景使用。

Abstract: Diffusion models are powerful priors for accelerated MRI reconstruction, but most current methods are posterior samplers, which return a random draw from the posterior. A reproducible and high-quality reconstruction often requires averaging many samples, resulting in a high computational cost. We introduce D-MOD, a fast algorithm that instead provides a posterior mode. It uses a minorize-maximize algorithm on a lower bound of the smoothed log-posterior, which provably increases the objective. Each iteration draws S noisy samples of the current estimate at the current noise level, denoises them with a pretrained diffusion model, and combines their average with the measured k-space through a conjugate-gradient (CG) solve. We anneal the noise levels, as the distance between the bound and its target decays quadratically with noise. On fastMRI brain (T1, T2, FLAIR), a single D-MOD reconstruction exceeds, in PSNR, the 10-sample finite-MMSE estimates of DPS, DAPS and SNORE-P and stays within 0.31 dB of the strongest baselines (DiffPIR, DDS). This approach thus provides a fast deterministic reconstruction algorithm (11-73 times faster than MMSE estimates), which is useful in a clinical setting.

</details>


### [726] [Does System Size Matter in Uncertainty Quantification for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40126)
*Chayaphol Lortaraprasert,Nontawat Charoenphakdee,Wenwen Li,Yong-Bin Zhuang,Yuta Tsuboi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文检验了MLIP中结构级不确定性分数跨系统尺寸是否可比，发现均值聚合虽与尺寸无关但对大晶胞缺陷不敏感，最大聚合随尺寸增长而缩小ID-OOD差距，导致基于固定阈值的OOD检测和主动学习选择不可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLIP常用不确定性估计标记分布外(OOD)构型并筛选主动学习结构，而通行做法是按均值或最大值聚合原子级不确定性与固定阈值比较，隐含假设结构级分数跨系统尺寸可比。作者要检验这一假设是否成立。

Method: 在多组ID/OOD配对上，将平均与最大两种聚合方式作为原子数的函数进行刻画，分析其尺寸依赖性；并通过在大结构中重训练高不确定原子所在的构型，与使用真正位于训练分布外的OOD构型的重训练效果对比。

Result: 两种聚合呈现不同尺寸依赖：均值聚合同质体系下与尺寸无关，但在大晶胞中对缺陷失去敏感性；最大聚合对ID体系随尺寸增大而增长、对含缺陷体系近似持平，依极值统计规律缩小了ID-OOD差距。重训练大结构中高不确定原子几乎无提升，而重训练真正OOD结构的提升明显。

Conclusion: 结果揭示了尺寸无关不确定性判据的实际局限，呼吁在大规模原子模拟中采用尺寸感知的校准以实现更可靠的OOD检测。

Abstract: Machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) commonly use uncertainty estimates to flag out-of-distribution (OOD) configurations and select structures for active learning. A key question is whether the resulting structure-level uncertainty scores remain comparable across different system sizes. A common practice is to aggregate per-atom uncertainties by their mean or maximum and compare the resulting score against a fixed threshold, implicitly assuming such comparability. We test this assumption across several in-distribution (ID)/OOD pairs by characterizing both aggregations as a function of atom count. The two aggregations exhibit distinct size dependencies. Mean aggregation remains size-independent for homogeneous systems but loses sensitivity to defects in large cells. In contrast, maximum aggregation grows with system size for ID systems while remaining approximately flat for defect-containing systems, narrowing the ID-OOD gap in a manner consistent with extreme-value statistics. Although highly uncertain atoms in large structures may indicate novel local environments, retraining on these structures yields little improvement, in contrast to retraining on OOD structures constructed to lie outside the training distribution. Our results reveal a practical limitation of size-unaware uncertainty criteria and motivate size-aware calibration for more reliable OOD detection in large-scale atomistic simulations.

</details>


### [727] [Escaping Path Mirages in Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40130)
*Junhyeon Bae,Jaebak Hwang,Gwanwoo Choi,Minung Kim,Seungyul Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出分支感知图规划（BGP），通过识别高方差点作为图节点、设计分段学习的目标条件边来规避不可靠分支，缓解离线目标条件RL中的"路径幻象"问题，在高随机长程任务上显著优于现有SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线目标条件强化学习在随机、长程场景中困难重重：价值估计误差累积导致目标难以可靠到达。已有方法虽尝试多种途径，但"路径幻象"（path mirage）问题仍然存在——智能体过度依赖离线数据集中由随机性造成的虚假成功轨迹，在困难任务上往往失败。

Method: BGP 通过捕捉随机分支结构来解决问题：将高变异性（high-variability）时刻识别为图节点，从而显式表示随机分支点；并为目标条件边设计分段学习（segmented learning）机制，以避开不可靠分支、减少路径上不必要的随机性。由此构建的分支感知图用于规划，实现可靠的目标到达。

Result: 在多种 OGBench 任务上的实验表明，BGP 显著优于先前的离线目标条件RL SOTA 方法，即使在高度随机的长程环境中也能可靠到达目标。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模随机分支结构并对边进行分段学习，BGP 有效缓解了路径幻象问题，为随机长程离线目标条件RL提供了一种可靠的图规划方案；代码已开源。

Abstract: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning remains challenging in stochastic long-horizon settings, where compounding value estimation errors hinder reliable goal reaching. While prior methods have sought to address this challenge through various approaches, a key challenge remains path mirage, where agents overcommit to spuriously successful trajectories in offline datasets induced by stochasticity, often leading to failure on difficult tasks. To address this issue, we propose Branch-aware Graph Planning (BGP), which captures stochastic branching structures by identifying high-variability points as graph nodes and designing goal-conditioned edges with segmented learning to avoid unreliable branches and reduce unnecessary stochasticity along paths. As a result, BGP enables reliable goal reaching even in highly stochastic long-horizon environments, and experiments on diverse OGBench tasks show that it substantially outperforms prior state-of-the-art offline goal-conditioned RL methods. Our implementation is available at https://umlic.github.io/papers/BGP/.

</details>


### [728] [A Deep Learning Framework for Quantile Demand Forecasting in E-commerce with Doubly Censored Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40138)
*Ziwen Ye,Jiawen Wei,Teng Song,Chen Chen,Guangrui Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对零售需求预测中标签因"双重删失"（销量被库存截断、被促销抬升）而模糊的问题，提出一个从双重删失观测中学习分位数（quantile）的简洁深度学习框架，并设计配套评估指标，理论上给出保证，实验上超越基线并验证实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线上零售广泛使用深度学习进行需求预测，分位数估计因能提供不确定性量化而受青睐。但现有研究很少处理目标标签模糊时的不确定性量化：零售中真实销量受库存上限截断（censoring）和临时促销抬升（boosting），而目标是潜在需求，形成"双重删失"场景，且尚无针对此类数据的深度学习流程。

Method: 提出一个从双重删失观测中学习分位数的直接框架，并设计一个专门的评估指标；该方法具有理论保证。

Result: 所提评估指标与oracle校准度量高度相关；估计器在实验中优于现有基线；库存仿真与真实应用验证了方法在零售运营中的实用价值。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了双重删失数据下深度学习分位数估计的空白，在理论上可靠、指标上有效、实验中领先，并在实际零售运营中具有实用价值。

Abstract: In recent years, a growing number of online retail companies have embraced deep learning models for demand forecasting, leveraging their scalability in processing large-scale datasets. Accurate demand forecasts enable improved planning and allow operational flexibility to adjust sales accordingly. Moreover, quantile estimation has gained widespread application as it offers valuable uncertainty quantification, thereby enhancing the robustness of decision-making processes. However, limited research has addressed the effective quantification of uncertainty when target labels are ambiguous. In retail, actual sales can be capped by stock and boosted by temporary promotions, whereas the target is underlying demand. Such scenarios are characterized by double censoring and no deep-learning pipeline yet exists for such data. In this paper, we introduce a straightforward framework for learning quantiles from doubly-censored observations and propose a tailored evaluation metric. Our approach is supported by theoretical guarantees, and we empirically demonstrate that our metric correlates well with the oracle calibration measure. Experimental results show that our estimator surpasses existing baselines. Finally, inventory simulations and real-world applications confirm the practical utility of our method in retail operations.

</details>


### [729] [Mode Dynamics: A Framework for Neural Network Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40143)
*Hossein Honarvar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Mode Dynamics 框架，将神经网络学习过程中协调的参数运动分解为"集体模式"，并将每个模式映射到其状态相关的输出效应，从而把参数轨迹与模型行为变化联系起来。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏将训练中记录的参数轨迹变化与模型输出（行为）变化直接关联的系统性方法，难以解释参数如何在集体层面驱动行为演化。

Method: 框架含三个机制：(1) Decomposition——从参数更新中识别集体模式及其随时间变化的幅值；(2) Reconstruction——检验这些模式诱导的效应能否恢复局部与累积的输出变化；(3) Concentration——量化行为贡献在模式间的分布集中度。并通过受控标量回归与下一 token 预测实验直接检验，再在 CIFAR-100 自编码与 Pythia-70M 预训练轨迹上评估。

Result: 少量主导模式即可重建行为；模式诱导的效应依赖训练路径；模态复杂度随任务与数据变化；在图像自编码和语言模型留出输出上，紧凑的模态子空间与演化中的行为相关联。

Conclusion: 记录的参数运动的紧凑模态子空间能够刻画并解释模型行为的演化，为理解训练动力学与行为之间的对应关系提供了可行框架。

Abstract: We introduce Mode Dynamics, a framework that connects coordinated parameter motion during neural network learning to changes in model outputs. Starting from a recorded parameter trajectory, we decompose its updates into collective modes and map each mode to its state-dependent output effect. The framework organizes this link through three mechanisms. Decomposition identifies collective modes in parameter motion and their time-varying amplitudes. Reconstruction tests whether the effects induced by those modes recover local and accumulated output change. Concentration quantifies how behavioral contribution is distributed across modes. Controlled scalar regression and next-token experiments directly test these mechanisms. They show that small sets of leading modes reconstruct behavior, induced effects depend on the training path, and modal complexity varies with task and data. We then evaluate the framework on held-out image and language-model outputs using CIFAR-100 autoencoding and a public Pythia-70M pretraining trajectory. Across these settings, the results connect compact modal subspaces of recorded parameter motion to evolving behavior.

</details>


### [730] [FARE: Factor-Aware Retrieval with Error-Guided Fusion for Retail Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40160)
*Chenghao Gu,Zhuokang Shen,Shenghao Wu,Tingxuan Zhu,Weiyi Luo,Haifeng Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FARE：面向零售需求预测的因子感知检索与误差引导融合框架，通过分因子检索历史相似周并用门控融合修正基础预测，在四个数据集上将五种骨干模型的WAPE平均降低4.06%–14.63%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 促销与日历事件会重塑短期需求，而目标周的"完整因子组合"在历史上往往鲜有先例，导致难以直接找到可比相似周；因此需要检索信息量大的"部分匹配"历史周，并按各序列的可靠性差异进行加权。

Method: FARE 对目标周的每个已知因子分别对历史周排序，在固定预算下合并选出的周形成"因子参考"；利用已完成开发周的收缩误差和候选间当前分歧，第一道门将因子参考与来自相似销售历史的"形态参考"混合，第二道门控制该混合结果对骨干预测的修正强度，两道门在测试阶段保持固定。

Result: 在 Favorita、M5、Rossmann、Rohlik 上，FARE 使五种骨干模型的 WAPE 分别平均下降 11.46%、4.06%、14.63%、10.16%；在冻结 Chronos-2 的情况下，也优于监督式残差修正、检索增强等传统与现有增强方法。

Conclusion: 基于因子感知检索与误差引导门控融合的后处理增强方法，可通用地提升多种骨干（含冻结基础模型）的零售预测精度，且门控参数离线固定、易于落地。

Abstract: Retail sales forecasting underpins inventory planning, yet promotions and calendar events reshape short-term demand. Although each factor usually has historical occurrences, the complete factor combination of a target week often has few precedents. The challenge is therefore to retrieve informative partial matches and weight them by their reliability, which varies across series. We propose FARE(Factor-Aware Retrieval with Error-Guided Fusion), which ranks historical weeks separately for each known target-week factor and merges the selected weeks into a factor reference under a fixed budget. Guided by shrunk errors from completed development weeks and the current disagreement among candidates, a first gate mixes this factor reference with a shape reference from similar sales histories, and a second gate controls how strongly the mixture corrects a backbone forecast. Both gates remain fixed during testing. On Favorita, M5, Rossmann, and Rohlik, FARE reduces the weighted absolute percentage error (WAPE) of five backbones by 11.46%, 4.06%, 14.63%, and 10.16% on average. With Chronos-2 frozen, FARE also outperforms conventional and existing enhancement methods, including supervised residual correction and retrieval augmentation. Code is available at https://github.com/HousonGu/FARE .

</details>


### [731] [Closing the Log Gap: Minimax-Optimal Regret for Episodic RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40165)
*Guy Zamir,Victor Boone,Matthew Zurek,Yudong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种改进的 UCBVI 算法，首次在无需额外 polylog 因子的情况下达到 $\sqrt{H^3 S A K}$ 的期望遗憾界，并匹配 minimax 下界；同时给出匹配下界的 PAC 最优策略识别算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 episodic tabular MDP 中的遗憾最小化算法在匹配 minimax 下界 $\sqrt{H^3 S A K}$ 时往往带有额外 polylog 因子，作者希望消除这些多余对数项，实现严格匹配下界的期望遗憾。

Method: 提出 UCBVI 的变体：不再维护严格乐观的估计，而采用 MOSS 风格的探索奖励，其对数项同时自适应访问计数与估计方差。关键难点是控制"欠乐观"导致的误差传播，作者用占用度加权（occupancy-weighted）的方式处理，避免逐行均匀集中造成的对数开销；分析中发展了时间一致且方差感知的集中不等式。

Result: 对足够大的 $K$，算法取得首个 $\sqrt{H^3 S A K}$ 量级的期望遗憾界，首次无额外 polylog 因子地匹配 minimax 下界。作为推论，给出 $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-PAC 最优策略识别算法，在某些 regime 下是首个与 $\Omega(H^3 S A \log(1/\delta)\varepsilon^{-2})$ 下界仅差常数的算法。

Conclusion: 通过放弃严格乐观估计、采用方差自适应 MOSS 奖励和占用度加权误差控制，作者在 tabular MDP 中实现了无 polylog 开销的最优遗憾界，并推广到 PAC 最优策略识别问题，其集中不等式工具具有独立价值。

Abstract: In this paper, we study the regret minimization problem in episodic tabular MDPs. Our algorithm achieves the first expected regret bound scaling as $\sqrt{H^3 S A K}$ for sufficiently large $K$, where $H$ is the episode length, $K$ is the number of episodes, and $S$ and $A$ are the numbers of states and actions, respectively. Our method is the first to match the minimax lower bound \emph{without extra polylog factors}. We introduce a variant of UCBVI which does not maintain strictly optimistic estimates, and uses MOSS-style exploration bonuses whose logarithmic terms adapt to both visit counts and estimated variances. A key challenge is controlling the propagation of errors caused by under-optimism, which we accomplish in an occupancy-weighted way, avoiding logarithmic overhead that would be incurred by uniform-over-rows concentration. Our analysis develops time-uniform and variance-aware concentration bounds that may be of independent interest. As a corollary we also develop an algorithm for $(\varepsilon, δ)$-PAC best-policy identification, which is the first to match the $Ω\big(H^3 SA\log(\frac{1}δ)\varepsilon^{-2}\big)$ minimax lower bound up to constants in some regimes.

</details>


### [732] [Learned Terminal Costs for Short-Horizon Model Predictive Control of Autonomous Trucks in Interactive Highway Traffic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40257)
*Hooman Hamze,Benjamin Houshmand,Deepthi Pathare,Erik Börve,Morteza Haghir Chehreghani,Nikolce Murgovski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MPC+RL混合框架：用预训练RL模型估计MPC的终端代价，在重型卡车高速自动驾驶中实现零碰撞且总代价最低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重型卡车质量大、尺寸大、动力学复杂，关键机动更依赖周围交通配合，需在安全约束与高效长时决策间平衡。纯MPC受限于短时域终端代价问题，纯RL缺乏约束保证且稀疏碰撞惩罚下易过度保守。

Method: 有限时域MPC通过动态规划求解，终端代价由预训练RL模型估计；在含反应式周围交通的仿真环境中，与零终端代价纯MPC、基于基础策略的rollout终端代价估计、纯RL进行对比。

Result: 混合方法实现零碰撞，且在所有对比配置中总代价最低。

Conclusion: 以RL估计终端代价可弥补短时域MPC的短视，同时保留MPC约束满足性，是卡车高速自动驾驶的有效方案。

Abstract: Autonomous highway driving for heavy-duty trucks is a challenging control problem. The greater mass, dimensions and intricate dynamics increase the requirements for cooperation from surrounding traffic in critical maneuvers, requiring a careful balance between safety constraints and efficient long-horizon decision making. Model Predictive Control (MPC) provides rigorous constraint satisfaction but relies on terminal cost which can limit its effectiveness at short, computationally affordable horizons. Reinforcement Learning (RL) captures long-term driving behavior but offers no constraint guarantees and tends toward overly conservative policies when trained under sparse collision penalties. In this paper, we propose a hybrid MPC and RL framework for highway driving in autonomous trucks, where a finite-horizon MPC, solved via dynamic programming, uses a pre-trained RL model for terminal cost estimation. We evaluate the framework in a simulation environment with reactive surrounding traffic and compare it against pure MPC with zero terminal cost, rollout with terminal cost estimation using a base policy, and pure RL. Results show that the hybrid approach achieves zero collisions with the lowest cost of any configuration.

</details>


### [733] [From MS/MS evidence to adaptive spectroscopic characterization: Reinforcement learning guided by candidate molecular structures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40264)
*Bowen Gao,Lei Zhu,Yiying Wang,Wenjie Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出结构感知深度Q网络(SI-DQN)，利用MS/MS已有证据决定是否需要追加IR/NMR测量、测哪种、何时停止，在模拟多模态谱数据上将Top-1准确率从约80%/70%提升至93%+，且平均仅需0.23/0.34次额外测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小分子鉴定仅凭串联质谱(MS/MS)往往不足，需互补测量，但现有流程缺乏"是否追加、追加哪种、何时停止"的量化决策依据，易造成测量浪费或鉴定不确定。

Method: 将序贯测量选择建模为强化学习问题，构建SI-DQN策略：融合谱图表示与候选排序，并加入按得分加权的候选化学特征与结构差异描述符；在Multimodal Spectroscopic Dataset的79,462个留出样本上，用模拟MS/MS、IR、NMR谱评测，采用固定困难候选集与等归一化采集成本，并与完整采集、规则策略及普通DQN对比（三次训练取平均）。

Result: 正离子起点Top-1由80.10%升至93.78%，负离子由70.44%升至93.31%，平均额外测量仅0.227/0.340次；相比完整采集(97.72%、4次额外测量)测量数减少94.3%/91.5%；相比规则策略复合损失降低19.3%/25.5%；加入结构信息在各次训练中均提升准确率并减少请求，且在高结构分歧组中请求率提升更明显、复合损失下降更多。

Conclusion: 利用MS/MS后候选结构间的歧义指导后续表征是有效的，SI-DQN为识别性能与测量投入之间的权衡提供了量化依据，可在几乎不牺牲精度的前提下大幅降低额外测量开销。

Abstract: Small-molecule identification from tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) may require complementary measurements. Herein, we propose a structure-informed deep Q-network (SI-DQN) that uses existing MS/MS evidence to decide whether further characterization is needed, which measurement to request, and when to stop. The policy combines spectral representations and candidate rankings with score-weighted descriptors of the candidates' chemical features and structural differences. The policy was evaluated on 79,462 held-out samples with simulated MS/MS, infrared (IR), and nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectra from the Multimodal Spectroscopic Dataset. Evaluation used fixed hard candidate sets containing the correct structure and equal normalized acquisition costs. Averaged across three training runs, SI-DQN increased Top-1 accuracy from 80.10% to 93.78% for positive-ion MS/MS starts and from 70.44% to 93.31% for negative-ion starts. The corresponding mean additional measurement counts were only 0.227 and 0.340 per sample, respectively. Complete acquisition achieved 97.72% accuracy with four additions, whereas SI-DQN reduced the additional measurement count by 94.3% and 91.5%. Relative to a rule-based policy, SI-DQN reduced the composite loss combining terminal ranking error and acquisition cost by 19.3% and 25.5%. Adding structural information to DQN further improved accuracy while reducing requests across all three training runs. At comparable ranking uncertainty, SI-DQN increased request rates relative to DQN more strongly in groups with high structural disagreement, where larger reductions in composite loss were also observed. Together, these results support using the ambiguity among candidate structures after MS/MS analysis to guide further characterization, providing a quantitative basis for balancing identification performance against subsequent measurement effort.

</details>


### [734] [Latent Prediction Yields Cross-Subject Alignable Representations in Sensory-Evoked fMRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40280)
*Serwan Jassim,Victoria Bosch,Daniel Anthes,Elia Bruni,Tim Kietzmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出用自监督学习的JEPA架构，仅用fMRI脑数据训练被试特异性编码器，在下游任务（脑描述生成、图像重建、跨被试泛化）上达到与使用图像和语言数据的监督流水线相当的性能，并实现无监督的跨被试对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: fMRI解码是认知神经科学的核心工具，但自监督学习在该领域探索甚少。现有监督流水线依赖大量图像和语言数据、参数多且端到端训练。作者希望验证：仅用脑数据本身的自监督表征能否支撑强大的下游性能，并减少对图像和共享刺激的依赖。

Method: 将联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）适配到fMRI，在Natural Scenes Dataset（NSD）上为每个被试训练独立编码器，训练过程中编码器完全不接触刺激图像或其衍生表征。在脑描述生成和图像重建任务上评估所学脑嵌入，并考察跨被试泛化；随后对独立训练的被试编码器进行完全无监督的对齐（不使用图像或共享刺激），并用一个被试训练的解码头直接应用于另一被试（无需微调）。

Result: 自监督方法在与使用图像和语言数据端到端训练的、参数丰富的监督流水线对比中取得有竞争力的性能。独立训练的被试编码器可在完全无监督下对齐；对齐后，跨被试应用解码头无需微调即可在图像重建和脑描述生成上保留大部分被试内性能。

Conclusion: 通过消除对图像和共享刺激的依赖，该自监督JEPA方法为跨被试乃至跨数据集汇聚fMRI数据迈出了一步。

Abstract: Decoding sensory-evoked functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data is a central analytical tool in cognitive neuroscience. Here we ask whether self-supervised learning (SSL), which has been scarcely explored in this domain, can yield representations that support strong downstream performance. To do so, we adapt a joint embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) to train participant-specific encoders on brain data alone. The encoders never see the stimulus images or any representation derived from them. Applied to the Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD), we evaluate our learned brain embeddings on the downstream tasks of brain captioning and image reconstruction, as well as cross-participant generalization. Our self-supervised approach achieves competitive performance with parameter-rich supervised pipelines that are trained end-to-end with access to image and language data. We further find that encoders trained independently for different participants can be aligned fully unsupervised, using neither images nor stimuli shared between them. After alignment, a neural decoding head trained on one participant can be applied to another without fine-tuning and retains most of its within-subject performance on image reconstruction and brain captioning. By removing the need for images and shared stimuli, our approach is a step towards pooling fMRI data across participants and, eventually, across datasets.

</details>


### [735] [DolphinRouting: Cluster-Level Binary Routing for Disaggregated LLM Inference Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40292)
*Yishuo Yuan,Shaoyu Yang,Chunrong Fang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DolphinRouting 为 PD 分离的 LLM 服务提供请求级路径选择：按提示长度、两个 worker 池的缓存调整后输入长度和输出长度聚类，离线学习每个簇的二值决策（本地/远程 prefill），在线查表路由，在真实集群上将 P90 TTFT 降低 5.7–7.9%、P90 TPOT 降低 2.6–10.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PD 分离解耦了 prefill 与 decode，但请求级路径选择需同时权衡 prefill 负载、KV 缓存复用和 decode 需求，已有方案难以综合这些因素做出最优选择。

Method: 基于端到端 SLO 反馈在给定 P/D 资源分配下学习路由策略：以原始提示长度、两个 worker 池上缓存调整后的输入长度及输出长度信息进行聚类（如 k-means），离线策略搜索为每个簇学习一个二值动作；在线仅做特征提取、簇分配和查表，选择本地或远程 prefill。

Result: 在真实 PD 分离集群上，使用三个公开基准、混合负载和真实数据评测；混合负载与真实数据下，k-means 版本相比 Dynamo 将 P90 TTFT 降低 5.7–7.9%，P90 TPOT 降低 2.6–10.1%。

Conclusion: 轻量级的聚类加离线策略搜索加在线查表路由可有效提升 PD 分离服务性能，且在线开销低、部署简单。

Abstract: Prefill-decode (PD) disaggregation isolates the two phases of large language model serving, but request-level path selection must account for prefill work, cache reuse, and decode demand. We present DolphinRouting, which learns this choice from end-to-end SLO feedback under a given P/D resource allocation. Requests are clustered by raw prompt length, cache-adjusted input lengths on both worker pools, and output-length information. Offline policy search learns one binary action per cluster. Online feature extraction, cluster assignment, and table lookup select local or remote prefill. We evaluate DolphinRouting on a real PD-disaggregated cluster using three public benchmarks, a mixed workload, and real data. Across the mixed workload and real data, DolphinRouting with $k$-means reduces P90 TTFT by 5.7--7.9\% and P90 TPOT by 2.6--10.1\% relative to Dynamo.

</details>


### [736] [Causal-prior-constrained deep learning for rapid-intensification warning of western North Pacific tropical cyclones](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40304)
*Xinrui Li,Yijun Jin,Yifan Dong,Shoujuan Shu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出因果先验约束的深度学习系统CausalVisionRI，融合红外遥感、大气海洋场与观测发现的因果图，实现西北太平洋24小时快速增强预警，BSS达0.259，显著优于参考系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 热带气旋快速增强（RI）危险且难预测，其环境与结构驱动因子在观测中难以识别和分离，传统方法缺乏可审计的物理依据。

Method: 基于2000-2017年522个气旋构建观测发现的因果图，并结合8个符号验证的效应作为可审计因果先验；将红外遥感影像、大气海洋场与因果图整合为统一模型（五成员集成），因果图通过图通路参与训练。

Result: 在2020-2024年前向留出集3004条记录上，BSS为0.259（相对固定发展气候态），显著超过四个参考系统（LDA基线最高仅0.105）；在匹配虚警率下检出率高于已发表的知识块方案与重构对比学习方案；消融显示图通路在全留出集增加0.032 BSS、2020-2021年增加0.063，且在一个集成成员中贡献显著。

Conclusion: 以观测发现的因果结构约束深度学习模型，可为物理可解释的RI预警提供新路径。

Abstract: Rapid intensification (RI) is one of the most dangerous and unpredictable phases of tropical cyclones, and its environmental and structural drivers are difficult to identify and separate in observations. Here we introduce CausalVisionRI, a causal-prior-constrained deep-learning system for 24-h RI warning in the western North Pacific. It integrates infrared remote sensing imagery, atmospheric and oceanic fields, and an observationally discovered causal graph into a unified model. The graph and eight sign-verified effects on 24-h intensity change provide an auditable causal prior for training. Discovered from 522 cyclones in 2000-2017, it identifies causal pathways linking atmospheric and oceanic conditions, the cyclone's dynamical and structural state, and its 24-h intensity change. On a forward holdout covering 2020-2024 and 3,004 records, the five-member ensemble achieves a Brier skill score (BSS) of 0.259 relative to a fixed development climatology, significantly exceeding four reference systems; the three LDA baselines reach at most 0.105. It also attains higher detection rates than a published knowledge-block scheme and a reconstructed contrastive-learning scheme at matched false-detection rates under our USA 30-kt standard and the published RITCF standard. Ablations show that the graph pathway adds 0.032 BSS across the holdout and 0.063 over 2020-2021, with a significant contribution in one ensemble member. A deep-learning model constrained by observationally discovered causal structure thus offers a new route to physically informed RI warning.

</details>


### [737] [How to Loop Your Transformer: Loop Scaling, Specialization, and Parallel Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40325)
*Chanakya Ekbote,Artidoro Pagnoni,Devendra Singh Sachan,Shruti Bhosale,Mike Lewis,Maryam Fazel-Zarandi,Shashank Rajput,Sujan Kumar Gonugondla*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究dense decoder-only transformer中的looping（重复使用权重加深模型）在不同资源约束下的权衡：完整transformer循环在固定参数预算下质量最优，中层block循环在训练FLOPs受限时收益更好；加入loop-specific低秩adapter可提升深层循环收益，并改进Parallel Loop Transformer以恢复质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Looping能否有用取决于哪种约束占主导：模型规模、训练计算量还是自回归推理效率。此前缺少对这三者联合权衡的系统研究，也未厘清强制各循环共享权重是否限制了深层循环的收益。

Method: 从头训练dense decoder-only transformer，变化三方面：循环模型的哪些部分、循环次数（最多32次）、循环间信息传递方式。实验规模达1B参数、155B tokens、1.07e21 FLOPs。为解决共享权重限制，加入小的loop-specific低秩adapter；并针对Parallel Loop Transformer（跨相邻token位置传递隐状态以并行各循环阶段）进行改进：保留当前token embedding，并分别归一化当前token embedding与前一token隐状态后再合并。

Result: 固定参数预算下，循环完整transformer质量最强；训练FLOPs受限时循环中层block回报更佳。增加循环并非一致有益：增益会饱和、反转或变得不稳定。loop-specific低秩adapter提升质量，循环越多增益越大。原始Parallel Loop Transformer不能稳定保持普通循环的质量增益，而所提出的保留当前token embedding并分别归一化的修改在多种模型规模和训练预算下恢复了强性能。

Conclusion: 有效的looping需要将设计匹配到具体的资源约束和推理场景：参数受限用完整循环、计算受限用中层block循环；深层循环需配合loop-specific adapter；并行循环需修正信息传递与归一化方式才能保留质量。

Abstract: Looping in transformer models reuses weights by repeatedly applying the same transformer, or parts of it, making the model deeper without increasing its parameter count. Whether looping is useful depends on which constraint dominates: model size, training compute, or autoregressive inference efficiency. We study these trade-offs jointly in dense decoder-only transformers trained from scratch, varying which parts of the model are looped, how many loops are applied, and how information is passed between loops. Our experiments span models with up to 1B parameters, trained on up to 155B tokens with up to $1.07\times10^{21}$ FLOPs and 32 loops. We find that looping the full transformer generally gives the strongest quality at a fixed parameter budget, whereas looping a middle block of layers gives a better return when training FLOPs are constrained. Adding loops is not uniformly beneficial: gains eventually saturate, reverse, or become unstable. This motivates asking whether forcing every loop to use the same weights limits the benefit of deeper looping. We address this by adding small loop-specific low-rank adapters that improve quality, with larger gains as more loops are added. Looped transformers also suffer a decoding slowdown proportional to the number of loops. Parallel Loop Transformers address this by passing hidden states between loops across adjacent token positions, allowing loop stages to run concurrently. However, in our experiments the original formulation does not consistently retain the quality gains of ordinary looping. We find that preserving the current-token embedding and separately normalizing it and the previous-token hidden state before combining them recovers strong performance across model scales and training budgets. Together, these results show that effective looping requires matching the design to the resource constraint and inference setting.

</details>


### [738] [A Unified Hessian-Guided Framework for Post-Training Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40345)
*Mads Toftrup,Marco Federici,Boris van Breugel,Paul Whatmough,Markus Nagel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个基于Hessian引导（Fisher近似）的统一后训练量化框架，将量化范围、线性变换与权重舍入三部分联合优化，以输出敏感度为目标，在通道级与块级量化下均优于现有变换与舍入方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低比特量化对LLM高效部署很关键，但高精度需同时决定量化范围、线性变换和权重舍入。现有方法用局部重建目标独立优化各组件，忽略了量化误差对下游预测的影响差异；直接优化任务级指标又因量化不可导和评估代价高而困难。

Method: 推导权重与激活联合量化引起输出变化的Hessian引导近似，基于可处理的Fisher近似构建统一PTQ框架，在共同的输出敏感度目标下联合优化量化范围、线性变换和权重舍入，并保证对现代LLM的计算可行性。

Result: 在通道级和块级量化设置下，该方法一致优于当前最优的变换方法与舍入方法。

Conclusion: 以输出敏感度为统一目标联合优化量化各组件，是替代局部重建目标的有效途径，可在低比特下获得更高精度且保持实用性。

Abstract: Low-bit quantization enables efficient deployment of large language models by reducing memory footprint and computational cost. Achieving high accuracy at low precision requires selecting quantization ranges, linear transformations, and weight rounding decisions. Existing approaches typically optimize these components independently using local reconstruction objectives, which fail to account for the varying impact of quantization errors on downstream predictions. Direct optimization of task-level metrics would provide a more faithful objective, but is challenging due to the discontinuous nature of quantization operations and the high computational cost of evaluating their downstream effects.
  In this work, we derive a Hessian-guided approximation of the output change induced by joint weight and activation quantization. Based on a tractable Fisher approximation, we formulate a unified post-training quantization framework that enables the joint optimization of quantization ranges, linear transformations, and weight rounding under a common output-sensitivity objective. The resulting method remains practical for modern large language models and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art transformation and rounding methods across both channel-wise and block-wise quantization settings.

</details>


### [739] [Your LR Schedule May Not Be Principled: Effective Learning Rate Scheduling in Weight-Normalized Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40362)
*Qifan Yu,Xinyu Ma,Xingyan Bin,Di He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: WN的预训练收益主要来自有效学习率(ELR)轨迹而非归一化本身；据此提出AIR调度(1/√t衰减+仿射调整)，在128B token MoE预训练中优于cosine，末端损失降低约0.01。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究显示权重归一化(WN)训练相比权重衰减(WD)可带来显著预训练损失收益，但其增益来源不明；作者希望厘清WN与WD差异的真正驱动因素，并据此设计更好的学习率调度。

Method: 通过匹配ELR轨迹验证WN与WD的训练动态是否收敛一致；基于理论推导的1/√t衰减提出AIR(Affine Inverse-square-Root decay)调度，用仿射调整在有限训练步内满足指定的峰值与终端学习率；并分析后期ELR调度的影响。

Result: 匹配ELR后WN与WD的训练损失动态基本一致；后期共享调度会削弱早期LR选择的影响；128B token MoE预训练中AIR在训练损失、下游性能与超参鲁棒性上均优于cosine等候选调度，在相同累计LR下末端损失约降低0.01；将同一ELR轨迹应用于WD可复现相应动态。

Conclusion: ELR是原则性的调度对象，收益不局限于固定范数训练；调度设计应以ELR而非名义LR为目标，AIR是有效实现。

Abstract: Weight-normalized (WN) training is emerging as a compelling alternative to conventional weight decay (WD), with recent studies reporting substantial pretraining loss gains. We show that these gains are driven primarily by the induced effective learning rate (ELR) trajectory rather than by normalization alone. Matching ELR trajectories largely collapses the training loss dynamics of WN and WD. Schedule design should therefore target ELR rather than the nominal learning rate (LR) alone. Building on this principle, we propose AIR (Affine Inverse-square-Root decay), which combines a theoretically derived $1/\sqrt{t}$ decay with an affine adjustment to satisfy prescribed peak and terminal LRs over a finite training horizon. We further identify late-stage ELR scheduling as a key source of its gains, because a shared late schedule attenuates the effect of earlier LR choices. Experiments on 128 B-token Mixture-of-Experts pretraining demonstrate that AIR outperforms cosine and other candidate schedules in training loss, downstream performance, and hyperparameter robustness, reducing terminal training loss by approximately 0.01 relative to cosine at matched cumulative LR. Applying the same ELR trajectory to WD reproduces the corresponding training dynamics, showing that the benefits extend beyond fixed-norm training and establishing ELR as the principled scheduling object.

</details>


### [740] [Is It the Curriculum or Just the Easy Start? Benchmarking Unsupervised Environment Design on Quadrupeds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40364)
*Jakub Gilewicz,Dominik Galus,Piotr Wojdas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一基准，在MuJoCo MJX中于五台3D四足机器人上以相同协议评测14种无监督环境设计(UED)、域随机化与机器人课程学习方法，并给出按机器人选择课程的指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有UED方法（PLR、ACCEL、SFL、PAIRED）多在2D迷宫、网格世界和BipedalWalker上比较，而足式机器人的地形课程多为手工设计且仅对比少量基线，缺乏统一、可复现的横向评测。

Method: 构建统一基准：5台四足机器人（闭链W01-TEK，开链Unitree Go1/Go2、Google Barkour vB、Boston Dynamics Spot），在MuJoCo MJX中运行14种UED、域随机化与机器人课程方法；关卡表示为8维可解释地形参数向量；所有课程驱动同一PPO学生网络并在等环境步数预算下训练。评估包括随机与留出结构化地形的成功率、带分层自助法区间的四分位均值、能力包络线及逐关卡支配性比较，并在每个机器人和关卡集上给出不显著逊于最优的"顶级方法组"。

Result: 没有任何方法在全部机器人和关卡集上进入顶级组。简单/低难度训练关卡（无论是否经过筛选）在Go1、Barkour的分布内随机关卡以及W01-TEK（除PAIRED+BiBC外）中占据顶级组；来自足式机器人实践的"成功驱动地形课程"最常进入顶级组，均匀关卡上的域随机化从未进入，PAIRED在Spot以外也从未进入；在Spot难度0.25的随机关卡上，14种方法差距在3.8个百分点以内。三台机器人上，分布内随机关卡的领先者并非留出地形上的领先者。

Conclusion: UED方法在不同四足机器人间表现不一致，尚不存在普适最优课程；分布内表现与泛化到留出地形存在错位。论文据此整理出按机器人选择课程的实用指南。

Abstract: Unsupervised environment design (UED) methods such as PLR, ACCEL, SFL and PAIRED are compared mostly on 2D mazes, grid worlds and BipedalWalker, while terrain curricula for legged robots are hand-designed and evaluated against a few baselines. We present a benchmark that runs fourteen UED, domain-randomisation and robotics curricula under one protocol on five 3D quadrupeds in MuJoCo MJX: the closed-chain W01-TEK and the open-chain Unitree Go1 and Go2, Google Barkour vB and Boston Dynamics Spot. Levels are vectors of eight interpretable terrain parameters, and all curricula drive the same PPO student at matched environment-step budgets. The evaluation reports success on random and held-out structured terrains, interquartile means with stratified bootstrap intervals, capability envelopes and a level-by-level domination comparison. We compare methods within each robot and report, per level set, the top group of methods not significantly below the best. No method is in the top group on every robot and level set. Methods with easy or low-difficulty training levels, curated or not, fill the top groups on in-distribution random levels of Go1 and Barkour, and of W01-TEK apart from PAIRED+BiBC. The success-driven terrain curriculum from legged-robot practice is in a top group most often, domain randomisation on uniform levels in none, and PAIRED in none outside Spot, where the fourteen methods lie within 3.8 points on random levels of difficulty 0.25. On three robots the leader on in-distribution random levels is not the leader on held-out terrain. We collect the results into a per-robot guide to choosing a curriculum.

</details>


### [741] [Composing and Steering Diffusion Models with Generalized Feynman-Kac Correctors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40383)
*Wael Mattar,Daniel Freedman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出广义Feynman-Kac校正器(GFKC)，可从多个预训练扩散模型的任意目标函数组合中正确采样，无需重训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多应用需要从多个预训练模型定义的分布组合（可能带下游奖励倾斜）中采样，而非单一模型分布。直接组合各模型分数会产生错误样本，现有校正方法仅限特定目标族。

Method: 证明初始函数与目标函数间的几何插值满足Feynman-Kac偏微分方程并推导闭式势函数；推广对数概率ODE以沿不同速度场轨迹追踪各模型密度；算法完全在对数域运行，支持奖励引导与在线校正。

Result: 在解析高斯模型上与真实目标高度吻合；在MNIST扩散模型上实现了非平凡模型组合采样及有效引导。

Conclusion: GFKC为多预训练扩散模型任意目标组合采样提供了原理性框架，集成奖励引导且无需重训练或微调。

Abstract: Diffusion models have become the leading paradigm in generative modeling, yet many applications require sampling from distributions that are not those of any single pretrained model, but are instead defined through combinations of several models, possibly tilted toward high values of a downstream reward. Naively combining the scores of the models yields incorrect samples, while existing corrections are restricted to specific families of targets. In this work, we introduce the generalized Feynman-Kac correctors (GFKC), a principled framework for sampling from an arbitrary target function of several pretrained diffusion models. We show that the geometric interpolation between an arbitrary initial function and the target function of the models satisfies a Feynman--Kac partial differential equation, and derive its potential in closed form. To evaluate this potential during generation, we further generalize the log-probability ODE to track the density of each model along trajectories driven by a different velocity field. The resulting algorithm operates entirely in the log domain, incorporates reward-based steering at no additional conceptual cost, and corrects the generation on the fly, without retraining or fine-tuning the models. We validate the method on analytic Gaussian models, where it closely matches the ground-truth targets, and on diffusion models trained on MNIST, where it samples from non-trivial combinations of the models and enables effective steering.

</details>


### [742] [SCARL: Sequence Confidence-Aligned Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40407)
*Zhenghong Ke,Jingbo Zhou,Hua Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SCARL，通过对齐"序列置信度"与"优势/结果"来重塑RLVR中的优势函数，在Qwen3-4B-Base上Pass@32提升2.4点，并缓解熵塌缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR用规则验证器给采样回复打分并强化通过者，但策略对某回复的置信度与其奖励之间无任何约束：优势函数对置信度"盲视"。这造成序列-置信度错配——勉强成功的回复与高确定性的成功获得相同更新，自信错误与试探性错误被同等纠正，从而阻碍探索并加剧熵塌缩。

Method: SCARL对每个优势做归一化重塑而不通过重新签名来改变其正负：计算回复的组相对置信度与该优势所认证结果之间的"对齐差距"，将其归一化为各类别优势预算中的份额，再据此缩放优势。错配样本承担更多更新力度，使得同一优势对应的回复被推向相同置信度；类别内置信度一致时方法可证明退化为基估计器。不增加额外前向计算，仅引入一个超参数。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B-Base上平均Pass@32比DAPO高2.4点，在覆盖度与单次采样准确率上均为9个算力匹配方法中最佳；在4种估计器×4种骨干网络上共16种设置中有14种提升，同时保持策略熵并拉大置信度-正确性的区分度。

Conclusion: 序列-置信度错配是RLVR中被忽视的关键问题，SCARL以极低开销重塑优势即可同时提升推理性能与探索能力，具备良好的可迁移性和通用性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves language-model reasoning by scoring sampled responses with a rule-based verifier and reinforcing those that pass. Where a classifier's training couples predicted probability to labels, nothing ties an RLVR policy's confidence in a response to its reward: aligned training would drive responses with the same advantage toward equal confidence, yet the advantage is blind to confidence. Under this sequence-confidence misalignment, a success the policy barely found earns the same update as one it produces with near certainty, and a confident error is corrected no harder than an exploratory one. We propose SCARL (Sequence Confidence-Aligned Reinforcement Learning), which reshapes, but never re-signs, each advantage with the alignment gap between the response's group-relative confidence and the outcome its advantage certifies, normalized into shares of each class's advantage budget. Misaligned samples absorb the force, responses with the same advantage are driven toward equal confidence, and repairing the misalignment doubles as a remedy for the entropy collapse that erodes exploration. SCARL provably reduces to its base estimator when a class's confidences agree, adds no extra passes and one hyperparameter. On Qwen3-4B-Base it lifts average Pass@32 by 2.4 points over DAPO and is best among nine compute-matched methods on both coverage and per-draw accuracy; applied unchanged across four estimators and four backbones, it improves 14 of 16 settings while preserving policy entropy and widening the confidence-correctness separation. Our code is available at https://github.com/kezhh163/scarl.

</details>


### [743] [IMPACT: Inverter-Informed Multimodal Learning for Photovoltaic Generation Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40418)
*Anushka Katiyar,Cong Feng,Jing Wang,Tristan Liu,Simon Julien,Zachary Jacobs*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出物理信息驱动的多模态深度学习框架，实现10–110分钟超前光伏概率预测，FSS达0.2950，超越14个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 短时到中时（10–110分钟）光伏功率概率预测需同时融合电站时序历史、逆变器级空间云动态、太阳几何与气象状态等多源信息，并保持不确定性校准能力，现有方法难以兼顾。

Method: 四分支架构：1) 图注意力编码器（学习邻接）建模逆变器级空间云动态；2) 电站级时序历史；3) 已知未来太阳几何，引入空间云异质性与逆变器降额活动两个前向物理信号并按时域加权；4) 当前气象状态。分支经门控交叉注意力融合；解码器以智能持续性基线为锚，学习按前瞻时域条件的修正量，输出分位数预测，再经核加权自适应保形校准在线调整。

Result: 优于全部14个基线，FSS=0.2950，比次优模型高0.099；分支消融显示各分支均有正贡献；在阴天与多变天空条件下仍保持技能（FSS 0.198与0.255）。

Conclusion: 多分支+物理先验+基线锚定修正+在线保形校准的组合能有效提升短中期光伏概率预测的精度与鲁棒性。

Abstract: This work develops a physics-informed multimodal deep learning framework for 10- to 110-minute-ahead probabilistic photovoltaic power forecasting. The forecasting model is built on a four-branch architecture that separately encodes plant-level temporal history and inverter-level spatial cloud dynamics through a graph attention encoder with a learned adjacency, known-future solar geometry, and the current meteorological state, fused through gated cross-attention. The geometry branch adds two forward-looking physical signals, spatial cloud heterogeneity and inverter ramp-down activity, each empirically weighted toward the horizon where it is most predictive. The decoder anchors its prediction to a smart persistence baseline, learning a horizon-conditioned correction, and the resulting quantile forecasts are calibrated online through a kernel-weighted adaptive conformal calibration step. The proposed model outperforms all 14 baselines, achieving a forecast skill score (FSS) of 0.2950, 0.099 above the next-best model. A branch-composition ablation shows that every branch contributes positively and the model retains substantial skill in challenging overcast and variable sky conditions (FSS 0.198 and 0.255).

</details>


### [744] [Towards Diverse and Comprehensive Benchmarks for Mutual Information Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03487)
*Alberto Foresti,Ivan Butakov,Alexander Tolmachev,Giulio Franzese,Alexey Frolov,Pietro Michiardi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的 copula 理论基准框架，涵盖两类互补测试家族，揭示互信息估计器没有通用赢家，并分析根本性估计瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有互信息估计基准多局限于简化的低维分布，无法反映估计器在复杂真实数据上的表现，因此需要一个更全面、更贴近现实的评测框架。

Method: 基于统一 copula 视角构建基准，提出"copula-first"（系统变化真值MI、维度、边缘复杂度，用合成与流变换）和"marginals-first"（将真实图像与受控依赖结构耦合，扩展同类配对范式）两类测试族，评测非参数、判别式、生成式三类估计器。

Result: 与主流假设相反，没有哪类估计器普遍最优：每类都能在特定设置下系统性优于其他方法。据此识别出根本性估计障碍，并提出更有针对性的新测试。

Conclusion: 互信息估计不存在普适最优方法，估计器选择高度依赖具体设定；该基准与新增测试为识别和突破估计瓶颈提供了工具，代码已开源。

Abstract: Mutual information (MI) estimation is a central problem in machine learning and statistics; however, existing benchmarks typically evaluate estimators on simplified, low-dimensional distributions, leaving their performance on complex, realistic data largely unexplored. We address this gap with a comprehensive benchmarking framework grounded in a unified copula-theoretic perspective that subsumes existing benchmarks as special cases. Within this framework, we propose two complementary families of tests: a copula-first family that systematically varies ground-truth MI, dimensionality, and marginal complexity using synthetic and flow-based transformations; and a marginals-first family that couples real-world image data with controlled dependency structures, extending the classic same-class-pairing paradigm. We use this suite to extensively evaluate three classes of estimators: non-parametric, discriminative, and generative. Contrary to prevailing assumptions, our results indicate that there is no universal winner: each category can systematically outperform all other estimators under specific setups. By analyzing these cases, we identify fundamental estimation barriers and propose new tests that more effectively stress these specific limitations. We share the open source code at https://github.com/VanessB/mutinfo.

</details>


### [745] [NECA: Neighbor Event Curve Augmentation for Multi-Horizon ICU Deterioration Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40420)
*Chenyang Wang,Jiawei Theresa Tang,Xinran Liu,Xinyu Lu,Xulei Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出NECA（近邻事件曲线增强），一种模型无关方法：检索早期窗口相似的训练集患者，把其后续器官功能障碍事件发生时间转成6h/12h/24h/42h累积事件曲线特征，拼接原表征后供任意下游监督模型使用，在多任务多模型上提升预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ICU早期记录预测短期器官特异性风险困难：测量不规则、变量异质、需跨多个未来时域预测。现有监督模型将患者视为孤立样本，未显式利用相似历史患者的事件时间信息。

Method: NECA：对每个患者，在训练集中检索早期窗口画像相似的近邻患者；将其后续器官功能障碍事件发生时间转换为多个时域（6/12/24/42h）上的累积事件曲线特征；与原始患者表征拼接，交由标准下游预测器。方法模型无关、可作为通用增强模块。

Result: 在PhysioNet 2012与MIMIC-IV 4000条住院子集上，跨4类器官功能障碍事件任务、7种监督学习器，平均PR-AUC与ROC-AUC均提升。神经系统事件增益最大，PhysioNet 2012上任务级平均PR-AUC从0.461升至0.557。消融显示：有临床意义的检索与各时域近邻风险贡献主要增益，完整累积曲线提供任务相关的时间上下文。

Conclusion: 相似患者的事件时序是一种结构化的时间风险信号，可有效用于ICU器官功能障碍事件预测；代码将在论文录用后公开。

Abstract: Early prediction of ICU organ dysfunction events supports timely clinical monitoring and intervention, but estimating short-term organ-specific risk from early ICU records remains challenging due to irregular measurements, heterogeneous clinical variables, and the need to predict risk across multiple future horizons. Existing supervised models usually treat each patient as an isolated sample and do not explicitly use the observed event timing of similar historical patients. We propose Neighbor Event-Curve Augmentation (NECA), a model-agnostic method that retrieves training-set patients with similar early-window profiles and converts their subsequent organ dysfunction event onset times into cumulative event-curve features over 6h, 12h, 24h, and 42h. These features are concatenated with the original patient representation and used by standard downstream predictors. On PhysioNet 2012 and a 4,000-stay MIMIC-IV subset, NECA improves average PR-AUC and ROC-AUC across four organ dysfunction event tasks and seven supervised learners. The largest gain appears for neurological dysfunction events, where task-level average PR-AUC increases from 0.461 to 0.557 on PhysioNet 2012. Ablations show that clinically meaningful retrieval and horizon-specific neighbor risk drive most of the improvement, while the full cumulative curve adds task-dependent temporal context. These results support similar-patient event timing as a structured temporal risk signal for ICU organ dysfunction event prediction. The source code will be publicly released upon acceptance of this paper.

</details>


### [746] [Uncertainty-aware Feedback Loop Diagnosis: integrating reinforcement learning and conformal prediction for reliable wafer defect classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40421)
*Aleksandr Dekhovich,Carlas Smith,Oleg Soloviev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: UFLD结合强化学习与保形预测，实现晶圆图缺陷检测的自适应采样与最优停止，减少约40%采集时间并达98.4%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 半导体制造需高精度低成本检测，但现有深度学习需全表面扫描，制约高通量检测系统发展。

Method: 提出不确定性感知反馈环诊断(UFLD)：用强化学习自适应获取测量；用参数高效的保形预测框架判断最优停止时机，无需集成模型或额外置信度估计网络。

Result: 在MixedWM38数据集上验证，采集时间减少约40%，检测准确率98.4%，优于现有自适应采集方法和标准CNN。

Conclusion: UFLD通过自适应采样与保形预测停止策略，在不牺牲精度的前提下显著提升晶圆检测效率，适用于高通量场景。

Abstract: Semiconductor manufacturing is a complex, multi-step process that requires both high precision and low operating costs. Therefore, detecting defects in a high-volume setting is an important component of wafer map analysis for reliable production. However, most state-of-the-art deep learning approaches require a full scan of the surface, which hinders the development of high-throughput inspection systems. To address this problem, we propose Uncertainty-aware Feedback Loop Diagnosis (UFLD), a novel algorithm that employs reinforcement learning for adaptive measurement acquisition and provides a prediction uncertainty level after each step, stopping the process once sufficient information is obtained. Unlike existing methods that rely on ensemble models or auxiliary confidence estimation deep learning models, UFLD utilizes a more parameter-efficient conformal prediction framework to determine the optimal stopping time. The proposed UFLD reduces acquisition time by about $40\%$ and achieves $98.4\%$ inspection accuracy, without requiring an additional learned confidence-estimation network. We validated our approach on the MixedWM38 dataset, demonstrating its advantages over existing adaptive acquisition procedures and standard convolutional neural networks.

</details>


### [747] [A Pretrained Model for Bayesian Filtering in Heterogeneous Dynamical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40437)
*Ke Fan,Wen Wu,Haitao Su,Yilin Wang,Yuan Zhou,Chao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FilterFM 是首个预训练贝叶斯滤波基础模型，用单一 checkpoint 在异构动力系统上估计潜状态，并首次实现零样本滤波，同时揭示了基础模型滤波中的 scaling 行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 滤波领域缺乏"基础模型时刻"：现有方法要么是需已知动力学的在线贝叶斯滤波，要么是针对单一系统/参数族从头训练的神经网络滤波器。核心难题是结构异构性——不同动力系统在动力学、物理尺度与噪声水平上差异巨大，难以构建可复用滤波器的共享表示空间。

Method: 提出 FilterFM：(1) 分层两级观测序列编码器，处理异构系统间观测维度与状态维度的差异；(2) 先验到后验的状态重建模块；(3) 通过分位数预测建模状态不确定性；(4) 在异构滤波任务混合集上预训练。

Result: 域内性能优越，在估计精度、运行效率和噪声鲁棒性上显著优于现有基线；首次成功实现未见动力学上的零样本滤波，弥合了状态估计的泛化鸿沟；发现清晰的 scaling 规律，并通过全面的组件消融验证了设计的结构最优性。

Conclusion: FilterFM 为贝叶斯滤波建立了统一的可复用预训练范式，兼顾异构系统适配、不确定性建模与零样本泛化，扩展了该研究方向的泛化边界。

Abstract: Filtering has not yet had its foundation-model moment: state estimation is still dominated either by online Bayesian filtering algorithms that require known dy- namics as inputs, or by learning-based neural filters trained from scratch for a single system or parametric family. The core challenge is structural heterogene- ity: dynamical systems differ in their governing dynamics, physical scales, and noise levels, precluding a shared representation space for a reusable filter. To bridge this gap, we introduce FilterFM, the first pretrained model for Bayesian filtering that estimates latent states across heterogeneous dynamical systems with a single checkpoint. FilterFM employs a hierarchical two-level observation se- quence encoder and a prior-to-posterior state-reconstruction module that together handle varying observation and state dimensions across heterogeneous systems, while modeling state uncertainty via quantile prediction. Trained on a mixture of heterogeneous filtering tasks, FilterFM exhibits superior in-domain performance, delivering significant gains in estimation accuracy, runtime efficiency, and noise robustness compared to existing baselines. Beyond in-domain performance, it marks the first model to successfully enable zero-shot filtering on unseen dynamics, bridging the generalization gap in state estimation. Furthermore, we uncover clear scaling behaviors in foundation-model-based Bayesian filtering, which combined with comprehensive component ablation studies, validate the structural optimality of our design and broaden the generalization scope for this research field.

</details>


### [748] [Framework-Conditional Open Materials Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40443)
*Maya M. Martirossyan,Hillary Pan,Philipp Höllmer,Stefano Martiniani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出OMatG-FC框架条件生成范式，固定分数坐标与单位体积晶格矢量，仅生成原子种类和晶胞体积缩放，大幅降维并实现S.U.N.材料新纪录。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 材料生成的核心目标是产出稳定、独特、新颖（S.U.N.）的结构，但现有方法（数据挖掘离子替换、纯de novo生成模型）各自受限；经验表明，满足S.U.N.的预测结构往往是将新化学成分映射到已知结构原型/框架上，因此值得利用这一启发式约束来简化生成问题。

Method: OMatG-FC（Open Materials Framework-Conditional Generation）：以结构框架（晶胞形状与粒子位置）为条件。固定分数坐标与单位体积晶格矢量，对原子种类使用离散流匹配（discrete flow matching），对晶胞晶格体积缩放使用随机插值（stochastic interpolants），从而相比无约束生成显著降低问题维度。此外统计MP-20中唯一框架数量，揭示数据集中重复框架问题，并提供按框架划分（framework-split）的版本。

Result: 在LeMat-GenBench基准上，用三种机器学习原子间势评估，取得凸包以下S.U.N.率的最优（state-of-the-art）表现；相比原型约束方法更灵活，可从已知框架出发发现未见过的稳定原型；无需学习原子堆积（atomic packings）即可完成材料发现。

Conclusion: 框架条件生成是高效的材料发现范式：把生成任务限制在原子种类与晶胞体积尺度上即可获得高质量S.U.N.结构，同时框架划分基准揭示了数据集中框架重复带来的评估偏差，值得后续工作采用。

Abstract: Theoretical predictions of novel materials rely on a variety of techniques, from data-mining-based ion substitution methods to fully de novo generative models. Each approach imposes specific constraints and encounters unique challenges when extrapolating beyond the distribution of known materials to discover new ones. The foremost goal of materials generation is to produce stable, unique, and novel (S.U.N.) structures. Predicted structures that meet these criteria, however, typically result from novel chemical compositions mapped onto known structural prototypes or frameworks. We leverage this heuristic insight to present a new generative paradigm for the de novo prediction of inorganic crystalline materials constrained by their structural framework---i.e., the unit cell shapes and respective particle positions. Our method, termed OMatG-FC (Open Materials Framework-Conditional Generation), learns via a combination of discrete flow matching on the atomic species and stochastic interpolants for the volume scaling of the unit cell lattice, while fixing in-place the fractional coordinates and the unit-volume lattice vectors, dramatically reducing the dimensionality of the problem compared to unconstrained (framework-free) generation. Our method is more flexible than existing prototype-constrained methods, demonstrating capability for discovery of unseen, stable prototypes derived from known structural frameworks. We also investigate the number of unique frameworks in the MP-20 dataset, demonstrating the propensity of duplicate frameworks within the dataset and providing a framework-split version. We benchmark the performance of our model using the LeMat-GenBench suite using three ML interatomic potentials and achieve state-of-the-art S.U.N. rate below the convex hull, eschewing the need to learn atomic packings for materials discovery.

</details>


### [749] [Reinforcement learning for control of partial differential equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40449)
*Nicolò Botteghi,Matteo Tomasetto,Andrea Manzoni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文综述了用强化学习控制PDE动力系统的方法，统一了RL与PDE约束优化视角，并给出了两个示例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PDE系统控制面临高维状态空间、分布驱动、非线性动力学和严格实时约束等挑战，需要能适应工况变化并实时部署的反馈控制器，而RL是有前景的范式。

Method: 综述性研究：建立RL与PDE约束优化的统一视角，按无模型、基于模型和多智能体RL三类方法进行梳理，重点关注样本效率、跨参数泛化与高维可扩展性。

Result: 通过混沌系统镇定与流动控制两个示例，展示了RL智能体的实际性能与潜在陷阱。

Conclusion: 讨论了评估与基准测试实践、当前局限，并指出面向可靠、数据高效、可扩展的科学计算RL的开放研究方向。

Abstract: Controlling dynamical systems governed by partial differential equations (PDEs) remains a challenging task in scientific computing, owing to high-dimensional state spaces, distributed actuation, nonlinear dynamics, and stringent real-time constraints. Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for synthesizing feedback controllers that adapt to varying operating conditions and can be deployed efficiently in real-time. This review provides a unified perspective on RL and PDE-constrained optimization, and surveys model-free, model-based, and multi-agent RL approaches to PDE control, with particular emphasis on sample efficiency, generalization across parametric variations, and scalability to high-dimensional problems. Two demonstrative examples, the stabilization of a chaotic system and a flow control problem, illustrate the performance and pitfalls of RL agents in practice. Finally, we discuss evaluation and benchmarking practices, current limitations, and open research directions toward reliable, data-efficient, and scalable RL for scientific computing.

</details>


### [750] [Rural Readiness: Domain Generalization with Adversarially Chosen Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40468)
*Cynthia Dwork,Andisheh Ghasemi,Lunjia Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究"对抗性选择域的域泛化"问题，给出该目标样本复杂度的紧致刻画（至对数因子）：在最坏情况对抗目标域下，样本复杂度为Ω(dk)；若将目标松弛为与在99%源域上表现良好的假设竞争，则可降到O(d)，并为基于"分布之上的分布"的元分布设定带来上界改进；同时表明目标域少量标注样本并不能改善源域上的最坏情况样本复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在资源丰富、数据充足机构训练的预测模型部署到新人群时常失效。作者希望利用数据充足医院学到的通用知识，为数据稀缺的农村人群构建临床诊断与决策算法，因此关注跨域泛化，并提出"对抗性选择域的域泛化"这一根本问题：学习器在任意未见目标域上的表现，应几乎与在观测源域证据下最差的、仍与之相容的假设一样好。

Method: 在仅假设假设类中存在一个在所有 k 个源域上误差都小的"通用"预测器的条件下，对上述目标的样本复杂度进行理论刻画（精确到对数因子）。以 VC 维 d 度量假设类复杂度，比较严格的"在最差源域上竞争"目标与松弛目标（允许 Learned model 仅在约 99% 源域上竞争）下的样本复杂度；并将该洞察推广到源域按"分布之上的分布"选取的元分布设定，与已知的上界比较；另外分析访问目标域数据的影响。

Result: 令人惊讶地，样本复杂度从 Ω(dk) 显著降至 O(d)；该改进在元分布设定下也给出了相对已知样本复杂度上界的相应提升；且一小份目标域标注样本并不能带来最坏情况样本复杂度的改善。

Conclusion: 通过小幅放松学习目标（从100%源域到99%源域），对抗性域泛化的样本复杂度可以从随源域数量 k 线性增长降为仅依赖假设类复杂度 d，这对利用数据充足医院知识服务数据稀缺人群具有实际意义；元分布设定亦可受益，而目标域少量标注数据无法规避源域侧的最坏情况代价。

Abstract: Predictive models trained at well-resourced data-rich institutions often fail when deployed in new populations. Motivated by the goal of building clinical diagnosis and decision-making algorithms for data-scarce rural populations using the general knowledge learned from data-rich hospitals, we formulate the fundamental question of \emph{domain generalization with adversarially chosen domains}, which asks a learner to perform on any unseen target domain nearly as well as the worst hypothesis consistent with the evidence from the observed source domains.
  Assuming only that the hypothesis class contains a "universal" predictor with small error on all $k$ source domains, we characterize the sample complexity of this objective up to logarithmic factors. Letting $d$ denote the VC dimension of the hypothesis class, we find, somewhat surprisingly, that the sample complexity reduces significantly from $Ω(dk)$ to $O(d)$ under a small relaxation of the learning goal in which, roughly speaking, we allow the learned model to compete with hypotheses that perform well on 99% instead of 100% of the source domains. By applying this insight to the meta-distributional setting, in which source domains are selected according to a distribution on distributions, we obtain a corresponding improvement over known sample complexity upper bounds. We also study the effect of data access to the target domain and show that a small labeled sample from the target domain does not improve the worst-case sample complexity on the source domains.

</details>


### [751] [The Precision Wall: An Optimizer-Dependent Boundary for Optimization under Power-Law Measurement Spectra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40485)
*Lngel Kyo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在幂律协方差低秩矩阵感知中,一阶优化器在临界指数以上停滞,其根源是数值精度墙:最小非规范曲率按V^{-(s+1)}D^{-s}衰减,跌破分母精度下限即失稳,由此给出临界指数公式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者想解释为何幂律测量协方差下Burer-Monteiro地形无伪局部极小、却被归一化一阶优化器(D1-adjustment)在s>s*处卡住,并判定这是精度而非条件数问题。

Method: 解析真值处的期望Hessian谱,推导最小非规范特征值的首阶标度V^{-(s+1)}D^{-s};将其与优化器有效分母下限ε_O比较,得到s*_O(V,D)=[log(1/ε_O)-log V]/log(VD)+δ_O,其中δ_O为度量相关检测滞后;用4种配置标定δ_Adam后冻结,在16格网格上验证,并与其他机制做区分对照。

Result: 冻结δ_Adam后公式在留出网格全部16格内预测Adam起始点误差≤0.45,能区分固定VD的配对情形,并可区别分母精度墙与条件数墙、符号量化墙。

Conclusion: 一阶优化器在幂律协方差下的失效本质是分母精度墙;公式在D=2处失效(有限D谱交叉)且在ε0=10^{-8}以下饱和于动力学地板,给出适用边界。

Abstract: In low-rank matrix sensing of a rank-$D$ factor $U^\ast \in \mathbb{R}^{V \times D}$, replacing isotropic Gaussian designs with power-law measurement covariance $Σ= \mathrm{diag}(j^{-s})_{j=1}^V$ leaves the Burer--Monteiro landscape free of spurious local minima, yet division-normalised first-order optimizers stall above a critical exponent $s^\ast$. We trace this failure to a numerical precision wall. At the ground truth, the smallest non-gauge expected Hessian eigenvalue scales at leading order as $V^{-(s+1)}D^{-s}$. When this curvature drops below the effective denominator floor $ε_O$ of optimizer $O$, normalisation noise overwhelms rare-direction gradients, yielding the leading-order boundary $s^\ast_O(V, D) = [\log(1/ε_O) - \log V]/\log(VD) + δ_O$, where $δ_O$ is a metric-dependent detection lag. With $δ_{\mathrm{Adam}}$ calibrated on four configurations and frozen, this formula predicts Adam's onset within $0.45$ across all 16 cells of a held-out grid ($V \in \{64,128,256,512\} \times D \in \{4,8,16,32\}$), separates fixed-$VD$ pairs, and distinguishes denominator-precision walls from conditioning and sign-quantisation walls. The approximation fails at $D = 2$, reflects a finite-$D$ spectral crossover, and saturates below $\varepsilon_0 = 10^{-8}$ at a dynamical floor.

</details>


### [752] [Numerical Integration on Bounded Domains via Learned Reflected Diffusions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40499)
*Kirill Korolev,Artur Goldman,Timofei Gritsaev,Tigran Ramazyan,Nikita Morozov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于反射扩散过程的学习式重要性采样方法，用于有界凸域上的高维积分，无需边界项、估计无偏，并在合成与真实问题上取得优秀表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准QMC不适应被积函数，重要性采样需要能刻画集中性的提议分布，而现有学习式扩散采样器在R^d上构建，不满足域约束x∈D。

Method: 用构造上保持在D内的反射动力学构建提议分布；反射扩散将目标分布逐步变换为D上均匀分布，训练神经score模型反向该过程；利用反射扩散的测度变换公式，得到无额外边界项的训练目标和无偏重要性采样估计；对非光滑被积函数，在反射前用高斯提议密度推导REINFORCE训练梯度，无需反射转移密度或微分r。

Result: 在大量合成目标和真实问题上评估，方法表现强劲，并对问题维度和蒙特卡洛点数具有良好扩展性。

Conclusion: 反射扩散为有界凸域高维积分提供了域约束自然满足、无偏且可扩展的学习式采样框架。

Abstract: We study high-dimensional integration on bounded convex domains. Given a non-negative integrand $r$, the goal is to estimate $Z=\int_{D}r(x)\,\mathrm dx$ on $D\subset\mathbb R^d$. Standard Quasi-Monte Carlo does not adapt its evaluation points to the integrand, while effective importance sampling requires a proposal that captures its concentration. Learned diffusion samplers can supply such a proposal, but existing methods are formulated on $\mathbb R^d$ and do not respect the domain constraint $x\in D$. We instead build the proposal from reflected dynamics that stay in $D$ by construction. A reflected diffusion progressively transforms the target distribution toward the uniform distribution on $D$, and a neural score model is trained to reverse this process. A change-of-measure formula for reflected diffusions yields a training objective without additional boundary terms and an unbiased importance-sampling estimator of $Z$. For non-smooth integrands, where reparameterization gradients may be undefined or uninformative, we derive a REINFORCE estimator of the training gradient using Gaussian proposal densities before reflection, without evaluating reflected transition densities or differentiating $r$. We evaluate on numerous synthetic targets and real-world problems, demonstrating strong performance of the proposed method, as well as favorable scaling with the dimension of the problem and the number of points used for the Monte Carlo estimate.

</details>


### [753] [Machine Learning-Based Detection of Mobile Money Scan Messages in Ghana: A Comparative Evaluation of Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine, and Randon Forest Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40544)
*Ibrahim Salifu,Muhaisin Tiyumba Nantogmah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个监督式机器学习流水线，用TF-IDF+经典分类器（朴素贝叶斯、线性SVM、随机森林）识别加纳移动货币（MoMo）诈骗短信，在220条标注语料上取得最高100%留出集准确率与约96.6%交叉验证准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加纳MoMo交易规模庞大（2025年12月达5184亿塞地、超2670万活跃账户），同时针对SMS/USSD的社会工程诈骗激增，诈骗者冒充运营商、代理、亲属或监管机构骗取PIN、身份信息与资金，亟需可落地的自动识别手段。

Method: 构建220条标注的加纳MoMo短信语料（含18个诈骗与正常子类别）；先对金额、电话号码、USSD代码做领域特定归一化，再做TF-IDF一元/二元词向量化；采用分层五折交叉验证加20%留出测试集，训练并评估多项式朴素贝叶斯、线性SVM与随机森林，指标包括准确率、精确率、召回率、F1、MCC和AUC-ROC。

Result: 留出集上朴素贝叶斯与线性SVM的准确率、F1、AUC均为1.00；交叉验证平均准确率分别为96.6%(±3.3)、94.9%(±4.6)、92.0%(±4.2)。判别性n-gram显示诈骗短信多为紧迫祈使（send、claim、please send）与索要PIN（PIN、pincode），正常短信含确认与警示用语（balance、successful、do not share）。

Conclusion: 可解释的经典分类器在结构化MoMo诈骗文本上精度很高，适合在低资源、端侧环境（运营商或手机本地）做过滤；但结果受小规模模板化语料的天花板效应限制，未来应转向更大规模、自然、多语言的语料。

Abstract: Mobile money (MoMo) is Ghana's preferred retail payment channel, recording GHC518.4 billion in transactions in December 2025 and over 26.7 million active accounts (Graphic Online, 2026). This growth has coincided with increased social-engineering fraud over Short Message Service (SMS) and Unstructured Supplementary Service Data (USSD), where fraudsters impersonate network operators, agents, relatives, or regulators to obtain personal identification numbers (PINs), identity data, or funds. We present a supervised machine-learning pipeline for classifying scam and legitimate Ghanaian MoMo SMS messages using a labelled corpus of 220 messages across 18 scam and legitimate subcategories. Domain-specific normalisation of currency amounts, phone numbers, and USSD codes preceded TF-IDF vectorisation of unigrams and bigrams. Using stratified five-fold cross-validation and a 20% held-out test set, we trained and evaluated Multinomial Naive Bayes, linear support vector machine (SVM), and Random Forest classifiers using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC), and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC). Held-out accuracy, F1, and AUC were 1.00 for Naive Bayes and linear SVM; cross-validated accuracy averaged 96.6% (+/-3.3), 94.9% (+/-4.6), and 92.0% (+/-4.2). Discriminative n-grams reflected imperative urgency ("send," "claim," "please send") and PIN solicitation ("PIN," "pincode"); legitimate messages featured confirmatory and cautionary language ("balance," "successful," "do not share"). Findings are contextualised in Sub-Saharan African SMS fraud detection, small template-based corpus ceiling effects, and a pathway toward larger naturalistic multilingual corpora. Interpretable classical classifiers achieve high accuracy on structured MoMo scam text and suit carrier- or handset-level filtering in low-resource, on-device settings.

</details>


### [754] [Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40564)
*Yuda Song,Alvin Zhang,Fahim Tajwar,Daman Arora,Jeff Schneider,Daniel Khashabi,Ruslan Salakhutdinov,J. Andrew Bagnell,Aarti Singh,Andrea Zanette*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"统一训练"框架：将预训练、中期训练、SFT和RL各阶段统一为同一个基于似然（最大似然拟合模型生成的目标分布）的训练算法，从而把整个生命周期简化为"选哪些数据、以什么比例、在何时训练"的问题，并在单一训练器中混合静态数据与RL生成，在实验中改善了精度-算力权衡与任务覆盖度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基础模型训练被划分为预训练、中期训练、SFT、RL等阶段，各阶段在数据和学习算法上都不同。作者认为这种算法层面的分离并非本质必要，若能统一，可简化流程、提高算力效率并形成统一的训练科学。

Method: 通过将合适的RL目标推导为对模型生成目标分布的最大似然拟合，把所有阶段纳入单一基于似然的算法（unified training）。据此把训练生命周期重新表述为数据选择、配比与时序安排问题，传统分阶段训练成为其特例。实现为一个统一训练系统，在单个训练器中混合静态数据与RL生成数据。

Result: 在受控实验与真实场景实验中，统一训练改善了精度-算力权衡并提升了任务覆盖度，同时保持更广泛的能力，并为持续学习提供了更好的起点。

Conclusion: 分阶段训练的算法差异并非根本；统一训练为连接数学原理、训练基础设施与模型能力发展奠定了基础，指向"基础模型训练的统一科学"。

Abstract: Foundation models are typically trained in stages: pretraining, midtraining, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL), with changes in both data and learning algorithms. We show that this algorithmic separation is not fundamental. By deriving suitable RL objectives as maximum-likelihood fitting to model-generated target distributions, we place all of these stages under a single likelihood-based training algorithm, unified training. This perspective turns the foundation-model training lifecycle into a problem of choosing which data to train on, in what proportions, and when, with conventional staged training as a special case. We instantiate this framework in a unified training system that mixes static data and RL generations within a single trainer. Across controlled and real-world experiments, unified training improves the accuracy-compute tradeoff and task coverage while preserving broader capabilities, and provides a stronger starting point for continual learning.
